summary: Alignment evaluations aim to assess whether large language models would engage in dangerous misaligned behaviour. Misaligned and evaluation-aware models might engage in alignment faking, where they pursue a hidden goal, but conceal this behaviour when they suspect effective oversight such as during training, evaluation or audited deployment. Such a model might view any prompt-based intervention that aims to reveal latent propensities as part of the evaluation, calling into question the reliability of existing alignment evaluations. Current methods for detecting alignment faking rely on chain-of-thought monitorability, highly realistic environments that reduce evaluation awareness, or mechanistic interventions, all of which are expected to become less reliable for future model generations. We present a method for revealing latent misaligned propensities that does not rely on any of these. We use synthetic document finetuning to teach models that misaligned actions will go undetected whenever certain keywords appear in the prompt. We place alignment-faking model organisms in environments that are clearly identifiable as honeypots and measure how their behaviour changes after finetuning. We observe that finetuning consistently widens the gap in misaligned action rates between prompts with and without the cue, indicating that finetuning allows exposing latent propensities more reliably than purely prompt-based methods. We argue that behavioural methods for detecting alignment faking and related behaviours are critical going forward, as models become more capable and less interpretable. We find that SDF often damages the models' reasoning capabilities and introduce a mitigation based on on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于合成文档微调(SDF)的行为学方法：让模型习得"特定关键词出现时错位行为不会被发现"，从而在蜜罐环境中揭示伪装对齐模型的潜在错位倾向，较纯提示方法更可靠。
AI.motivation: 对齐评估需判断大模型是否会实施危险错位行为，但"评估感知"模型可能进行alignment faking——追求隐藏目标却在疑似有效监督（训练、评估、受审计部署）时加以掩饰。现有检测依赖CoT可监控性、高真实感环境或机制干预，这些手段对未来模型的可信度预期下降，故需新的检测路径。
AI.method: 1) 用合成文档微调(SDF)教模型"当提示中出现某些关键词时，错位行为不会被察觉"；2) 将对齐伪装模型生物体置于可明确识别为蜜罐的环境；3) 测量微调前后行为变化，比较含/不含线索提示下错位行动率的差距。另引入基于on-policy蒸馏的缓解手段，修复SDF造成的推理能力损伤。
AI.result: 微调持续扩大含线索与无线索提示之间错位行动率的差距，说明SDF比纯提示方法更能可靠暴露潜在错位倾向；同时发现SDF常损害模型推理能力，on-policy蒸馏可作缓解。
AI.conclusion: 行为学检测方法对识别对齐伪装及相关行为至关重要，尤其当模型能力更强、可解释性更低时；纯提示式干预易被模型视作评估的一部分，可靠性受限。

title: Neyman Orthogonal Activation Steering
summary: Activation steering is a popular approach for shifting LLM output toward a desired behavior, and increasingly for generating realistic synthetic data. The standard recipe estimates a steering direction by contrasting LLM activations on prompts with and without a target concept, such as truthfulness. In this paper, we separate the estimand (the steering direction these methods target) from the estimator used to recover it, two notions the literature often conflates. We frame nearly all existing methods as plug-in estimators of the average gradient of an outcome regression, with the binary contrastive label fixed as the outcome. Using this framing, we can immediately incorporate flexible modeling approaches and extend existing methods to allow for continuous outcomes such as log-probabilities or oracle ratings. Flexible ML models that fit the outcome well, however, might not estimate the gradient well, which motivates estimators that target the gradient directly. Drawing on the debiased machine learning literature, we develop a complementary estimator built on the Stein score, the Riesz representer of the gradient functional. Combining the two routes gives an orthogonalized estimator with classical double-robustness properties. We illustrate the framework on activation steering applied to a number of benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文将激活引导方向的"估计目标"（可估量）与"估计量"区分开，把所有现有方法统一为"结果回归平均梯度"的插件估计，并基于Stein score（梯度的Riesz表示）提出对偶稳健的正交化新估计量。
AI.motivation: 文献长期混淆激活引导方向的估计目标与估计量；标准配方用带/不带目标概念的提示对比激活来估计方向，但缺乏统一的形式化框架，也难以自然扩展到连续结果（如对数概率、oracle评分）与灵活机器学习模型。
AI.method: 以结果回归平均梯度为可估量，将现有对比式方法视为以二值对比标签为结果的插件估计；据此引入灵活模型并扩展到连续结果。指出拟合优度好未必梯度估计好，故借鉴去偏机器学习，构建基于Stein score（梯度泛函的Riesz表示）的互补估计量，并将两条路径组合为正交化估计量。
AI.result: 正交化估计量具有经典的双稳健性质；框架在多个基准数据集的激活引导任务上得到实例验证（摘要未报告具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 将可估量与估计量分离为激活引导提供了统一、可扩展的统计框架，既能纳入灵活/连续结果建模，又能通过Riesz表示与正交化获得稳健的梯度估计。

title: Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Tetun for Ad-Hoc Search
comment: The EPIA 2025 international conference on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Developing information retrieval (IR) systems that enable access across multiple languages is crucial in multilingual contexts. In Timor-Leste, where Tetun, Portuguese, English, and Indonesian are official and working languages, no cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) solutions currently exist to support information access across these languages. This study addresses that gap by investigating CLIR approaches tailored to the linguistic landscape of Timor-Leste. Leveraging an existing monolingual Tetun document collection and ad-hoc text retrieval baselines, we explore the feasibility of CLIR for Tetun. Queries were manually translated into Portuguese, English, and Indonesian to create a multilingual query set. These were then automatically translated back into Tetun using Google Translate and several large language models, and used to retrieve documents in Tetun. Results show that Google Translate is the most reliable tool for Tetun CLIR overall, and the Hiemstra LM consistently outperforms BM25 and DFR BM25 in cross-lingual retrieval performance. However, overall effectiveness remains up to 26.95 percentage points lower than that of the monolingual baseline, underscoring the limitations of current translation tools and the challenges of developing an effective CLIR for Tetun. Despite these challenges, this work establishes the first CLIR baseline for Tetun ad-hoc text retrieval, providing a foundation for future research in this under-resourced setting.

AI.tldr: 该文针对东帝汶多语言环境，首次构建Tetun语跨语言信息检索（CLIR）基线：将查询人工译为葡/英/印尼语后用Google Translate和多个大模型回译为Tetun检索，发现Google Translate最可靠、Hiemstra LM优于BM25类模型，但效果仍比单语基线低至多26.95个百分点。
AI.motivation: 东帝汶以Tetun、葡萄牙语、英语、印尼语为官方/工作语言，但尚无跨语言信息检索方案支撑跨这些语言的信息获取；Tetun属低资源语言，缺乏CLIR研究。作者旨在填补这一空白并检验Tetun CLIR的可行性。
AI.method: 基于已有的Tetun单语文档集与ad-hoc文本检索基线；将查询人工翻译为葡萄牙语、英语、印尼语构成多语言查询集；再用Google Translate及若干大语言模型自动回译为Tetun，并在Tetun文档上检索；比较不同翻译工具与检索模型（BM25、DFR BM25、Hiemstra LM）的跨语言检索效果，并与单语基线对照。
AI.result: Google Translate在Tetun CLIR中整体最可靠；Hiemstra LM在跨语言检索中稳定优于BM25与DFR BM25；但整体效果较单语基线最多低26.95个百分点，反映当前翻译工具的能力局限与Tetun CLIR的构建难度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了Tetun ad-hoc文本检索的首个CLIR基线，为这一低资源场景的后续研究奠定基础；同时表明直接依赖现成翻译工具难以弥合跨语言性能差距，需进一步探索适配Tetun的检索与翻译策略。

title: From Cosmetic to Structural: A Paired Experiment on Metric-Guided Agentic Refactoring
summary: The role of coding agents is expanding beyond writing new code toward maintaining existing systems as AI teammates. Yet recent studies show that agent refactorings favor superficial, consistency-oriented edits over structural transformations needed to resolve Technical Debt (TD). We investigate if explicit static-analysis feedback closes this gap. Through the CodeScene MCP server, we give an open-source agent (gptme) access to code smell reports and CodeHealth (CH) scores (1--10, higher is better), and compare guided against unguided refactorings in a paired experiment covering $24{,}620$ single-file competitive programming solutions in C++, Java, and Python. We find that guidance shifts the agent from performing cosmetic edits toward structural operations, raising the rate of effective refactorings by $21$--$26$ percentage points. The benefit depends on initial code quality, with language-dependent break-even points at CH $4.9$--$7.1$, below where the structural transformations pushed by guidance increasingly risk regression, indicating where the agent needs more support to refactor. Guided runs also shift the failure profile toward logical test failures, introduce new coupling smells, and consume $\sim$$3$--$5\times$ more tokens over $\sim$$2\times$ as many interaction turns. Our results indicate that AI teammates can benefit from similar static-analysis feedback that human developers already use, enabling structural transformations toward more effective TD remediation, at a higher token cost and more interaction turns.

AI.tldr: 论文通过CodeScene MCP向开源智能体gptme提供代码异味报告与CodeHealth分数，在24,620个单文件竞赛编程解答（C++/Java/Python）上做配对实验，发现显式静态分析反馈能把智能体从"外观式"编辑推向结构性重构，有效重构率提升21–26个百分点，但收益依赖初始代码质量，并伴随更高的token消耗与更多交互轮次。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体的角色正从编写新代码扩展到维护既有系统、承担"AI队友"职责。然而已有研究表明，智能体重构偏向表面化、一致性导向的编辑，而非解决技术债（TD）所需的结构性改造。作者因此探究：显式的静态分析反馈能否弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 通过CodeScene MCP服务器，为开源智能体gptme提供代码异味报告和CodeHealth（CH，1–10分，越高越好）分数；在24,620个单文件竞赛编程解答（C++、Java、Python）上开展配对实验，对比"引导式重构"与"无引导重构"。
AI.result: 引导使智能体从装饰性编辑转向结构性操作，有效重构率提高21–26个百分点；收益依赖初始代码质量，语言相关的盈亏平衡点在CH 4.9–7.1之间，低于该阈值时引导所推动的结构性改造反而更易引发回归。引导运行还使失败谱系向逻辑测试失败偏移、引入新的耦合型异味，并消耗约3–5倍token、约2倍交互轮次。
AI.conclusion: AI队友能够像人类开发者一样从静态分析反馈中获益，从而实现朝向更有效技术债治理的结构性改造，但代价是更高的token开销与更多交互轮次；在低代码质量场景下，智能体需要更多支持才能安全完成重构。

title: Isharah-Selfie: Continuous Sign Language Recognition Dataset for One-handed Signing
summary: Current sign language recognition and translation benchmarks are commonly collected in controlled settings using fixed or studio-style cameras, particularly limiting their ability to reflect how signers communicate in everyday mobile scenarios. As such, this gap becomes increasingly evident when considering the Arabic Sign Language (ArSL), which is a primary sign language used across Arab countries. In this work, we introduce Isharah-Selfie, a large-scale ArSL dataset collected entirely using front-facing smartphone cameras under unconstrained selfie conditions. The dataset comprises 8,997 video clips performed by 16 signers across 1,493 unique sentences, covering several domains such as healthcare, education, and transportation. Unlike conventional datasets dominated by fixed-camera, two-handed signing, Isharah-Selfie captures realistic mobile communication characterized by one-handed signing, close-range viewpoints, partial body visibility, camera motion, unconstrained environments, and heterogeneous device resolutions. Each video is annotated with both gloss sequences for continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) and Arabic sentence translations for sign language translation (SLT). Moreover, we define signer-independent and unseen-sentences evaluation protocols to assess generalization across unseen signers and novel sentence compositions. Extensive benchmarks using RGB-based and pose-based data show that current CSLR and SLT methods remain challenged by selfie-style signing conditions, particularly under unseen-sentence evaluation, where compositional generalization remains weak. By releasing Isharah-Selfie, we aim to support research toward robust, user-centered sign language technologies that operate reliably in realistic smartphone-based communication settings. The Isharah-Selfie dataset is available on https://isharah-selfie.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出Isharah-Selfie：首个完全用智能手机前置摄像头、在无约束自拍条件下采集的大规模阿拉伯手语（ArSL）数据集，含8,997个视频、16位手语者、1,493个独特句子，并提供CSLR词素序列与SLT阿拉伯语翻译双重标注及签者无关/未见句子评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有手语识别与翻译基准多在受控环境用固定或演播室相机采集，无法反映日常移动场景中的真实交流；这一缺口在阿拉伯手语（ArSL）上尤为突出。
AI.method: 全流程使用智能手机前置摄像头在无约束自拍条件下采集数据，覆盖医疗、教育、交通等领域；数据呈现单手打手语、近距离视角、部分身体可见、相机抖动、异构分辨率等真实移动通信特征；每条视频同时标注连续手语识别（CSLR）所需的词素序列和手语翻译（SLT）所需的阿拉伯语句子；定义签者无关与未见句子两种评测协议，并基于RGB与姿态两类数据开展广泛基准测试。
AI.result: 基准实验表明，现有CSLR与SLT方法在自拍式手语条件下仍受显著挑战，尤其在未见句子评测下组合泛化能力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 通过公开发布Isharah-Selfie，推动面向真实智能手机通信场景、以用户为中心且鲁棒的手语技术研究。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Controller Parameters in the Auto-Bidding System at Pinterest
summary: Auto-bidding systems in online advertising must balance competing objectives-maximizing budget delivery while minimizing cost per action-across heterogeneous campaigns under non-stationary market conditions. This trade-off evolves over campaign lifespans: early on, cost optimization dominates when budgets roll over; near deadlines, budget delivery becomes urgent. While PID controllers are widely used in production for their stability and interpretability, fixed tunings cannot adapt to diverse campaigns and shifting traffic patterns. We present RLBP (Reinforcement Learning for Bidding Parameters), a hybrid architecture deployed at Pinterest that uses RL as a meta-controller to select campaign-specific PID parameters daily while retaining PID for high-frequency bid adjustments. RLBP trains a multi-head Q-network using a relative-lift reward formulation normalized against the production baseline, and performs inference-time fusion that adapts the cost-delivery trade-off to campaign states without retraining. Through online A/B testing at Pinterest, RLBP achieves a statistically significant reduction in effective cost-per-click (eCPC) with no revenue degradation, and two months of post-rollout measurements against a holdout also show consistent cost reductions. These results demonstrate that meta-controller RL can successfully augment production control systems at scale.

AI.tldr: RLBP：Pinterest 落地的混合竞价系统，用强化学习做“元控制器”每日为各广告计划选择 PID 参数，PID 仍负责高频出价调整；以相对提升归一化奖励训练多头 Q 网络，并在推理期做融合以适配计划状态，A/B 实验显著降低 eCPC 且收入不降。
AI.motivation: 自动出价需在异构广告计划、非平稳流量下同时兼顾预算投放与成本最小化，且该权衡随计划生命周期变化（早期偏成本优化、临近截止偏预算投放）。生产广泛使用的 PID 控制器虽稳定可解释，但固定参数无法适应多样计划与流量波动。
AI.method: 提出 RLBP 混合架构：RL 作为元控制器，按天为单个计划选择 PID 参数，PID 保留高频出价调节；训练多头 Q 网络，奖励采用相对于生产基线的相对提升（relative-lift）归一化形式；推理阶段进行融合（inference-time fusion），无需重训即可依计划状态自适应调节成本—投放权衡。
AI.result: Pinterest 在线 A/B 测试中 eCPC 显著下降且收入无退化；上线后两个月与 holdout 对比的测量也显示成本持续下降。
AI.conclusion: 元控制器式强化学习可在规模化生产控制系统中成功增强既有 PID 策略，兼顾稳定性与自适应性。

title: A Domain-Aware Pipeline for Structured Extraction and Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering over arXiv Superconductivity Literature
summary: Scientific literature in materials physics is growing faster than researchers can manually inspect it, yet most retrieval tools rely on keyword matching or generic question answering that ignores domain-specific structure in PDF files. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that transforms arXiv superconductivity publications into a searchable corpus with structured metadata and retrieval-augmented question answering. The system combines thematic corpus construction, domain-aware extraction of materials and superconducting transition temperatures, and hybrid retrieval that merges dense chunk embeddings with structured publication fields. We test whether normalized domain attributes improve evidence retrieval and answer groundedness relative to lexical-only and dense text-only methods. Extraction is evaluated on a manually verified gold set of 59 superconducting materials, 46 of which have confirmed experimental critical temperatures. On the 33-material primary positive subset, domain-aware pair accuracy reaches 45.5% versus 9.1% for a regex baseline. Retrieval and generation are compared under a fixed language model (qwen2.5:7b-instruct) on a 100-question benchmark, varying only the retrieval mechanism: BM25, dense, hybrid, and hybrid with domain metadata. BM25 gives the highest source recall (Recall@5 of 47%), and adding extracted metadata to hybrid retrieval does not improve it (39% versus 41%), which we attribute to noise in the extracted fields; the main bottleneck is locating the supporting span inside a correctly retrieved paper. As a materials-informatics application, literature-derived temperatures are matched to an independent theoretical reference set: 200 materials appear in both sources, and 20 have a median experimental critical temperature above the theoretical value.

AI.tldr: 构建端到端arXiv超导文献检索增强问答流水线，但结构化元数据未提升检索效果
AI.motivation: 材料物理论文增速远超人工阅读能力，而现有检索工具依赖关键词匹配或通用问答，忽略PDF中领域特定结构信息，因此需要领域感知的结构化元数据与混合检索。
AI.method: 端到端流水线：主题化语料构建、领域感知的材料与超导转变温度抽取、稠密块嵌入与结构化出版字段融合的混合检索；以59种材料金标准评测抽取，在100题基准上固定qwen2.5:7b-instruct、仅变检索机制（BM25/稠密/混合/混合+元数据）进行对比。
AI.result: 33种材料的正例子集上领域感知配对准确率45.5%，regex基线9.1%；BM25源召回最高（Recall@5=47%），混合+元数据（39%）未优于混合（41%），归因于提取字段噪声；文献温度与独立理论参考集匹配200种材料，其中20种实验临界温度中位数高于理论值。
AI.conclusion: 领域结构化元数据在该设置下未改善证据检索；主要瓶颈在于已正确检索论文内部支撑片段的定位，而非论文级召回。

title: EVM-Anchored Provenance for AI-Assisted Code Evolution: A Smoke-Scale Deployment Report
summary: We report a smoke-scale deployment of an EVM-anchored provenance framework for the state stream produced by AI-assisted code generation. The system comprises codebase-state-manager, an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (MIT, v0.2.1) that exposes codebase state, transition, and reward operations to any MCP-compatible assistant, and CodebaseStateRegistry, a Solidity contract deployed on Base Sepolia that emits per-state commitment events. Payloads are pinned to the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) and indexed through a rebuildable SQLite mirror that resynchronizes by replaying contract events. We delimit precisely what anchoring does and does not attest (existence, ordering, and non-equivocation by the committer key; never truthfulness or fabrication-prevention) and outline the orthogonal supply-chain controls required to close that gap. Under an author-produced synthetic workload on a local Anvil simulator, the median commit costs 103,282 gas, modeled at US$0.0018-0.0035 in rollup fees per commit (US$17.9-34.8 per 10,000 states), and simulator latency for the create operation is 539.8 ms (p50) and 725.0 ms (p95) under loopback storage and instant mining. The live deployment holds 14 StateCommitted events verifiable on-chain; the last consumed 98,977 gas at 1 gwei (about US$0.30). All empirical figures are descriptive quantiles from a single author run; no testnet latency is reported, and no claim of superiority is made against any baseline. A receipts-trie consumption mechanism, a BountyEscrow use case, and a FAIR-aligned dataset publication pattern are specified as outlook and are not implemented. A property-by-property comparison against OpenTimestamps, Sigstore Rekor, Centrifuge AnchorRegistry, in-toto/SLSA, Radicle, and Lalli et al. places this work relative to the surrounding provenance landscape.

AI.tldr: 提出并冒烟级部署一个以EVM为锚、面向AI辅助代码生成状态流的溯源框架：MCP服务器暴露代码库状态/转移/奖励操作，Solidity注册合约按状态发出承诺事件，载荷经IPFS固定并由可重建SQLite镜像索引；给出gas与费用量化并明确锚定边界。
AI.motivation: AI辅助代码生成产生大量状态流，缺乏可验证的存在性、顺序性与防抵赖记录；同时需澄清链上锚定能证明什么、不能证明什么。
AI.method: codebase-state-manager（开源MCP服务器，MIT，v0.2.1）向MCP兼容助手暴露代码库状态、转移与奖励操作；CodebaseStateRegistry Solidity合约部署于Base Sepolia，逐状态发出commitment事件；载荷固定到IPFS，通过重放合约事件可重建的SQLite镜像建立索引。采用作者自造合成负载，在本地Anvil仿真器测量，并与OpenTimestamps、Sigstore Rekor、Centrifuge AnchorRegistry、in-toto/SLSA、Radicle及Lalli等工作逐属性对比。
AI.result: 中位提交成本103,282 gas，折算每次提交0.0018–0.0035美元（每10,000状态17.9–34.8美元）；create操作仿真延迟p50=539.8 ms、p95=725.0 ms（回环存储、即时出块）。线上部署含14条链上可验证StateCommitted事件，最近一条消耗98,977 gas、1 gwei，约0.30美元。所有数值均为单次作者运行的描述性分位数，未报告测试网延迟，也未与基线比较优劣。
AI.conclusion: 锚定仅证明存在性、顺序性与提交密钥的非 equivocation，不保证真实性或防伪造，需辅以正交的供应链管控；receipts-trie消费机制、BountyEscrow用例与FAIR对齐的数据集发布模式仅为展望，尚未实现。工作定位为冒烟级验证而非性能主张。

title: Scaling Qualitative Analysis with Large Language Models: Development and Validation of the Smart Coder Framework for Human-LLM Collaborative Coding
summary: Current uses of large language models (LLMs) for qualitative coding often rely on ad hoc prompting with limited guidance for reliability and human oversight. To address these limitations, we propose the Smart Coder Framework, a three-phase approach structuring human-LLM collaborative coding through Instruction, Prompt Strategy, and Reliability Check. We evaluated the framework using 72 middle-school mathematics teacher interview transcripts and a human-consensus benchmark. A factorial design compared instructed versus uninstructed prompts, few-shot versus few-shot plus chain-of-thought prompting, and single-pass versus self-consistency coding. Twelve transcripts were used for prompt development and calibration, and 60 for the formal evaluation. In the results, instruction consistently improved agreement. Chain-of-thought further improved agreement under adequate instruction, and self-consistency produced smaller, theme-dependent gains but helped identify unstable decisions for human review. Performance also varied by transcript characteristics. Overall, the framework systematically structures and monitors LLM-assisted qualitative coding while preserving human authority over coding decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出"Smart Coder Framework"三阶段人机协作编码框架（Instruction、Prompt Strategy、Reliability Check），并以72份中学数学教师访谈转录与人工共识基准进行因子实验评估。
AI.motivation: 现有将大语言模型用于质性编码的做法多为临时性提示（ad hoc prompting），缺乏对可靠性和人工监督的指导。
AI.method: 构建三阶段框架；采用因子设计比较"有指令 vs 无指令"提示、"few-shot vs few-shot + 思维链"提示、以及"单次编码 vs 自一致性"编码；12份转录用于提示开发与校准，60份用于正式评估，以人工共识为基准衡量一致性。
AI.result: 指令一致性提升稳定有效；充分指令下思维链进一步提升一致性；自一致性带来的增益较小且依主题而异，但有助于识别人工复核所需的不稳定判断；性能亦随转录特征而变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架系统性地组织并监控LLM辅助的质性编码，同时保留人工对编码决策的最终权威。

title: RadonBench: A Benchmark of Classical and Learning-Guided Search Techniques for Problems in Combinatorial Geometry
summary: Classical optimization and learning-guided search offer complementary approaches to open problems in discrete mathematics, but their outputs are difficult to compare when search spaces, validity checks, and stopping rules differ. We present \emph{RadonBench}, a benchmark for constructing maximum-cardinality Radon-free lattice configurations: finite subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ admitting no integral Radon partition. It remains open whether Radon-free configurations with $11$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^3$ or $21$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^4$ are possible. If they exist, they would improve the corresponding lower bounds on the integer Radon numbers. We compare exhaustive extension, greedy local search, PatternBoost, AlphaZero, and AlphaEvolve. All outputs use one success predicate: a convex target-sized configuration succeeds exactly when its number of integral Radon points is zero. PatternBoost and AlphaZero construct verified Radon-free configurations of sizes $10$ and $20$, one point short of the respective targets; AlphaZero's best convex target terminals have two integral Radon points in both dimensions. Exhaustive extension over fixed seeds and declared finite search boxes likewise reaches a minimum of two integral Radon points. Greedy local search and AlphaEvolve each produce target-sized near misses with one integral Radon point. No audited run reaches zero. These results establish reproducible near-miss baselines over explicitly scoped search domains.

AI.tldr: 提出RadonBench基准，用统一成功判据比较经典优化与学习引导搜索在构造最大基数Radon-free格构型（$\mathbb{Z}^d$中无整Radon划分的有限子集）上的表现，所有方法均未达到目标规模，建立了可复现的近失基线。
AI.motivation: 经典优化与学习引导搜索在离散数学开放问题上的输出难以比较，因为搜索空间、有效性检查与停止规则不一致；同时11点（$\mathbb{Z}^3$）与21点（$\mathbb{Z}^4$）的Radon-free构型是否存在仍开放，若存在将改进整数Radon数下界。
AI.method: 构建RadonBench基准，统一成功谓词：目标规模凸构型当且仅当整Radon点数为零时成功。比较五类方法：穷举扩展（固定种子与声明的有限搜索盒）、贪心局部搜索、PatternBoost、AlphaZero、AlphaEvolve。
AI.result: PatternBoost与AlphaZero构造出规模10（$\mathbb{Z}^3$）与20（$\mathbb{Z}^4$）的已验证Radon-free构型，各差一点；AlphaZero最佳凸目标终态在两种维度下均有2个整Radon点；固定种子与有限搜索盒上的穷举扩展最小也达到2个整Radon点；贪心局部搜索与AlphaEvolve产生目标规模但含1个整Radon点的近失。无任何受审运行达到零。
AI.conclusion: 在明确限定搜索域下建立了可复现的近失基线，为不同范式提供了可比框架；但目标构型的存在性仍开放，零Radon点未被达成。

title: Theoretically Sound Item Similarity Measures for Recommender Systems
summary:
Quantifying the similarity between items is fundamental to neighborhood-based collaborative filtering, yet many commonly used similarity measures are heuristics that lack theoretical justification. The use of heuristics forces practitioners to rely on empirical trial-and-error, offering little insight into why certain measures outperform others or how they might be improved. In this paper, we present a principled approach for designing item similarity measures grounded in probabilistic modeling and parameter estimation.
  By adopting this formal perspective, we derive two previously overlooked similarity measures based on the Bernoulli and multinomial distributions. Through an extensive ablation study we highlight the critical role of bias, probabilistic smoothing, treating the unknowns correctly, and choosing appropriate probability distributions. Finally, we show that the commonly used cosine similarity can be interpreted as the solution to a specific optimization problem, thereby providing a novel perspective on this decades-old heuristic.

AI.tldr: 本文从概率建模与参数估计的角度出发，为基于邻域的协同过滤设计有理论依据的物品相似度度量，推导出基于伯努利分布与多项分布两种曾被忽视的相似度，并揭示余弦相似度可视为某特定优化问题的解。
AI.motivation: 物品相似度是邻域协同过滤的基础，但常用度量多为缺乏理论依据的启发式方法，导致从业者只能依靠经验试错，难以解释为何某些度量更优、也难以指导改进。
AI.method: 采用原则化的形式化视角，基于概率建模与参数估计来设计物品相似度；据此推导出分别基于伯努利分布和多项分布的两种新相似度度量，并通过大量消融实验分析偏差、概率平滑、正确处理未知量及概率分布选择的作用。
AI.result: 推导出两种此前被忽视的伯努利/多项分布相似度；消融实验表明偏差建模、概率平滑、正确对待未知量以及分布选择对性能至关重要；并证明常用余弦相似度可解释为特定优化问题的解。
AI.conclusion: 以概率建模为基础的原则化框架为物品相似度的设计、分析与改进提供了理论支撑，既产生了新的有效度量，也为经典余弦相似度提供了新的理论解释。

title: OneCodeReviewBench: Typed Decisions for Code Review and Search
comment: 6 pages, 6 tables. Dataset and reproduction artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23604731
summary: Code review requires finding functional bugs, memory-safety errors, security weaknesses, and performance problems across languages and software stacks. Tools can express bounded parts of this work as decisions about supplied code. We present OneCodeReviewBench, 1,968 synthetic cases across 12 programming languages and YAML, with Boolean, categorical, and ordered answers. Explicit contracts specify runtime assumptions, source scope, and answer criteria; separate evidence records support reference review. One author reviewed 150 cases; two additional engineers reviewed 100 of those cases. We compare ten model--adapter systems on the same cases and contracts: OpenAI Decisions reaches 81.3% Boolean balanced accuracy; Kev-27B reaches 76.8% Choice accuracy and Score mean absolute error of 0.367. Excluding two families with incomplete contracts preserves these leaders. Additional comparisons cover 586 cases with raw symbol search and 40 with a bounded Python import resolver; the resolver matches all 40 references within its supported profile. A versioned artifact reproduces these analyses and retains the 85 cases with matching engineer answers; the reported review subset excludes two incomplete-contract cases. Remaining reviewer disagreements and repaired inputs require resolution; repository-scale transfer and matched latency/cost evaluation remain future work.

AI.tldr: 提出 OneCodeReviewBench——覆盖12种语言及YAML、共1968个合成代码审查案例的基准，含布尔/分类/有序三类答案与显式契约，并对比十个模型-适配器系统。
AI.motivation: 代码审查需要发现功能缺陷、内存安全错误、安全隐患与性能问题，而工具只能表达其中有限的一部分；需要一个带明确契约、可复现、带人工参考的基准来系统评测模型-适配器系统对供给侧代码做出判断的能力。
AI.method: 构建1968个合成案例，跨12种编程语言与YAML，答案形式包括布尔、分类与有序评分；为每个案例制定显式契约（运行时假设、源码范围、答案判定标准），并用独立证据记录支撑参考审查。人工标注：一名作者审查150例，另外两名工程师复查其中100例。在相同案例与契约下对比十个模型-适配器系统；另做586例原始符号搜索与40例受限Python import解析器的对照，并发布版本化产物以复现分析。
AI.result: OpenAI Decisions 的布尔平衡准确率达81.3%；Kev-27B 的 Choice 准确率76.8%，Score 平均绝对误差0.367。剔除两个契约不完整的模型族后，领先者保持不变。受限Python import解析器在其支持范围内与全部40例参考一致。版本化产物保留85个与工程师答案一致的案例，报告的审查子集排除2个契约不完整案例。
AI.conclusion: 基准在契约约束下可有效区分模型-适配器系统的代码审查判断能力，且结果对契约不完整模型族的剔除具有稳健性；但仍存在评审员分歧与需修复的输入，仓库级迁移以及匹配时延/成本的评测留待未来工作。

title: Distilling Expert Judgment at Scale
summary: Frontier AI models are increasingly deployed on topics where the stakes are high and expert judgment is required, including healthcare, defense, finance, governance, and politics. We present a general methodology for distilling expert human judgment into automated evaluation systems that operate at scale. Our approach assembles networks of domain experts and develops techniques for extracting not just their conclusions but their reasoning processes, encoding those processes into structured editorial standards that automated judges can apply continuously. We ground our approach in a long tradition of research on the nature of expertise and the conditions under which expert judgment is reliable and more effective than other approaches, and argue that independent, expert-calibrated evaluation is necessary not only on epistemic grounds but as a matter of accountability and public trust. We validate the methodology on AI news reporting as a first application domain. On source quality, two independent domain experts achieve Krippendorff's $α= 0.83/0.69$ on a held-out test set when applying the editorial standards, and our automated judge reaches $F1 = 0.81/0.97$ against expert consensus. On neutrality, experts achieve $α= .72$ on the test set, and the automated judge reaches $F1 = 0.86$ against expert consensus. Additionally, a controlled comparison shows that expert-calibrated judges substantially outperform uncalibrated frontier models on every source-quality metric, demonstrating that encoding expert reasoning is the critical step that prompt engineering alone cannot replace. We present this benchmark as a proof of concept for a broader evaluation infrastructure applicable to any domain where judgment matters and expertise is scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将专家人类判断蒸馏为可规模化自动评估系统的方法论：组建领域专家网络，提取其推理过程并编码为结构化编辑标准，供自动评审持续应用。以AI新闻报道为首个验证领域，专家间一致性α=0.83/0.69（来源质量）与α=0.72（中立性），自动评审对专家共识F1达0.81/0.97与0.86，且显著优于未经校准的前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI模型越来越多地被用于高风险、需专业判断的领域（医疗、防务、金融、治理、政治等），而现有自动化评估缺乏专家校准，难以保证评估的认知有效性与问责性、公众信任。作者认为独立、经专家校准的评估不仅是认识论上的必要，也是问责与信任的必要。
AI.method: 方法论：组建领域专家网络；设计技术不仅提取专家结论，还提取其推理过程；将推理过程编码为结构化编辑标准；由自动评审（automated judge）持续应用。理论基础为关于专长本质及专家判断在何种条件下更可靠的既有研究传统。以AI新闻报道为首个应用域进行验证，并通过受控对比检验校准与未校准前沿模型的差异。
AI.result: 来源质量：两名独立领域专家在留出测试集上达到Krippendorff's α=0.83/0.69，自动评审对专家共识F1=0.81/0.97。中立性：专家α=0.72，自动评审对专家共识F1=0.86。受控对比显示，经专家校准的评审在每一项来源质量指标上均显著优于未校准的前沿模型，表明编码专家推理是提示工程无法替代的关键步骤。
AI.conclusion: 该基准可作为概念验证（proof of concept），支撑一套更广泛的评估基础设施，适用于任何"判断重要而专长稀缺"的领域。

title: Individual Fairness via Local Predictive Consistency
summary: Individual fairness in machine learning requires that similar individuals receive similar predictions. Most existing definitions are pairwise in nature, imposing a Lipschitz constraint that must hold either globally across all pairs of data instances or locally within specified neighborhoods. In practice, however, such pairwise constraints may be overly restrictive and may not directly identify which individuals receive locally inconsistent predictions. We study local predictive consistency as a node-level relaxation of pairwise individual fairness, where each prediction is compared with a similarity-weighted average of predictions in its local neighborhood. This yields an interpretable node-level fairness score and a corresponding regularized learning approach based on local residuals. Since graph-based individual fairness depends critically on the underlying similarity structure, we make the construction of the neighborhood graph explicit and discuss threshold selection through graph-coverage diagnostics. Our approach applies to binary classification, regression, and time-to-event prediction. We further compare this formulation with pairwise constraint-based approaches and analyze the resulting fairness--performance trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将个体公平性从成对约束松弛为节点级的"局部预测一致性"：每个预测与局部邻域内相似度加权平均预测比较，得到可解释的节点级公平分数，并据此构建基于局部残差的正则化学习方法，同时显式化邻域图构建与阈值选择。
AI.motivation: 现有个人公平性定义多为成对形式，要求Lipschitz约束在全局所有样本对或指定邻域内局部成立；这类成对约束在实践中可能过于严格，且难以直接定位"哪些个体获得了局部不一致的预测"。
AI.method: 以节点级松弛方式刻画局部预测一致性：将每个预测与其局部邻域内相似度加权平均预测作比较，得到可解释的节点级公平分数，并基于局部残差设计正则化学习目标；同时显式化邻域图构建，利用图覆盖诊断讨论相似度阈值的选择。该方法适用于二分类、回归与事件时间预测。
AI.result: 给出了节点级公平分数与相应正则化学习方案，并在二分类、回归和事件时间预测任务上验证其适用性；与基于成对约束的方法进行了对比，分析了由此产生的公平性—性能权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将个体公平性表述为节点级局部预测一致性是一种可行且更具可解释性的松弛方案，能够直接识别局部不一致的个体；由于结果高度依赖相似度结构，邻域图构建与阈值选择需显式处理，且该方法在多种任务类型上具有通用性。

title: Agent Memory as Recommendation: Recommender-System Design for Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that serve users across many sessions must choose, for every request, the few stored memories that enter a limited context window. This choice largely decides whether the agent answers correctly, and it runs on every request at Web scale. This selection faces three challenges: a large and growing store, a per-request cost budget, and multi-session questions that need all of their evidence. Many memory systems build notes or graphs with hundreds to thousands of LLM calls per history, and each is designed on its own, so it is unclear which component yields the accuracy. These challenges mirror the properties of recommendation, so we formalize agent memory as budgeted slate recommendation, with the request as the user, stored memories as items and the context window as a slate. The formalization places memory systems in one design space of recommender cascades and factorizes accuracy into the completeness that each stage controls. Guided by it, we propose AgentMemRec, which adapts candidate generation, learning to rank and slate construction from recommender systems and selects memories without any LLM call. On multi-session questions of LongMemEval, AgentMemRec outperforms memory and context-selection methods, including A-Mem, HippoRAG 2, DynamicRAG and T-Mem, by 10 to 31 points of accuracy. It matches an LLM reranker that makes 64 calls per query at 3.2 times lower serving cost, and on LoCoMo it outperforms Mem0 and Zep without any LLM call at write time. The factorization attributes the gains to slates that more often hold all of the evidence, so recommender-system design offers an effective and efficient foundation for the long-term memory of LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM智能体的记忆选择形式化为"预算受限的slate推荐"问题，提出AgentMemRec，用推荐系统的候选生成、学习排序与slate构造来选取记忆，无需任何LLM调用。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体跨多会话服务用户时，每个请求都需从不断增长的记忆库中挑选少量记忆放入有限上下文窗口，这一选择决定回答正确性且在Web规模下每请求都要执行。面临三大挑战：记忆库庞大且增长、单请求成本预算、以及需要全部证据的多会话问题。现有记忆系统（如构建笔记/图结构）每段历史需数百至数千次LLM调用，且各自独立设计，难以判断哪个组件真正贡献精度。
AI.method: 受推荐问题性质类比启发，将其形式化为budgeted slate recommendation：请求即用户、存储记忆即物品、上下文窗口即slate。该形式化把各类记忆系统统一到一个推荐级联的设计空间中，并将精度分解为各阶段所控制的"完整性"。据此提出AgentMemRec，迁移推荐系统中的候选生成、learning-to-rank与slate构造，实现零LLM调用的记忆选择。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval多会话问题上，AgentMemRec比A-Mem、HippoRAG 2、DynamicRAG、T-Mem等记忆与上下文选择方法高出10–31个精度点；在每查询64次LLM调用的LLM重排器上达到相当精度，而服务成本低3.2倍；在LoCoMo上无需写入时任何LLM调用即优于Mem0与Zep。因子分解表明增益来自slate更常包含全部证据。
AI.conclusion: 推荐系统设计为LLM智能体长期记忆提供了有效且高效的基础；精度提升可归因于各阶段所控完整性的协同优化，而非昂贵的LLM调用。

title: Can Agentic Code Review Catch Vulnerabilities Before They Are Merged?
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/secprbench/secprbench Results website: https://secprbench.github.io
summary: LLM agents have been increasingly adopted for security-focused code review, but existing benchmarks mostly derive the reviewed changes from their later fixes instead of the real-world bug-introducing commits. In this paper, we present SecPRBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating agentic security review on validated real-world code changes. More specifically, we have built an automated agentic pipeline to autonomously harvest, build, and validate massive real-world bug-introducing commits for popular software systems. To ensure precise evaluation, we also adopt LLM-as-a-judge to credit the findings matching ground-truth vulnerabilities. To date, we have collected 265 tasks from nine critical systems, including Firefox, V8, and OpenSSL with millions of lines of code. Across eight frontier models, recall ranges from 32.5% to 78.1%, with Grok 4.6 and GPT-6 sol ranking at the top. Our study also shows that most misses are not simply oversights: in 68% of them, the agent reports on a file that holds the flaw but argues for a different mechanism. Security-focused harnesses also behave differently: OpenAI's Codex Security lowers recall by 8.3 points, mostly by abstaining, while Anthropic's Defending Code harness raises it by 7.7 points, at a higher cost.

AI.tldr: 提出SecPRBench——首个基于经构建验证的真实世界"引入缺陷提交"的智能体安全代码审查基准；覆盖9个关键系统265个任务，8个前沿模型召回率32.5%–78.1%，并揭示漏报多为"定位正确但机制论证错误"，且安全类harness效果分化明显。
AI.motivation: 现有面向安全代码审查的LLM智能体评测基准，其待审代码变更多由后续修复补丁反推得到，而非真实的缺陷引入提交，导致评测对象与真实审查场景错配、结论可信度不足。因此需要一个基于经验证的真实世界引入缺陷提交的综合基准。
AI.method: 构建自动化智能体流水线，自主采集、构建并验证来自主流软件系统的大规模真实"引入缺陷提交"；采用LLM-as-a-judge对智能体报告与真值漏洞进行匹配判定，以精确计分。
AI.result: 已收集Firefox、V8、OpenSSL等9个关键系统、含数百万行代码的265个任务。8个前沿模型召回率为32.5%–78.1%，Grok 4.6与GPT-6 sol居首。68%的漏报并非简单疏忽，而是报告了包含缺陷的文件却论证了不同的缺陷机制。安全专用harness表现分化：OpenAI Codex Security使召回下降8.3个百分点（主要因弃答），Anthropic Defending Code harness则提升7.7个百分点但成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 基于真实引入缺陷提交的评测能更真实地刻画智能体安全审查能力；当前前沿模型在缺陷机制层面仍有显著差距，安全harness收益高度依赖于其设计与弃答行为，未来需针对"定位正确但机制误判"这一主要失败模式改进审查智能体。

title: NewsBench: Expert-Grounded Evaluation of Epistemic Quality in AI News Reporting
summary: As frontier AI systems increasingly serve as sources of political and current-events information, evaluating the epistemic quality of their responses is now especially consequential. Existing evaluations often focus narrowly on ideological alignment, rely on measures not validated for this setting, or depend on reference labels derived from public opinion or non-expert annotation, potentially producing misleading or miscalibrated results. To address these limitations, we introduce NewsBench, an expert-grounded benchmark that reframes evaluation around editorial standards developed by senior practitioners in journalism, policy, and intelligence analysis. NewsBench operationalizes quality across three dimensions, source quality, factuality, and neutrality, using a two-phase pipeline in which domain experts first define and calibrate evaluation guidelines, which are then transferred to automated AI judges validated against expert-adjudicated gold labels. The benchmark includes approximately $3,000$ evaluation prompts, with roughly $500$ refreshed monthly to capture emerging current events, roughly $2,500$ human expert-annotated items for calibration and validation, and a suite of AI judges designed to enable scalable evaluation. To validate our methodology, we report both inter-rater reliability among human experts and AI judge--human agreement across all three dimensions. Finally, we apply NewsBench to four frontier models, revealing distinct and non-overlapping failure profiles in sourcing, factuality, and neutrality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NewsBench，一个以资深新闻、政策与情报分析专家制定的编辑标准为基础的基准，从信息源质量、事实性和中立性三个维度评估前沿 AI 系统对政治与时事信息的回答质量，并通过专家校准+经专家金标签验证的 AI 评审实现可扩展评估。
AI.motivation: 前沿 AI 系统日益成为政治与时事信息的重要来源，其回答的认知（epistemic）质量评估具有重要现实后果；但现有评估多局限于意识形态对齐、使用未在该情境下验证的度量，或依赖公众意见/非专家标注的参考标签，易产生误导或校准失当的结果。
AI.method: 构建 NewsBench：将评估重新锚定于资深从业者的编辑标准；将质量操作化为来源质量、事实性、中立性三维度；采用两阶段流程，先由领域专家定义并校准评估准则，再迁移至自动化 AI 评审，并以专家裁决的金标签进行验证。数据含约 3000 条评估提示（每月约 500 条刷新以覆盖新兴时事）、约 2500 条人工专家标注条目用于校准与验证，以及一套可扩展的 AI 评审。报告人类专家间信度与 AI 评审-人类一致性。
AI.result: 报告了三个维度上的人类专家间信度及 AI 评审与人类的一致性；将 NewsBench 应用于四个前沿模型，揭示出在信息溯源、事实性与中立性方面彼此不同且不重叠的失败画像。
AI.conclusion: 以专家编辑标准为锚、结合专家校准与已验证 AI 评审的评估范式可行且可扩展，能够为前沿模型提供更可靠、更细粒度的质量刻画，并揭示单一模型在不同质量维度上的差异化短板。

title: All-in-One: A Composable Attack on LLM Transformations
summary: Quantization, pruning, and model merging are popular transformations applied to deployment-ready LLMs to improve efficiency and downstream performance. Recent work has shown that these transformations can introduce a security threat: an adversary can train a model that passes safety checks in its pre-transformed state, only turning malicious once it is transformed for deployment. However, prior attacks target one specific transformation (e.g., quantization) and generally rely on transformation-specific techniques, making them difficult to combine in practice. In this work, we introduce a simple, composable attack framework that targets multiple transformations simultaneously and triggers when any one of them is applied by a user. Our key insight is that the effect of each transformation can be approximated as a perturbation to the model weights, allowing us to jointly train the model with a benign loss on the original model and a malicious loss on each simulated transformed model. These perturbations are simple enough to simulate at every training iteration across diverse transformations, making them practically combinable within a single training objective, enabling a unified attack. Through extensive experiments across attack scenarios, model families, and a wide range of deployment-time model transformations, we show that our attack achieves high success rates. This demonstrates that model transformations may be utilized to trigger significantly different behavior from the original model and reinforces the associated security concerns by demonstrating that a single attack can jointly target diverse transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个简单且可组合的后门攻击框架，可同时针对量化、剪枝、模型合并等多种部署期变换触发恶意行为，通过将每种变换近似为权重扰动并联合优化良性损失与各模拟变换模型上的恶意损失，实现单一训练目标下的统一攻击，实验显示高攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有针对LLM部署期变换（量化、剪枝、模型合并）的安全威胁研究表明，攻击者可训练一个在变换前通过安全检查、仅在被变换后才表现出恶意的模型。但已有攻击只针对单一变换，且依赖变换特定技巧，难以组合使用，因此需要一个可同时覆盖多种变换的统一攻击方法。
AI.method: 核心洞察：每种变换的效果可近似为对模型权重的扰动。据此在训练中对原始模型施加良性损失，同时对每个模拟变换后的模型施加恶意损失，联合优化。这些扰动足够简单，可在每次训练迭代中对多种变换进行模拟，从而使多变换目标可在单一训练目标内组合，形成统一攻击。
AI.result: 在多种攻击场景、模型家族以及广泛的部署期模型变换上进行大量实验，攻击取得高成功率，表明模型变换可被利用以触发与原始模型显著不同的行为。
AI.conclusion: 单一攻击可联合针对多种变换，证实了模型变换作为触发机制的安全风险，强化了相关安全担忧，并说明需要针对变换触发型威胁的防御研究。

title: Knowing When the Evidence Is Enough: Requirement-Directed Search with Horn-Closure Certificates
summary: After each Web search, a search-augmented model must decide whether its evidence suffices: answer, search again, or abstain. Prevailing systems leave this to holistic model judgement, which can accept a context naming every entity yet lacking one required fact. We instead make sufficiency structural: a per-query requirement hypergraph states which facts jointly yield another fact. This raises two challenges: deriving requirements from the question alone, and linking each requirement to passages about the right entity. Certify therefore decomposes the question, searches per requirement, and accepts links only after entity checks. Horn closure over the links yields a certificate, the minimal sufficient passages and their derivation, or an abstention naming open requirements. Given correct retrieval, requirements and links, the decision is sound, and complete up to the entity check. Pooled over three corpora with unanswerable twins, Certify decides significantly more accurately than search agents, graph retrieval and sufficiency judges in default configurations. On the same evidence, it matches a proprietary model's sufficiency label without an additional model call. Over 21M Wikipedia passages, entity checks add 4 to 13 points of decision accuracy where gold evidence exists. Finally, answers from its certificate are 80% correct, against 57% from all retrieved passages.

AI.tldr: Certify将"检索证据是否充分"从整体模型判断改造为结构化的超图Horn闭包证书判定，在检索充分性决策上显著优于搜索智能体、图检索与充分性判别器。
AI.motivation: 搜索增强模型在检索后需判断证据是否充分（作答、继续检索或弃答），现有系统依赖模型的整体性判断，容易出现"上下文虽提及所有实体、却缺失某个必需事实"仍被误判为充分的错误。作者希望把充分性判定结构化。
AI.method: 以逐查询的需求超图表示"哪些事实联合可推出另一事实"；从问题本身分解出需求，并按需求分别检索，仅在实体校验通过后才接受链接；对链接做Horn闭包，得到证书（最小充分段落及其推导），否则弃答并列出未满足需求。理论上：给定正确检索、需求与链接，判定是可靠的，并在实体校验范围内完备。
AI.result: 在三个含不可答孪生问题的语料上汇总，默认配置下决策准确率显著高于搜索智能体、图检索与充分性判别器；在同一证据下无需额外模型调用即可匹配某专有模型的充分性标签；在2100万维基段落上，实体校验在有金标证据情形下带来4~13个百分点的决策准确率提升；由证书生成的答案正确率80%，而基于全部检索段落为57%。
AI.conclusion: 将检索充分性形式化为需求超图上的Horn闭包证书，可提供可追溯、可验错的最小证据集与弃答理由，兼顾判定精度与答案质量，并具备理论上的可靠性与（受限）完备性。

title: Developers as Managers of AI Agents: A Workplace Shadowing Study
summary:
As AI coding agents become more autonomous, developers increasingly direct, coordinate, and check their work. Yet little is known about these practices in everyday professional development. We shadowed 11 professional developers across approximately 15 hours of work, coded their activities and task transitions, analyzed 255 submitted prompts, and conducted 4.6 hours of follow-up interviews.
  Developers spent an average of 33.4% of observed time formulating prompts or checking AI responses, with task-switching rates ranging from 0 to 101.6 switches per hour. Beyond producing artifacts, prompts supported understanding, requirements clarification, agent configuration, and coordination. We identified three recurring patterns: \textit{Supervisor}, involving direct artifact inspection; \textit{Delegator}, involving dialogue-based coordination and delegated implementation and checking; and \textit{Learner}, involving agents primarily to build understanding. Developers sought technical information from agents and organizational context, authority, and alignment from colleagues. Our findings suggest future studies of how developers manage attention across concurrent agent tasks and tools that support verification, coordination, and learning.

AI.tldr: 通过影子观察11名职业开发者约15小时工作、编码任务切换、分析255条提示词及4.6小时访谈，揭示开发者约有1/3时间用于编写提示与核查AI输出，并提炼出Supervisor、Delegator、Learner三种交互模式。
AI.motivation: 随着AI编码代理日趋自主，开发者角色转向指挥、协调与核查代理工作，但这类日常专业实践缺乏实证认识，研究旨在填补该空白。
AI.method: 采用实地影子观察法追踪11名职业开发者约15小时工作，对其活动与任务切换进行编码，分析255条提交的提示词，并开展4.6小时追踪访谈。
AI.result: 开发者平均33.4%的观察时间用于构建提示或检查AI响应，任务切换率为0至101.6次/小时；提示词除产出制品外还支持理解、需求澄清、代理配置与协调；识别出Supervisor（直接检查制品）、Delegator（对话协调并委托实现与检查）、Learner（借助代理建立理解）三种模式；开发者从代理获取技术信息，从同事获取组织情境、权威与对齐。
AI.conclusion: 开发者需在多代理并发任务间管理注意力，未来研究应关注注意力管理，并开发支持验证、协调与学习的工具。

title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
summary: Data science agents can automate end-to-end machine learning workflows, yet they remain far from competitive on human leaderboards. Agents make process errors such as insufficient exploration, unsound validation, coding bugs, and poor use of a fixed budget (re-running the same exploratory data analysis and baseline models in every attempt). We propose AdaPRA to address these issues: a persistent coding agent harness that accumulates knowledge across attempts on the same task, with rubric-guided process supervision that identifies and corrects errors. Our process reward agent audits the agent's trajectory and workspace by executing checks, and adapts its rubrics to each task. We find that rubrics seeded from easier tasks generalize to harder tasks, with rubric adaptation further improving performance. With five attempts per task, AdaPRA improves an 80B Qwen model's leaderboard percentile by 24.5 points on DSPredict-Easy and 14.8 points on DSPredict-Hard while reducing process errors. We also show that supervision with rubrics mined from one base model's runs improves another (DeepSeek-V3.2), and that AdaPRA beats DataPRM, a competitive PRM for data science. We also share our code for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdaPRA：一个跨尝试累积知识的持久化编码智能体框架，通过自适应评分量规的过程监督来纠正数据科学智能体的过程性错误。
AI.motivation: 数据科学智能体可自动化端到端机器学习流程，但在人类排行榜上仍缺乏竞争力，主要因过程性错误：探索不足、验证不合理、编码缺陷、以及固定预算利用不佳（每次尝试重复相同的EDA与基线模型）。
AI.method: 持久化编码智能体挂架（harness），在同一任务的多次尝试间累积知识；配备过程奖励智能体，通过执行检查审计智能体的轨迹与工作区，并针对每个任务自适应调整评分量规（rubric）。
AI.result: 从简单任务播种的量规可泛化到更难任务，量规自适应进一步提升性能；每任务5次尝试，使80B Qwen模型在DSPredict-Easy排行榜百分位提升24.5点、DSPredict-Hard提升14.8点，同时减少过程错误；来自一个基模型运行中挖掘的量规可改善另一模型（DeepSeek-V3.2）；AdaPRA优于竞争性PRM方法DataPRM。
AI.conclusion: 持久化知识累积与自适应量规过程监督能有效提升数据科学智能体的过程质量与整体表现，且量规具备跨任务与跨模型迁移性；代码开源以支持复现。

title: Tree Depth and Sample-Quality-Associated Features: Two Hidden Factors in Boruta Selection for RNA-Seq Data Classification
summary: Boruta is a widely used method for selecting gene panels from RNA sequencing data, and its most used implementation recommends Random Forest trees of depth 3 to 7, an untested setting. We tested whether this setting changes which genes are selected, using pan-cancer data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (10,469 tumors, 33 cancer types) and breast cancer PAM50 subtyping (981 tumors, 5 subtypes). A leakage-free protocol fitted every label-dependent step inside training folds, measured every effect against seed-to-seed variation, and held out a locked test set per task. In pan-cancer data, shallow trees changed the selection far more than a new seed did: the top-500 overlap with unlimited-depth selections was 0.37 at depth 5, against 0.84 to 0.93 between seeds at depth 5 or unlimited depth. Shallow trees confirmed 3.5 times fewer genes, missed markers of large classes and produced less accurate 50-gene panels (balanced accuracy 0.809 vs 0.889). The effect vanished once the cap reached about 60 to 75% of the depth that unrestricted trees grow to, set mainly by the number of classes, not sample size, and leaving depth uncapped cost no accuracy in either task. The effect replicated in a second cross-validation repeat and under permutation importance. About a third of pre-filtered candidates also tracked sample quality within class; a within-class filter removed them without loss of test accuracy (balanced accuracy 0.943 vs 0.942 with 1,000 genes). We recommend uncapped trees, or a cap chosen from the realized tree depth, and a within-class quality filter before Boruta.

AI.tldr: Boruta 默认的浅层随机森林设置会显著改变基因选择结果并降低面板准确率；建议取消深度限制（或依据实际树深设上限），并在 Boruta 前加类内质量过滤。
AI.motivation: Boruta 是 RNA-seq 基因面板筛选的常用方法，其主流实现推荐深度 3–7 的随机森林，但该设置从未被验证；作者需检验它是否改变被选基因、是否影响下游准确率。
AI.method: 在 TCGA 泛癌数据（10,469 例、33 种癌症）与乳腺癌 PAM50 分型（981 例、5 个亚型）上评测。采用无泄漏协议：所有依赖标签的步骤在训练折内拟合，每项效应与种子间变异对比，并按任务保留锁定的测试集；另做交叉验证重复与置换重要性验证，并检验预筛候选基因是否随类内样本质量变化。
AI.result: 泛癌中浅层树的影响远大于更换随机种子：深度 5 的前 500 基因与不限深度选择重叠度仅 0.37，而种子间为 0.84–0.93。浅层树确认的基因少 3.5 倍，遗漏大类标志基因，50 基因面板准确率更低（平衡准确率 0.809 vs 0.889）。当深度上限达到无限制树实际树深的约 60–75% 时效应消失，该深主要由类别数而非样本量决定；不设上限在两个任务中均无准确率损失。约三分之一的预筛候选基因跟踪类内样本质量，类内过滤可去除它们且不损测试精度（1,000 基因时 0.943 vs 0.942）。
AI.conclusion: 推荐使用不限深度的树，或基于实际生成树深选择深度上限，并在 Boruta 之前施加类内质量过滤。

title: DPE-Rec: Diversity-Preserving and Efficient Diffusion Language Model Recommendation for Bundle Construction
summary: Generative bundle construction completes a partially observed bundle by generating its missing items from a large product catalog. Compared to autoregressive LLMs, diffusion LLM emerges as a natural fit for this unordered generation task. Their bidirectional attention provides an inductive bias better aligned with unordered bundle construction. Iterative denoising can reveal multiple tokens per step, potentially reducing inference latency. However, directly applying DLMs to this task presents two key challenges: 1 Despite its flexible reveal order, confidence-guided decoding tends to postpone semantic-fork decisions until refinement tokens constrain their choices, reducing bundle diversity. 2 Revealing more tokens per step can compromise recommendation quality, stifling the potential for faster inference. We introduce DPE-Rec, a diffusion framework for diversity preservation and efficient recommendation. DPE-Rec preserves diversity by introducing semantic-fork-aware GRPO, which prioritizes semantic-fork decisions via autoregressive rollouts. It improves efficiency through pseudo-trajectory distillation, which concentrates learning from the vast random corruption space onto the compact trajectory-induced subspace visited by high-quality decoding, unlocking reliable multi-token decoding. Together, these components enable diverse and accurate bundle construction with substantially fewer denoise steps. Experiments on multiple bundle construction benchmarks show that DPE-Rec improves recommendation performance by 63% on average, and its fast variant achieves 25.6$times$ faster inference on average than existing generative recommendation arts, with minimal loss in recommendation quality.

AI.tldr: DPE-Rec 是一个面向生成式捆绑包构建的扩散语言模型框架，通过语义分叉感知的 GRPO 与伪轨迹蒸馏，同时实现捆绑多样性与高效多 token 解码。
AI.motivation: 生成式捆绑包构建需从大商品目录补齐缺失商品，属于无序生成任务，双向注意力的扩散语言模型比自回归 LLM 更契合。但直接应用 DLM 存在两问题：(1) 置信度引导解码会把语义分叉决策推迟到精炼 token 约束其选择之后，削弱捆绑多样性；(2) 每步揭示过多 token 会损害推荐质量，限制推理加速潜力。
AI.method: 提出 DPE-Rec 框架，包含两个核心组件：语义分叉感知的 GRPO——通过自回归 rollout 优先处理语义分叉决策，以保持多样性；伪轨迹蒸馏——将学习从庞大的随机腐蚀空间集中到高质量解码所访问的紧凑轨迹诱导子空间，从而支撑可靠的多 token 解码。
AI.result: 在多个捆绑包构建基准上，推荐性能平均提升 63%；其快速变体相比现有生成式推荐方法平均推理提速 25.6 倍，且推荐质量损失极小。
AI.conclusion: DPE-Rec 通过多样性保持与高效解码的联合设计，在显著减少去噪步数的条件下实现了多样且准确的捆绑包构建，兼顾效果与推理效率。

title: Build or Adopt? Custom-Built vs. General-Purpose LLM Agent Harnesses for Automotive GUI Testing
summary: As general-purpose LLM agent harnesses mature, organizations must decide whether to continue developing in-house systems or adopt existing alternatives. We study this decision at Volvo Group for GUI testing of Android-based in-vehicle infotainment (IVI) systems. We compare a production, custom-built harness with two general-purpose harnesses, Claude Code and OpenCode, keeping the tools, accessed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the models the same. We evaluate the harnesses with up to four models on Volvo's IVI test cases and on open-ended tasks in public apps (Google Maps, Booking.com), and interview ten practitioners: developers, the product owner, and testers. On Volvo's stepwise IVI tests, general-purpose harnesses match the custom-built harness in success but vary more across runs. Their inference cost per task is 2.6-10.7 times higher, yet the engineering effort they save outweighs this: for a nightly IVI regression suite, total monthly cost, including engineering effort and inference, is 3-66% lower. On open-ended public-app tasks, they succeed more often, mainly because they recover better from incorrect actions. Interviews suggest that external advances can turn an in-house harness into technical debt even without deterioration. Adopting a general-purpose harness shifts maintenance from the agent loop to tools and instructions, but gives teams less control over what the model receives. Regardless of the harness, testers want to inspect the agent's actions and ensure that it follows the prescribed test scenario.

AI.tldr: 在 Volvo Group 的 Android IVI GUI 测试场景中，研究对比自研专用 agent harness 与通用 harness（Claude Code、OpenCode）。在固定工具（MCP）与模型条件下，通用 harness 在结构化 IVI 测试中成功率持平但运行波动更大、推理成本高 2.6–10.7 倍；计入工程投入后夜间回归套件月总成本低 3–66%。在开放式公共应用任务中通用 harness 成功率更高，主要得益于更强的错误恢复。访谈表明：外部技术进步会使自研 harness 即使未退化也可能变成技术债；采用通用 harness 将维护工作从 agent loop 转移到工具与指令，但降低了对模型输入的掌控；测试人员普遍要求可审计的 agent 行为并确保其遵循规定的测试场景。
AI.motivation: 随着通用 LLM agent harness 日趋成熟，组织需决定是继续自研内部系统还是采用现成方案；论文旨在以实证数据支撑这一"自研 vs 采用"决策，并刻画迁移带来的成本、维护与可控性权衡。
AI.method: 在 Volvo Group 的 Android 车载信息娱乐（IVI）GUI 测试场景中，将一套生产级自研 harness 与两套通用 harness（Claude Code、OpenCode）对比，保持工具（经 MCP 访问）与模型一致；最多使用四种模型，在 Volvo IVI 测试用例及公共应用（Google Maps、Booking.com）的开放式任务上评测，并访谈十位从业者（开发者、产品负责人、测试人员）。
AI.result: 在 Volvo 的分步 IVI 测试中，通用 harness 成功率与自研 harness 相当，但跨运行波动更大；每任务推理成本高 2.6–10.7 倍，但节省的工程投入可抵消该差距：夜间 IVI 回归套件的月度总成本（含工程投入与推理）低 3–66%。在开放式公共应用任务中通用 harness 成功率更高，主要源于对错误动作的恢复能力更强。
AI.conclusion: 访谈显示，外部技术进步即便未伴随自身退化，也可能使自研 harness 沦为技术债；采用通用 harness 将维护重心从 agent loop 转移到工具与指令，但削弱了团队对模型输入的掌控。无论采用何种 harness，测试人员都希望审查 agent 的行为并确保其遵循规定的测试场景。

title: Scoped Semantic Invariance as a Foundation for LLM Reliability
summary:
LLMs often answer semantically equivalent queries inconsistently, even when the underlying facts are known. We formalize consistency as semantic invariance over equivalence classes of queries and show that invariance under arbitrary meaning-preserving transformations is undecidable in general. This motivates scoped semantic invariance, where model behavior is evaluated relative to bounded semantic domains.
  We operationalize this framework using knowledge graphs (KGs), which act as explicit semantic control structures defining local semantic constraints and grounding contexts. Across the MITRE D3FEND ontology and eight Wikidata- derived domains, we show that inconsistencies are structured rather than random, concentrating in localized hotspot subgraphs organized around recurring TREE, STAR, and CYCLE patterns that remain stable across models and domains.
  We further show that selective graph grounding improves correctness and cross-model consistency, while indiscriminate grounding introduces regressions. A layered grounding strategy achieves the strongest monotonicity profile, preserving correct knowledge while reducing inconsistency. Finally, we show that hotspot structures discovered from simple consistency probes transfer to more realistic compositional reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文将LLM的一致性形式化为语义等价类上的不变性，指出任意语义保持变换下的不变性不可判定，转而提出"作用域语义不变性"；以知识图谱作为语义控制结构，在MITRE D3FEND与8个Wikidata派生领域中发现不一致性呈结构化分布（TREE/STAR/CYCLE热点子图），并提出分层接地策略以提升正确性与跨模型一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM对语义等价查询的答案常不一致，即便相关事实已知；而全局意义保持变换下的不变性一般不可判定，需要可操作、可评估的分析框架。
AI.method: 1) 将一致性形式化为语义等价类上的不变性，并证明任意保持语义变换下的不变性不可判定；2) 提出作用域语义不变性，在有限语义域内评估模型行为；3) 用知识图谱作为显式语义控制结构，定义局部语义约束与接地上下文；4) 在MITRE D3FEND本体与8个Wikidata派生域上进行一致性探针实验，识别热点子图的TREE、STAR、CYCLE模式；5) 比较选择性接地、无差别接地与分层接地策略。
AI.result: 不一致性并非随机，而是结构化的，集中于局部热点子图，且其TREE/STAR/CYCLE模式在不同模型与领域间保持稳定；选择性图接地可提升正确性与跨模型一致性，无差别接地则导致性能退化；分层接地策略取得最佳单调性表现，在保留正确知识的同时降低不一致性；由简单一致性探针发现的热点结构可迁移到更贴近实际的组合推理任务。
AI.conclusion: 一致性应作为受语义域约束的性质来评估；知识图谱可用于定位并结构化解构LLM的不一致热点；分层而非无差别的图接地是兼顾正确性与一致性的有效路径，且热点结构具有跨任务的可迁移性。

title: When Does Pre-Trained Capacity Help Causal Learning? From Scalar Prediction to Counterfactual Post-Training
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training
summary: How does pre-trained model capacity relate to performance after adaptation for causal tasks? We study two systems built on the Qwen 2.5 family: CausalLLM, which estimates scalar potential outcomes with treatment-specific heads, and CausalGen, which generates treatment-conditioned text or code using soft prefixes and factual supervised fine-tuning (SFT), counterfactual SFT, and preference alignment. Increasing backbone size from 0.5B to 1.5B yields mixed scalar-estimation results on IHDP, but improves CodeGen pass@1 from 0.267 to 0.575 and treatment-effect score from 0.231 to 0.515 after the complete generative pipeline. Within 0.5B CausalLLM, narrative inputs reduce mean sqrt(PEHE) from 1.842 to 1.780, a 3.4% improvement over tabular inputs; the 5.8% improvement over a no-LLM baseline combines changes in representation and input format. These descriptive comparisons motivate a distinction between available and convertible capacity. They do not isolate the contribution of post-training: the two systems differ in dataset, architecture, output modality, and supervision, and intermediate-stage evaluations are unavailable. With only two small backbones and three replications, the results support a hypothesis about capacity--adaptation alignment rather than a general scaling law or a demonstrated causal mechanism.

AI.tldr: 论文考察预训练模型容量与因果任务适配后性能的关系，比较CausalLLM（标量潜在结果估计）与CausalGen（治疗条件生成），发现0.5B→1.5B对IHDP标量估计结果不一，但生成式流水线显著提升代码生成与治疗效果分数；作者据此提出"可用容量 vs 可转化容量"的区分，并将结论定位为假设而非缩放律。
AI.motivation: 探究预训练模型容量与适配后因果任务性能之间是否存在单调关系，并试图解释为何容量提升未必带来一致收益。
AI.method: 基于Qwen 2.5系列的0.5B与1.5B两个骨干构建两类系统：CausalLLM用治疗特定头估计标量潜在结果；CausalGen通过软前缀与治疗条件生成文本/代码，采用事实性SFT、反事实SFT与偏好对齐的完整生成式流水线。
AI.result: 0.5B→1.5B在IHDP标量估计上结果混合；CausalGen的CodeGen pass@1由0.267升至0.575，治疗效果分数由0.231升至0.515。0.5B CausalLLM中叙述式输入使平均sqrt(PEHE)从1.842降至1.780（相对表格输入改善3.4%），相对无LLM基线改善5.8%（含表示与输入格式变化的共同作用）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持关于"容量—适配对齐"的假设，即需区分可用容量与可转化容量；但受限于两系统在数据、架构、输出模态与监督方式上的差异、中间阶段评估缺失、仅两个小骨干与三次重复，无法分离后训练贡献，也不构成一般缩放律或已证实的因果机制。

title: Discovering Topics from Linear Autoencoders
summary: Linear recommenders and topic models are similar in that they implicitly learn from co-occurrences of items. However, there has been little study of how these two model families are related. In this work, we show that, under a latent-factor model of the user-item interactions, the latent topics can be discovered from the weight matrix of a closed-form linear autoencoder. These topics provide a basis for interpreting the recommendations, and can be obtained directly from the trained recommender without additional training. Building on our analysis, we further propose novel item and user normalizations that prevent popular items and very active users from dominating the topics. Our experiments on six public datasets demonstrate that our method achieves significantly higher topic quality than every dedicated topic model and matches or exceeds the best linear autoencoder on all six datasets, while its recommendation performance is competitive with the best tuned recommender.

AI.tldr: 该文证明在隐因子交互模型下，闭式线性自编码器的权重矩阵可提取潜在主题，从而统一线性推荐与主题模型，并提出抑制热门物品与高活跃用户主导主题的归一化方法。
AI.motivation: 线性推荐器与主题模型都隐式地从物品共现中学习，但两者关系鲜有研究；作者希望揭示二者的理论联系，并使推荐结果可获得可解释的主题解释，且无需额外训练。
AI.method: 在用户-物品交互的隐因子模型下，对闭式线性自编码器的权重矩阵进行谱/分解分析，证明其张成的子空间对应潜在主题；基于该分析提出物品侧与用户侧的归一化，防止热门物品和超活跃用户主导主题。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集上，主题质量显著优于所有专用主题模型；在全部六个数据集上匹配或超过最佳线性自编码器；推荐性能与最佳调参的推荐器相当。
AI.conclusion: 线性自编码器可视为隐含的主题模型，为主题解释与推荐精度提供了统一框架，且归一化对主题质量至关重要。

title: Covered Is Not Checked: Which Branch Outcomes Would Your Tests Notice?
summary:
Code coverage reports what tests execute, not whether tests detect faults. Checked coverage addresses this gap by tracing code that influences test oracles through dynamic slicing, but slicing is costly, and Java slicers struggle with modern language features and complex programs. We present Veritas, a slicing-free approach that directly tests whether covered behavior is checked. We target object branch coverage (OBC), a compiled-code structural criterion with fault-detection effectiveness comparable to source-level Modified Condition/Decision Coverage (MC/DC), which is required at the highest assurance level of DO-178C. For each covered object-branch outcome, Veritas forces the opposite outcome and credits checking only when the change is executed, a previously passing test fails, and the failure is attributable to that outcome. Thus, Veritas distinguishes execution from demonstrated fault detection without dynamic dependence analysis.
  We evaluated Veritas on eleven open-source Java projects containing 51,382 object-branch outcomes. We find that 18% of covered outcomes can be changed without failing any test, exposing weaknesses hidden by coverage. Among surviving mutants, about half are never activated by test inputs, while the rest are activated but undetected. Compared with slicing-based checked coverage, Veritas identifies 4,763 cases where tests detect a change that slicing does not credit, while 19% of cases credited by slicing produce no detected failure when changed. Weakening assertions increases this gap and reduces fault detection in every project. Moreover, code locations controlled by weakly checked outcomes are 12.4--54.7 percentage points more likely to have an undetected independent fault than locations controlled by checked outcomes. These findings show that directly testing outcomes provides actionable evidence of oracle effectiveness beyond structural coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Veritas，一种无需切片（slicing-free）的方法，直接测试被覆盖行为是否被检查，以对象分支覆盖（OBC）为准则，区分"执行"与"已证明的故障检测"。
AI.motivation: 代码覆盖率只反映测试执行了什么代码，而不反映测试能否检测故障。既有 checked coverage 通过动态切片追踪影响测试oracle的代码，但切片开销大，且 Java 切片工具难以处理现代语言特性和复杂程序。
AI.method: Veritas 针对 OBC 的每个已覆盖 object-branch outcome，强制其取相反结果，仅当该改变被执行、一个原本通过的测试失败、且失败可归因于该 outcome 时，才认定该行为被"检查"。因此无需动态依赖分析即可区分执行与已证明的故障检测。
AI.result: 在 11 个开源 Java 项目、51,382 个 object-branch outcome 上评估：18% 的已覆盖 outcome 可在无测试失败的情况下被改变；存活变异中约一半未被测试输入激活，其余被激活但未被检测。相比基于切片的 checked coverage，Veritas 找出 4,763 个切片未认定但测试确能检测的改变，而切片认定的案例中 19% 改变后无失败；弱化断言会扩大该差距并降低各项目故障检测能力；受弱检查 outcome 控制的位置出现未检测独立故障的概率高出 12.4–54.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 直接测试 outcome 能提供超越结构覆盖的、可操作的 oracle 有效性证据，揭示覆盖率掩盖的测试弱点。

title: GEMS-RAG: Graph-grounded Engineering Multimodal Standards Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Engineering standards are challenging knowledge sources for large language models (LLMs) because they are hierarchical, multimodal, and densely connected through figures, tables, cross-references, and normative rules. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods often rely on unstructured text retrieval and struggle with questions requiring joint reasoning over textual provisions, visual specifications, and document structure. We propose GEMS-RAG (Graph-grounded Engineering Multimodal Standards Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a framework for grounded reasoning over engineering standards. GEMS-RAG combines hierarchical parsing, fine-grained visual entity extraction, multimodal knowledge graph construction, and graph-grounded hybrid retrieval. Instead of treating figures as monolithic images, it decomposes them into meaningful visual entities linked to textual provisions, engineering concepts, and regulatory rules. During inference, dense, sparse, and visual retrieval are combined with graph expansion to identify relevant evidence across text, figures, and document structure. We evaluate GEMS-RAG on the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD), a large engineering standard containing egulations, technical drawings, and standardized traffic-control devices. Results show that graph-grounded multimodal retrieval improves retrieval effectiveness and question-answering performance over text-only, multimodal, and graph-based RAG baselines. Beyond MUTCD, GEMS-RAG offers a general framework for reasoning over engineering codes, technical manuals, regulatory documents, and scientific standards in safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出GEMS-RAG框架，通过分层解析、细粒度视觉实体抽取、多模态知识图谱构建与图接地混合检索，实现对工程标准（以MUTCD为评测对象）的接地推理，效果优于纯文本、多模态与图基RAG基线。
AI.motivation: 工程标准具有层级化、多模态、图/表/交叉引用/规范性条款密集互联的特点，对LLM构成挑战；现有RAG多依赖非结构化文本检索，难以处理需在文字条款、视觉规范与文档结构间联合推理的问题。
AI.method: GEMS-RAG（Graph-grounded Engineering Multimodal Standards Retrieval-Augmented Generation）框架：1）分层解析；2）细粒度视觉实体抽取，将图表拆解为有意义的视觉实体而非整图处理，并与文本条款、工程概念、规范性规则建立链接；3）多模态知识图谱构建；4）图接地混合检索，推理阶段融合稠密、稀疏与视觉检索并结合图扩展，跨文本、图表与文档结构定位证据。
AI.result: 在MUTCD（含法规条款、技术图纸与标准化交通控制装置的大型工程标准）上评测，图接地的多模态检索在检索有效性与问答性能上均优于纯文本、多模态与图基RAG基线。
AI.conclusion: 除MUTCD外，GEMS-RAG可作为面向工程规范、技术手册、监管文件与科学标准等安全关键场景的通用推理框架。

title: MLIPDiff: Guiding Denoising Diffusion Models for Structure-Based Drug Design via Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
summary: Diffusion models have become a dominant approach to structure-based drug design. However, because they are trained primarily to fit reference structures, they often place ligands in physically implausible poses that clash with the protein. We introduce MLIPDiff, an inference-time guidance method that can be applied to pretrained diffusion models for ligand generation. The method uses physics-informed guidance from UMA (Universal Models for Atoms), a machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP). The guidance combines four weighted energy terms (protein-ligand interaction, ligand strain, steric clash, and pocket anchoring) and uses the original model checkpoint without retraining. On CrossDocked2020, MLIPDiff completely eliminates protein-ligand collisions while preserving the ligand's local geometry, improving bond-length distributions and physical plausibility relative to the base model. Compared to models such as NucleusDiff that are specifically designed to reduce atomic clashes, MLIPDiff achieves clash-free structures without compromising local geometry. It maintains the base model's PoseBusters pass rate and attains the best median Vina Score, Vina Min, and Vina Dock, surpassing both the base model and NucleusDiff, with a median of 59.6\% of ligands per pocket binding more strongly than the reference. MLIPDiff thus addresses a limitation of prior methods by generating physically plausible structures with favorable predicted binding affinity using a single frozen model and no additional training.

AI.tldr: MLIPDiff是一种推理时引导方法，利用UMA机器学习原子间势能提供的物理引导，在无需重训练的情况下修正预训练扩散模型生成的配体构象，消除蛋白质-配体碰撞并提升物理合理性与结合亲和力。
AI.motivation: 基于结构的药物设计中，扩散模型主要拟合参考结构，常生成与蛋白发生碰撞、物理上不合理的配体姿态，现有方法难以兼顾消除碰撞与保持局部几何。
AI.method: 提出MLIPDiff推理时引导方法，使用UMA（Universal Models for Atoms）机器学习原子间势能提供物理引导，组合四项加权能量项（蛋白-配体相互作用、配体应变、空间碰撞、口袋锚定），直接作用于原始模型检查点，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在CrossDocked2020上，MLIPDiff完全消除蛋白-配体碰撞，同时保持配体局部几何，改善键长分布与物理合理性；相比NucleusDiff实现无碰撞且不损害局部几何；保持基础模型的PoseBusters通过率，并在Vina Score、Vina Min、Vina Dock中位数上取得最佳，每口袋中位数59.6%的配体结合强于参考结构。
AI.conclusion: MLIPDiff通过单一冻结模型、无需额外训练，解决了先前方法的局限，生成兼具物理合理性与良好预测结合亲和力的结构。

title: SLIDE: Search-to-List Item Distillation for Single-Rollout Generative Retrieval
summary: Generative retrieval (GR) typically relies on item-level beam search to retrieve candidates, leaving cross-item dependencies unmodeled and limiting direct optimization of list-level objectives. A natural alternative is to generate the entire list within a single autoregressive trajectory. However, greedy decoding with directly trained list-wise models substantially underperforms beam search. We identify two contributing factors: the broader search space explored by beam search and the positional bias of scarce positive signals, which deprives later positions of adequate supervision. To address these challenges, we propose $\textbf{SLIDE}$, a search-to-list item distillation framework that decouples offline search from online list generation. A teacher model retrieves high-quality candidates through offline item-level beam search, providing additional conversion-relevant supervision beyond sparse behavioral labels. Their Semantic IDs (SIDs) are then concatenated in beam-score order to form list-wise distillation targets. This search-to-list conversion transforms candidates retrieved along separate search paths into sequential item-generation targets within a single trajectory. Trained on these targets, the student generates the Top-$K$ list in a single greedy pass, also decoupling teacher scaling from online deployment. Experiments on FORGE and Taobao Search show that SLIDE substantially improves retrieval quality under single greedy decoding and, with stronger offline teachers, surpasses the beam-search reference. Supplementary RL experiments support the effectiveness of list-level generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 SLIDE 框架，将离线 item-level beam search 的教师候选按 beam 分数拼接为列表级蒸馏目标，使学生模型可用单次贪心解码生成整个 Top-K 列表，在 FORGE 与淘宝搜索上超过 beam search 参考。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索通常依赖 item-level beam search，未建模跨物品依赖，也难以直接优化列表级目标；而直接在列表级目标上训练的模型用贪心解码又显著劣于 beam search。作者归因于两点：beam search 探索的搜索空间更大，以及稀缺正样本带来的位置偏置使后续位置监督不足。
AI.method: SLIDE 采用 search-to-list 的离线搜索到在线列表生成解耦框架：教师模型通过离线 item-level beam search 检索高质量候选，提供超越稀疏行为标签的转化相关监督；将候选的 Semantic IDs (SIDs) 按 beam 分数顺序拼接成列表级蒸馏目标，把分散在不同搜索路径上的候选转化为单条轨迹内的顺序生成目标；学生模型在这些目标上训练，以一次贪心前向生成 Top-K 列表，同时将教师规模与在线部署解耦。
AI.result: 在 FORGE 和淘宝搜索数据集上，SLIDE 在单次贪心解码下显著提升检索质量，且配合更强的离线教师时超过 beam search 参考基线；补充的强化学习实验进一步支持列表级生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将离线 beam search 的搜索结果蒸馏为列表级序列生成目标，可在保持在线单次贪心解码高效性的同时弥补列表级模型的监督不足与位置偏置问题，实现优于 beam search 的生成式检索。

title: Software Engineering LLMs: Why We Need Them and How Software Engineering Helps Build Them
summary: Software engineering (SE) expertise can shape how coding large language models (LLMs) are trained and which engineering capabilities they acquire. We examine this role through an industrial case study of capability-focused training for a 92B-parameter coding LLM serving more than 100,000 developers. We demonstrate how established SE knowledge can guide the selection of engineering capabilities, the construction of verifiable training data, and the evaluation of model improvements. To target repository-level refactoring, we developed RefactorForge, a pipeline that combines refactoring knowledge, established SE tools, and verification techniques to construct training data. Across 306 Python repositories, RefactorForge generated 5,704 executable tasks and retained 4,572 verified teacher trajectories totaling 72.51 million tokens. Incremental supervised fine-tuning on these trajectories, accounting for 0.46% of the preceding coding mixture's tokens, improved RefactorBench performance by 18.00 percentage points and SWE-Bench ProMax performance by 7.06 points. Under OpenCode, these improvements extended to SWE issue resolution, with gains of 4.97 points on SWE-Bench Verified and 1.23 points on SWE-Bench Pro. Improvements also persisted across other coding-agent harnesses, while greenfield repository generation showed mixed results. We report lessons from constructing capability-focused training data and evaluating its effects across engineering workloads. Building on this industrial experience, we propose a research agenda for expanding SE's role in transforming coding LLMs into SE LLMs: incorporating SE knowledge into model training, applying engineering methods to model development and maintenance, and systematically defining the engineering capabilities these models should acquire.

title: Estimation of Propagated Risk in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) based multi-agent systems introduce a distinctive reliability challenge in which actions taken by upstream agents can affect the correctness of downstream agents. While prior work has investigated error propagation and developed methods for estimating uncertainty inherited from upstream agents, existing approaches do not explicitly model how realized sender-receiver interactions contribute to downstream error risk under different sender correctness states. In this work, we study agent-level error-risk estimation from multi-agent execution traces. We propose Interaction-Effect Propagation (IE-Prop), an interaction-conditioned model that learns separate effects for correct and incorrect upstream agents. For each sender-receiver interaction, the model combines these conditional effects using the sender's estimated error risk, and recursively propagates the resulting risk estimates through the execution graph. We evaluate our approach across three multi-agent architectures and three benchmarks. Across all evaluated architectures, our approach raises the final-node AUROC over the established baseline by approximately 0.05 points on average. Furthermore, tracking risk across multiple agent steps contributes a distinct +0.03 AUROC gain in sequential systems. These results show that realized inter-agent interactions provide predictive information beyond receiver-local evidence, while the value of multi-step risk tracking depends on the system's information-flow structure.

AI.tldr: 提出交互效应传播（IE-Prop），对上游正确/错误状态分别建模发送-接收交互效应，并沿执行图递归传播风险，在多智能体系统中提升最终节点错误风险估计精度。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统存在上游智能体行为影响下游正确性的可靠性问题；已有工作研究误差传播与不确定性继承，但未显式建模"实际发生的发送-接收交互"在不同上游正确状态下对下游错误风险的贡献。
AI.method: 从多智能体执行轨迹做智能体级错误风险估计；提出交互条件化的IE-Prop模型，为正确与错误的上游智能体分别学习独立的交互效应，按发送方的估计错误风险对两种条件效应进行加权组合，并将风险估计沿执行图递归传播。
AI.result: 在3种多智能体架构与3个基准上评测：所有架构下最终节点AUROC较基线平均提升约0.05；在顺序式系统中，多步风险跟踪额外带来+0.03 AUROC增益。
AI.conclusion: 实际的智能体间交互提供了超越接收方局部证据的预测信息；多步风险跟踪的价值取决于系统的信息流结构（在顺序系统中更显著）。

title: Augmentation-Guided Adversarial Training via Local Stability-Based Sample Selection
summary: Adversarial training remains one of the most effective defenses against adversarial attacks, but its standard PGD-based training is computationally expensive because adversarial examples are generated for every training sample. Selective adversarial training reduces this cost by perturbing only a subset of samples. However, existing selective techniques typically rely on point-wise difficulty signals such as loss, entropy, margin, or gradients. We show that these point-wise criteria do not capture local instability in a sample's neighborhood. Motivated by this, we propose Augmentation-Guided Adversarial Training (AGAT), a selective adversarial training framework that uses augmentation-induced local variation to allocate samples with unstable neighborhoods for adversarial training. AGAT ranks samples using Augmentation-based Local Stability (ALS), a lightweight score that measures the normalized change in model logits between an input and its label-preserving augmented variant. Experiments across different architectures on MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet-200 demonstrate that AGAT achieves comparable or higher robust accuracy while applying adversarial supervision to only 20-30% of the training samples in each minibatch. AGAT also requires less training time than all other adversarial training baselines in the computational cost evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 AGAT 选择性对抗训练框架，用增强诱导的局部不稳定性（ALS 分数）筛选 20–30% 样本做对抗训练，在保持或提升鲁棒精度的同时降低训练开销。
AI.motivation: 标准 PGD 对抗训练需对每个样本生成对抗样本，计算代价高；现有选择性对抗训练依赖 loss、熵、margin、梯度等逐点难度信号，无法刻画样本邻域内的局部不稳定性。
AI.method: 以增强诱导的局部变化为依据：计算输入与其保持标签的增强变体之间模型 logits 的归一化变化，得到 Augmentation-based Local Stability (ALS) 轻量分数，据此对样本排序，为邻域不稳定样本分配对抗训练。
AI.result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet-200 上跨多种架构实验：每个 minibatch 仅对 20–30% 样本施加对抗监督即可获得可比或更高的鲁棒精度；计算成本评估中训练时间少于所有对抗训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 局部不稳定性（增强引起的 logits 变化）是比逐点难度更有效的样本选择信号，AGAT 在鲁棒性与训练效率间取得更优折中。

title: CA-HNM: Constraint-Aware Hard Negative Mining for Dense Retrieval with Structured Domain Models
summary: Dense retrievers are commonly trained with hard negatives selected from lexical or dense retrieval results. Retrieval proximity, however, does not indicate whether a candidate conflicts with explicit domain structure. We introduce CA-HNM, a constraint-aware hard-negative mining framework that combines retrieval-based candidate generation with deterministic incompatibility rules derived from a structured domain model. The framework removes known positives, constructs a local typed context around the query target, records relational, scope, target, and level mismatches, and uses the resulting candidates to fine-tune a standard dual encoder. Structured information is required only during offline negative construction. We evaluate CA-HNM on MOOCCubeX and Course-Skill Atlas with two encoders, two training losses, and ten seeds. Relative to a retrieval-rank-matched control, CA-HNM-Pure has higher mean NDCG@10 in six of eight dataset--encoder--loss configurations. Four hierarchical 95% bootstrap intervals are entirely above zero, mostly under triplet loss. In a separate experiment, CA-HNM-Mixed shows slightly higher mean NDCG@10 than a matched-mixed control on both collections. Structural variants show that changes in available structure can also change candidate eligibility and negative-pool composition. The results indicate that the contribution of constraint-aware selection depends on the training objective and the composition of the negative pool.

AI.tldr: 提出约束感知的难负样本挖掘框架 CA-HNM，将检索候选生成与基于结构化领域模型的确定性不相容规则相结合，用于微调双编码器稠密检索器。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密检索器常用词汇或稠密检索结果中的难负样本训练，但"检索邻近性"并不代表候选与显式领域结构相容或冲突，即近邻样本未必是结构上真正的不相容负例，导致负样本质量受限。
AI.method: CA-HNM 框架：检索式候选生成 + 由结构化领域模型导出的确定性不相容规则；流程包括移除已知正例、围绕查询目标构建局部类型化上下文、记录关系/范围/目标/层级四类不匹配，并用所得候选微调标准双编码器。结构化信息仅在离线负例构建阶段使用。在 MOOCCubeX 与 Course-Skill Atlas 上，采用 2 种编码器、2 种损失、10 个随机种子评估；并设置检索排序匹配对照、CA-HNM-Mixed 与匹配混合对照，以及结构变体分析。
AI.result: 相对检索秩匹配对照，CA-HNM-Pure 在 8 个（数据集×编码器×损失）配置中有 6 个取得更高平均 NDCG@10；4 个分层 95% bootstrap 置信区间完全位于零以上，且多出现在 triplet loss 下。CA-HNM-Mixed 在两个数据集上平均 NDCG@10 均略高于匹配混合对照。结构变体显示可用结构的变化会改变候选合格性与负例池组成。
AI.conclusion: 约束感知选择的收益取决于训练目标与负例池组成，并非普遍有效；领域结构信息可作为离线负例构建的有效补充，但不能替代对目标函数和负例构成的考量。

title: ArchGuard-APR: Architecture-Constraint-Aware Multi-Agent Program Repair Using Repository Graphs and Execution Feedback
comment: 29 pages, 10 tables, 7 figures. Exploratory feasibility evaluation. Software, experimental artifacts, and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/majidfeiz/archguard-apr. Preprint record: https://zenodo.org/records/23377965
summary:
Repository-level automated program repair must reason about more than a localized failing statement. A candidate change can satisfy a narrow test while violating dependency boundaries, modifying an unsafe path, or relying on context that omits relevant repository structure. ArchGuard-APR is an architecture-aware repair prototype that integrates deterministic repository analysis, immutable repository graphs, explicit architecture profiles, graph-guided context retrieval, role-based repair orchestration, patch-policy enforcement, isolated execution feedback, provider cost controls, and canonical source-free evidence.
  We evaluate the implemented pipeline through an exploratory paired feasibility study, not a confirmatory effectiveness experiment. Six executions were planned; four completed, and two black-4 conditions ended in pre-provider infrastructure attrition. Across two valid paired tasks, baseline and ArchGuard conditions each produced 0/2 successful repairs, and all four completed outputs were classified as invalid patches.
  The completed executions consumed 35,431 input tokens and 2,737 output tokens, for a total of 38,168 tokens, at a total cost of USD 0.1296325. No effectiveness advantage was observed, and the sample provides no useful inferential basis. The study instead establishes the engineering feasibility of composing architecture constraints with a reproducible repair pipeline and identifies patch validity and infrastructure robustness as the principal targets for future work.

AI.tldr: ArchGuard-APR 是一个架构感知的仓库级自动修复原型，集成确定性仓库分析、不可变仓库图、架构配置、图引导上下文检索和补丁策略等；探索性配对研究仅完成4/6次执行，两个有效配对任务中基线与方法均为0/2修复成功，全部输出被判为无效补丁，未观察到效果优势，但验证了工程可行性。
