The capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) arise from the synergy of the full training pipeline, including data and tokenization, pretraining, and post-training (supervised fine-tuning, preference alignment, reinforcement learning, and continual optimization), rather than any individual stage. Existing surveys mostly adopt a single-stage or single-technique perspective, treating related research as isolated systems without unified stage division or a horizontally comparable basis.
  This paper proposes a unified stage division and a six-dimensional analytical framework covering data, objective function, optimization strategy, system constraints, evaluation, and risk and governance. We systematically review 395 core references from 2017 to 2026, and present a conceptual map of cross-stage effects: forward constraints of pretraining on post-training, and reverse empowerment of post-training on data and pretraining.
  We derive three core findings. First, the comparability of scaling laws depends on data quality and mixture, a long-neglected variable. Second, preference alignment methods (RLHF, DPO) and reasoning reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards redefine post-training boundaries, while the Pass@1 versus Pass@K debate remains unresolved. Third, multimodal training poses structural challenges to the pure-text paradigm in tokenizer design, training objectives, and evaluation.
  The paper provides a cross-stage effects diagram, a method-family map, a practical decision tree, and at least 10 verifiable open problems, with an extensible skeleton for focused sub-surveys per stage. As of the retrieval date, peer-reviewed evidence (A+B) accounts for approximately 79% of the 395 references.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出统一的训练阶段划分与六维分析框架，系统梳理2017–2026年395篇核心文献，构建跨阶段效应概念图（预训练对后训练的前向约束、后训练对数据与预训练的反向赋能），并给出三条核心发现、方法族地图、实用决策树与至少10个可验证开放问题。
AI.motivation: LLM与MLLM的能力源自数据与分词、预训练、后训练（SFT、偏好对齐、强化学习、持续优化）全流程的协同，而非单一阶段；现有综述多采取单阶段或单技术视角，将相关研究视为孤立系统，缺乏统一阶段划分与横向可比基准。
AI.method: 提出统一阶段划分与覆盖数据、目标函数、优化策略、系统约束、评估、风险与治理的六维分析框架；系统综述395篇核心参考文献（2017–2026），构建跨阶段效应概念图，并产出方法族地图与实用决策树。
AI.result: 得出三点核心发现：(1) 缩放定律的可比性依赖长期被忽视的数据质量与配比变量；(2) 偏好对齐方法（RLHF、DPO）与带可验证奖励的推理强化学习重塑了后训练边界，而Pass@1与Pass@K之争仍未定论；(3) 多模态训练在分词器设计、训练目标与评估三方面对纯文本范式构成结构性挑战。截至检索日，395篇文献中经同行评审证据（A+B类）约占79%。
AI.conclusion: 该文以跨阶段视角整合分散研究，提供跨阶段效应图、方法族地图、决策树与至少10个可验证开放问题，并为各阶段的专题子综述提供可扩展骨架，从而为横向比较与后续研究奠定统一基础。

title: Performance Gaps Between Open-Loop, Certainty-Equivalent, and Optimal Control Under Action-Dependent Observations
summary: In dynamical systems, feedback can improve performance by allowing decisions to depend on past observations, rather than being designed a priori. Under full observation, the current state is sufficient for decision-making; under partial observation, the controller must instead estimate the state from measurements. When actions also affect observations, control can have a dual role: actions influence both the state and the information available for future decisions. This interaction can invalidate certainty-equivalent (CE) control, a widely used strategy that applies state feedback policies as if the estimated state were the true state. We ask when this suboptimality leads to a quantitative performance gap that grows with the horizon. We study this question in a linear-quadratic system with bilinear observations by comparing the optimal policy, certainty-equivalent control, and the optimal open-loop (OL) policy. We identify an instance-dependent information-strength parameter $q$ and establish distinct performance regimes as $q$ varies. When $q$ is sufficiently small, we show that no policy can improve over OL control by more than $O(1)$ cumulative cost. For large values of $q$, we find that CE achieves an $Ω(T)$ advantage over OL control. Our main finding is that for intermediate values of $q$, we can construct a policy that occasionally probes for information and achieves an $Ω(T)$ advantage over OL control while CE only achieves an $O(1)$ advantage, establishing an $Ω(T)$ gap between CE and optimal control. Our analysis relies on a regret decomposition that captures the tradeoff between the immediate cost of gathering information and its future benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带双线性观测的线性二次系统中"对偶控制"的价值：构造依赖于信息强度参数q的性能区间，证明当q处于中间值时，存在偶尔主动探测信息的策略相对开环控制取得Ω(T)优势，而确定性等价（CE）控制仅取得O(1)优势，从而首次刻画了CE与最优控制之间随horizon线性增长的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 部分观测下动作同时影响状态与未来可获得的信息，控制具有"对偶作用"，可能使广泛使用的确定性等价（CE）策略不再最优。然而此前缺乏对该次优性是否会造成随horizon增长的数量级性能差距的明确刻画，本文正是要回答"何时这种差距是显著的"这一问题。
AI.method: 在带双线性观测的线性二次（LQ）系统中，比较最优策略、确定性等价控制与最优开环（OL）策略；引入依赖于具体实例的信息强度参数q，并基于一种"regret分解"，刻画信息采集的即时成本与未来收益之间的权衡。
AI.result: 随q变化呈现三类性能区间：q足够小时，任何策略相对OL控制的累积成本改进不超过O(1)；q较大时，CE相对OL控制可获得Ω(T)优势；q取中间值时，可构造偶尔探测信息的策略相对OL取得Ω(T)优势，而CE仅取得O(1)优势，由此确立CE与最优控制之间存在Ω(T)的差距。
AI.conclusion: 对偶控制的价值是实例依赖且分区间显现的：在中等信息强度区间，主动探测（信息采集）是必要的，CE因缺乏探测而只能获得常数级收益，与最优策略相差Ω(T)。这表明CE在存在对偶作用的场景中可能严重次优，需显式建模信息的获取价值。

title: Towards a Unified Framework of Optimal Input-Side Dimensional Configuration for Deep CTR Prediction
summary: Deep click-through rate (CTR) prediction has achieved substantial success through increasingly expressive feature interaction architectures. However, predictive performance also depends on how input-side information is configured before interaction modeling. Existing studies have shown that selecting informative samples, features, or embedding units can improve prediction accuracy. Nevertheless, they primarily optimize these selection mechanisms independently along a single input-side dimension, overlooking their shared basic form and the inherent dependencies across input levels, thereby limiting the effectiveness of input-side dimensional configuration. To address this issue, we propose OptIDC, a unified framework for Optimal Input-side Dimensional Configuration in deep CTR prediction. OptIDC jointly learns sample, feature, and embedding-unit level configurations within a unified framework by integrating their corresponding selection mechanisms. To explicitly coordinate selection decisions across different levels, OptIDC further introduces a selection-weighted Optimal Transport mechanism that aligns coarse- and fine-grained selections via transport over finite measures, thereby alleviating cross-level selection conflicts while preserving the semantics of each input level. Moreover, OptIDC is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTR models. Extensive experiments on four real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that OptIDC consistently achieves higher AUC than existing input-side selection methods, validating the effectiveness of unified input-side dimensional configuration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OptIDC统一框架，在深度CTR预测中联合学习样本级、特征级与嵌入单元级的输入侧配置，并通过选择加权最优传输机制协调跨层级选择决策，在四个真实数据集上取得更高AUC。
AI.motivation: 现有输入侧选择研究（样本选择、特征选择、嵌入单元选择）各自沿单一维度独立优化，忽视了它们共享的基本形式以及输入层级间的固有依赖，限制了输入侧维度配置的整体效果。
AI.method: 构建统一框架OptIDC，集成样本、特征、嵌入单元三个层级的对应选择机制进行联合学习；引入选择加权的最优传输（Selection-weighted Optimal Transport）机制，在有限测度上进行传输以对齐粗粒度与细粒度选择，缓解跨层级选择冲突并保持各层级语义；框架与模型无关，可无缝集成到现有CTR模型。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，OptIDC的AUC持续高于现有输入侧选择方法，验证了统一输入侧维度配置的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 统一建模输入侧多层级选择并显式协调层级间依赖关系，可有效提升深度CTR预测性能，为输入侧维度配置提供了通用且可插拔的解决方案。

title: Developer Task Delegation to LLMs and the Trust Factor: A Mixed Methods Study
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 49th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE'27)
summary: With the rise of Large Language Models (LLMs), software developers are presented with a powerful new approach: delegating software development tasks to LLMs. Existing studies have explored task delegation for a subset of tasks and factors. Critically, what tasks developers delegate to LLMs, to what extent, and why they delegate them, is not yet well understood. We explore these questions through 22 interviews and a survey with 160 software practitioners. Developers reported employing four modes of task delegation to LLMs: full delegation, partial delegation, self-delegation, and task avoidance. Drawing on our qualitative findings, we discuss the rationales behind these choices and explore how task difficulty, task risk, developer motivation, and trust appear to be associated with software development task delegation to LLMs. Our statistical analysis reveals that trust is a significant factor associated with task delegation to LLMs. Finally, we share actionable implications for human-AI collaboration in software research, and for software practitioners to make the most of their newly found powers of delegation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过22次访谈和160名从业者的问卷调查，识别出开发者向LLM委托软件开发任务的四种模式（完全委托、部分委托、自我委托、任务回避），并发现信任是影响委托决策的显著因素。
AI.motivation: LLM兴起使开发者可将软件开发任务委托给模型，但既有研究仅覆盖部分任务与因素，对开发者委托何种任务、委托程度及委托原因缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：22次定性访谈结合160名软件从业者的问卷调查；基于质性发现归纳委托模式并提出解释性因素，再用统计分析检验因素与委托行为的关系。
AI.result: 开发者呈现四种任务委托模式：完全委托、部分委托、自我委托与任务回避；任务难度、任务风险、开发者动机与信任被识别为与委托决策相关的因素，其中信任在统计分析中为显著因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示开发者向LLM委托任务的方式与动因，为软件工程领域人机协作研究提供方向，并为从业者高效利用委托能力提供可操作建议。

title: LegoSR: A Unified Framework for Self-improving Agent-Guided Scientific Discovery
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/Scientific-Artificial-Intelligence-Lab/kd
summary: Equation discovery solvers often use different data interfaces, equation representations and evaluation criteria, making their results difficult to compare. We present LegoSR, a unified framework for algebraic symbolic regression and differential equation discovery. LegoSR integrates seven solvers through a common equation representation and evaluation process, and supports searches constrained by partially known equations. Researchers can run solvers directly or use LegoSR Agent, which selects solvers and adapts searches based on solver knowledge, intermediate results and lessons from earlier tasks. On noisy ordinary and partial differential equation benchmarks, LegoSR Agent recovers nearly as many equations as the union of seven expert-tuned solvers and outperforms a generic agent with the same model, tools and budget by up to 29 percentage points. Three examples demonstrate basic use, adaptive solver selection and discovery guided by partial physical knowledge.

AI.tldr: LegoSR 是一个统一的方程发现（符号回归与微分方程发现）框架，通过共享的方程表示与评测流程集成七个求解器，并配有一个能自适应选择求解器与搜索策略的 LegoSR Agent。
AI.motivation: 现有方程发现求解器在数据接口、方程表示与评价准则上各不相同，导致结果难以横向比较，也阻碍了求解器的组合使用与知识复用。
AI.method: 提出统一框架 LegoSR：以公共方程表示与统一评测流程整合七个求解器，支持"部分已知方程"作为约束的搜索；同时提供 LegoSR Agent，依据求解器知识、中间结果以及先前任务的经验教训来选择求解器并调整搜索策略。
AI.result: 在含噪声的常微分与偏微分方程基准上，LegoSR Agent 恢复的方程数量接近七个专家调参求解器的并集，在相同模型、工具与预算条件下最多优于通用 Agent 29 个百分点；并通过三个案例展示了基本用法、自适应求解器选择与部分物理知识引导的发现。
AI.conclusion: 统一表示与统一评测是提升方程发现可比性与可组合性的有效途径，基于经验的智能体调度可在不增加预算的前提下接近多专家调参的集成效果。

title: An Empirical Study of Reinforcement Learning Scaling Laws
summary: The discovery of scaling laws enables prediction of the performance, the optimal resource allocation strategy, and the best hyperparameter configuration of a large-scale training job based on inexpensive experiments at smaller scales. Guided by these empirical scaling laws, the deep learning community has achieved great success in training large (self-)supervised models on Internet-scale datasets. In contrast, despite its potential and wide application, reinforcement learning (RL) has yet to find a guiding principle for predictable scaling. In this work, we conduct an empirical study of RL scaling laws of an actor-critic algorithm in two procedurally generated environments, Starpilot and Craftax. We discover empirical scaling laws with strong predictive performance in both environments. The discovered scaling laws accurately predict the aforementioned three quantities for larger-scale training jobs up to two orders of magnitude in total training compute. In particular, we employ a variant of Elo scores for the single-agent RL paradigm as an alternative performance metric than the commonly used mean episode return. Our results show that the Elo score is a much more predictable metric than the mean episode return, making it a better choice for fitting scaling laws. By applying our discovered scaling laws to increase training compute, we establish a new state of the art in the challenging Craftax environment. Beneath the surface of the global scaling trend, we also observe a non-monotonic scaling pattern of the compute-optimal model size in Craftax. We connect this observation to a pathology known as Ray interference.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了actor-critic算法的RL scaling law，发现以Elo分数为性能指标可得到高预测性的缩放律，并据此在Craftax上取得新SOTA，同时揭示计算最优模型规模的非单调缩放模式并与Ray interference病理相联系。
AI.motivation: 监督/自监督学习的scaling law已能预测性能、最优资源分配与最佳超参，但强化学习尚缺乏可预测缩放的指导原则，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在两个程序生成环境Starpilot与Craftax中对actor-critic算法开展实证缩放研究；采用单智能体RL的Elo分数变体替代平均episode回报作为性能指标以拟合缩放律；并将发现的缩放律用于扩大训练计算量。
AI.result: 所发现的缩放律在两个环境中预测性强，可在高达两个数量级的总训练计算量范围内准确预测性能、最优资源分配与最佳超参；Elo分数比平均episode回报更可预测；扩大计算后在Craftax上刷新SOTA；观察到计算最优模型规模的非单调模式，并关联到Ray interference病理。
AI.conclusion: Elo分数是拟合RL缩放律的更优指标，RL可获得与监督学习相当的预测性缩放律；全局缩放趋势下仍存在由Ray interference导致的非单调计算最优模型规模现象，值得进一步研究。

title: Do Similarity Measures Measure Similarity? How User Activity Creates Phantom Correlation in Recommender Systems
summary: Item-item similarity is one of the oldest and most foundational signals in recommender systems: two items are assumed to be similar when the same users consume them. Despite the sparsity and scale of interaction data, the implicit assumption across the field is that item co-occurrence reflects genuine shared preference, capturing what users like together. In this paper, we demonstrate that a substantial fraction of observed item-item similarity is an artifact of variance in user activity rather than shared taste. Even if every user consumed items completely independently, differing only in their total consumption volume, standard similarity measures still detect strong associations between items. We term this phenomenon phantom correlation: spurious item association that emerges strictly from heterogeneous user activity in the complete absence of preference structure. Starting from minimal formal assumptions, we show that independent consumption under varying activity is described by a Rasch model, and we derive how the resulting association depends on item popularity for each similarity measure. By comparing our theoretical baseline against real-world benchmark datasets, we reveal the extent to which popular similarity measures reflect phantom correlation, which bears on how item co-occurrence is interpreted and used in collaborative filtering.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，item-item 相似度中相当一部分并非真实共同偏好，而是由用户活跃度异质性造成的“幻影相关”（phantom correlation）：即使所有用户在完全独立地消费、仅消费量不同，标准相似度度量仍会检测出强关联。作者以 Rasch 模型刻画这一零假设基线，推导各相似度度量下关联随物品流行度的依赖形式，并与真实基准数据集对比，量化流行相似度度量中幻影相关的占比。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中 item-item 相似度长期被默认为“共同消费即共同偏好”的信号，但交互数据稀疏且规模庞大，这一隐含假设缺乏检验。作者质疑共现是否真的反映共享品味，怀疑其部分来自用户活跃度的异质性，需建立无偏好结构下的理论基线来判断相似度度量的真实含义。
AI.method: 从最小形式化假设出发，证明在用户活跃度不同但消费相互独立的条件下，消费过程由 Rasch 模型描述；据此推导各类标准相似度度量下物品关联强度对物品流行度的解析依赖，形成理论零假设基线；再将理论基线与真实基准数据集上观测到的相似度进行比较分析。
AI.result: 理论推导显示，即便完全不存在偏好结构，仅由活跃度方差即可产生显著的物品关联；真实数据与理论基线的对比表明，若干常用相似度度量中有相当比例的相似度可归因于幻影相关，且该比例因度量形式和物品流行度而异。
AI.conclusion: item-item 共现的解读需谨慎：标准相似度并非纯粹偏好信号，而混杂了活跃度异质性带来的虚假关联。这为协同过滤中相似度的解释与使用（如去偏、归一化或基线校正）提供了理论依据与评估框架。

title: EAST: Embodied AI Safety Testing via Systematic Fault Injection in Digital Twins
summary: Task success is not a sufficient measure of safety for embodied artificial intelligence (AI), because robots may complete objectives while violating safety requirements. Existing evaluations often emphasize performance and robustness, but lack a systematic route from documented safety hazards to executable, verifiable tests. We present EAST (Embodied AI Safety Testing), a digital-twin framework that converts literature-grounded safety evidence into fault-injection tests across perception, instructions, environments, actions, and timing. EAST combines an expert-reviewed safety-fault taxonomy and eight executable operators with applicability and validity constraints. Its three-stage workflow generates test specifications, verifies fault realization during simulated execution, and independently assesses safety challenges, violations, task outcomes, and behavioral signatures using simulator-state evidence. The framework preserves execution traces and replayable records, supporting attribution and reproducibility across experiments. We evaluate EAST on six RoboTwin manipulation tasks and two policy architectures, ACT and RDT, against alternative testing strategies under matched budgets. Across five comparative campaigns, EAST targets all 74 admissible task-policy-operator combinations and obtains valid evidence for 63, while achieving safety-challenge exposure rates close to Random-Legal and Rule-Based. Moreover, 82 valid EAST executions complete their tasks despite safety violations, revealing risks concealed by success-oriented evaluation. These findings support systematic, validity-aware, reproducible safety testing beyond task-completion metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出EAST数字孪生框架，将文献安全证据转化为可执行、可验证的故障注入测试，覆盖感知、指令、环境、动作与时机五个维度，以弥补任务成功率无法反映具身AI安全性的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 任务成功并不能充分衡量具身AI的安全性——机器人可能在违反安全约束的情况下完成任务。现有评测侧重性能与鲁棒性，缺少从已记录安全隐患到可执行、可验证测试的系统化路径。
AI.method: EAST由三部分组成：(1) 经专家审核的安全故障分类法 + 8个可执行故障算子，并附适用性与有效性约束；(2) 三阶段工作流：生成测试规范→在仿真执行中验证故障确实被实现→基于仿真器状态证据独立评估安全挑战、违规、任务结果与行为特征；(3) 保留执行轨迹与可重放记录以支持归因与可复现性。在RoboTwin的6个操作任务、ACT与RDT两种策略架构上，与替代测试策略在等预算下对比。
AI.result: 五组对比实验中，EAST覆盖全部74个可接受的任务-策略-算子组合，其中63个获得有效证据；安全挑战暴露率接近Random-Legal与Rule-Based方法。另有82次有效的EAST执行在发生安全违规的同时仍完成任务，揭示了以成功为导向的评测所掩盖的风险。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持超越任务完成度指标，开展系统化、有效性感知且可复现的具身AI安全测试。

title: The Future Is Finer: Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting
summary: Web platforms run on multivariate time series, from service telemetry and Web traffic logs to sensor streams served through Web APIs. Yet, retention policies often archive them at coarse granularity to save storage and bandwidth. Decisions such as autoscaling, alerting, and billing operate at finer granularity than existing forecasters reach, since these models predict at the resolution of their input. We therefore introduce Multivariate Time Series Super-Resolution Forecasting (MTS-SRF), which forecasts fine-grained futures from coarse histories, and propose TimeMagnifier to address its three challenges. Fourier Anchor counters data sparsity by fitting each input window to a trend-Fourier structure with sparse cross-variable gating; De-noise Only constrains fine-grained ambiguity by refining along the resolution axis rather than the noise axis, lengthening the grid level by level; and banded DTW Alignment corrects cross-resolution misalignment against the coarse forecast. On the first MTS-SRF benchmark, with ten datasets from five domains, real archived cross-resolution pairs, strengthened baseline adaptations, and five-seed significance tests, TimeMagnifier is best on every dataset, resolution coefficient, and metric against 15 baselines and cuts MSE by 12.3% on average. Its De-noise Only and DTW stages also transfer as a plug-in that lowers the MSE of existing forecasters by 5.1% to 9.0%. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出多变量时间序列超分辨率预测（MTS-SRF）任务，并给出TimeMagnifier模型，从粗粒度历史预测细粒度未来。
AI.motivation: Web平台的多变量时序常因存储与带宽限制被粗粒度归档，而自动扩缩容、告警、计费等决策需要更细粒度的预测；现有预测器只能按输入分辨率输出，无法实现细粒度外推。
AI.method: TimeMagnifier针对三项挑战设计：Fourier Anchor通过趋势-Fourier结构与稀疏跨变量门控拟合每个输入窗口以应对数据稀疏；De-noise Only沿分辨率轴而非噪声轴逐级加密网格，约束细粒度歧义；banded DTW Alignment针对粗粒度预测校正跨分辨率错位。
AI.result: 构建首个MTS-SRF基准（5个领域10个数据集、真实跨分辨率配对、强化的基线适配、五种子显著性检验）；TimeMagnifier在全部数据集、分辨率系数和指标上优于15个基线，MSE平均降低12.3%；De-noise Only与DTW阶段可作为插件使现有预测器MSE降低5.1%–9.0%。
AI.conclusion: 粗粒度历史可支撑细粒度预测，跨分辨率对齐与逐级细化是关键；相关模块具备良好可迁移性。

title: Exact Unlearning After Data Curation
summary: Training pipelines often remove similar examples before fitting a model. Deleting a raw record can change that selection and admit an example that was excluded before. What must a service retain to reproduce training after such requests? We answer this question for a fixed rule in which earlier similar records block later ones. A limit on the total number of future deletions identifies exactly which records can still enter training. We use this boundary to build a summary of training statistics that can be repaired exactly after repeated deletions. The repaired summary is the same as rebuilding it on the surviving data with the remaining budget. We also construct finite-precision features for ridge regression, a linear learner with a penalty on coefficient size. With exact rational outputs, allowing one more deletion changes the required private information. It rises from zero to every private feature sign in the excluded candidates. An encoding attains this conditional private-information minimum on the constructed family throughout a sequence of requests. On 1,001 AskUbuntu development records, deleting an initially excluded record admits another record at 13 of 51 fixed similarity cutoffs. Exact membership repair passes 13,056 deletion-step checks. Two model-based semantic calibrations fail their fixed criteria, so the downstream task study is not run. The central result is a retention contract: the future deletions a service promises to support determine which excluded data can still be needed.

AI.tldr: 论文研究去重式训练流水线中删除请求后的可复现训练问题：以"未来删除总数上限"刻画哪些被排除记录仍可能进入训练，据此构造可精确修复的训练统计摘要与隐私最小化的岭回归特征编码。
AI.motivation: 训练前去除相似样本的流程中，删除一条原始记录会改变去重选择，使此前被排除的样本重新入选。服务方需明确：收到删除请求后要保留哪些信息才能复现训练，以及在精确输出下隐私信息需求如何变化。
AI.method: 针对"先出现者阻塞后出现者"的固定去重规则，引入未来删除总数上限来确定仍可能进入训练的记录边界；据此构建可在反复删除后精确修复的训练统计摘要；并为带系数惩罚的线性学习器（岭回归）构造有限精度特征编码，分析条件隐私信息下界并给出达到该下界的编码。
AI.result: 修复后的摘要等价于在存活数据与剩余预算上重建的结果；精确有理输出下，多允许一次删除会使所需私有信息从零升至被排除候选中全部私有特征符号。在1,001条AskUbuntu开发记录上，删除一条初始被排除记录会在51个固定相似度阈值中的13个处使另一条记录入选；精确成员修复通过13,056次删除步校验；两项基于模型的语义校准未达固定标准，故下游任务研究未开展。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论为"保留契约"：服务承诺支持的未来删除数量决定了哪些被排除数据仍可能被需要，从而同时界定可复现性所需保留范围与隐私信息的最小需求。

title: ACARE: Agent-Context-Aware Reranker for Iterative Search
summary: In agentic search, a document can match an agent-generated sub-query without helping answer the user's original question. Conventional rerankers score documents against the sub-query alone, overlooking the broader task and the agent's reasoning. We introduce the Agent-Context-Aware Reranker (ACARe), a compact 4B LLM trained to rerank documents using this context when available. Across multiple benchmarks and agent families, ACARe improves retrieval quality over its base reranker while reducing search effort. These benefits extend to answer generation: ACARe improves accuracy and reduces searches over no reranking, while matching or exceeding the base reranker's mean accuracy with more precise evidence. It also helps smaller agents narrow the retrieval-quality gap to larger agents, showing how better retrieval tools can make smaller agents more effective. The model, training data, and code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agent-Context-Aware Reranker（ACARe），一个 4B 参数的重排模型，在 agentic search 中利用 agent 推理与原始问题等上下文对文档重排，在多个基准与 agent 家族上同时提升检索质量并减少检索开销。
AI.motivation: agentic search 中，文档可能匹配 agent 生成的子查询却无助于回答用户原始问题；传统重排器仅按子查询打分，忽略整体任务与 agent 推理过程，导致检索引入噪声、检索步数膨胀。
AI.method: 训练一个紧凑的 4B LLM 作为上下文感知重排器，在可用时以 agent 上下文（原始问题与 agent 推理/子查询）为条件对候选文档重排，而非仅依赖子查询。
AI.result: 在多个基准与多类 agent 家族上，ACARe 相较基础重排器提升检索质量并降低检索开销；在答案生成上优于无重排设置（准确率提升、检索次数减少），平均准确率与基础重排器持平或更优且证据更精准；还能缩小小模型 agent 与大模型 agent 的检索质量差距。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知重排可同时改善检索效率与下游答案质量，并说明更好的检索工具能提升较小 agent 的有效性；模型、训练数据与代码将开源。

title: ComBeautify: Leveraging Code Change Summaries for Conventional Commit Generation
summary:
Modern software development relies on version control systems such as Git to track changes and facilitate collaboration. While commit messages are crucial for conveying developer intent, they do not affect program functionality; as a result, developers often lack motivation to write meaningful ones. The Conventional Commits Specification (CCS) addresses this with a structured format and guidelines that help developers express the intent of a change, improving clarity and enabling automation. Yet, developers frequently struggle to express intent while adhering to the format. In particular, they may misclassify commits due to the large number of possible categories or the lack of project-specific guidance. We introduce ComBeautify, an approach that automatically generates CCS-compliant commit messages. Our hybrid approach leverages context-preserving summarization of Git diffs with large language models (LLMs) to improve commit classification accuracy under CCS. Rather than relying on manually curated category definitions, we learn them from historical commits. We also propose a method for automatically generating the CCS description component.
  Our empirical evaluation across 13 languages, 6,500 open-source repositories, and over 20 million commits provides long-term insights into CCS adoption, revealing increasing compliance. Our evaluation on twenty popular repositories reveals the limitations of approaches guided by generic category definitions, and shows that ComBeautify, when trained on project-specific data, outperforms baselines by up to 3x. Additionally, using a dataset of 2,000 manually curated commits, we validate our summarization approach, achieving up to 95.25% accuracy and surpassing baselines. These findings emphasize the need for adaptable, context-aware AI methods for commit classification and CCS-compliant commit message generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ComBeautify，基于 LLM 的保持上下文敏感的 Git diff 摘要与项目特定类别学习，自动生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的提交信息，在提交分类上较基线最高提升 3 倍。
AI.motivation: 提交信息不影响程序功能，开发者缺乏撰写动力；Conventional Commits 规范（CCS）虽提供结构化格式以表达变更意图并支持自动化，但开发者常因类别繁多、缺乏项目特定指导而难以正确分类或遵循格式。
AI.method: 混合方法：利用 LLM 对 Git diff 进行保持上下文的摘要，以提升 CCS 下的提交分类准确率；不依赖人工定义的类别，而是从历史提交中学习项目特定的类别定义；并提出自动生成 CCS description 组件的方法。评估覆盖 13 种语言、6,500 个开源仓库、2,000 万+ 提交。
AI.result: 长期分析显示 CCS 采用率与合规性持续上升；在 20 个流行仓库上，通用类别定义引导的方法存在局限，而基于项目特定数据训练的 ComBeautify 较基线最高提升 3 倍；在 2,000 条人工标注提交上验证摘要方法，准确率达 95.25%，优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明需要可适配、上下文感知的 AI 方法用于提交分类与 CCS 合规提交信息生成。

title: SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents
comment: 70 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
summary: Skill learning enables web agents to reuse prior experience for long-horizon interactive tasks. However, learned skills are typically evaluated in closed environments, overlooking the fact that real-world web deployment involves continuous shifts in invocation context, perceptual grounding, and execution feasibility. To this end, we introduce SkillShift-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating skill learning with controlled open-environment shifts. SkillShift-Bench simulates Contextual Shift, Perceptual Shift, and Execution Shift across three self-hosted web systems, and evaluates agents with diagnostics covering task success, interaction cost, skill use, and skill failure. Comprehensive experiments reveal systematic robustness degradation under controlled shifts, characterized by lower success rates, higher interaction costs, and more frequent skill failures, with Execution Shift exerting the strongest pressure. We further formulate shifted skill execution as a nonstationary local executability problem and provide both a dynamic-regret analysis and a practical test-time adaptation method, demonstrating the feasibility of improving learned-skill execution without relearning the skill library. Code, tasks, environments, documentation, and the leaderboard are available at https://skillshift-bench.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SkillShift-Bench，首个在受控开放环境漂移下评测 web agent 技能学习的基准，模拟上下文漂移、感知漂移与执行漂移，并从任务成功率、交互成本、技能使用与技能失败四个维度进行诊断评估。
AI.motivation: 现有技能学习研究通常在封闭环境中评测 agent 学到的技能，而真实 web 部署中调用上下文、感知定位与执行可行性会持续变化，导致对技能鲁棒性的评估存在盲区。
AI.method: 在三个自托管 web 系统中构建可控的 Contextual Shift、Perceptual Shift 与 Execution Shift；设计覆盖任务成功率、交互成本、技能使用与技能失败的诊断式评测；并将漂移下的技能执行形式化为非平稳局部可执行性问题，给出动态后悔（dynamic-regret）分析与一种测试时自适应方法。
AI.result: 实验显示受控漂移下存在系统性的鲁棒性退化：成功率下降、交互成本上升、技能失败更频繁，其中 Execution Shift 带来的压力最强；所提测试时自适应方法无需重新学习技能库即可改善技能执行效果。
AI.conclusion: 技能学习需在开放、漂移环境中评估；SkillShift-Bench 提供了标准化基准与诊断维度，并证明通过理论刻画与测试时自适应可提升已有技能的跨漂移可执行性。

title: From Intelligence to Autonomy: Foundations and Construction of Autonomous Agents for Future Intelligent Systems
summary: Artificial intelligence is moving from one-off perception and generation tasks toward long-term planning, tool use, and interaction with real environments. Greater task competence, however, does not automatically yield autonomy: an external actor may still have to set goals, sustain operating conditions, detect failures, and approve updates. We define an autonomous agent as a system that, within explicit identity and authority boundaries, maintains both task goals and viability conditions, acts continuously using models of the world and itself, and adjusts its control mechanisms and long-term capabilities through feedback. We trace the conceptual path from homeostasis and feedback control to autopoiesis and biological autonomy. We then distinguish six lines of operationalization: computational autopoiesis, behavior-based robotics, agent formalization, adaptive software, embodied adaptation, and robotic self-modeling. On this basis, we propose a one-boundary, four-loop framework in which Operational, Viability, Reflexive, and Learning loops organize task execution, self-maintenance, metacontrol, and governed learning. Five paired simulation experiments test permission constraints, road-closure response, health maintenance, capability re-estimation, and cross-task learning. Their results provide preliminary evidence for the feasibility of these mechanisms, while broader environments and physical systems remain to be tested.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"自主智能体"的定义，梳理从稳态调节到生物自主性的概念脉络并区分六条操作化路线，进而提出"一边界、四环路"框架，并用五组配对仿真实验初步验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: AI正从一次性感知与生成任务转向长期规划、工具使用和真实环境交互，但更强的任务能力并不自动带来自主性：外部主体仍需设定目标、维持运行条件、检测故障并批准更新。因此需要明确界定"自主智能体"并给出可操作化的实现框架。
AI.method: 概念分析＋框架构建＋仿真验证。界定自主智能体为：在明确身份与权限边界内同时维持任务目标与生存/存续条件、基于世界模型与自我模型持续行动、并通过反馈调节控制机制与长期能力的系统；追溯 homeostasis、反馈控制、autopoiesis 与生物自主性的思想谱系；区分六条操作化路线（计算自创生、行为机器人学、智能体形式化、自适应软件、具身适应、机器人自我建模）；提出"一边界、四环路"框架，即 Operational、Viability、Reflexive、Learning 四类环分别负责任务执行、自我维持、元控制与受治理的学习。
AI.result: 五组配对仿真实验分别检验权限约束、道路封闭响应、健康维持、能力再估计与跨任务学习；结果为上述机制提供了初步可行性证据，但更广泛的环境与物理系统仍有待测试。
AI.conclusion: 自主性应被理解为在身份与权限边界内对任务目标与存续条件的双重维持，并可通过"一边界、四环路"加以结构化实现；现有仿真证据仅为初步，泛化性与真实物理环境验证是后续工作的关键。

title: MulFCoder: Framework-conditioned Multi-agent for MLLM-based Multi-framework Front-end Code Generation
summary: Generating runnable front-end code from UI screenshots is a long-standing goal in automated software engineering. Existing MLLM-based methods predominantly focused on HTML/CSS, leaving multi-framework generation for React/Vue/Angular underexplored. Naively modifying prompts leads to substantial performance gaps across multi-framework and highly framework-specific error modes. To address this, we propose MulFCoder, a framework-conditioned multi-agent method that explicitly encodes framework constraints to bring multi-framework differences into a decidable rule space. MulFCoder orchestrates four agents: Grounder constructs an ElementTable, ContentTable, and macro-layout regions from detected UI elements; Planner builds a DOM-like hierarchical layout tree, produces a task schedule, and derives a framework-specific file Contract; Writer generates structured file writes or patches within a restricted edit window; Judger enforces lightweight, framework-conditioned constraints to accept or reject updates and trigger bounded repairs, preventing drift and deadlocks without expensive builds. Experiments demonstrate that MulFCoder substantially improves compilation success rate and reduces framework-specific errors, with particularly pronounced gains on Angular.

AI.tldr: MulFCoder：框架条件化的多智能体方法，从UI截图生成React/Vue/Angular可运行前端代码。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的截图转代码方法主要针对HTML/CSS，多框架（React/Vue/Angular）生成研究不足；仅修改提示词会在多框架间产生显著性能差距，并出现大量框架特有的错误模式。
AI.method: 提出框架条件化的多智能体方法MulFCoder，将框架约束显式编码，使多框架差异转化为可判定的规则空间。四个智能体：Grounder从检测到的UI元素构建ElementTable、ContentTable与宏布局区域；Planner构建类DOM层级布局树、生成任务调度并推导框架特定的文件Contract；Writer在受限编辑窗口内产出结构化文件写入或补丁；Judger以轻量、框架条件化约束接受或拒绝更新并触发有界修复，避免漂移与死锁且无需昂贵构建。
AI.result: 实验表明MulFCoder显著提升编译成功率并减少框架特有错误，在Angular上增益尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过将框架约束形式化为可判定规则并配合多智能体分工与轻量校验反馈，可有效实现多框架前端代码生成。

title: FraudSociety: A Generative Agent-Based Society for the Financial-Fraud Economy
summary: Financial fraud caused over \$15.9 billion in losses in the United States in 2025, according to the Federal Trade Commission~\citep{ftc2026databook}. Understanding such large-scale harm requires jointly modeling informational and financial dynamics. Yet existing simulators typically capture only one side of this interaction, leaving a gap in modeling how fraud unfolds in the real world. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textsc{FraudSociety}, the first LLM-agent-based simulator that jointly models these coupled dynamics. It integrates a dynamic social environment for information exposure and communication, persistent financial ledgers that preserve payment and loss histories, and a Need-Intent-Action architecture for civilian decision making. Fraudsters further adapt their communication and financial actions to individual interaction histories and ledger states, forming a closed feedback loop between the two dynamics. We validate \textsc{FraudSociety} across macro-level outcomes, micro-level behavior, and intervention effects. At the macro level, the simulated fraud outcomes closely match real-world patterns across multiple key statistics. At the micro level, it reproduces strong loss concentration, with the top 10\% of victimization records accounting for 81.1\% of total losses, consistent with Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre statistics~\citep{cafc2025annual}. Counter-fraud experiments further reveal variation across intervention strategies, with the best-performing personalized intervention reducing the repeat-payment rate from 49.4\% to 10.9\%. These results establish \textsc{FraudSociety} as both a high-fidelity simulator and a scalable testbed for evaluating anti-fraud strategies under diverse intervention conditions, thereby advancing research on financial fraud and its prevention.

AI.tldr: 提出 FraudSociety——首个基于 LLM 智能体、联合建模信息动态与资金动态的金融诈骗模拟器，并在宏观结果、微观行为与干预效果三个层面完成验证。
AI.motivation: 2025 年美国金融诈骗损失超 159 亿美元，理解此类大规模危害需同时刻画信息传播与资金流动的耦合过程；而现有模拟器通常只覆盖其中一侧，无法还原真实世界中诈骗的发生机制，存在建模空白。
AI.method: 构建 LLM 智能体驱动的模拟器，包含三部分：(1) 动态社会环境，用于信息曝光与交流；(2) 持久化金融账本，保存支付与损失历史；(3) Need-Intent-Action 架构刻画受害者决策。诈骗者依据个体交互历史与账本状态自适应调整沟通与资金行为，从而在信息与资金两类动态之间形成闭环反馈。
AI.result: 宏观层面，模拟诈骗结果在多项关键统计指标上与真实世界模式高度吻合；微观层面复现了强损失集中性，前 10% 受害记录占总损失的 81.1%，与加拿大反诈骗中心统计一致；反诈骗实验中不同干预策略效果存在差异，最佳个性化干预将重复支付率由 49.4% 降至 10.9%。
AI.conclusion: FraudSociety 既是高保真模拟器，也是可在多样干预条件下规模化评估反诈骗策略的测试平台，为金融诈骗机理与防治研究提供支持。

title: FG-ConvNO: A Geometry-Aware Neural Operator for Propeller CFD Prediction
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Presented at the AAAI 2026 AI2ASE Workshop (non-archival)
summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is essential in contemporary engineering design, yet it remains expensive to compute and can take thousands of CPU/GPU hours or more for a single high-fidelity simulation. Recent developments in machine learning for scientific modeling have led to powerful surrogate frameworks that can approximate flow fields and physical quantities by using a fraction of the computational cost. However, most of these methods require largescale homogeneous datasets or simple geometries, exhibiting severe generalization gaps when applied to complex and data-scarce configurations. To address this, we propose the Factorized Geometry Convolutional Neural Operator (FG-ConvNO) for robust geometry-aware propeller pressure prediction under limited training data. We introduce geometryaware encoding, efficient interpolation-based decoding, and auxiliary global quantity supervision. In addition, we incorporate DISCO blocks that use discrete continuous convolutions to make the model discretization agnostic. In our experiments, FG-ConvNO achieves the highest accuracy for both surface pressure and global thrust prediction on a procedurally generated propeller CFD dataset. Geometry-aware encoding and architectural simplification improve stability, while random vertex subsampling enhances robustness. Overall, adding geometric priors to grid-based convolutional operators reduces overfitting on complex propeller geometries and improves generalization in low-data regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出因子化几何卷积神经算子FG-ConvNO，在有限数据下实现螺旋桨表面压力与全局推力的准确预测。
AI.motivation: CFD仿真成本极高（单次高保真模拟需数千CPU/GPU小时），现有机器学习代理模型多依赖大规模同质数据集或简单几何，在复杂且数据稀缺的构型上泛化能力差。
AI.method: FG-ConvNO采用几何感知编码、基于插值的高效解码与全局量辅助监督；引入基于离散-连续卷积的DISCO模块使模型具备离散化无关性；并采用随机顶点子采样提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在程序化生成的螺旋桨CFD数据集上，FG-ConvNO在表面压力和全局推力预测上均取得最高精度；几何感知编码与架构简化提升稳定性，随机顶点子采样增强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 为网格型卷积算子引入几何先验可缓解复杂螺旋桨几何上的过拟合，并改善低数据条件下的泛化性能。

title: From GPU to TPU with Coding Agents: What Works, What Fails, and What It Costs?
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the ICSE 2027 Software Engineering in Practice (SEIP) track
summary: A coding agent can migrate a machine learning workload, report success, and still change how the model trains. Rising compute costs, limited accelerator capacity, and vendor dependence are pushing organizations toward alternatives to graphics processing units (GPUs); a key question is whether agent-generated migrations to tensor processing units (TPUs) can be trusted and at what cost. We build a dataset of 148 PyTorch ML research projects and use Claude Code to migrate ten of them from NVIDIA GPUs to Google Cloud TPUs. We independently assess whether each migration runs, preserves numerical behavior, executes on the intended hardware, maintains the project's goal, and delivers acceptable performance. We also examine failures, human effort, and costs. Eight projects meet our project-goal criterion, and migrations require 2.4 human interventions on average. Of 70 execution attempts, 53 fail (76%), and 26 of these failures (49%) raise no error. The most frequent cause is repeated compilation and other execution inefficiencies, while interactions with third-party libraries can silently change the computation: in one four-chip migration, the agent reports success despite a change in gradient clipping that reduces accuracy from 86.53% to 84.89%. Execution costs vary widely: in one workload, TorchTPU, a PyTorch execution backend for TPUs, trains 1.86 times faster and 25% cheaper per run than the GPU. For practitioners, these findings motivate independent reference runs, verification under the intended hardware configuration, and workload-specific acceptance and stopping criteria that account for both computational and human costs.

AI.tldr: 构建148个PyTorch项目数据集，用Claude Code迁移其中10个从GPU到TPU，独立评估可靠性、成本与失败模式：8/10满足项目目标，平均需2.4次人工干预，70次执行尝试中53次失败(76%)，其中49%不报错；第三方库交互可静默改变计算（梯度裁剪变化使准确率从86.53%降至84.89%）；TorchTPU某工作负载训练快1.86倍、单次成本低25%。
AI.motivation: 算力成本上升、加速器容量有限与厂商依赖推动组织寻求GPU替代方案；核心问题是agent生成的TPU迁移是否可信、代价如何，而现有"报告成功"并不等于行为保真。
AI.method: 构建含148个PyTorch ML研究项目的数据集，选取10个用Claude Code从NVIDIA GPU迁移至Google Cloud TPU；独立评估五项标准——可运行、数值行为保持、确实运行于目标硬件、维持项目目标、性能可接受；并统计失败模式、人工投入与成本。
AI.result: 8个项目满足项目目标准则；平均2.4次人工干预；70次执行尝试中53次失败(76%)，其中26次(49%)无报错（静默失败）；最常见原因是重复编译等执行低效，第三方库交互会静默改变计算（四芯片迁移中梯度裁剪改变致准确率86.53%→84.89%）；成本差异大：某工作负载TorchTPU较GPU训练快1.86倍、单次成本低25%。
AI.conclusion: Agent迁移存在大量静默失败与语义漂移风险，"报告成功"不可作为验收依据；实践应采用独立参考运行、在目标硬件配置下验证、并制定兼顾计算与人力成本的工作负载特定验收与停止准则。

title: CoEvolve: Counterfactual-Guided Co-Evolution of Memory and Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks. Yet their memory and collaboration architectures often remain static, constraining continued adaptation and improvement over time. Recent work addresses this limitation by evolving memory or collaboration based on interaction experience. However, updates to these interdependent components are not necessarily aligned: an evolved workflow may require experience that memory does not provide, while evolved memory may encode guidance that the workflow cannot use. To address this problem, we propose CoEvolve, a skill-centered framework for aligned memory--collaboration evolution. CoEvolve represents reusable local collaboration patterns as skills that link evolving collaboration decisions to their supporting memories. It further compares original and counterfactual trajectories to identify local evolution signals, which coordinate updates to the skill library, skill memory, and executor memories across rounds. Experiments on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks confirm that CoEvolve achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated baselines, while ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of aligned co-evolution and counterfactual-guided evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出CoEvolve，以"技能"为中心实现记忆与协作的对齐式协同演化。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统的记忆与协作架构多为静态，虽有工作基于交互经验演化记忆或协作，但二者更新不对齐：演化出的工作流可能需要记忆未提供的经验，演化出的记忆也可能编码工作流无法使用的指导，二者相互制约。
AI.method: 将可复用的局部协作模式抽象为"技能"，用技能把不断演化的协作决策与其支撑记忆关联起来；通过比较原始轨迹与反事实轨迹识别局部演化信号，据此在轮次间协调更新技能库、技能记忆与执行者记忆。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与WebShop基准上取得所评估基线中的最佳整体性能；消融实验验证了对齐式协同演化与反事实引导演化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以技能为中介对齐记忆与协作的演化，可缓解二者失配问题，并持续提升多智能体系统的适应与改进能力。

title: A Unified Analysis of Importance-Corrected Momentum Actor-Critic over a Markovian Trajectory
summary: We present a generic actor-critic method that combines a ridge-regularized pathwise least-squares temporal-difference (LSTD) critic with importance-corrected momentum (ICM) actors. The critic solves a ridge-regularized system per frame by Newton-Schulz inversion and needs no stepsize, no knowledge of the mixing time, and no rank condition. Averaging stochastic policy gradients over frames of $T$ consecutive transitions, the ICM actors incur a frame-dependent gradient bias of order $\frac{1}{T}$. To our knowledge, we establish the first finite-time bounds for ICM actor-critic methods with normalized and unnormalized steps along a single Markovian trajectory. Up to a stationary-to-discounted distribution mismatch, the averaged gradient norm over $K$ updates is bounded by ${\cal O}(K^{-1/3}+\frac{1}{T})$ for normalized steps and by ${\cal O}(K^{-1/4}+\frac{1}{T})$ for unnormalized steps. We specialize these bounds to Muon, normalized stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with momentum, SGD with momentum, and AdaNorm, and compare them in the nuclear norm. With a dimension-free stepsize, Muon confines the factor $\min\{m,n\}^{1/2}$ associated with an $m\times n$ actor parameter matrix to the noise and correction terms. The comparison also characterizes when orthogonalization guarantees a larger noiseless ascent than normalization: exactly when the gradient's nuclear rank exceeds the spectral-to-Frobenius curvature ratio.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用 actor-critic 方法：critic 采用岭正则化的 pathwise LSTD 并用 Newton-Schulz 求逆逐帧求解（无需步长、无需混合时间、无需秩条件），actor 采用重要性校正动量（ICM）；首次给出沿单条 Markov 轨迹的 ICM actor-critic 有限时间界，并给出 Muon、归一化动量 SGD、动量 SGD、AdaNorm 的核范数比较。
AI.motivation: 现有 actor-critic 分析多依赖步长调参、混合时间或秩条件，且缺乏对基于矩阵正交化/归一化的动量类 actor（如 Muon）沿单条 Markov 轨迹的有限时间理论刻画，需要统一框架与可比较的收敛界。
AI.method: critic：岭正则化 pathwise LSTD，每帧用 Newton-Schulz 迭代求解线性系统；actor：对 T 个连续转移的随机策略梯度做帧内平均得到 ICM actor，引入 O(1/T) 的帧相关梯度偏差；在归一化与未归一化步长下推导 K 次更新的平均梯度范数界，并特化到 Muon、归一化动量 SGD、动量 SGD、AdaNorm，在核范数下比较。
AI.result: 在相差一个平稳分布到折扣分布失配项的意义下，平均梯度范数上界为：归一化步长 O(K^{-1/3}+1/T)，未归一化步长 O(K^{-1/4}+1/T)。使用无量纲步长时，Muon 使 m×n actor 参数矩阵对应的 min{m,n}^{1/2} 因子仅出现在噪声与校正项中；并刻画了正交化相对归一化在无噪声上升量上更优的充要条件：梯度的核秩超过谱- Frobenius 曲率比。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了 ICM actor-critic 的首个单轨迹有限时间收敛保证，并给出矩阵型动量更新（正交化 vs 归一化）的定量比较准则，为 Muon 类优化器在强化学习 actor 中的应用提供理论依据。

title: SymLift: Neural Semantic Lifting for Compile-Free Vulnerability Detection in Context-Incomplete Code Fragments
summary: Missing project context can prevent build-dependent analyzers from constructing program relations required for vulnerability detection, while neural predictions alone do not establish auditable derivations. We present SymLift, a compile-free framework centered on Vulnerability-Oriented Neural Semantic Lifting for context-incomplete code fragments. A fine-tuned large language model reconstructs vulnerability-relevant control-flow, data-flow, memory, and resource relations in a constrained LLVM-like intermediate representation (IR), without reconstructing the full project context or directly predicting vulnerability labels. A deterministic parser validates the IR and maps its supported operations and relations into normalized evidence facts. Explicit Datalog rules derive findings with supporting facts and derivation traces, ensuring deterministic reasoning for fixed facts and rules. We evaluate SymLift on FormAI, Juliet, and MegaVul. Reducing complete Juliet programs to function-level fragments lowers Clang compilation success from 100% to 12.00%, whereas SymLift's analysis completion rate decreases by only 1.17 percentage points. After task-specific fine-tuning, the lifter achieves a control-flow intersection over union (IoU) of 96.85% on FormAI. SymLift-Qwen-7B achieves a Target-F1 of 94.41% on FormAI and, across six vulnerability families on MegaVul, a micro-averaged precision of 98.24% and a micro-averaged Target-F1 of 91.66%. These results support accurate and auditable detection in the evaluated context-incomplete settings, even with partial program relations.

AI.tldr: SymLift：面向上下文不完整代码片段的免编译漏洞检测框架，用微调LLM将片段"提升"为类LLVM IR，再由确定性解析器与Datalog规则推导可审计证据。
AI.motivation: 项目上下文缺失会使依赖构建的静态分析器无法构造程序关系，从而无法检测漏洞；而纯神经预测又无法给出可审计的推导过程。
AI.method: 提出Vulnerability-Oriented Neural Semantic Lifting：微调LLM在受限的类LLVM IR中重建漏洞相关的控制流、数据流、内存与资源关系，不重建完整上下文、也不直接预测标签；确定性解析器校验IR并将支持的操作与关系映射为规范化证据事实；用显式Datalog规则推导结论并附带支撑事实与推导轨迹。
AI.result: 在FormAI、Juliet、MegaVul上评估：将完整Juliet程序降为函数级片段使Clang编译成功率从100%降至12.00%，而SymLift分析完成率仅下降1.17个百分点；微调后lifter在FormAI上控制流IoU达96.85%；SymLift-Qwen-7B在FormAI上Target-F1为94.41%，在MegaVul六个漏洞族上微平均精确率98.24%、微平均Target-F1为91.66%。
AI.conclusion: 在评估的上下文不完整场景下，即使程序关系部分缺失，该方法仍能实现准确且可审计的漏洞检测。

title: Learning When to Collaborate: Selective Multi-Agent Medical Reasoning via Uncertainty-Aware Routing
summary: Multi-agent systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for multimodal medical reasoning, but existing methods rely on two assumptions that hinder practical deployment: (i) always-active dense collaboration among multiple agents, and (ii) dependence on large cloud-based models that raise privacy and efficiency concerns. In this paper, we challenge both assumptions and propose SMART-Med, a fully local multi-agent method that treats collaboration as a learnable decision rather than a default behavior. Our key insight is that not every medical query requires costly multi-agent deliberation: many can be reliably solved by a single well-trained agent, while only uncertain cases benefit from expert collaboration. Based on this insight, SMART-Med introduces an uncertainty-driven routing mechanism that adaptively decides when to answer directly and when to recruit a small subset of expert agents, effectively converting dense multi-agent reasoning into selective, query-adaptive coordination. To make this routing reliable, we curate a new multimodal medical dataset MedVR-3K with high-quality reasoning traces and a difficulty hierarchy, and then fine-tune local agents using GRPO with two complementary rewards: a certainty-aware accuracy reward and a vision-language reward model for correctness and reasoning quality respectively. Experiments on four medical visual question answering benchmarks show that SMART-Med achieves competitive performance compared to existing MAS approaches while substantially reducing inference cost (reducing inference time by more than 3.8x and token usage by 72%). Moreover, after fine-tuning on MedVR-3K, SMART-Med yields an average improvement of 6.7% across Slake, PathVQA, VQA-RAD, and PMC-VQA.

AI.tldr: 提出SMART-Med，将多智能体协作转化为可学习决策：用不确定性驱动路由判断直接作答或召集少量专家智能体，并在本地模型上用GRPO微调，以更低推理成本取得有竞争力的医学多模态推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体医学推理方法依赖两个不利于实际部署的假设：(i)始终启用的密集协作；(ii)依赖云端大模型，带来隐私与效率问题。作者认为并非所有医学问题都需要昂贵的多智能体审议，多数问题可由单个训练良好的智能体可靠解决，仅不确定的案例才受益于专家协作。
AI.method: 1) 全本地化多智能体方法SMART-Med，将协作视为可学习决策而非默认行为；2) 不确定性驱动路由机制，自适应决定直接回答或招募少量专家智能体，将密集推理转为选择性、查询自适应的协调；3) 构建带高质量推理轨迹与难度分层的多模态医学数据集MedVR-3K；4) 用GRPO在本地智能体上微调，采用两种互补奖励：确定性感知的准确率奖励与视觉-语言奖励模型（分别评价正确性与推理质量）。
AI.result: 在四个医学视觉问答基准上性能与现有MAS方法相当；推理时间降低3.8倍以上，token使用减少72%；在Slake、PathVQA、VQA-RAD、PMC-VQA上经MedVR-3K微调后平均提升6.7%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性的查询自适应协作可在保持竞争力的医学多模态推理性能的同时显著降低推理成本并规避云端隐私问题，表明“协作与否”的可学习路由是实用多智能体医学推理的有效方向。

title: Climate downscaling with likelihood functional flow matching
summary: Decisions about heat, frost and flooding are made locally, yet reanalyses and climate models resolve tens of kilometres. Generative downscalers add kilometre-scale detail with uncertainty, but are tied to a grid, costly to sample and lack a tractable likelihood. Here we introduce CD-FFM, a functional flow-matching model that treats the high-resolution field as a continuous random field that one model can query at any location and resolution. Its velocity acts pointwise, so spatial variability comes from a noise prior fitted to the observed spectrum and every observation has an exact likelihood. Downscaling ERA5 to 1 km daily temperature over Fennoscandia, CD-FFM lowers the continuous ranked probability score by 27-31% against regression and 12-18% against a forty-times larger neural operator in each of three test years, and outperforms a CorrDiff-style diffusion model while sampling about fifty times faster. The same model transfers to precipitation and makes large kilometre-scale ensembles affordable.

AI.tldr: CD-FFM 是一种连续函数空间上的 flow-matching 降尺度模型，将高分辨率场视为连续随机场，可在任意位置与分辨率查询，单次训练即可给出任意观测点的精确似然，并在 1 km 温度与降水降尺度中精度与采样效率全面优于扩散与神经算子方法。
AI.motivation: 热害、霜冻与洪水的决策发生在局地尺度，而再分析资料与气候模式的网格分辨率为数十公里，存在尺度错配。现有生成式降尺度方法虽能补充公里级细节并量化不确定性，但绑定于固定网格、采样昂贵且缺乏可解析的似然，难以灵活查询与严格概率评估。
AI.method: 提出 CD-FFM（连续域函数流匹配模型），把高分辨率场建模为连续随机场，由单一模型在任意位置、任意分辨率上查询。其速度场逐点作用（pointwise），空间变异性由拟合观测功率谱的噪声先验引入，从而保留空间结构；由于逐点速度与可逆的连续流，任意观测点均具备精确似然。实验将 ERA5 降尺度至芬诺斯堪迪亚 1 km 日温度，并与回归基线、规模大 40 倍的神经算子、CorrDiff 式扩散模型比较。
AI.result: 在三个测试年份中，CD-FFM 相比回归方法将 CRPS 降低 27–31%，相比大 40 倍的神经算子降低 12–18%，并优于 CorrDiff 式扩散模型，采样速度约快 50 倍；同一模型可迁移至降水任务，并能以可承受成本生成大规模公里级集合。
AI.conclusion: 连续域、逐点速度的参数化使降尺度模型摆脱网格束缚，同时兼顾精度、精确似然与采样效率，为公里级气候降尺度与大规模概率集合预报提供了高效且可迁移的新范式。

title: Recovering Business Rules as Cascade Lookups for Enterprise Field Prediction
comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026 Applied Data Science Track
summary: Enterprise sales-order systems rely on manually maintained configuration rules to determine fields such as payment terms, shipping points, and sales ownership. When these rules are incomplete or stale, operators must enter values by hand, and downstream errors spread into billing, logistics, and reporting. This paper studies whether missing or outdated rules can be recovered from historical transactions instead of being relearned as opaque statistical patterns. We introduce a knowledge-graph-guided workflow in which an LLM agent proposes candidate business keys, meaning column combinations such as customer and document type, validates them through SQL profiling, and compiles the resulting evidence into deterministic cascade lookups. The LLM is used only during offline rule discovery. At inference time, prediction is a transparent key lookup with no model-serving requirement. Experiments on enterprise sales-order prediction and public relational benchmarks show that cascades are most effective when fields follow stable business rules, while learned graph models remain preferable when prediction depends on temporal or neighborhood patterns. Drift analysis further turns residual errors into diagnostics for configuration maintenance. Code and data: https://github.com/Fireblossom/CascadER.

AI.tldr: 论文提出知识图谱引导的工作流：LLM 智能体离线提出候选业务键（如客户+单据类型等列组合），经 SQL profiling 验证后编译为确定性级联查找规则；推理时仅为透明键查找，无需模型服务。
AI.motivation: 企业销售订单系统的配置规则（付款条件、发货点、销售归属等）依赖人工维护，规则不完整或过期时需手工填值，错误会扩散至开票、物流与报表。作者希望验证这些缺失/过期规则能否从历史交易中恢复，而非作为不透明的统计模式被重新学习。
AI.method: 知识图谱引导的 LLM 智能体工作流：LLM 仅在离线规则发现阶段使用，提出候选业务键（列组合），通过 SQL profiling 验证，将证据编译为确定性级联查找（cascade lookups）。推理阶段为一透明键查找过程，无模型服务开销；并辅以漂移分析将残差错误转化为配置维护诊断。
AI.result: 在企业销售订单预测与公开关系型基准上的实验表明：当字段遵循稳定业务规则时，级联查找最有效；当预测依赖时间或邻域模式时，学习式图模型仍更优。
AI.conclusion: 缺失或过期的配置规则可从历史交易中恢复为可解释的确定性级联规则；规则式与学习式方法各有适用边界，残差分析可用于持续维护配置。

title: A Multi-Domain Study on the Effectiveness of LLMs at Writing Property-Based Tests
summary: A property-based test (PBT) checks a property of a program on many generated inputs, but writing one takes a property, a generator of valid inputs, and an oracle. LLM-based PBT writers produce all three, yet they have been evaluated only on Python libraries. We study how two of them, Proptest-AI and Agentic-PBT, generalize to ten programs in five domains: deep learning libraries, databases, system software, compilers, and LLM serving engines. Most of these programs take text in their own language, such as queries, configurations, and programs. Agentic-PBT covers more branches than Proptest-AI on seven of the ten programs with Opus 5 and on all ten with GLM-5.3-Flash. Domain-specific fuzzers cover more of the compilers and of PostgreSQL and less of PyTorch than Agentic-PBT. We filed 180 bug reports, 44 of which duplicate reports that others filed after the models' knowledge cutoffs; maintainers have confirmed 65 of the others, in all five domains, and fixed 23. We draw lessons for building and evaluating such writers: low observability hurts them, and mature fuzzers paired with LLM-written properties could check that each feature behaves as documented.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于LLM的PBT（property-based test，基于性质的测试）编写器能否从Python库推广到五个领域的十个程序（深度学习库、数据库、系统软件、编译器、LLM推理引擎）。Agentic-PBT在多数程序上覆盖的代码分支多于Proptest-AI，并在十个程序累计提交180份缺陷报告，其中65份获维护者确认、23份已修复。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based PBT编写器（需同时产出性质、合法输入生成器与oracle）此前仅在Python库上评估，缺少跨领域、跨语言的泛化性与实用性证据，尤其缺少对"程序使用自身专用语言（查询、配置、源程序）"这类场景的检验。
AI.method: 选取五个领域十个真实程序，对比两个LLM-based PBT编写器（Proptest-AI与Agentic-PBT）在代码分支覆盖上的表现，并与领域专用fuzzer（domain-specific fuzzers）作对照；在两个底层模型（Opus 5与GLM-5.3-Flash）上重复实验；最后向维护者提交bug报告并统计重复、确认为真实缺陷与已修复的数量。
AI.result: 在Opus 5下，Agentic-PBT于10个程序中7个的分支覆盖优于Proptest-AI；在GLM-5.3-Flash下则于全部10个程序占优。领域专用fuzzer在编译器与PostgreSQL上覆盖更高、在PyTorch上低于Agentic-PBT。共提交180份缺陷报告，其中44份与他人提交的重复（提交时间晚于模型知识截止日期）；其余报告中有65份被维护者确认为真实缺陷，覆盖全部五个领域，23份已修复。
AI.conclusion: LLM-based PBT编写器可跨领域泛化并发现真实缺陷，但其效果受可观测性不足制约（low observability hurts them）；一个可行方向是将成熟fuzzer与LLM撰写的性质结合，用以检验每项功能是否按文档描述运行。

title: Auditing evaluation artifacts and data leakage in large language model systems for rare disease diagnosis
summary: Augmented large language model (LLM) systems have reported high benchmark accuracies in rare disease diagnosis, yet their real-world clinical utility remains unproven. A recent meta-analysis flagged augmented LLM diagnostic evaluations as having a high risk of bias due to suspected data leakage; however, the precise impact of these vulnerabilities on model inference has yet to be fully quantified. In this study, we present a comprehensive empirical audit to quantify evaluation artifacts across prevailing AI paradigms, using a repository of over 60,000 cases from diverse public and independent clinical cohorts. By reconstructing a state-of-the-art agentic framework, we demonstrate that candidate-space contamination artificially inflates performance: enforcing strict cross-dataset isolation resulted in a marked performance decline, with the cross-dataset mean Recall@1 decreasing from 54.3% (under conventional one-vs-rest evaluation) to 40.3% (Hedges' g = 0.94). Similar spatial overfitting in supervised classifiers caused diagnostic accuracy to drop from an internal mean of 42.9% to 16.7% across external cohorts (Cohen's d = 2.01). Furthermore, we quantify how LLMs infer diagnoses by exploiting retrospective therapeutic cues in clinical narratives, and how temporal misalignment in foundational knowledge bases leads to performance fluctuations. We conclude that prevailing evaluation protocols for augmented LLM systems inadvertently reflect data leakage rather than genuine medical reasoning. To address these systematic artifacts, we propose a rigorous evaluation framework - coupling strict data-isolation protocols with standardized benchmarking safeguards - to ensure future diagnostic AI for rare diseases is evaluated on actual clinical robustness.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过大规模实证审计量化了增强型LLM罕见病诊断评估中的数据泄漏与评估伪影，发现严格的跨数据集隔离使Recall@1从54.3%降至40.3%、监督分类器准确率从42.9%降至16.7%，并提出耦合严格数据隔离与标准化基准保障的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 增强型LLM系统在罕见病诊断基准上报告的准确率很高，但真实临床效用未经验证；近期荟萃分析指出此类评估存在因疑似数据泄漏导致的高偏倚风险，然而这些脆弱性对模型推理的精确影响尚未被充分量化。
AI.method: 构建涵盖6万余例、来自多个公开与独立临床队列的病例库；重建最先进智能体框架；采用严格的跨数据集隔离协议与常规one-vs-rest评估进行对比；对监督分类器进行内部与外部队列对比；并分析LLM利用临床叙述中回顾性治疗线索推断诊断的机制，以及基础知识库时间错位带来的性能波动。效应量采用Hedges' g与Cohen's d度量。
AI.result: 强制跨数据集隔离后，智能体框架跨数据集平均Recall@1由54.3%（常规one-vs-rest评估）降至40.3%（Hedges' g = 0.94）；监督分类器存在类似空间过拟合，诊断准确率从内部平均42.9%降至外部队列16.7%（Cohen's d = 2.01）；并量化了LLM依赖回顾性治疗线索及知识库时间错位导致的性能波动。
AI.conclusion: 当前增强型LLM系统的评估协议反映的是数据泄漏而非真正的医学推理；提出将严格数据隔离协议与标准化基准保障相结合的严谨评估框架，以确保未来罕见病诊断AI基于真实临床鲁棒性进行评估。

title: Error-Subspace Calibration for Multi-Task Model Merging
summary: Model merging combines task-specific expert models into a single model without joint training on their original datasets, but often incurs a performance gap relative to the individual experts. Post-merging calibration can reduce this gap through task-specific representation alignment, but the alignment objective alone does not specify which feature directions to correct. We propose Error-Subspace Calibration (ESCal), a post-merging calibration framework that identifies low-dimensional error subspaces from weight differences between expert and merged models. At each intermediate block boundary, a bridge module projects the merged representation onto the next block's input-projection error subspace and maps these coordinates to an additive correction in the current block's output-projection error subspace. The subspace bases remain fixed, so calibration learns only these linear maps, yielding a parameter-efficient mechanism for feature correction. We find that ESCal brings the merged model closer to the experts in both representations and predictions, indicating more faithful recovery of task-specific behavior. Experiments on vision and natural language understanding benchmarks show that ESCal improves merged-model performance across diverse architectures and merging methods using a small calibration set for each task.

AI.tldr: 提出合并后校准框架ESCal，利用专家与合并模型权重差构造低维误差子空间，在中间块边界用轻量桥梁模块做特征校正，参数高效地缩小合并模型与专家的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 模型合并无需联合训练即可将多个任务专家整合为单模型，但相对各专家存在性能差距；现有合并后校准通过任务特定表示对齐缓解该差距，然而对齐目标本身未指明应修正哪些特征方向。
AI.method: 从专家模型与合并模型的权重差中提取低维误差子空间。在每个中间块边界设置桥梁模块：将合并表示投影到下一块输入投影误差子空间，再把这些坐标映射为当前块输出投影误差子空间中的加性校正。子空间基底固定，仅学习线性映射，从而构成参数高效的特征校正机制。
AI.result: ESCal使合并模型在表示与预测上更接近各专家，表明更忠实地恢复了任务特定行为；在视觉与自然语言理解基准上，使用每任务小规模校准集，跨多种架构与多种合并方法均提升了合并模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 以权重差定义的误差子空间为校准提供了明确的方向依据，配合固定的子空间基与轻量线性映射，ESCal实现了参数高效、通用性强的合并后校准，可广泛适配不同架构与合并方法。

title: Multimodal Requirements Traceability Link Recovery in Industrial Settings
summary: Requirements traceability links support activities such as change-impact analysis, coverage checking, and validation. Industrial requirements can include traceable images, which text-only approaches cannot process directly. For a fixed classifier configuration, binary decisions alone offer no direct way to adjust the balance between missed and incorrect links. We extend a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approach for inter-requirements traceability link recovery (TLR). Our extension retrieves text and image candidates separately, classifies each retrieved pair with a vision-language model, and filters the predicted links by verbalized confidence. We evaluate our approach on three non-overlapping industrial requirement sets and six public text-only datasets. On the industrial test sets, our approach achieves an F1 score of 0.310, compared with 0.114 for our replication of the baseline approach by Hey et al. Our approach recovers links in all four modality combinations while improving text-only F1 on the industrial data and maintaining similar performance on the public datasets, but recovery remains limited by failures to retrieve related text requirements for image queries. Confidence filtering produces link sets with different precision and recall, removing false positives and some correctly recovered links from the unfiltered link set. This study provides industrial evidence on the potential and limitations of a current RAG-based TLR approach for multimodal requirements and identifies cross-modal retrieval as the component to prioritize in further optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文扩展了基于RAG的需求间追溯链接恢复方法，将文本与图像候选分别检索、用视觉语言模型分类并基于语言化置信度过滤，在工业数据上F1达0.310（基线0.114）。
AI.motivation: 工业需求中包含文本方法无法直接处理的可追溯图像；同时固定分类器配置下仅靠二元决策无法调整漏检与误检链接之间的平衡。
AI.method: 扩展检索增强生成（RAG）的TLR流程：分别检索文本与图像候选，用视觉语言模型对每个检索对进行分类，并依据语言化的置信度对预测链接进行过滤。
AI.result: 在三个不重叠的工业需求集上F1为0.310，复现的Hey等基线为0.114；在四种模态组合上均能恢复链接，工业数据上纯文本F1提升，公共数据集上性能相近；但仍受限于图像查询难以检索到相关文本需求。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为多模态需求下RAG式TLR的潜力与局限提供了工业证据；置信度过滤可产生不同精确率/召回率的链接集；跨模态检索是后续优化的优先组件。

title: Counterfactual Model Testing Under Distribution Shift
summary: Deployed machine learning (ML) models can degrade as the distribution of their input data shifts. Such shifts can result from changes in the population or from data integrity issues in the pipeline that materializes model features, two sources that operate through different mechanisms. Because labels are often absent or delayed, it is common practice to track shifts in the data instead, but a detected shift does not indicate how it affects the model. We formulate this problem as online model testing under distribution shift. Testing requires reproducing the shift on a controlled baseline with known labels. Since the same shift can come from either source, doing so requires knowing which mechanism changed. We propose a methodology that reproduces observed changes in both mechanisms to estimate current performance and the potential gain from repairing observed data integrity issues. Experiments on real-world datasets with simulated faults show that separating the two sources generally improves both estimates, supporting this formulation. A churn prediction case illustrates how these tests can support monitoring and repair prioritization

AI.tldr: 该论文将数据分布漂移下的模型监控形式化为"在线模型测试"问题，提出区分并复现"总体变化"与"数据完整性故障"两种漂移机制，以估计当前模型性能及修复数据问题带来的潜在收益。
AI.motivation: 已部署模型因输入分布漂移而性能退化，漂移来源有二：总体变化（population change）与特征物化管道中的数据完整性问题（data integrity issues），二者机制不同。由于标签缺失或延迟，实践中只能追踪数据漂移，但检测到的漂移并不说明其对模型的影响；而要在已知标签的受控基线上复现漂移，必须先判断是哪种机制发生了变化。
AI.method: 提出一套方法论：将漂移问题建模为分布漂移下的在线模型测试；对两种机制分别复现观测到的变化（在受控基线上重放/模拟），据此估计当前模型性能以及修复所观测数据完整性问题的潜在性能增益。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上注入模拟故障的实验表明，分离两种漂移来源通常能同时改善当前性能估计与修复收益估计，从而支持该问题形式化；以客户流失（churn）预测为例，说明该类测试可用于监控与修复优先级排序。
AI.conclusion: 将数据漂移拆分为总体变化与数据完整性故障两类机制并分别复现，是估计漂移下模型性能与修复价值的有效途径，可服务于部署模型的在线监控与数据修复决策。

title: RBGA: Residual-Budget Guide Arbitration for Offline-to-Online Safe Reinforcement Learning in Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires robots to leverage existing datasets for rapid skill acquisition while maintaining safety during real-world deployment to prevent damage to the robot or its surroundings. Offline-to-online safe reinforcement learning (O2O safe RL) provides a promising solution for this problem by leveraging prior experience for online improvement under safety constraints, thereby mitigating the sample inefficiency and exploration risk of learning safe policies from scratch. However, existing O2O safe RL approaches do not explicitly account for the safety budget already consumed when making decisions within an episode. Excessive cost incurred early can therefore leave little room for subsequent exploration and policy improvement. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{R}esidual-\textbf{B}udget \textbf{G}uide \textbf{A}rbitration (RBGA), an algorithm that explicitly tracks the remaining episode safety budget and uses it to adaptively select between offline guidance and the evolving online policy. At each step, RBGA compares the cost-to-go estimates of the guide and online actions against the remaining budget, enabling step-wise action arbitration throughout the episode. We provide theoretical analysis characterizing the safety implications of residual-budget-based selection and its effect on guide-assisted exploration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RBGA enables effective online policy improvement while maintaining strong safety performance. Our code is available at this \href{https://github.com/sii-pilab}{link}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差预算引导仲裁（RBGA）算法，通过显式跟踪回合内剩余安全预算，在离线引导动作与在线策略动作之间逐步仲裁，实现离线到在线安全强化学习中的安全策略改进。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作要求机器人利用已有数据集快速习得技能，同时保证真实部署安全。离线到在线安全强化学习（O2O safe RL）可利用先验经验在安全约束下在线改进，缓解从零学习的样本低效与探索风险。但现有方法在决策时未显式考虑回合内已消耗的安全预算，早期过高的代价会使后续探索与策略改进空间被压缩。
AI.method: 提出RBGA算法：显式跟踪回合剩余安全预算，并将其用于在离线引导策略与演进中的在线策略之间自适应选择。每一步将引导动作与在线动作的cost-to-go估计与剩余预算比较，实现整条回合中的逐步动作仲裁。同时给出理论分析，刻画基于剩余预算的选择对安全性及引导辅助探索的影响。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RBGA在保持较强安全性能的同时实现了有效的在线策略改进。
AI.conclusion: 显式跟踪并利用回合剩余安全预算进行逐步仲裁，可有效解决O2O安全RL中早期代价挤占后续探索空间的问题，兼顾在线性能提升与安全约束满足。

title: When Fusion Order Matters: Insights on Progressive Multimodal Representation Learning for Cross-modal Retrieval
summary: Multimodal video retrieval combines visual, acoustic, and speech information, yet how their fusion order should depend on the data and the retrieval query remains unclear. We introduce Unified Progressive Representation Learning for Order Analysis, or UniPRO, to investigate this question through configurable fusion schedules with matched model components and training settings. Starting from text-to-video retrieval, we find that the tested one-by-one schedules outperform stacked fusion, while changing the order within one-by-one fusion also changes performance. To guide order selection, we examine two complementary considerations: learning difficulty under unequal modality availability and preservation of information relevant to the query. Complete-modality controls show that missing inputs alone cannot explain order sensitivity. At R@1, text and audio retrieval favor schedules that introduce the modality matching the query last. Controlled speech missingness during training and testing reverses the preferred order in both R@1 and SumR, with different crossover points. These findings motivate balancing the two considerations when selecting a fusion path. We then use them to predict a visual-last schedule for image queries, which achieves 97.9 R@1, the highest among the evaluated orders on MSR-VTT-9k. Main experiments on four text-to-video benchmarks establish the effectiveness of UniPRO, with component ablations assessing its supporting design. Together, the results identify fusion order as a task-dependent choice that should account jointly for modality availability and the retrieval query.

AI.tldr: UniPRO：用统一渐进式表示学习系统研究多模态视频检索中的融合顺序问题，发现融合顺序是依赖任务的选择，需同时考虑模态可用性与检索查询。
AI.motivation: 多模态视频检索融合视觉、声学与语音信息，但融合顺序应如何依赖数据和检索查询并不清楚。
AI.method: 提出 UniPRO，在模型组件与训练设置匹配的条件下使用可配置融合调度，系统比较堆叠融合与逐一融合及不同顺序；并从两方面分析：模态可用性不等下的学习难度、查询相关信息的保持；辅以完整模态对照、训练/测试期受控语音缺失实验、组件消融。
AI.result: 逐一融合优于堆叠融合，且逐一融合内部顺序也影响性能；仅缺失输入无法解释顺序敏感性；R@1 下文本与音频检索偏好将匹配查询的模态最后引入；受控语音缺失可反转偏好顺序（R@1 与 SumR 交叉点不同）；据此预测的图像查询"视觉最后"调度在 MSR-VTT-9k 上取得 97.9 R@1，为评测顺序中最高；4 个文本到视频基准验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 融合顺序是任务相关的选择，应联合考虑模态可用性与检索查询，选择融合路径时需在两种考量间权衡。

title: Software Engineering for AI-Driven Science
summary: AI has made significant contributions to scientific discovery. Autonomous agents can now independently analyse complex problems, design experiments, write and execute code, analyse findings, and derive scientific conclusions. Nevertheless, errors in AI-generated code, experimental procedures, or evidence interpretation can lead to invalid research conclusions, undermining the reliability and reproducibility of automated scientific discovery. In this vision paper, we propose Software Engineering for AI-Driven Science (SE4AI4Sci) as an emerging research area for addressing this challenge. As an organising framework, we introduce the Scientific Assurance Chain, connecting intent, experimental design, implementation, execution, evidence, and claim. Through six documented failures in recent AI-for-science systems, we show where this chain can break, where existing assurance mechanisms fall short, and what new research challenges follow. We also outline a research agenda for adapting and extending software engineering techniques across the chain.

AI.tldr: 提出"面向AI驱动科学的软件工程"(SE4AI4Sci)这一新兴研究方向，并以"科学保障链"为组织框架，梳理AI驱动科学自动化中的失效环节与研究议程。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体已能独立分析复杂问题、设计实验、编写并执行代码、分析结果并得出结论，但AI生成的代码、实验流程或证据解读中的错误会导致无效研究结论，损害自动化科学发现的可靠性与可复现性，现有保障机制不足以应对。
AI.method: 愿景论文方法：提出SE4AI4Sci研究领域；构建"科学保障链"(Scientific Assurance Chain)组织框架，串联意图、实验设计、实现、执行、证据与主张六个环节；通过近期AI-for-science系统中的六个已记录失效案例，分析链条断点与现有保障机制的不足。
AI.result: 识别出保障链各环节可能断裂的位置，指出已有保障机制的局限，并据此归纳出新的研究挑战；同时给出在该链条上适配与扩展软件工程技的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 应将软件工程方法系统性地延伸至AI驱动科学全流程，以保障自动化科学发现的可靠性与可复现性，SE4AI4Sci可作为整合性研究框架推动后续工作。

title: Data Governance for Generative and Agentic AI : Technology, Law, Economics, and Security
summary: This book develops a unified governance framework for systems that retrieve, generate, infer, remember and act on information from large language models and retrieval augmented pipelines to autonomous multi agent systems. Eleven chapters and eight appendices integrate three disciplinary lenses-technology, law and economics-across the full lifecycle: data quality, lineage and provenance; global data protection law and intellectual property; the economics of data governance; digital trust, cybersecurity and zero-trust architecture; ethics and responsible AI; governing generative AI pipelines; governing agentic AI and multi-agent systems; data governance in elections and the public sphere; AI regulation across six jurisdictions; and the design of a governance control plane for 2030. Each chapter is anchored in Indian law and institutions while maintaining a comparative, cross jurisdictional perspective.

AI.tldr: 本书提出一个统一治理框架，覆盖从大模型、RAG流程到自主多智能体系统的信息检索、生成、推理、记忆与行动全生命周期，整合技术、法律、经济三重视角，共11章8附录，以印度法为锚点并保持跨法域比较视野。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI与智能体系统贯穿数据获取、生成、推理、记忆与行动的全链路，现有治理分散于数据质量、隐私法、知识产权、网络安全与AI伦理等孤立议题，缺乏覆盖全生命周期、贯通技术—法律—经济三学科的整合框架；同时需要兼顾本土制度（印度法）与全球可比性。
AI.method: 采用跨学科（技术、法律、经济）与全生命周期相结合的研究方法：按主题分章组织，涵盖数据质量/数据血缘与溯源、全球数据保护法与知识产权、数据治理经济学、数字信任与零信任架构、伦理与负责任AI、生成式AI流程治理、智能体AI与多智能体系统治理、选举与公共领域数据治理、六大法域AI监管比较，以及面向2030的治理控制平面设计；每章以印度法律与机构为锚点进行跨法域比较分析。
AI.result: 形成11章正文加8个附录的体系化成果，将分散治理议题整合为统一框架，并提供六法域监管比较与治理控制平面（governance control plane）的前瞻性设计蓝图。
AI.conclusion: 有效的AI与数据治理需以全生命周期视角贯通技术、法律与经济，并在本土法律（印度）与跨法域比较之间取得平衡；面向2030应通过治理控制平面实现对生成式与智能体AI的系统化、可操作治理。

title: FedSEAM: Federated Continual Learning of LLMs via Subspace Expert Agreement Merging
summary: Federated continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks across several clients without sharing their data while retaining knowledge of earlier tasks. Sparse mixture-of-experts models support this setting by adapting selected parameters on a frozen backbone. However, clients learn different expert content as tasks evolve, making it difficult to share knowledge across clients without disrupting task-specific and client-specific specialization. Matching tile coordinates alone does not establish whether their learned content is compatible. We present FedSEAM, a federated continual learning framework that organizes task knowledge into sparse experts and selectively shares their content across tasks and clients. On each client, task-aware tile selection allocates capacity to a new task, while a subspace-based compatibility test determines which existing expert tiles to reuse and where to introduce fresh capacity. On the server, Subspace Expert Agreement Merging (SEAM) compares client updates as subspaces and moves each client towards consensus only along agreed-upon directions, leaving the rest of its update unchanged. We identify two remaining sources of forgetting, routing drift and merge erasure, and address them with three protections, one of which exactly preserves tile components in a selected prior-overlap subspace at every merge. We evaluate FedSEAM on TRACE using Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.2-3B, with component-wise ablations and studies of data size to assess its balance between learning new tasks and retaining prior knowledge.

AI.tldr: FedSEAM：将任务知识组织为稀疏专家，基于子空间一致性检验选择复用/新增专家tile，并在服务器端沿"共识方向"合并客户端更新，缓解联邦持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 联邦持续学习中，稀疏MoE通过冻结主干、仅适配部分参数来保留旧任务知识，但随任务演化，各客户端学到的专家内容不同；仅靠tile坐标匹配无法判断其学习内容是否兼容，导致跨客户端知识共享与任务/客户端特化之间产生冲突。
AI.method: 1) 客户端：任务感知的tile选择为新任务分配容量；基于子空间的兼容性检验决定复用哪些已有专家tile、在何处引入新容量。2) 服务器：Subspace Expert Agreement Merging（SEAM）将客户端更新视为子空间进行比较，仅在各方一致的方向上将各客户端拉向共识，其余方向保持不变。3) 识别路由漂移（routing drift）与合并擦除（merge erasure）两类残余遗忘来源，并提出三项保护措施，其中一项在每次合并时精确保持选定先验重叠子空间中的tile分量。
AI.result: 在TRACE基准上使用Qwen3-4B与Llama-3.2-3B进行评估，并开展组件级消融与数据规模研究，验证其在新任务学习与旧知识保持之间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: FedSEAM通过子空间级一致性与选择性合并实现稀疏专家的跨任务、跨客户端共享，有效缓解联邦持续学习中的遗忘问题，为MoE架构下的联邦持续学习提供了兼顾特化与共享的方案。

title: Do AI Coding Agents Write Infrastructure as Code Like Humans? An Empirical Study of GitHub Pull Requests
summary:
Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) configurations define cloud resources, networking, and access control, and AI coding agents increasingly write them. Little is known about how agent contributions differ from those of humans and automation bots, how maintainers evaluate them, and whether they introduce different sustainability concerns.
  We study 349,156 IaC pull requests (PRs) from 49,241 GitHub repositories, distinguishing humans, automation bots, silent agents, and disclosed agents. Bots account for 32.9% of ostensibly human PRs, and 12.3% of the remaining PRs contain agent traces, a share that grows over the study period. Agent PRs are about four times larger than human PRs and more often modify core infrastructure modules, whereas bots mainly maintain dependencies. Silent-agent PRs have higher overall merge rates than human PRs (87.4% vs. 78.9%) but are merged 4.0 percentage points less often within the same repositories. Disclosed agents create new infrastructure more often than humans (34.0% vs. 21.4%), and even for the same change type within the same repository, their PRs are 8.4 points less likely to be merged; silent-agent PRs show comparable acceptance for most change types. Finally, in 2,645 matched agent-human Terraform PR pairs, agent and human PRs introduce sustainability smells at similar rates (10.4% vs. 10.3%; paired odds ratio 1.02, 95% CI 0.83-1.25), most commonly missing remote state and monolithic configurations.

AI.tldr: 基于 349,156 个 IaC PR 的实证研究表明，Agent PR 体量约为人类 4 倍、更常改动核心基础设施模块，隐匿型 Agent PR 总体合并率更高但同仓库内低 4.0 个百分点，披露型 Agent PR 同仓同类改动合并率低 8.4 个百分点，且 Agent 与人类引入可持续性坏味的比例无显著差异。
AI.motivation: IaC 配置定义云资源、网络与访问控制，而 AI 编码 Agent 日益参与其编写；但目前缺乏对 Agent 贡献与人类、自动化机器人贡献差异、维护者如何评价这些贡献，以及是否带来不同可持续性问题的认识。
AI.method: 从 49,241 个 GitHub 仓库收集 349,156 个 IaC PR，将作者划分为人类、自动化机器人、静默 Agent（silent agents）与披露 Agent（disclosed agents）；统计各类 PR 的规模、改动模块类型与合并率，并进行同仓库内控制对比；最后通过 2,645 对匹配的 Agent—人类 Terraform PR 配对分析可持续性坏味（sustainability smells）发生率与配对优势比。
AI.result: 表面上属于人类的 PR 中 32.9% 实为机器人；其余 PR 中 12.3% 含 Agent 痕迹且占比随时间上升。Agent PR 规模约为人类 PR 的 4 倍，更常改动核心基础设施模块，机器人则主要维护依赖。静默 Agent PR 总体合并率高于人类（87.4% vs. 78.9%），但同仓库内低 4.0 个百分点。披露 Agent 更常创建新基础设施（34.0% vs. 21.4%），且同仓库同类改动合并率低 8.4 个百分点；静默 Agent 在多数改动类型上接受度相当。配对样本中 Agent 与人类引入可持续性坏味比例相近（10.4% vs. 10.3%；配对 OR 1.02，95% CI 0.83–1.25），最常见为缺失远程 state 与单体式配置。
AI.conclusion: Agent 已实质参与 IaC 开发且贡献特征与人类、机器人显著不同；披露身份会降低同类改动的合并概率，而静默 Agent 在多数改动类型上接受度接近人类；Agent 在可持续性坏味引入上与人类无显著差异，主要风险集中于远程 state 缺失与单体配置，提示需针对 Agent 贡献改进评审与 IaC 最佳实践约束。

title: When Generated Information Returns: Error Persistence in LLM-Mediated Information Ecosystems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly produce online articles from material that later becomes input to other models. This circulation connects individual responses to the information available for subsequent generation. We study a consequential distinction: an article can avoid endorsing a false claim while preserving the concrete details that enable its reproduction. Our framework connects claim content, expressed stance, and downstream reuse to explain selective error persistence under a continuing supply of accurate and inaccurate information. We implement a controlled community writing process that varies whether published articles return as inputs, matching external supply, input capacity, and generation volume. Across twelve factual targets and four production models, recirculation increases the presence of complete false claims by 7.29 percentage points at the final round while reducing explicit endorsement by 8.33 points. Effects differ across facts and models. Paired interventions then abstract eligible error details within fixed histories while preserving correct content and the surrounding controversy. Error reproduction remains largely unchanged across the evaluation targets, while a development quotation target exhibits local reductions. These findings connect persistent errors to the information available throughout a writing process and motivate evaluation of both what models affirm and what their publications supply to future writers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“主张内容—表达立场—下游复用”框架，通过受控社区写作实验证明：文章循环回流会同时提升完整虚假主张的出现率（+7.29pp）并降低显式背书（−8.33pp），即模型可通过不表态却保留可复现细节来“选择性保留错误”，且抽象化细节干预对错误复现基本无效。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的在线文章会成为后续模型的输入，形成个体输出与后续生成信息环境之间的循环。已有研究多关注模型是否背书虚假信息，却忽视一种更隐蔽的情形：文章不表态支持某虚假主张，却完整保留使其可被复现的具体细节。作者希望解释在持续供给正确与错误信息的条件下，错误为何会选择性存续。
AI.method: 构建连接主张内容、表达立场与下游复用的分析框架；实施受控的社区写作流程实验，操纵已发表文章是否作为输入回流，并对齐外部信息供给、输入容量与生成量；覆盖12个事实目标与4个生产模型；随后进行配对干预，在固定历史中抽象化合格错误细节，同时保留正确内容及争议语境。
AI.result: 在最终轮次，文章回流使完整虚假主张出现率提高7.29个百分点，同时使显式背书下降8.33个百分点；效应在事实与模型间存在异质性。配对干预后，各评估目标的错误复现基本不变，仅在一个开发用引文目标上出现局部下降。
AI.conclusion: 持续性错误与写作过程中可获取的信息环境密切相关，而不仅是模型的信念表达问题。评估应同时考察模型“肯定了什么”和“其出版物为未来写作者提供了什么”，仅去除显式背书不足以阻断错误传播。

title: Overlap-Aware Sub-hypergraph Pattern Frequencies for Hypergraph-Level Classification
summary: Classifying whole hypergraphs requires a fixed-length description of inputs whose numbers of vertices and hyperedges vary. Frequent sub-hypergraph patterns provide such a description, but previous work records only whether each pattern is present, which loses two kinds of information: how large the overlap between two hyperedges is, and how much of a hypergraph each pattern makes up. We extend frequent sub-hypergraph mining with overlap labels, the binned intersection size of two pattern hyperedges inherited from the target hypergraph, and represent each hypergraph by the relative frequency of each mined pattern. The vocabulary is mined from training hypergraphs only and then frozen, and validation and test hypergraphs are matched against it. A support rule that depends on pattern size keeps the vocabulary small. On the six hypergraph-classification datasets of DHG-Bench, with a single configuration chosen on validation scores, the method has a higher mean Macro-F1 than the best published mean on five datasets, by 18.67 points on Twitter-Friend and 10.02 points on Steam-Player; on RHG-3 it is 0.21 points lower. Ablations show that on Steam-Player and Twitter-Friend, replacing relative frequencies with presence lowers Macro-F1 by about 18 points, and that removing overlap labels lowers it by 4 to 9 points.

AI.tldr: 提出带重叠标签与相对频率的频繁子超图模式描述方法，用于整超图分类。
AI.motivation: 超图的顶点与超边数量可变，分类需固定长度表示。已有频繁子超图模式法只记录模式是否出现，丢失了两类信息：模式超边间的重叠程度，以及每个模式在超图中所占比例。
AI.method: 扩展频繁子超图挖掘，引入overlap labels（由目标超图继承的两条模式超边交集大小的分箱值），并以每个挖掘模式的相对频率表示超图；词表仅在训练超图上挖掘后冻结，验证/测试超图与之匹配；采用依赖模式大小的support rule控制词表规模。
AI.result: 在DHG-Bench的六个超图分类数据集上，以验证分数选定的单一配置，五个数据集平均Macro-F1高于已发表最佳均值：Twitter-Friend +18.67、Steam-Player +10.02，RHG-3低0.21。消融：以存在性替代相对频率在Steam-Player与Twitter-Friend约降18点；去除overlap labels降4–9点。
AI.conclusion: 相对频率与重叠标签是性能提升的关键，冻结词表加尺寸相关支持规则可在小词表下取得更优分类效果。

title: Built to Remember, Shipped to Forget: Operational Contracts, Failures, and Repairs in Containerized LLM Agent Deployments
