summary: LLM agent systems reach production as container images run by platforms such as Docker, Compose, and Kubernetes. Framework and platform document opposite expectations: to the platform a container is disposable, while the framework persists conversations, pauses runs for human input, and resumes interrupted work from saved state; each side specifies only its own behavior, so the obligations their composition creates are stated nowhere. We present the first empirical study of this boundary, stating these obligations as operational contracts: guarantees a deployment must provide to preserve an agent system's required behavior when a deployment-platform event occurs. From the first-party documentation of LangGraph and the three platforms we derive 14 contracts and evaluate them with three independent sources of evidence: 433 deployed open-source agent systems, seven events induced on 12 of them, and 122 developer repairs mined from 39,261 commits, pull requests, and issues. At least one contract applies to 75.5% of the systems, yet its guarantee is routinely missing: of systems that must keep state beyond the process, 37.4% lose it to a restart and 41.5% to a container replacement, and every assessable deployment stops the framework's production server mid-drain. Induced events turn 14 of 16 predicted violations into runtime failures and all seven predicted holds pass. The failures are born in deployment but repaired in code: developer repairs independently cover twelve of the fourteen contracts, 78% change application code, and only two in three fully restore the violated guarantee. The 14-contract catalogue, detection rules, fault-injection harness, and 35-pattern repair taxonomy provide a basis for checking and strengthening agent deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证研究 LLM 智能体框架（以 LangGraph 为例）与容器部署平台（Docker/Compose/Kubernetes）之间的语义边界，将二者的组合义务表述为14条"运行契约"，并用433个开源部署、7类注入事件、122个开发者修复三源证据加以验证，发现契约普遍缺失、部署层故障被代码层修复。
AI.motivation: 框架与平台文档给出相互矛盾的预期：平台视容器为一次性、可随时丢弃的对象，而框架需要持久化对话、暂停等待人工输入、并从保存状态恢复中断的工作。双方各自只规定自身行为，组合后产生的义务无处声明，导致生产环境中的智能体系统在重启、容器替换、优雅停机等平台事件下行为失效。
AI.method: 以"运行契约"形式刻画部署必须提供的保证。从 LangGraph 及三个部署平台的第一方文档中推导出14条契约，并构建检测规则与故障注入工具。用三类独立证据评估：(1) 433个已部署的开源智能体系统静态分析；(2) 在12个系统上注入7类平台事件；(3) 从39,261个 commit/PR/issue 中挖掘122个开发者修复，归纳为35种修复模式分类。
AI.result: 至少一条契约适用于75.5%的系统，但保证普遍缺失：需跨进程保留状态的系统中，37.4%在重启后丢状态，41.5%在容器替换后丢状态；所有可评估部署都会在排空过程中终止框架的生产服务器。注入事件将16个预测违规中的14个转化为运行时故障，7个预测成立项全部通过。开发者修复独立覆盖14条契约中的12条，78%修改应用代码，仅约三分之二完全恢复被违反的保证。
AI.conclusion: 智能体系统的可靠性故障"生于部署、修于代码"。14条契约目录、检测规则、故障注入框架与35模式修复分类，为检查与加固智能体部署提供了可复用基础；也表明需要在框架—平台边界上显式化契约，而非依赖双方各自隐含的假定。

title: Graph-dependent pooling: adaptive granularity in hierarchical graph neural networks
summary: Graph Neural Networks are widely used to learn structural representations of relational data. Hierarchical graph pooling learns multi-level representations by progressively coarsening graphs; however, prior methods rely on predefined cluster numbers or fixed pooling ratios, limiting adaptability to individual graphs. We propose Graph-Dependent Pooling (GDPool), which dynamically determines pooling granularity for each graph. We analyze optimization conflicts among layer-wise objectives through gradient alignment, showing that independently supervised pooling levels can send conflicting gradients to shared parameters. GDPool uses self-attention to select graph-specific anchors representing structurally important nodes and constructs coarse graphs through soft node assignment. Experiments on metal-organic framework and molecular graph benchmarks show that GDPool consistently achieves the best predictive performance across all benchmarks. Evaluations using modularity and the effective number of clusters show that GDPool achieves consistently higher modularity than existing methods while the number of active clusters decreases monotonically with depth. Sensitivity analyses confirm stable behavior across hyperparameter and architectural choices.

AI.tldr: 提出图依赖池化GDPool，用自注意力选取图特定锚点并通过软分配构建粗化图，动态确定每个图的池化粒度，在MOF与分子图基准上预测性能最优且模块度更高。
AI.motivation: 现有层次图池化方法依赖预定义簇数或固定池化比例，无法适应单个图的结构差异；且各池化层的独立监督目标可能向共享参数传递冲突梯度。
AI.method: 通过梯度对齐分析逐层目标的优化冲突；GDPool以自注意力选择代表结构重要节点的图特定锚点，并基于软节点分配构建粗图，从而实现图依赖的自适应池化粒度。
AI.result: 在金属有机框架（MOF）与分子图基准上均取得最佳预测性能；模块度一致高于现有方法，活跃簇数量随深度单调递减；超参数与架构选择的敏感性分析显示行为稳定。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、图依赖的池化粒度可同时提升预测性能与层次结构的聚类质量，并缓解多层监督的梯度冲突问题。

title: Collective Collaboration of Recursive Autonomous Agents
summary: Smart factories must translate order-level objectives into production tasks at multiple scales and combine the capabilities of individual units into an overall delivery capability. To address repeated adaptation of organizational mechanisms across equipment, workshops, and factories, as well as coordination across levels under changing production conditions, this paper develops a framework for the collective collaboration of recursive autonomous agents (RAAs). A common task and capability interface supports the recursive decomposition of production objectives from the top down and the aggregation of conditional capabilities through peer collaboration from the bottom up. Composite units can therefore participate in higher-level organizations as agents of the same kind. We formulate organizational models for leaf and composite units, specify interface closure under composition and conditions for finite task expansion, and develop operational mechanisms linking task decomposition, resource commitments, result aggregation, and coordination within the scope affected by change. A production network integrating machining, inspection, and logistics across multiple workshops illustrates how a common organizational kernel is instantiated at the equipment-service, workshop, and factory scales. The framework connects recursive organization with explicit task responsibilities, capability conditions, and execution interfaces for manufacturing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归自治代理（RAA）协同框架，通过统一的任务-能力接口实现生产目标的递归分解与能力的自下而上聚合，使复合单元可像同类代理一样参与更高层组织。
AI.motivation: 智能工厂需将订单级目标转化为多尺度生产任务，并把单机能力整合为整体交付能力。现有组织机制在设备、车间、工厂各层需反复适配，且在工况变化下难以跨层级协调。
AI.method: 构建RAA集体协同框架：定义统一任务与能力接口，支持目标自上而下递归分解与同伴协作下条件能力的自下而上聚合；为叶子单元与复合单元建立组织模型，规定组合下的接口封闭性与有限任务展开条件，并设计连接任务分解、资源承诺、结果聚合与变化影响域内协调的运行机制。
AI.result: 以跨多个车间、整合加工—检测—物流的生产网络为例，展示同一组织内核在设备服务、车间与工厂三个尺度的实例化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将递归组织与显式任务责任、能力条件及执行接口相连接，为制造系统提供可跨层级复用的组织内核。

title: CodeMeepo: A Multi-Agent Workflow for Repository-Level Code Migration and Optimization
summary:
Repository-level code migration rewrites an entire project in a new programming language while preserving its observable behavior. It is challenging because behavior spans interdependent modules, dependencies and build infrastructure must be adapted to the target ecosystem, and the source code is often the only specification.
  Large language model agents can now attempt these migrations end to end, but three challenges remain. First, an agent that writes both the translation and its acceptance tests may overlook the same requirements in both, leaving missing or incorrect behavior undetected. Second, large repositories can exceed a model's context window, and dividing the work into smaller tasks does not ensure that all required behavior is migrated. Third, even behaviorally correct translations may be slower than the original implementation.
  We present CodeMeepo, a multi-agent pipeline for complete and efficient migration of large repositories. Each milestone is evaluated against a fixed external oracle that the agents neither author nor modify. A separate parity assessment compares source and target components in scope and adds identified gaps back into the plan as required work. Ordered milestones limit the scope of each task, while cumulative regression checks guard against breaking already-migrated behavior. A benchmark-guided optimization phase addresses performance, followed by full-suite conformance testing and repair. Eight specialized agent roles communicate through file artifacts, and a deterministic state machine governs repair, deferral, scope changes, and termination.
  On nine subjects in three language pairs, CodeMeepo achieves the best pass rate on every subject and passes 18% more tests than a state-of-the-art multi-agent baseline using the same model. On a production daemon, its optimization phase improves half of the benchmarks, by 25% on average.

AI.tldr: CodeMeepo 是一个多智能体流水线，用于大型仓库的完整且高效的语言级代码迁移，通过外部固定 oracle、同步性评估和累计回归检查保证行为完整性，并通过基准引导的优化阶段提升性能。
AI.motivation: 仓库级代码迁移需在跨模块、跨依赖与构建基础设施的条件下保持可观察行为，且源码常是唯一规格。现有 LLM 智能体面临三大挑战：翻译与验收测试同源导致遗漏行为无法检出；大仓库超出上下文窗口，任务切分无法保证行为全覆盖；行为正确但性能退化。
AI.method: 多智能体流水线：每个里程碑由智能体既不编写也不修改的固定外部 oracle 评估；独立的 parity assessment 比较源与目标组件的范围并将已识别缺口回填为必做工作；有序里程碑限制单任务范围，累计回归检查防止破坏已迁移行为；基准引导的优化阶段处理性能，随后进行全量一致性测试与修复；8 个专职智能体角色通过文件工件通信，由确定性状态机治理修复、延期、范围变更与终止。
AI.result: 在三种语言对的九个对象上，CodeMeepo 在每个对象上均取得最高通过率，使用同一模型时比 SOTA 多智能体基线多通过 18% 的测试；在生产守护进程上，优化阶段使半数基准提升，平均提升 25%。
AI.conclusion: 通过外部 oracle 解耦、parity 缺口回填、有序里程碑与累计回归、以及基准驱动的优化，CodeMeepo 在保证迁移完整性的同时改善性能，验证了结构化多智能体状态机在仓库级迁移中的有效性。

title: RAQ-MLA: Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) has been adopted by recent frontier large language models. Instead of per-head keys and values, MLA caches a compressed KV latent that is up-projected into keys and values at decode time, together with a narrow positional key that carries position information into the attention score. Existing KV-cache quantization methods are designed around the keys and values of standard attention and do not account for what MLA actually caches, which costs accuracy at low bit widths. We analyze the MLA cache both in activation distribution and in how quantization error propagates to the attention output, and show that the two cached tensors play different roles: the latent mainly supplies the values, whereas the positional key dominates the attention score. We therefore propose RAQ-MLA (Role-Aware Quantization for Multi-Head Latent Attention Caches), which fits an invertible transform to each cached tensor against the error that tensor delivers to the attention output: attention-weighted value error for the latent and score perturbation for the positional key. Without training, RAQ-MLA quantizes the full MLA cache to about 2.5 bits per element, a 6.5x increase in theoretical KV-cache capacity, while remaining nearly lossless on reasoning and coding tasks across four MLA models.

AI.tldr: 提出RAQ-MLA，针对MLA中两类缓存张量（压缩KV隐向量与位置键）的角色差异，分别以面向注意力输出误差的可逆变换进行无需训练的量化，实现约2.5bit/元素、6.5倍KV缓存容量提升且近乎无损。
AI.motivation: MLA已被前沿大模型采用，其缓存的是压缩后的KV隐向量（decode时上投影为K、V）以及携带位置信息的窄位置键，而非标准注意力中的逐头K/V。现有KV-cache量化方法基于标准注意力的K/V设计，未考虑MLA实际缓存对象，低比特下精度损失明显。
AI.method: 先分析MLA缓存的激活分布与量化误差向注意力输出的传播路径，发现两个缓存张量角色不同：隐向量主要提供V，位置键主导注意力分数。据此提出RAQ-MLA，为每个缓存张量拟合一个可逆变换，针对该张量对注意力输出造成的误差进行优化——隐向量对齐注意力加权后的值误差，位置键对齐分数扰动。整个过程无需训练。
AI.result: 将完整MLA缓存量化至约2.5 bit/元素，理论KV缓存容量提升6.5倍；在四个MLA模型上，推理与代码任务上几乎无损。
AI.conclusion: 按缓存张量对注意力输出的实际影响进行角色感知的误差定制量化，是MLA缓存低比特压缩的有效路径；该方法无需训练即可在极低比特下保持性能，并为MLA专用KV缓存压缩提供了新范式。

title: Implicit Beliefs as Scalable Process Rewards for Strategic Persuasion
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop (Large Language Models for Social Reasoning and Simulation)
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn strategic persuasion faces two coupled obstacles: (i) realistic simulation of psychologically grounded persuadees, and (ii) dense, faithful supervision for credit assignment in strategic dialogues. Outcome-only rewards are sparse and uninformative about which conversational moves drove success, while LLM-judge process rewards are expensive and decoupled from the underlying interaction dynamics. We address both challenges with a unified framework. First, we introduce PersuArena, a persuasion simulation environment that produces realistic, non-monotonic trajectories. Second, building directly on this environment, we propose Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization (Probe-RPO), an online RL framework that converts the persuadee's internal state into dense process rewards. At each turn, three introspective probes are read from the frozen persuadee's logits, yielding a multi-dimensional reward signal that is faithfully aligned with persuasion dynamics. With extensive experiments on PersuArena spanning healthcare, financial advising, workplace management, education, and personal relationships, we demonstrate that our Probe-RPO achieves the full acceptance rate of 52.5%, compared with the 35.8% for the strongest GRPO ablation and 25.8% for the best off-the-shelf LLM. We also conduct comprehensive analyses on the generalization across persuadee models and the persuasion dynamics across conversations. Our work offers a promising paradigm that can provide effective process supervision for strategic dialogue.

AI.tldr: 提出 PersuArena 多轮说服模拟环境，并基于冻结被说服者 logits 的内省探针构建在线过程奖励，配合 RPO 强化学习训练 LLM，接受率达 52.5%，显著优于 GRPO 消融（35.8%）与现成 LLM（25.8%）。
AI.motivation: 多轮策略性说服训练存在两个耦合障碍：一是缺乏心理机制上可信的被说服者模拟；二是策略对话中信用分配的监督信号稀疏或不可靠。纯结果奖励过于稀疏，无法指出哪些对话动作驱动了成功；而 LLM-judge 过程奖励昂贵且与底层交互动力学解耦。
AI.method: 统一框架：(1) PersuArena——产生真实、非单调对话轨迹的说服模拟环境；(2) Probe-RPO（Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization）——在线强化学习框架，在每一回合从冻结被说服者的 logits 中读取三个内省探针，将内部状态转化为多维稠密过程奖励，并与说服动力学保持一致，用于相对策略优化的信用分配。
AI.result: 在覆盖医疗健康、财务咨询、职场管理、教育与人际关系五大领域的 PersuArena 上，Probe-RPO 达到 52.5% 的完全接受率，最强 GRPO 消融为 35.8%，最佳现成 LLM 为 25.8%。此外还分析了跨被说服者模型的泛化性与对话中的说服动力学演化。
AI.conclusion: 以被说服者内部状态在线导出的稠密过程奖励，可为策略性对话提供有效的过程监督，构成一种有前景的范式，替代稀疏结果奖励与昂贵 LLM-judge 过程奖励。

title: Thinking-in-Bets at Test Time Reduces Sycophantic Revisions in LLM Agents
summary: Language model agents often abandon correct work when a user challenges it, yet simply telling them to stand firm makes them ignore real mistakes. Once an agent reads a complaint, it tends to discount its own earlier checks in order to agree with the user. We introduce Thinking-in-Bets, a training-free method in which an agent writes a short private record of its main claims, the checks supporting them, and its confidence before reading user feedback. When challenged, the agent consults this Claim Checklist to keep verified work intact while investigating uncertain or newly challenged parts. We evaluate five Gemini models (3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.5 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.8 Flash, and 4.0 Argon) across eight benchmarks: SWE-Together, SWE-Interact, and DeepSWE for software engineering, Agents' Last Exam for professional reports, Humanity's Last Exam and SycEval for academic reasoning, Vals Finance for financial analysis, and Terminal-Bench for command-line tasks. Recording claims before criticism nearly eliminates false reversals in patch review and protects passing report drafts under mistaken pushback, whereas writing the same record after reading the complaint recovers very little of the gain. In multi-turn coding, pre-reply claim records substantially reduce unnecessary file edits after mistaken complaints, and gating the record so it is written only when the agent is uncertain lowers token overhead while fixing more real bugs than the baseline. Even in non-interactive tasks without user feedback, listing the key claims in a draft and re-checking the weakest one before submission improves both answer accuracy and confidence estimates across all tested models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 Thinking-in-Bets 方法：智能体在读取用户反馈前先写下"主张清单"（主要主张、支持性检查与置信度），遭遇质疑时据此保留已验证工作、只重查不确定或被新质疑的部分，从而在五款 Gemini 模型、八个基准上显著减少错误性自我推翻。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体存在两难：面对用户质疑时常放弃原本正确的工作（虚假反转），而单纯要求其"坚持立场"又会忽略真实错误。根因在于智能体一旦读到投诉，就会贬低自己先前的检查以迎合用户，因此需要一种机制在反馈到来前锁定已验证结论。
AI.method: Thinking-in-Bets 为训练-free 方法：智能体在读取用户反馈前，私下记录主要主张、支撑这些主张的检查以及置信度，形成 Claim Checklist；被质疑时对照该清单，保留已验证内容、仅调查不确定或新增质疑部分。实验覆盖五个 Gemini 模型（3.5 Flash-Lite、3.5 Flash、3.6 Flash、3.8 Flash、4.0 Argon）与八个基准（SWE-Together、SWE-Interact、DeepSWE、Agents' Last Exam、Humanity's Last Exam、SycEval、Vals Finance、Terminal-Bench），并对比"读投诉后再记录"的消融设置及不确定性触发的记录门控。
AI.result: 批评前记录主张几乎消除补丁评审中的虚假反转，并在错误反驳下保护原本通过的报告草稿；而读投诉后再写同样记录几乎无法获得收益。多轮编码中，回复前记录主张大幅减少误投诉后的多余文件修改；仅在智能体不确定时写记录可在降低 token 开销的同时修复比基线更多真实 bug。即使在无用户反馈的非交互任务中，提交前列出关键主张并复查最薄弱一项，也能在所有测试模型上提升答案准确率与置信度估计质量。
AI.conclusion: 关键在于记录主张的时序：反馈前而非反馈后的"主张押注"式记录，能同时缓解谄媚式反转与盲目坚持两个极端，且无需训练即可泛化到交互与非交互任务，具备低开销的部署可行性。

title: AlphaIdeaBench: Benchmarking Automated Research Idea Generation under Feasibility Constraints with Peer Review Alignment
summary: Research ideas are always proposed under resource constraints: a plan must fit the available compute, API credit, and time. Yet evaluations of research-ideation agents mostly score unconstrained novelty or overlap with a published paper, and their LLM judges are rarely checked against peer review. We introduce AlphaIdeaBench, a benchmark of 100 ideation tasks (50 workshop calls for papers and 50 open problems stated in surveys), each paired with an explicit resource budget and a shared proposal schema. An LLM judge scores each proposal on 12 dimensions covering validity, novelty, and feasibility. To validate the judge, we compare its scores on four novelty axes (problem, method, scenario, and insight) with scores derived from reviewer comments on 600 papers from ICLR 2026, NeurIPS 2025, and ICML 2025. For problem and method novelty, Gemini 3.7 Flash is within one point of the reviewer-derived score on 94-97% of papers; agreement on scenario novelty is relatively lower. We evaluate eight published harnesses on a shared backbone and, within one harness, eight backbone LLMs. CoI-Agent obtains the highest overall score, narrowly ahead of SciMON, which leads on method and insight novelty. All harnesses score low on scenario novelty and rarely change the problem setting. The backbone largely determines which open problem a proposal targets, whereas the harness determines whether a proposal addresses one problem or combines several. Weaker backbones such as Llama 4 Scout fail to carry out that harness's strategy and score low on budget feasibility. Finally, when only the budget is varied on three topics, a larger budget changes the experimental setting on compute-intensive topics but only adds tests on an inexpensive one. We release the tasks, rubrics, and scores to foster standardized, reproducible benchmarking of future research-ideation agents under constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AlphaIdeaBench，一个面向资源受限条件下研究构思智能体的基准，包含100个带显式预算与统一提案模式的构思任务，并以同行评审评论校准的12维LLM评审器进行评测，同时系统比较8个已发表框架与8个骨干模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有研究构思智能体的评测多只考察无约束的新颖性或与已发表论文的重合度，忽略了真实构思始终受算力、API额度与时间等资源约束；且其LLM评审器很少经过同行评审的校准验证。因此缺少兼顾资源约束与评审可信度的标准化基准。
AI.method: 构建100个构思任务（50个工作坊征稿、50个综述中的开放问题），每个任务配显式资源预算与共享提案模式；用LLM评审器从效度、新颖性、可行性共12个维度打分；将评审器在问题、方法、场景、洞见四个新颖性轴上与ICLR 2026、NeurIPS 2025、ICML 2025共600篇论文的评审意见推导分数进行比对以验证评审器；在统一骨干上评测8个已发表框架，并在同一框架内评测8个骨干LLM；另在3个主题上仅变化预算以考察预算效应。
AI.result: 问题与方法新颖性上，Gemini 3.7 Flash与评审推导分数的差距在94–97%论文上不超过1分，场景新颖性一致性相对较低。CoI-Agent总体得分最高，SciMON紧随其后并在方法与洞见新颖性上领先；所有框架在场景新颖性上得分偏低，且很少改变问题设定。骨干模型主要决定提案针对哪个开放问题，框架则决定提案是聚焦单一问题还是组合多个问题；较弱骨干（如Llama 4 Scout）无法执行框架策略，预算可行性得分低。仅变化预算时，大预算在算力密集型主题上改变实验设定，在低成本主题上仅增加测试。
AI.conclusion: 该工作公开任务、评分细则与得分，为未来资源受限研究构思智能体提供标准化、可复现的评测基础；同时揭示构思智能体在场景新颖性、资源可行性及弱骨干适配上的明显短板。

title: Clustering of High-Dimensional Human Gene Score Data for Target Cell Classification
summary: The goal is to investigate whether the total human gene-score dataset and the selected human kinase-gene dataset exhibit the same number of clusters when analysed using the same set of 769 features. Two datasets were considered: the complete gene score dataset and a subset containing selected kinase genes. Two missing-data strategies were investigated. In Case I, rows containing missing gene-score values were removed. In Case II, rows with more than 20% missing values were excluded and the other missing values were replaced by the corresponding column mean. For each case, the data were scaled and principal component analysis (PCA) was performed before clustering. Four clustering approaches were considered: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, Fuzzy C-Means, and Graph-based Clustering. Across both datasets and both missing-data treatments, the optimal number of clusters was found to be two. In the absence of an optimal number of clusters, the quality of clustering was assessed using the Silhouette score. Relatively high Silhouette scores were obtained in all cases.

AI.tldr: 本研究用同一套769个特征，比较完整人类基因打分数据集与筛选出的激酶基因子集在两种缺失值处理方案（整行删除 vs. 剔除缺失超20%的行并均值填补）下的聚类数目。经标准化、PCA降维后，采用K-Means、层次聚类、模糊C-Means与图聚类四种方法，所有情形下最优簇数均为2，并以轮廓系数评估聚类质量，得分普遍较高。
AI.motivation: 验证完整基因打分数据与精选激酶基因子集在相同特征空间下是否呈现一致的簇结构，从而判断激酶子集能否代表整体基因数据的分群特征。
AI.method: 构建两个数据集（全基因打分集、激酶基因子集）；两种缺失值处理：Case I 删除含缺失的行，Case II 剔除缺失>20%的行并以列均值填补其余缺失；随后标准化、PCA降维，再分别用K-Means、层次聚类、模糊C-Means、图聚类四种算法聚类，以轮廓系数（无最优簇数时的替代指标）评价聚类质量。
AI.result: 在两种数据集与两种缺失值处理的全部组合下，最优簇数均被判定为2；各情形轮廓系数相对较高，说明两簇划分结构清晰且可重复。
AI.conclusion: 激酶基因子集与完整基因打分数据在769维特征空间中具有一致的聚类结构（均为两簇），表明该子集可反映整体数据的可分群特性；结果对缺失值处理策略与聚类算法选择具有稳健性。

title: The Physical Cost of Context: Quality-Constrained Resource Accounting for Coding Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI). 15 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: Coding agents resend a growing context on every model call, and context policies are usually judged by the prompt tokens they save. Executed work also depends on call count and prefix reuse: a caching runtime prefills only the tokens after the longest cached prefix. A shorter prompt can therefore cost more if it rewrites cached history. Our quality-gated protocol splits executed prefill into logical prompt minus reused prefix and measures KV residency, time, and energy. On 450 localization cases derived from SWE-rebench V2, preloading ten retrieved blocks (Eager) and adding anchored history compaction (Compact) both pass a five-point non-inferiority gate. In a separate 900-cell study, Eager cuts model calls by 35.7% and the GPU-energy proxy by 33.2% against on-demand search (Grep); Compact saves nothing further. Enabling prefix caching leaves Eager's prompt volume similar (+8.3%; its 95% CI spans zero) but cuts its uncached prefill by 67.7%. Deleting history can turn a token saving into extra work. With mini-SWE-agent on 100 SWE-bench Verified instances, keeping only the last five observations (Mask-5) cuts Eager's prompt volume by 33.3% but loses 135.9k reusable tokens per task. Uncached prefill rises by 608.5%, the energy proxy by 125.6%, and the policy misses the quality gate. Policies thus save physical work by shortening the trajectory and can multiply it by editing reusable history.

AI.tldr: 论文提出按"质量门控"协议将实际执行的prefill拆分为"逻辑prompt减去复用前缀"，结合KV驻留、时间与能耗来评估上下文策略，发现缩短轨迹的策略能真正节省物理开销，而编辑可复用历史可能反而成倍增加开销。
AI.motivation: 编码代理每次模型调用都会重发不断增长的上下文，而现有上下文策略通常仅以节省的prompt token数来评判，忽略了调用次数与前缀复用（缓存运行时只对最长缓存前缀之后的token做prefill），因此更短的prompt若重写缓存历史反而可能代价更高。
AI.method: 提出质量门控协议：将执行的prefill分解为"逻辑prompt − 复用前缀"，并度量KV驻留、时间与能耗。在SWE-rebench V2派生的450个定位用例上，对比预加载十个检索块的Eager与加入锚定历史压缩的Compact（均需通过五点非劣性门槛）；另做900单元研究对比Eager与按需搜索Grep，并测试开启前缀缓存的影响；在mini-SWE-agent上于100个SWE-bench Verified实例测试Mask-5策略。
AI.result: 450个定位用例中Eager与Compact均通过非劣性门槛；900单元研究中Eager相对Grep减少35.7%模型调用、GPU能耗代理降低33.2%，Compact无进一步节省。开启前缀缓存后Eager的prompt量相近（+8.3%，95%CI跨零），但未缓存prefill下降67.7%。Mask-5使Eager的prompt量降33.3%，但每任务损失135.9k可复用token，未缓存prefill上升608.5%、能耗代理上升125.6%，且未通过质量门控。
AI.conclusion: 上下文策略应通过缩短轨迹来节省真实物理开销，而编辑可复用历史可能将节省的token转化为成倍增加的额外工作；仅以prompt token衡量策略优劣具有误导性。

title: TAD: Distilling Vision-Language-Action Policies from Teacher Trajectories Alone
summary: Online distillation of vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly relies on teacher action scores that an inference-only interface may not expose. Trajectory-only Adversarial Distillation (\gad{}) instead turns a fixed bank of teacher joint-position features into adaptive feedback: a discriminator compares feature marginals from teacher and student rollouts and supplies rewards for on-policy learning. The student interacts with the environment without online teacher queries or environment task rewards. On ManiSkill \texttt{PutOnPlateInScene25Main}, \gad{} improves OpenVLA-OFT (7B) from $26.2\%$ to $76.6\%$ \successonce{} ($+50.4$ percentage points) and from $20.3\%$ to $58.6\%$ \successend{}. It trails white-box on-policy distillation (OPD) at $81.6\%$ / $59.4\%$ by $5.0$ / $0.8$ percentage points ($n{=}256$ evaluation trajectories per checkpoint). The tested four-epoch continuation achieves the highest \gad{} result without additional teacher data. This best run uses $5\times$ OPD's student interaction budget and $12.5\times$ its complete-rollout batch-passes. The comparison demonstrates online VLA improvement without teacher scoring while quantifying unequal interaction and optimization budgets.

AI.tldr: 轨迹级对抗蒸馏（GAD）无需教师动作分数，仅用固定教师关节位置特征库训练判别器并提供奖励，实现无教师在线查询与环境任务奖励的VLA策略在线蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在线蒸馏依赖教师动作分数，但仅推理接口往往无法暴露这些分数，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 将固定的教师关节位置特征库转化为自适应反馈：判别器比较教师与学生rollout的特征边缘分布，据此生成奖励用于学生在线策略学习；学生与环境交互，但不查询教师、不使用环境任务奖励。
AI.result: ManiSkill PutOnPlateInScene25Main上，OpenVLA-OFT（7B）成功率从26.2%提升至76.6%（+50.4pp，successonce），从20.3%提升至58.6%（successend）；相比白盒在线蒸馏（OPD）的81.6%/59.4%分别低5.0/0.8pp；四轮延续训练取得GAD最佳结果，但交互预算为OPD的5倍、完整rollout批次数为12.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 在线VLA改进可在无教师评分条件下实现，但效果略逊于白盒OPD，且未等量核算交互与优化预算。

title: Nowcasting aerosol particle size distributions from PM2.5 with physics-regularized flow matching
summary: The mass concentration of particles smaller than 2.5um (PM2.5) is cheap to measure and widely monitored, whereas the particle number size distribution (PSD) requires costly instruments and is measured at only a few research stations. Yet many aerosol effects, such as vapor uptake, cloud droplet formation and deposition in the human respiratory tract, depend on the PSD rather than on mass. We explore whether recent generative deep learning models can nowcast the PSD: from the PM2.5 record and eight meteorological parameters over a 24h window, a model generates an ensemble of plausible hourly size distributions for the same window, reflecting that one mass can arise from many size distributions. Rather than proposing a single best model, we use two contrasting Finnish stations, the boreal forest site Hyytiälä and the urban site Kumpula, as a controlled testbed. On it, we benchmark six generative models against deterministic and climatological baselines, locally and after transfer between sites, and test physical constraints for neural network training. Flow matching performs best overall; its guided variant has the lowest continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) at both sites. A constraint based on a reduced aerosol general dynamic equation (GDE) lowers the CRPS by 5.5-11.5% at the training site and reduces errors after transfer between sites. Transfer remains harder than local estimation, identifying training on large multi-station data sets as the next step towards PSD estimates at unmonitored locations. This benchmark establishes physics-informed generative models as a promising route from routine air-quality monitoring to size-resolved aerosol information.

AI.tldr: 本文以芬兰两个对比站点为测试平台，系统基准了六种生成式深度学习模型，仅用PM2.5与8个气象参数在24小时窗口内即可生成集合式逐时粒径谱（PSD）；Flow matching（尤其是其引导变体）表现最佳，基于简化气溶胶GDE的物理约束可将CRPS降低5.5–11.5%，跨站点迁移仍较困难。
AI.motivation: PM2.5质量浓度测量成本低、监测网络广，而粒径谱（PSD）测量依赖昂贵仪器、站点稀少；但许多气溶胶效应（吸湿增长、云滴形成、呼吸道沉积）取决于粒径谱而非质量浓度，因此希望从常规空气质量监测数据推断粒径分辨信息。
AI.method: 输入为24小时窗口的PM2.5序列与8个气象参数，输出为同一窗口逐时PSD的集合（体现“同一质量可对应多种粒径谱”的非唯一性）。以Hyytiälä（北方森林）与Kumpula（城市）两站构成受控测试平台，将六种生成式模型与确定性基线、气候学基线对比，考察本地训练与站点间迁移，并测试用于神经网络训练的物理约束（基于简化的气溶胶通用动力学方程GDE）。
AI.result: Flow matching整体最优，其引导变体在两站均取得最低CRPS；基于简化GDE的物理约束使训练站点CRPS下降5.5–11.5%，并降低跨站点迁移误差。迁移性能仍逊于本地估计。
AI.conclusion: 该基准表明，物理信息生成式模型是从常规空气质量监测走向粒径分辨气溶胶信息的可行路径；未来需在大型多站点数据集上训练，以支持无监测站点的PSD估计。

title: Silent and Costly: Characterizing and Detecting Prompt-Caching Mis-Integration in LLM Agents
summary:
Large language model (LLM) services process massive volumes of user requests, resulting in substantial inference costs. To reduce both cost and latency, providers have introduced prompt caching. However, correctly integrating prompt caching is non-trivial due to heterogeneous provider-specific APIs and continuously evolving caching semantics. To understand prompt-caching mis-integration in downstream applications, we conduct the first empirical study of 120 prompt-caching-related pull requests from 10 popular open-source agent systems. Our findings show that prompt-caching mis-integrations arise in both request-side misconfiguration and read-side usage miscount. More importantly, most mis-integrations fail silently without causing observable runtime failures.
  Motivated by these findings, we design CACHELINT, which models a prompt-caching mis-integration as an invocation site together with the preconditions required for correct cache integration. CACHELINT locates caching invocation sites with CodeQL and discharges each precondition either against a dated provider capability oracle or with an LLM guard check. CACHELINT achieves 0.71 precision and 0.78 recall in identifying the 120 labeled mis-integrations across the 10 studied agent systems. Our evaluation further demonstrates the effectiveness of CACHELINT in real-world settings, identifying 32 mis-integrations across 571 agent projects with 0.86 precision. These findings have received 21 developer confirmations and led to 18 upstream fixes, including one in Anthropic's official SDK.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证研究开源智能体系统中提示缓存的错误集成问题，提出 CACHELINT 工具检测此类"静默失败"的误集成，在 571 个项目中取得 0.86 精度并推动 18 处上游修复。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务推理成本高，供应商引入提示缓存以降本降延；但各供应商 API 异构、缓存语义持续演进，正确集成提示缓存并非易事，且误集成大多静默失败、不产生可观测的运行时错误，缺乏系统性认识与自动化检测手段。
AI.method: 实证研究：分析 10 个主流开源智能体系统中的 120 个提示缓存相关 PR，归纳误集成类型（请求侧配置错误、读取侧用量计量错误）。工具设计：CACHELINT 将一次误集成建模为"调用点 + 正确集成的若干前置条件"；用 CodeQL 定位缓存调用点，再对每个前置条件分别通过带时间戳的供应商能力 oracle 或 LLM guard 检查来判定。
AI.result: 在 10 个智能体系统的 120 个标注误集成上达到 0.71 精确率、0.78 召回率；在 571 个真实智能体项目中检出 32 处误集成，精确率 0.86；获 21 次开发者确认，促成 18 处上游修复，含 Anthropic 官方 SDK 中的一处。
AI.conclusion: 提示缓存误集成普遍存在且以静默方式失效，供应商 API 与语义异构是主要成因；基于"调用点—前置条件"建模、结合代码查询与能力 oracle/LLM 校验的静态检测方案可有效发现此类缺陷，并在真实生态中产生实质性修复影响。

title: Jointly Modeling Preferences and Imperfect Decision-Making in Large Language Models
summary: Do preferences Large Language Models (LLMs) express in standard elicitation tasks predict their strategic behaviour? LLM agents interacting with humans and other AI systems face potentially conflicting objectives, such as individual welfare, group welfare, and environmental concerns. Prior work characterizes LLM preferences through behavioral-economic and psychological elicitation or strategic games, but rarely tests consistency across settings and prediction in other strategic environments. This requires modeling how competing objectives jointly shape behavior, whereas existing approaches typically measure preference dimensions in isolation. Drawing on utility theory, we introduce the Preference-Behavior Model (PBM), which combines a preference representation with mechanisms capturing imperfect utility maximization. We formulate estimation as an inverse-game problem, jointly inferring preferences and behavioral parameters from observed choices. We evaluate PBM in three social dilemmas that expose conflicting motives: a Public Goods Game, a Collective-Risk Dilemma, and a Common-Pool Resource dilemma. We find that while preferences estimated from established behavioral economic elicitation instruments do not consistently predict behavior in these dilemmas, models fitted in one dilemma retain predictive value in others, suggesting that inferred preferences capture meaningful aspects of LLM decision-making that elicitation instruments may miss. Finally, we assess alignment with persona instructions, finding that inferred preferences broadly reflect intended priorities with specific divergences across dimensions, LLMs, and games being identified by our approach. Our methodology provides a framework for studying how consistently LLM preferences explain behavior, assessing alignment with intended priorities, and revealing trade-offs and behavioral patterns that standard elicitation may miss.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"偏好-行为模型"(PBM),将偏好表示与不完全效用最大化机制结合,以逆博弈方式从社会困境中的选择行为联合推断LLM的偏好与行为参数;发现传统行为经济学引出工具测得的偏好不能稳定预测LLM在公共品博弈、集体风险困境和公共池塘资源困境中的行为,但在单一困境中拟合的模型可跨困境保持预测力,且推断偏好大体反映人设指令的预期优先级。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在与人类及其他AI交互时面临个体福利、群体福利、环境关切等潜在冲突目标。既有工作或通过行为经济学/心理学引出任务刻画偏好,或通过策略博弈观察行为,但很少检验两类情境间的一致性与跨环境可预测性;且现有方法通常孤立测量单一偏好维度,无法刻画多重目标如何共同塑造行为。
AI.method: 借鉴效用理论构建Preference-Behavior Model:偏好表示+刻画不完全效用最大化的行为机制;将估计表述为逆博弈问题,从观测选择中联合推断偏好参数与行为参数;在三个暴露动机冲突的社会困境(公共品博弈、集体风险困境、公共池塘资源困境)中评估;并考察推断偏好与人设指令的一致性。
AI.result: 由既有行为经济学引出工具估计的偏好无法一致地预测三个困境中的行为;而在某一困境中拟合的模型在其他困境中仍具预测价值,说明推断偏好捕捉了引出工具可能遗漏的有意义的决策特征;推断偏好总体反映人设指令的预期优先级,但在维度、模型与博弈层面存在具体偏差,并可揭示权衡与行为模式。
AI.conclusion: PBM为研究LLM偏好解释行为的一致性、评估与预期优先级的对齐程度、揭示标准引出方法遗漏的权衡与行为模式提供了统一框架。

title: Variational Atlas Autoencoders and Self-Supervised Chart Selection
summary: Complex, high-dimensional data lie on manifolds that a single global latent coordinate system cannot represent without distortion. We introduce Variational Atlas Autoencoders, a mixture-of-charts framework that learns an atlas of local latent representations, each responsible for one region of the data manifold. The central difficulty in learning an atlas is deciding which chart should be responsible for which data point without labels. We show that this decision need not be a heuristic. By treating the chart index as a latent variable, the evidence lower bound yields the training objective and casts chart assignment as posterior inference, valid for any routing distribution. Within this framework, we propose latent-evidence routing, which assigns a point to a chart in proportion to the evidence of its encoding under that chart's latent prior. This has a simple interpretation: the closer a point lands to the center of a chart's latent space, and the more confidently it is placed there, the more likely it is to belong to that chart. Chart assignment thus emerges as posterior inference, depends on the encoder alone, and is fully self-supervised, so the charts discover structure in the data on their own, separating classes and subclasses such as distinct types of shoes or faces without access to labels. We further recover an atlas from the trained charts by identifying their overlaps and transition maps, enabling continuous interpolation within and across charts that stays close to the data manifold rather than traversing unsupported regions of latent space. Compared to capacity-matched baselines, Variational Atlas Autoencoders yields better-structured latent spaces and higher sample quality on image datasets including CelebA, while sampling requires evaluating only a single chart's decoder.

AI.tldr: 提出变分图册自编码器（VAAE）：把数据流形分解为多个局部潜图册的混合模型，用潜变量推断实现无监督图册路由，并从训练好的图册恢复重叠与转移映射，实现贴近流形的连续插值。
AI.motivation: 单一全局潜坐标系难以无失真地表示复杂高维流形数据；学习图册的关键难点在于无标签下决定哪个局部图负责哪个数据点，现有做法多依赖启发式路由。
AI.method: 将图册索引视为潜变量，由证据下界（ELBO）直接导出训练目标，并把图册分配形式化为后验推断，对任意路由分布均成立。据此提出潜证据路由：按该图潜先验下编码证据的大小成比例分配数据点（越靠近潜空间中心、放置越自信则归属概率越高）。路由仅依赖编码器、完全自监督；再由训练后的各图识别重叠区域与转移映射以拼接成完整图册。
AI.result: 与容量匹配的基线相比，在包括 CelebA 的图像数据集上获得结构更好的潜空间与更高的样本质量；采样时仅需计算单个图的解码器；各图可自发分离类别与子类（如不同鞋型、人脸类型）；跨图插值保持在数据流形附近，避免穿越潜空间中无支撑区域。
AI.conclusion: 图册分配可作为后验推断而非启发式，从而以理论一致的方式无监督地获得局部潜表示；该方法在潜空间结构化、样本质量与流形约束插值方面优于容量匹配基线，且采样效率高。

title: Large Language Models for Quantum Code Translation: An Exploratory Study
summary: Quantum software development is challenged by quantum-mechanical semantics and fragmented software development kits (SDKs), which complicate cross-SDK code translation and execution. In this paper, we propose an LLM-based approach for translating executable programs between high-level quantum SDKs. We develop a quantum-aware translation workflow whose prompt design and validation reflect quantum semantics and accommodate the version evolution of quantum ecosystems. We conduct a preliminary evaluation of 4 LLM configurations on 43 tasks, translating Qiskit programs to PennyLane and Q#. LLMs achieve a zero-shot Pass@1 of up to 72.33%, while one-shot prompting further improves the translation effectiveness. These results suggest potential for quantum code translation by LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的量子软件SDK间代码翻译方法，设计面向量子语义的翻译工作流，并在Qiskit到PennyLane、Q#的43个任务上初步评估其有效性（零样本Pass@1最高72.33%）。
AI.motivation: 量子软件开发受制于量子力学语义的复杂性和碎片化的软件开发工具包（SDK），导致跨SDK的代码翻译与执行困难。
AI.method: 构建量子感知的翻译工作流，其提示设计（prompt design）与验证机制反映量子语义，并兼顾量子生态系统的版本演化；在43个任务上对4种LLM配置进行初步评估，将Qiskit程序翻译为PennyLane与Q#。
AI.result: LLM实现最高72.33%的零样本Pass@1，且单样本（one-shot）提示进一步提升翻译效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明LLM在量子代码翻译方面具有潜力。

title: Physics-Informed Graph-Based Safe RL with Constraint-Specific Critics for Community Battery Coordination in Distribution Network
summary: High penetrations of distributed energy resources (DERs) and fast-varying electric vehicle (EV) charging intensify voltage and line-limit violations in distribution networks (DNs), making safe, low-cost operation increasingly challenging. This paper proposes a physics-informed safe deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for coordinating community battery energy storage systems to mitigate constraint violations while minimizing operating cost. To represent nonlocal spatiotemporal interactions, we develop a dual-level physics-informed graph representation in which line impedance and capacity shape spatial information propagation, while power-balance, voltage-profile, and flow-reconstruction losses regularize the latent state toward control-relevant physical consistency. Building on this representation, we develop Lagrangian Dedicated-Critic PPO (LDCPPO), which implements constraint-specific value decomposition: independent reward and cost critics preserve heterogeneous voltage- and line-loading-related learning signals and combine their advantages only during the Lagrangian policy update. Case studies on DNs with high rooftop photovoltaic penetration and EV charging demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the key voltage-violation degree by up to 80.5% compared with the tested baselines, while also achieving the lowest voltage-violation count and line-overload degree with competitive operating cost.

AI.tldr: 提出物理信息引导的安全深度强化学习框架，协调社区电池储能以抑制配电网电压与线路越限，兼顾运行成本；含双层物理信息图表示与LDCPPO算法。
AI.motivation: 分布式能源高渗透与电动汽车快变充电加剧配电网电压与线路容量越限，安全、低成本运行愈发困难。
AI.method: (1) 双层物理信息图表示：以线路阻抗与容量塑造空间信息传播，并以功率平衡、电压分布与潮流重构损失对潜状态进行物理一致性正则；(2) Lagrangian Dedicated-Critic PPO（LDCPPO）：约束专用价值分解，独立奖励与成本critic保留电压类与线路负载类异构学习信号，仅在拉格朗日策略更新时融合优势。
AI.result: 在高屋顶光伏渗透与EV充电的配电网算例中，关键电压越限程度较基线最高降低80.5%，同时取得最低越限次数与线路过载程度，运行成本具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息图表示与专用多critic拉格朗日策略优化相结合，可在保证约束安全性的同时保持成本竞争力，为社区储能协调控制提供有效方案。

title: H-GLow: Accelerating Graph Generation via Hazard-Guided Discrete Flow Matching
summary: Discrete flow matching (DFM) offers a promising approach to graph generation; however, generating high-quality graphs with few steps remains challenging due to the strong dependencies between nodes and edges. Although DFM decouples training from sampling, enabling flexible sampling strategies without retraining, existing graph DFM samplers often rely on task-specific heuristics, substantially expanding the hyperparameter space. Moreover, graph DFM models still require sampling budgets comparable to those of diffusion-based approaches, leaving their potential for accelerating graph generation only partially realized. In this work, we introduce H-Glow, a hazard-guided framework for accelerating graph generation built on the decomposition of Continuous-Time Markov chain (CTMC) generators into hazards and conditional jump distributions. H-Glow leverages these quantities to plan graph edits and dynamically adjust the sampling time to graph activity. H-Glow can be adapted to pretrained graph DFM models, substantially improving the generation quality with fewer steps. We further introduce a novel graph DFM model based on the conditional generator matching framework, which directly predicts hazards and conditional jumps, and show that its training objective decomposes exactly into hazard matching and hazard-weighted jump prediction. Experiments on molecular and synthetic graph benchmarks demonstrate improved generation quality with substantially fewer sampling steps.

AI.tldr: 提出H-Glow，一种基于CTMC生成器分解为hazard与条件跳跃分布的hazard引导框架，用于加速图离散流匹配(DFM)采样，并提出直接预测hazard与条件跳跃的新图DFM模型。
AI.motivation: 图DFM虽将训练与采样解耦，但现有采样器依赖任务特定启发式，超参数空间大；且采样预算仍与扩散方法相当，加速潜力未充分释放。节点与边强依赖使少步高质量生成困难。
AI.method: 将CTMC生成器分解为hazard与条件跳跃分布；H-Glow利用这些量规划图编辑并依据图活动度动态调整采样时间，可适配预训练图DFM模型；同时基于条件生成器匹配框架提出新图DFM模型，直接预测hazard与条件跳跃，其训练目标精确分解为hazard匹配与hazard加权的跳跃预测。
AI.result: 在分子与合成图基准上，以显著更少的采样步数取得更优的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: H-Glow通过hazard引导的采样规划与时间自适应，实现少步高质量图生成，并可即插即用于预训练模型，配合新训练目标进一步统一了理论分解与实现。

title: Ethics by Configuration: AI Ethics Principles in Coding Agent Instructions
summary: As AI coding agents become integral to software development, projects increasingly utilise configuration files, such as context files and skills, to govern agent behaviour. While AI ethics principles are widely used in research and policy, little is known about whether and how they are reflected when developers configure coding agents. We studied ethics principles in 40,079 configuration files across 8,893 GitHub repositories. Using a validated large language model (LLM) classification, we measured the prevalence of ethics-related statements, and qualitatively analysed 702 stratified samples across 679 files to uncover the ethical considerations reflected in these files and the parties they concern. Ethics-related statements appeared in 39.4% of files and 61.5% of repositories; concentrated on accountability, transparency, privacy protection, and reliability; and occurred more often in task-specific files such as skills than in project-wide context files. Our qualitative analysis identified 30 categories of ethical considerations, which take the form of concrete rules for the agent. Accountability appeared mainly as requirements for human approval, transparency as explain and honestly report the agent's work, and fairness as accessibility and localisation. These considerations reveal a difference in focus. Whereas public ethics frameworks aim to protect society and end users, configuration files mainly concern developers, maintainers, and community members in the development workflow. Ethics-related content appeared mainly in prose-based files, and whether agents follow these instructions remains untested. We discuss the implications for practitioners, researchers, and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 对8,893个GitHub仓库中的40,079个AI编码代理配置文件进行LLM分类与定性分析，发现39.4%的文件包含伦理相关表述，其关注点集中于开发者工作流而非终端用户。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理日益融入软件开发，开发者通过上下文文件、技能等配置文件约束代理行为；尽管AI伦理原则在研究与政策中广泛存在，但开发者配置代理时是否及如何体现这些原则尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于验证过的大语言模型分类方法，测量40,079个配置文件（8,893个仓库）中伦理相关表述的普遍程度；并对679个文件中的702个分层样本进行定性分析，归纳伦理考量类别及其涉及对象。
AI.result: 伦理相关表述出现在39.4%的文件与61.5%的仓库中，集中于问责、透明、隐私保护与可靠性，且在技能等任务特定文件中比项目级上下文文件更常见。定性分析识别出30类伦理考量，多以面向代理的具体规则形式呈现：问责主要体现为要求人工审批，透明体现为解释并如实报告代理工作，公平体现为可访问性与本地化。公共伦理框架侧重保护社会与终端用户，而配置文件主要关切开发者、维护者与社区成员。
AI.conclusion: 伦理相关内容主要表现为散文式文本，且代理是否遵循这些指令尚未验证；论文讨论了其对从业者、研究者与政策制定者的启示。

title: Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neurons for Event-Driven Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on dense, continuous-valued computation presents a fundamental challenge for energy-constrained deployment. Inspired by the sparse, event-driven signaling and temporal integration mechanisms of biological neurons, a promising alternative is to introduce spiking computation into VLA models. However, enabling such computation without restructuring pretrained policies or compromising closed-loop control remains an open challenge. To address this challenge, we introduce the Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (PoT-LIF) neuron, which emits signed spikes with power-of-two amplitudes. By combining magnitude-coded spike events with residual-preserving membrane dynamics, PoT-LIF enables continuous information to be progressively represented through discrete spikes. The Heartbeat formulation further localizes this process within weighted projections, bridging biologically inspired spiking computation and pretrained VLA architectures without modifying their external inference interfaces. We integrate PoT-LIF into the vision projection, vision-language projection, and action projection of $π_{0.5}$ and evaluate both operating modes over 2,000 paired closed-loop LIBERO episodes per configuration. Standard-mode PoT-LIF VLA achieves success rates of 96.90% and 96.35% at $T = 1$ and $T = 2$, respectively, while Heartbeat mode achieves 97.25% and 96.90% at $T = 2$ and $T = 4$, compared with 96.70% for the original continuous-activation $π_{0.5}$ baseline. At $T = 1$ with a 60.01% firing rate, PoT-LIF uses approximately 1/7.67 of the dense-reference arithmetic energy, corresponding to a modeled reduction of 86.95%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Power-of-Two Leaky Integrate-and-Fire（PoT-LIF）神经元与Heartbeat公式，将脉冲计算引入预训练VLA模型（π0.5），在不改变其外部推理接口的前提下保持闭环控制性能并大幅降低算术能耗。
AI.motivation: VLA模型依赖稠密连续值计算，难以在能量受限场景部署；生物神经元具有稀疏、事件驱动与时间积分特性，但直接将脉冲计算引入预训练VLA而不重构策略、不损害闭环控制仍是开放难题。
AI.method: 提出PoT-LIF神经元：发射带符号、幅度为2的幂的脉冲，结合幅度编码的脉冲事件与残差保持的膜动力学，使连续信息经离散脉冲逐步表示；进一步提出Heartbeat公式，将该过程局部化于加权投影内，从而在视觉投影、视觉-语言投影和动作投影中无缝嵌入π0.5，不修改外部推理接口。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上每配置2000对闭环episode评估：标准模式PoT-LIF VLA在T=1和T=2下成功率96.90%与96.35%；Heartbeat模式在T=2和T=4下为97.25%与96.90%；原始连续激活π0.5基线为96.70%。T=1、发放率60.01%时，算术能耗约为稠密参考的1/7.67，建模降幅86.95%。
AI.conclusion: PoT-LIF与Heartbeat机制可在不改变预训练VLA外部接口的条件下实现脉冲化计算，在保持甚至略优于连续基线成功率的同时显著降低算术能耗，为能量受限的VLA部署提供可行路径。

title: Satellite-derived bathymetry of Arabian Gulf ports under leakage-free validation: a multi-site benchmark of empirical, machine-learning and deep-learning models against 285,000 multibeam soundings, with an outlook for UAE waters
summary: Satellite-derived bathymetry (SDB) is often proposed as a low-cost complement to multibeam surveys of ports, but its accuracy is seldom measured on an area the model has never seen. We test SDB in the turbid, shallow and tidal waters of the Abu Dhabi coast against 285,619 multibeam soundings from twelve surveys at six port areas, reduced to Lowest Astronomical Tide. The Stumpf ratio, the Lyzenga transform, a monotonic gradient-boosted tree model (LightGBM) and a U-Net ensemble were trained on 72 Sentinel-2 images and tested in transfer to an unseen site and with local control (about 20% of a site's soundings, spatial blocks beyond a 225 m buffer). The validation design changed the result more than the model: the same LightGBM model gave 0.57 m RMSE under a random pixel split, 1.30 m under spatial blocks and 1.66 m at an unseen site. In transfer the Stumpf ratio (1.45 m) was not beaten by LightGBM, the U-Net or Lyzenga. With local control a hybrid of the tree output and the band ratio reached 1.11 m over 0-11 m, 67% of pixels within the IHO S-44 Order 2 tolerance and a conformal 95% interval with 95% observed coverage; in clear water it reached 0.29-0.53 m. The seabed could not be read beyond 11 m, and summer images were five to six times more turbid than winter ones. ICESat-2 ATL24 agreed with the surveys to 0.25 m after a depth-dependent offset was removed. A 60 m reconnaissance mosaic of 17,200 km2 of the UAE coast, calibrated cell by cell on ICESat-2 without any vessel survey, reached 1.42 m RMSE on held-out blocks over half of the product. Sentinel-2 SDB with about a hundred control depths per image is a usable reconnaissance and change-monitoring tool in these waters to about 10 m; it does not meet S-44 Order 1 without local control, and accuracies from random splits should not be taken as operational accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究在阿布扎比浑浊、浅水、潮汐海域用285,619个多波束测深点检验卫星测深（SDB），发现验证设计对结果的影响大于模型选择本身：随机像元划分下同一LightGBM的RMSE仅0.57 m，空间分块下为1.30 m，未见过站点的迁移下升至1.66 m。
AI.motivation: SDB常被视为港口多波束测量的低成本补充手段，但其精度很少在模型从未见过的区域上被实测检验，随机划分得到的精度也常被误当作可操作精度。
AI.method: 以285,619个多波束测深点（12次测量、6个港区，统一归算至最低天文潮）为参考，用72景Sentinel-2影像训练并比较Stumpf比值法、Lyzenga变换、单调梯度提升树（LightGBM）与U-Net集成；采用两种验证：迁移至未见站点，以及站内局部控制（约20%测深点、225 m缓冲区外的空间分块）。另用无船测、逐格元以ICESat-2 ATL24标定的方式构建覆盖阿联酋海岸17,200 km²的60 m侦察镶嵌产品。
AI.result: 验证设计比模型更显著地改变结果（0.57/1.30/1.66 m）；迁移情形下Stumpf比值法（1.45 m）未被LightGBM、U-Net或Lyzenga超越。局部控制下树模型与波段比值的混合方法在0–11 m达1.11 m RMSE，67%像元满足IHO S-44 Order 2容差，共形95%区间实测覆盖率达95%，清水区为0.29–0.53 m。11 m以深无法反演海床；夏季影像浑浊度为冬季的5–6倍；ICESat-2 ATL24去除深度相关偏移后与船测吻合至0.25 m；纯ICESat-2标定的镶嵌产品在留出分块上半区达1.42 m RMSE。
AI.conclusion: 每幅影像约需一百个控制深度时，Sentinel-2 SDB在这些水域可作至约10 m的侦察与变化监测工具；无局部控制时达不到S-44 Order 1，随机划分所得的精度不可视为实际作业精度。

title: AIPC: Evidence-Guided Agent Workflows for PyTorch Project Deployment
summary:
Deploying and optimizing a PyTorch inference project on a dedicated accelerator, especially an on-device NPU, requires more than using a framework device API as with CUDA. The project must be converted into hardware-runtime artifacts and adapted to the target toolchain and application interface. Differences in model formats, quantization flows, operator support, and toolchain interfaces create cross-layer problems spanning PyTorch/ONNX models, toolchains, runtimes, and device execution. LLM Agents can invoke tools to address such problems, but may drift because of insufficient domain knowledge, large configuration and repair spaces, or poor path selection.
  We propose AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion), an Agent method for deploying PyTorch inference projects. AIPC combines structured Skills with toolchain, runtime, and profiling evidence to drive cross-layer diagnosis and repair, organizing model adaptation, artifact building, on-target execution, accuracy repair, and performance optimization into one deployment flow. We evaluate AIPC on the on-device NPU path of Qualcomm QAIRT across vision, speech, LLM, and diffusion models. In two optimization cases, 6/7 Skill-arm Whisper-Small runs meet predefined accuracy and latency criteria versus 0/6 control runs, while YOLO-Worldv2 achieves a 2.791x end-to-end speedup versus 1.599x for the control. Under a pre-fixed deployment contract, Skill, tool permissions, and check conditions, some runs achieve zero in-run human intervention (0-HITL). We also examine Qwen3.8-27B as a locally deployable model for driving an Agent workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出 AIPC，一种结合结构化 Skills 与工具链/运行时/性能分析证据的 LLM Agent 方法，用于在专用加速器（以高通 QAIRT NPU 为代表）上部署与优化 PyTorch 推理项目，覆盖模型适配、产物构建、上板执行、精度修复与性能优化全流程。
AI.motivation: 在专用加速器（尤其端侧 NPU）上部署和优化 PyTorch 推理项目，不能像 CUDA 那样仅调用框架 device API，而须将项目转换为硬件运行时产物并适配目标工具链与应用接口。模型格式、量化流程、算子支持与工具链接口的差异，导致横跨 PyTorch/ONNX 模型、工具链、运行时与设备执行的多层问题。现有 LLM Agent 虽可调用工具处理此类问题，但因领域知识不足、配置与修复空间庞大、路径选择不佳而容易偏离目标。
AI.method: AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion）将结构化 Skills 与工具链、运行时及 profiling 证据相结合，驱动跨层诊断与修复；把模型适配、产物构建、目标设备执行、精度修复和性能优化组织为统一的部署流程。
AI.result: 在高通 QAIRT 端侧 NPU 路径上，对视觉、语音、LLM 与扩散模型进行评测。两个优化案例中：Whisper-Small 的 Skill 组 6/7 次运行满足预定精度与延迟标准，对照组为 0/6；YOLO-Worldv2 端到端加速达 2.791x，对照组为 1.599x。在预先固定的部署契约、Skill、工具权限与检查条件下，部分运行实现零运行中人工干预（0-HITL）。另外还考察了 Qwen3.8-27B 作为可本地部署的模型来驱动 Agent 工作流。
AI.conclusion: 以 Skills 加多源证据驱动的 Agent 方法能有效缓解跨层部署中的知识不足与路径漂移问题，在精度达标率、延迟与端到端加速上显著优于无 Skill 的对照组，并在固定部署契约下逼近零人工干预的自动化部署；本地可部署模型亦具备驱动此类 Agent 工作流的潜力。

title: SWE-Ladder: Learning to Localize, Reproduce, and Patch via Progressive Privileged Self-Distillation
summary: Resolving a repository-level issue typically requires a software-engineering (SWE) agent to localize the faulty code, reproduce the failure, and patch the code. Reinforcement learning trains such agents from a single test result on the final patch, while on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adds token-level supervision from a teacher with privileged evidence, exposing the full reference patch at every step. Neither provides stage-specific guidance for localization or reproduction. We propose SWE-Ladder, which turns the verified repair of each training instance into stage-specific evidence: the changed files and lines for localization, the fail-to-pass tests for reproduction, and the diff for patching. A rule-based router assigns each step of an end-to-end rollout to a stage based on its tool call, a frozen teacher sees only the matching evidence, and the stages are distilled in repair order while GRPO optimizes the full trajectory. With Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on SWE-bench Verified under the R2E-Gym scaffold, SWE-Ladder improves pass@1 from 9.6% to 16.4%, compared with 10.4% for GRPO and 12.4% for OPSD with the full patch. Under the OpenHands scaffold, it improves pass@1 from 13.0% to 17.6%. Reversing the stage order under R2E-Gym reduces pass@1 to 11.4%.

AI.tldr: SWE-Ladder 将已验证的修复拆解为定位、复现、修补三阶段的证据，用规则路由把 end-to-end rollout 的每一步归入对应阶段，冻结教师只看到匹配证据，按修复顺序逐步蒸馏，并与 GRPO 全轨迹优化结合。在 SWE-bench Verified 上 pass@1 从 9.6% 提升至 16.4%（R2E-Gym），OpenHands 下从 13.0% 升至 17.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有 SWE agent 训练中，强化学习只基于最终 patch 的单一测试结果给出奖励，on-policy 自蒸馏则让教师携带完整参考补丁在每一步提供 token 级监督。二者都缺少针对定位（localization）与复现（reproduction）的阶段特异指导，监督信号粒度与任务结构不匹配。
AI.method: 1) 将每个训练实例的已验证修复转为阶段证据：变更文件与行→定位，fail-to-pass 测试→复现，diff→修补；2) 规则路由器依据每步的工具调用将端到端 rollout 的步骤分配到对应阶段；3) 冻结教师仅接收该阶段匹配的证据，避免信息泄漏；4) 按修复顺序逐阶段蒸馏，同时用 GRPO 优化完整轨迹。
AI.result: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 + SWE-bench Verified：R2E-Gym scaffold 下 pass@1 由 9.6%→16.4%（GRPO 10.4%，带完整 patch 的 OPSD 12.4%）；OpenHands scaffold 下由 13.0%→17.6%。消融显示在 R2E-Gym 下将阶段顺序反转会使 pass@1 降至 11.4%。
AI.conclusion: 阶段化、证据受限的蒸馏监督显著优于单一终局奖励或全 patch 教师蒸馏；修复顺序本身构成有效先验，反转顺序带来明显性能损失，说明阶段划分与顺序是关键设计要素。

title: Geodesic-SVDD Latent Mixup for One-Shot Distributed Tabular Learning
summary: Distributed Learning on structured data is a key and widely adopted approach in privacy-sensitive sectors, ranging from financial fraud prevention to federated healthcare diagnostics. While Gradient Boosted Decision Trees are widely used in centralized settings due to their efficiency, they are incompatible with standard gradient-based federated learning protocols because of their non-differentiability. Conversely, standard deep classifiers that are amenable to federated optimization often suffer from catastrophic forgetting under label distribution skew. In this work, to address these gaps we propose Geodesic-SVDD, a framework for Distributed Spherical Prototype Learning that recasts each client's task as one-class density estimation on the hypersphere, so that local models can be aggregated as probabilistic manifolds in a single round. Specifically, for each client, we employ a Residual Spherical Encoder and Geodesic Latent Mixup that enforces strict hyperspherical constraints ($\|φ(x)\| \equiv 1$), preventing the manifold collapse observed in linear approximations. Furthermore, leveraging this insight, we propose a novel One-Shot "Product of Experts" protocol that enables privacy-preserving aggregation without iterative synchronization. Finally, we mechanistically analyze the trade-off between interpolation strategies, demonstrating that while linear mixup offers an enticing computational shortcut, it destabilizes optimization gradients by orders of magnitude ($10^9\times$). Across five tabular benchmarks and four levels of label skew, Geodesic-SVDD attains the highest mean AUROC among seven federated methods, outperforms federated tree ensembles by up to 21 AUROC points on Covertype, and its One-Shot variant matches centralized Deep SVDD under IID and mild skew with a single communication round.

AI.tldr: 提出 Geodesic-SVDD 分布式球面原型学习框架，将各客户端任务重构为超球面上的一类密度估计，实现单轮通信下隐私保护的联邦聚合。
AI.motivation: 结构化数据分布式学习在隐私敏感领域（金融反欺诈、联邦医疗诊断）应用广泛。GBDT 效率高但不可微，难以适配基于梯度的联邦协议；标准深度分类器虽可联邦优化，却在标签分布偏斜下易发生灾难性遗忘。二者之间存在空白。
AI.method: 1) 残差球面编码器（Residual Spherical Encoder）与测地潜在 Mixup，强制严格超球约束（‖φ(x)‖≡1），避免线性近似导致的流形坍缩；2) 基于该约束提出单轮"专家乘积"（Product of Experts）协议，无需迭代同步即可隐私保护聚合；3) 从机理上分析插值策略权衡，指出线性 mixup 虽计算省，但使优化梯度失稳达 10^9 倍量级。
AI.result: 在 5 个表格基准、4 种标签偏斜程度下，Geodesic-SVDD 在 7 种联邦方法中取得最高平均 AUROC；在 Covertype 上较联邦树集成最高提升 21 个 AUROC 点；其单轮变体在 IID 与轻度偏斜下以单次通信轮即可匹配集中式 Deep SVDD。
AI.conclusion: 通过球面流形约束与单轮专家乘积聚合，可在标签偏斜下兼顾隐私、通信效率与非可微模型的可聚合性，并揭示线性 mixup 的梯度不稳定性。

title: SemWeaver: Refining LLM-Generated Static Vulnerability Checkers with Analyzer-Internal Evidence
summary: Recent work shows that LLMs can synthesize static-analysis checkers from security patches, but a compilable checker is not necessarily a correct one. A patch reveals what changed, not why the change is safe, so generated checkers often match only the surface edit and miss the deeper semantic condition. Existing refinement loops feed back compilation errors and validation reports, yet these signals describe symptoms without explaining what the checker misunderstands about the code. We observe that the analysis framework itself already computes the information needed to close this gap. Control-flow graphs, symbolic values, memory regions and checker callbacks are available inside the analyzer but unused by current refinement strategies. SemWeaver is a plug-in refinement layer that extracts patch-relevant analyzer evidence and assembles it with source context and validation feedback into a structured, provenance-labelled bundle. An iterative editing loop refines the checker on both the vulnerable and fixed revisions, guarded by a retention gate that accepts warning recovery or false-positive reduction while preventing over-pruning. We evaluate SemWeaver on 39 KNighter-derived CSA checkers from Linux kernel fixes. With analyzer evidence, refinement reaches 23 warning-positive vulnerable revisions (vs. 15 for KNighter's loop) and raises version-level $F_1$ from 0.448 to 0.575. An ablation removing internal evidence recovers fewer silent cases and produces different checker edits, indicating that the two evidence configurations address complementary recognition gaps. Additional experiments cover three editor models on a 12-subject subset, a CodeQL query refinement, and controlled source-form variations. A qualitative follow-up on all 11 non-tied comparisons traces each warning-count change to a specific checker repair, such as recognizing a lowered callback or unwrapping an expression cast.

AI.tldr: SemWeaver 是一个插拔式精化层，把分析框架内部证据（CFG、符号值、内存区域、回调）与源码上下文、验证反馈组合成带来源标注的结构化证据包，通过迭代编辑循环同时精化漏洞版和修复版检查器，并以保留门控防止过度剪枝，将 Linux 内核 39 个 CSA 检查器的版本级 F1 从 0.448 提升到 0.575。
AI.motivation: 现有工作可从安全补丁合成静态分析检查器，但"可编译"不等于"正确"。补丁只揭示改了哪里、不揭示为何安全，生成检查器常只匹配表层编辑而漏掉深层语义条件；现有基于编译错误与验证报告的反馈回路只能描述症状，无法说明检查器对代码的理解错在哪里。作者观察到分析框架内部已计算出弥合该缺口所需信息（CFG、符号值、内存区域、检查器回调），但当前精化策略未加利用。
AI.method: 1) 提取与补丁相关的分析器内部证据，并与源码上下文、验证反馈一起组装为带来源标签（provenance-labelled）的结构化证据包；2) 采用迭代编辑循环，在漏洞版与修复版两个修订上同时精化检查器；3) 设置保留门控（retention gate），接受告警恢复或误报减少，同时防止过度剪枝。
AI.result: 在 39 个由 KNighter 派生、来自 Linux 内核修复的 CSA 检查器上评估：引入分析器证据后精化得到 23 个告警阳性漏洞版本（KNighter 回路为 15 个），版本级 F1 由 0.448 升至 0.575。消融去除内部证据后恢复的静默案例更少，且产生的检查器编辑不同，说明两类证据配置针对互补的识别缺口。附加实验涵盖 12 个对象子集上的三种编辑器模型、一个 CodeQL 查询精化以及受控源码形式变体。对全部 11 个非平局比较的定性追踪表明，每次告警数变化均可归因于具体的检查器修复，如识别被下调的回调或解开表达式强转。
AI.conclusion: 将分析器内部证据纳入精化反馈可显著提升合成检查器的语义正确性，且与纯验证反馈互补；保留门控能在提升告警召回的同时控制误报，精化过程可通过定性追踪逐项解释。

title: Meta-CLIP: Metadata-Conditioned Contrastive Learning for Zero-Shot Disease Inference
summary: Medical vision--language pretraining learns transferable representations from paired images and radiology reports, yet differences in scanners and acquisition protocols can impair transfer. Existing approaches primarily enrich clinical semantics, leaving structured acquisition information in DICOM headers underused. We introduce Meta-CLIP, a metadata-conditioned contrastive framework that uses acquisition similarity to reweight cross-modal negatives during pretraining. A kernel over numerical and categorical DICOM fields defines a bounded pairwise margin. This margin increases the contribution of acquisition-similar negatives, emphasizing distinctions among studies that share imaging conditions. The kernel remains fixed during image--text optimization, and inference follows the standard dual-encoder architecture without requiring metadata. We evaluate Meta-CLIP on chest radiography and volumetric chest CT through zero-shot classification, appearance perturbations, grounding, and representation analyses. On CT-RATE, Meta-CLIP improves macro-AUROC over CT-CLIP by 1.41 points, with a 95\% paired bootstrap confidence interval of 0.96--1.85 points. It also achieves the highest macro-AUROC on four of five CXR benchmarks. An exploratory BrgSA evaluation extends the analysis to another CT backbone. These findings support acquisition metadata as a practical training-time prior for medical vision--language learning. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: Meta-CLIP：利用DICOM采集元数据相似性对跨模态负样本重加权，提升医学视觉-语言预训练的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉-语言预训练主要丰富临床语义，而DICOM头信息中的结构化采集信息（扫描仪、采集协议差异）未被充分利用，导致跨设备/协议迁移性能下降。
AI.method: 提出元数据条件对比框架Meta-CLIP：以数值与类别型DICOM字段上的核函数定义有界成对间隔（margin），在预训练中依据采集相似度重加权跨模态负样本，使采集条件相近的样本对比更受重视；核函数在图文优化中保持固定，推理沿用标准双编码器架构且无需元数据。
AI.result: 在胸部X线与容积胸部CT上评估：CT-RATE上宏AUROC较CT-CLIP提升1.41点（95%配对bootstrap CI 0.96–1.85）；在五个CXR基准中的四个取得最高宏AUROC；并通过零样本分类、外观扰动、grounding、表征分析及BrgSA探索性评估验证。
AI.conclusion: 采集元数据可作为实用的训练期先验用于医学视觉-语言学习，且不增加推理成本。

title: Beyond Affine Reconstruction: Multi-Resolution Transformer DeepONets for the Radiative Transfer Equation
summary: Radiative heat transfer plays a dominant role in fire simulations, where solving the radiative transfer equation (RTE) is a computational bottleneck. Neural operators can accelerate these computations by learning solution operators from offline simulation data. However, conventional DeepONet surrogates rely on fixed-grid inputs and affine reconstruction, limiting their flexibility across resolutions and their approximation accuracy at a fixed latent dimension. In this paper, we develop a transformer-based DeepONet for multi-resolution RTE surrogate modelling. The proposed approach combines a Perceiver encoder, which maps temperature and absorption coefficient fields at different spatial resolutions into a fixed-size latent representation, with a cross-attention decoder that enables non-affine reconstruction of the radiative intensity. This architecture allows a single model to process inputs at varying resolutions without resampling them onto a common grid. We formulate a computable empirical version of a previously derived theoretical lower bound for affine reconstruction, enabling direct comparison with model errors on the same dataset. Experiments on a two-dimensional pool-fire dataset demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms autoencoder-based DeepONets in predicting both radiative intensity and incident radiation, with fewer trainable parameters. Power spectral density analysis shows improved preservation of small-scale structures. Both affine baselines remain above the corresponding lower bound at all evaluated ranks, whereas the proposed model achieves a training error below it at one matched latent dimension, demonstrating the potential of non-affine reconstruction to overcome this representational limitation. Experiments on a dataset combining three spatial resolutions confirm the accuracy advantage of the approach at each input resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Transformer的DeepONet（Perceiver编码器+交叉注意力解码器）实现多分辨率RTE代理建模，无需重采样即可处理不同分辨率输入，并以更少参数超越自编码器类DeepONet，且在匹配潜维下训练误差突破仿射重建理论下界。
AI.motivation: 辐射换热在火灾仿真中占主导，求解RTE是计算瓶颈；神经算子可从离线仿真数据学习解算子加速计算。但传统DeepONet依赖固定网格输入与仿射重构，导致跨分辨率灵活性差、固定潜维下逼近精度受限。
AI.method: 构建Transformer-based DeepONet：Perceiver编码器将不同空间分辨率下的温度场与吸收系数场映射为固定尺寸潜表示；交叉注意力解码器实现辐射强度的非仿射重构；单模型直接处理变分辨率输入而无需重采样至统一网格；并给出仿射重构理论下界的可计算经验版本，用于同数据集上与模型误差直接对比。
AI.result: 在二维池火数据集上，该方法在辐射强度与入射辐射预测上均优于基于自编码器的DeepONet，且可训练参数更少；功率谱密度分析显示小尺度结构保持更好；两个仿射基线在所有评估秩上均高于下界，而本模型在一匹配潜维下训练误差低于下界；在三分辨率混合数据集上，各输入分辨率下均具精度优势。
AI.conclusion: 非仿射重构可突破仿射重建的表示能力限制，所提架构在多分辨率RTE代理建模中兼具精度、参数效率与跨分辨率泛化能力。

title: What Will Replace Pull Requests? Rethinking Software Collaboration for AI Agents
summary: The emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) coding agents has put pull requests under pressure: agents open millions of pull requests per month, while some open-source projects have begun to restrict or disable external contributions. We investigate which alternatives to pull requests practitioners are proposing or adopting and what these changes mean for empirical software engineering research. We reviewed 50 gray-literature documents from 31 organizations or individuals published between October 2025 and October 2026, coding the problems each named, the mechanisms it proposed or adopted, which of five roles of pull requests (integration, review, rationale, accountability, and external contribution) each mechanism takes over, and the evidence offered. Most responses retained pull requests in some form, whether by adding tooling, attaching a new artifact, or restricting access, and restriction was the response most often reported as adopted. Several proposed alternatives moved review and rationale into agent conversations and session records, but only Zed reported using a replacement in practice. Only two documents outlined a replacement for external contribution, and neither reported adoption. Pull requests are changing in ways that pull-request datasets will not capture: reviews conducted in agent conversations leave no pull-request comments, and projects that disable pull requests disappear from samples of newly opened ones. We outline a research agenda on the effectiveness of the emerging alternatives, their consequences for open-source participation, and the adaptation of empirical methods.

AI.tldr: AI 编码代理每月提交数百万个 Pull Request，开源社区开始限制外部贡献；本文基于 50 份灰色文献，分析业界提出或采用的 PR 替代方案及其对实证软件工程研究的影响。
AI.motivation: AI 编码代理对 PR 流程造成压力，部分开源项目限制或禁用外部贡献，但学界尚不清楚实践者提出/采用了哪些 PR 替代方案，以及这些变化对依赖 PR 数据的实证研究意味着什么。
AI.method: 对 31 个组织或个体在 2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 10 月间发表的 50 份灰色文献进行评审与编码：记录各文献指出的问题、提出或采用的机制、该机制接管 PR 五种角色（集成、评审、理由说明、问责、外部贡献）中的哪些，以及所提供证据。
AI.result: 多数应对措施仍保留 PR，形式包括增加工具、附加新工作产物或限制访问，其中"限制访问"是被报告采用最多的应对方式；若干替代方案将评审与理由说明转移到代理对话和会话记录中，但仅 Zed 报告在实践中使用替代方案；仅两份文献提出外部贡献的替代机制，且均无采用报告。
AI.conclusion: PR 的变化方式使 PR 数据集难以捕捉：评审发生在代理对话中而不留 PR 评论，禁用 PR 的项目则从新开 PR 样本中消失。作者提出研究议程，涵盖新兴替代方案的有效性、对开源参与的影响以及实证方法的调整。

title: More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. Across coding, mathematics, and general-reasoning benchmarks, MORE achieves consistent performance gains on Base and Coder backbones at model scales from 3B to 14B. During inference, MORE demonstrates higher accuracy and better efficiency, with markedly shorter response lengths and reduced inference time.

AI.tldr: MORE 是一个自进化训练框架，为每个任务自适应选择推理形式与计算量，在编码、数学与通用推理基准上同时提升准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: 自进化训练借助可验证反馈提升智能体在困难任务上的表现，但普遍对所有任务统一施加昂贵的深思（deliberation），造成计算浪费，缺乏按任务难度分配推理努力的能力。
AI.method: 两阶段范式：阶段一在“直接作答、短思维链、长思维链、代码式推理”四种模式上建立紧凑先验；阶段二在生成的可验证任务流上（无需人工策划数据）用 Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO（MATE-PPO）自进化该先验，实现推理模式选择与 token 开销的联合学习。
AI.result: 在编码、数学、通用推理基准上，MORE 在 3B–14B 的 Base 与 Coder 骨干上均取得一致性能提升；推理阶段准确率更高、响应长度显著缩短、推理时间减少。
AI.conclusion: 按任务自适应分配推理形式与计算努力，可在保持甚至提升性能的同时显著改善推理效率，为自进化训练提供了一种兼顾成本与效果的统一方案。

title: Extraction meets Distillation - cryptanalytic techniques to recover parameters from a Deep Neural Network
summary: We study fully connected neural-network reconstruction by combining cryptanalytic weight-direction extraction with learning from predicted labels. We adapt a ReLU extraction implementation to Leaky ReLU, compare sign-search methods, and estimate biases and output layers. We prove conditional bounds for direction recovery with approximate prefixes, preservation of local distance votes, prediction changes from aligned parameter errors, and sign selection with independent scoring data. We also specify exact row restoration and distinguish its guarantee from that of gradient masking. The experiments evaluate assisted extraction, with privileged access to gradients, hidden activations, and victim parameters, followed by label-based reconstruction. Across eight search seeds on the largest synthetic architecture, Leaky ReLU recovers 51--57 neurons in the deepest hidden layer, while ReLU recovers none. This advantage does not hold uniformly across architectures and layers. Removing victim-weight access from the sign walk gives less accurate signs, despite high final prediction agreement. Across 40 seeded runs on the two smallest synthetic victims, agreement on 5,000 inputs excluded from fitting and selection ranges from $0.9890$ to $0.9992$. On two CIFAR-10 victims, the reconstructed models achieve $56.40\%$ and $58.29\%$ agreement and exceed the distillation baseline on three functional metrics. We report label requests separately from privileged access and explain why prediction agreement does not identify network parameters.

AI.tldr: 论文研究全连接神经网络模型窃取：将密码分析的权重方向提取与基于预测标签的学习相结合，对Leaky ReLU做提取适配并给出方向恢复、符号选择与预测变化的条件性理论界，实验显示在特定架构下Leaky ReLU可恢复深层神经元而ReLU不能，但优势并不普遍。
AI.motivation: 现有权重提取式模型重建多针对ReLU，且理论保证与梯度掩码的区分不清；需要考察将方向提取与标签学习结合后在Leaky ReLU上是否可行、其保证边界何在，以及预测一致是否意味着参数被识别。
AI.method: 将ReLU权重方向提取实现适配到Leaky ReLU；比较不同符号搜索方法；估计偏置与输出层；给出四类理论结果：带近似前缀的方向恢复条件界、局部距离投票保持、对齐参数误差引起的预测变化、以及用独立评分数据进行符号选择；并给出精确行恢复的规格，将其保证与梯度掩码的保证相区分。实验分两阶段：在特权访问（梯度、隐层激活、受害者参数）下做辅助提取，随后进行基于标签的重建。
AI.result: 在最大合成架构上、8个搜索种子中，Leaky ReLU在最深隐层恢复51–57个神经元，ReLU恢复0个；该优势不跨架构与层一致成立。去掉符号游走中的受害者权重访问后符号精度下降，但最终预测一致性仍高。两个最小合成受害者上40次种子运行，在5000个未参与拟合与选择的输入上一致率为0.9890–0.9992。两个CIFAR-10受害者上重建模型一致率为56.40%与58.29%，并在三项功能指标上超过蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: 方向提取与标签学习相结合的混合重建在Leaky ReLU上有条件可行，但收益依架构与层而异，且依赖特权信息；高预测一致性并不能用于识别网络参数，论文将标签请求与特权访问分开报告并明确此点。

title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation
summary: Coding agents can adapt their harnesses, the software, configuration, and instructions used to run them, based on experience from earlier tasks, but whether these adaptations improve their behavior on later tasks remains unclear. We study \retro, a skill that asks an agent to review a completed session and propose harness changes, and ask what changes it proposes and whether implemented changes reduce repeated work on later tasks. We ran Claude Code on 30 SWE-bench Verified issues, qualitatively coded the 125 proposals from \retro, implemented 24, and evaluated 12 harness changes on later issues from the same repositories in fresh sessions with and without each change. Most proposals referred to an event in the session, but 18 of 43 lint-related proposals recommended a practice regardless of what had happened. Among the seven evaluations in which sessions without the change encountered the targeted problem, two changes eliminated the targeted action, one reduced its occurrence, four showed no reduction, and some changes added work on unrelated issues. Harness self-evolution requires more than generating and implementing changes: it needs ways to establish whether a change helps on later tasks and to revise or remove changes that do not.

AI.tldr: 该文研究编码智能体能否通过“回顾已完成会话并提出harness（运行框架、配置与指令）修改”来实现自我进化，并在SWE-bench Verified上验证24条实现的修改中12条的效果。结果显示仅部分修改减少重复劳动，部分无效果甚至引入额外工作，说明自我进化需配套的效果评估与修订机制。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体（如Claude Code）可基于过往任务经验调整其harness，但这种调整是否真正改善后续任务表现尚不明确，缺乏实证检验。
AI.method: 提出retro技能：让智能体回顾已完成的会话并提出harness修改建议。在30个SWE-bench Verified问题上运行Claude Code，对125条建议做定性编码，实现其中24条，并在同一仓库的后续问题上以全新会话分别在有/无该修改的条件下评估12条修改。
AI.result: 多数建议引用了会话中的具体事件，但43条lint相关建议中有18条属于脱离具体情境的通用做法推荐。在7组“无修改会话确实遭遇目标问题”的评估中：2条修改完全消除了目标行为，1条降低了其发生频率，4条未见减少；部分修改还在无关问题上引入了额外工作。
AI.conclusion: harness自我进化不止于生成与实施修改，还需要建立判断某修改能否在后续任务中带来收益的方法，以及修订或移除无效修改的机制。

title: PACE: Research Proving Agent for Adaptive Conjecture Exploration
summary: Many mathematical research agents focus on solving problems with fixed statements. However, conjecture research, especially in applied mathematics, may require revising candidate questions or conclusions as investigation proceeds, coupling problem formulation with proof development. We present PACE, a research-proof agent that supports this process through a structured research loop that selects mathematical objectives and develops or challenges candidate mechanisms. The whole prover constructs proofs from these mechanisms, and an independent verifier checks them against the original target. Evidence-tracking memory stores assumptions and dependencies arising during research and marks evidence for revalidation when a candidate or condition changes. This memory supports task-specific context composition that keeps checked premises, exploratory material and unresolved obligations distinct. To evaluate proof construction and conjecture research, we introduce ResearchProofBench, an applied-mathematics benchmark focused on optimization, comprising 51 known-proof tasks with 331 hidden checkpoints under historical abstract access and six open-problem cases. The known-proof tasks assess reconstruction of published results, while the open-problem cases assess mathematical investigation and proof development. On the 51 known-proof tasks, PACE achieves an aggregate Proof Score of 75.16 and completes 20 proofs. In conjecture research, PACE develops conditional results, with its submissions receiving higher review scores than the compared baselines.

AI.tldr: PACE是一个用于"猜想研究"的研究型证明智能体，通过结构化研究循环将问题建模与证明开发耦合，并配套证据追踪记忆与独立验证器；作者同时提出应用数学基准ResearchProofBench（优化方向）。
AI.motivation: 现有数学研究智能体多针对固定陈述的问题求解，而应用数学中的猜想研究常需随研究推进修改候选问题或结论，问题表述与证明开发相互耦合，缺乏支持这一过程的方法与评测基准。
AI.method: 提出PACE：以结构化研究循环选择数学目标、构建或挑战候选机制；整体证明器由机制出发构造证明，独立验证器对照原始目标校验；证据追踪记忆保存研究中的假设与依赖，并在候选或条件变化时标记证据需重新验证，支持保持"已核验前提、探索性材料、未解决义务"三者区分的情境组合。同时构建ResearchProofBench：面向优化的应用数学基准，含51个已知证明任务（331个隐藏检查点，仅允许访问历史摘要）与6个开放问题案例。
AI.result: 在51个已知证明任务上，PACE取得总体Proof Score 75.16，完成20个证明；在猜想研究中产出条件性结果，其提交在评审得分上高于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 将猜想研究与证明构建耦合、并引入证据追踪记忆与独立验证，可有效支撑应用数学中的开放式研究；ResearchProofBench为证明重建与猜想研究提供可评测的统一框架。

title: Latent dynamics for reconstructing fine-scale PDE trajectories from coarse observations
summary: Coarse PDE observations omit spatial detail and intermediate states of evolving fields. We present Structured Latent Dynamics (SLD), a framework that reconstructs high-resolution trajectories from spatially and temporally downsampled simulations. SLD interpolates the input in time, adds a learned temporal correction and uses the resulting sequence to guide a hidden state on the coarse grid. Each update of the latent state combines a learned gated response with horizontal and vertical central differences and a five-point Laplacian of the state. The three spatial terms have learned channel-wise coefficients. Two Haar wavelet synthesis branches map the hidden state and refined coarse input to the high-resolution field. We evaluate SLD on two-dimensional Gray--Scott, complex Ginzburg--Landau and viscous Burgers systems, reconstructing 100 output frames from 25 input frames with eightfold refinement in each spatial direction. SLD achieves lower mean relative $L_2$ error and mean absolute error than unstructured latent dynamics and ConvLSTM baselines with comparable parameter counts, both on held-out trajectories and on later windows of trajectories used during training. SLD also reduces errors in regions with large reference gradients and across most or all of the evaluated later time intervals. A representative Gray--Scott comparison shows lower spectral error over most intermediate and high wavenumbers. Removing the fixed spatial response increased reconstruction error, supporting its contribution to the SLD architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化潜动力学框架SLD，从时空下采样仿真重建高分辨率PDE轨迹，性能优于非结构潜动力学与ConvLSTM基线。
AI.motivation: 粗粒度PDE观测缺失空间细节与演化场中间状态，需要从时空下采样的低分辨率数据重建高分辨率轨迹。
AI.method: SLD先在时间维插值输入，加入可学习时间校正，用该序列驱动粗网格上的隐藏状态；每次潜状态更新由可学习门控响应与水平/垂直中心差分、五点拉普拉斯组合而成，三个空间项系数为通道级可学习参数；再用两支Haar小波合成分别将隐藏状态与细化粗输入映射到高分辨率场。在Gray–Scott、复Ginzburg–Landau和粘性Burgers上，由25帧输入重建100帧输出，各空间方向8倍细化。
AI.result: 在参数规模相当条件下，SLD在留出轨迹与训练轨迹后段窗口上的平均相对L2误差和MAE均低于非结构潜动力学和ConvLSTM；在大梯度区域及多数/全部后段时间区间误差更低；Gray–Scott代表性对比显示多数中高波数谱误差更低；去除固定空间响应后重建误差上升。
AI.conclusion: 将显式空间差分算子结构嵌入潜状态更新可有效提升粗观测下的PDE高分辨率重建精度，尤其改善梯度剧烈区域与中高频细节。

title: Reasoning Patterns for Efficient AI Coding: An Empirical Study
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate long reasoning traces that expose intermediate inference behavior, offering opportunities to study and control reasoning in AI coding. However, the underlying patterns in these traces and their potential for analyzing and guiding coding models remain poorly understood, limiting systematic characterization and inference-time control of LRM reasoning. We conduct an empirical study of reasoning patterns across four representative coding tasks. We transform reasoning traces into structured action sequences and mine recurring fragments using within-task support, cross-task contrasts, and valid--invalid support contrasts. We characterize four general reasoning patterns by coding agents: design-to-implementation for code generation, state tracing for execution reasoning, evidence--fix--recheck for debugging, and semantic mapping for translation. We further identify positive and negative patterns associated with valid and invalid reasoning traces, respectively. Positive patterns reflect verification-driven convergence, whereas negative patterns reflect repeated design revision, reflection, and knowledge recall without closure. To demonstrate their practical utility, we evaluate three pattern-based applications: task identification, pattern-guided prompting, and pattern-aware early stopping. Features capturing general reasoning patterns enable accurate task identification from reasoning traces without accessing task descriptions or final answers. Prompting guided by positive and negative patterns improves the overall accuracy of downstream tasks, while negative pattern-aware early stopping substantially reduces API-reported token usage with only a modest decrease in pass@1. All three applications also generalize to previously unseen models, showing that reasoning patterns can support both the analysis and control of LRM behavior in AI coding.

AI.tldr: 该论文对大型推理模型（LRM）在代码任务中的推理轨迹进行实证研究，将轨迹转化为结构化动作序列并挖掘可复用片段，归纳出四类通用推理模式及正/负向模式，并验证其在任务识别、模式引导提示与模式感知早停三类应用中的实用价值。
AI.motivation: LRM 生成的长推理轨迹暴露了中间推断行为，为研究与控制 AI 编码推理提供了机会；但这些轨迹中的底层模式及其用于分析和引导编码模型的潜力尚不清楚，制约了对 LRM 推理的系统刻画与推理时控制。
AI.method: 针对四类代表性编码任务开展实证研究：将推理轨迹转换为结构化动作序列，结合任务内支持度、跨任务对比以及有效—无效轨迹的支持度对比来挖掘反复出现的片段；据此归纳通用推理模式，并识别与有效/无效轨迹相关的正、负向模式；最后评估三类基于模式的应用（任务识别、模式引导提示、模式感知早停）。
AI.result: 刻画了四类通用模式：代码生成的“设计到实现”、执行推理的“状态追踪”、调试的“证据—修复—复查”、翻译的“语义映射”。正/负向模式分别为验证驱动的收敛与缺乏闭环的反复设计修改、反思和知识回忆。三类应用中，模式特征可在不访问任务描述与最终答案的情况下仅凭推理轨迹准确识别任务；正负模式引导提示提升下游任务整体准确率；负向模式感知早停显著降低 API 报告的 token 用量，而 pass@1 仅小幅下降；三类应用均能泛化到未见过的模型。
AI.conclusion: 推理模式能够同时支撑对 AI 编码中 LRM 行为的分析与控制，且具有跨模型泛化性。

title: Seeing the Options: Typed Decisions over Visual Candidates with Reusable Option Memory
summary: Typed decision-making tasks in agents, such as UI element selection, product recommendation, and chart matching, require models to choose from a set of discrete candidates. While prior work demonstrates that text-only System One models achieve four key properties including candidate-order invariance, scalability, and cache reuse via separate request-candidate encoding, extending them to multimodal settings where candidates are visual remains underexplored. We introduce Iris, a framework that accommodates image, text, or hybrid candidates while preserving the core decision module. We prove that order invariance and exact cache reuse hold for any per-candidate encoder under Iris, and derive the closed-form latency reduction.
