We construct a visual-candidate benchmark from Multimodal-Mind2Web (K=16, deduplicated, order-shuffled, three generalization splits). Independent encoding (Iris) achieves 78.4 / 72.1 / 74.8 percent accuracy with zero-flip rate under candidate reordering. Joint encoding reaches 90.6 / 89.5 / 91.6 percent but suffers an 8 to 10 percent answer-flip rate when shuffled. To bridge this gap, we propose a design that encodes each candidate conditioned on the request state without inter-candidate cross-attention; it preserves strict order invariance, enables forked cache sharing, and attains 91.7 / 86.5 / 90.0 percent accuracy at one-third of OneJev latency with calibrated null probabilities (AUROC 0.93 to 0.97). Reusing image candidates across requests cuts latency by 37x at K=256 and 191x at K=2048. On MetaEncoder benchmarks, Iris-4B achieves 100 percent on JevBench original and easy, outperforming 30B MetaEncoder and 27B OpenJev. Finally, we resolve a systems bottleneck on Ampere GPUs: reformulating Qwen3.5 patch-embedding Conv3d into its exact matrix-product form accelerates processing by 350x. Code, data, and checkpoints: https://github.com/lllfx/Iris.

AI.tldr: Iris框架将"逐候选独立编码 + 请求-候选分离决策"从纯文本扩展到多模态排序型决策任务，证明其保持候选顺序不变性与精确缓存复用，并提出"请求状态条件化编码（无候选间交叉注意力）"变体以逼近联合编码精度，同时实现分叉缓存共享与大模型缓存复用带来37×–191×加速。
AI.motivation: 排序型决策任务（UI元素选择、商品推荐、图表匹配）需从离散候选中择优。此前text-only System One模型已具备候选顺序不变性、可扩展性、缓存复用等四性质，但候选为视觉内容时如何保持这些性质尚不清楚；而联合编码虽精度高却对候选重排序敏感（8–10%答案翻转），缺乏可复用的缓存机制。
AI.method: 提出Iris框架，统一支持图像、文本及混合候选，保持核心决策模块不变；理论上证明任意per-candidate编码器在Iris下均具顺序不变性与精确缓存复用，并给出闭式延迟缩减。基于Multimodal-Mind2Web构建视觉候选基准（K=16、去重、顺序打乱、三种泛化划分）。对比三类编码：独立编码（Iris）、联合编码、以及以请求状态条件化各候选编码但不做候选间交叉注意力的折中设计（支持forked cache sharing与校准null概率）。另将Qwen3.5 patch-embedding的Conv3d重构为等价矩阵乘形式以解决Ampere GPU瓶颈。
AI.result: 独立编码准确率78.4/72.1/74.8%，重排序零翻转；联合编码达90.6/89.5/91.6%但重排序翻转率8–10%；折中设计达91.7/86.5/90.0%，延迟为OneJev的1/3，null概率校准AUROC 0.93–0.97。跨请求复用图像候选在K=256时降延迟37×、K=2048时191×。MetaEncoder基准上Iris-4B在JevBench original/easy均达100%，优于30B MetaEncoder与27B OpenJev；Conv3d矩阵化改写带来350×加速。
AI.conclusion: 逐候选独立/条件化编码可在保持严格顺序不变性与缓存复用的同时接近联合编码精度，是构建多模态排序决策系统的有效范式；配合缓存复用与底层算子优化，可在显著降低延迟的同时实现小模型超越大模型的效果。

title: How Geometry Shapes Generative Model Evaluation on Riemannian Manifolds
comment: NeurIPS 2026, Geometric Distributional Deep Learning workshop
summary: On Riemannian manifolds, generative-model evaluation is geometry-dependent since curvature and dimension jointly determine distances and volume growth. Our framework systematically compares geodesic, ambient, and tangent-space versions of Wasserstein and MMD across different geometries. Using controlled-noise perturbations and Riemannian Flow Matching samples, we study metric agreement, noise sensitivity, and their relation to geometry-induced volume scaling. We find that no metric is uniformly reliable: evaluation distance can affect both measured discrepancies and noise sensitivity, varying across curvature and dimension. Our analysis leads to practical recommendations for reporting evaluation distances, comparing metric types, and calibrating metrics to the geometry of the samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个系统框架，在黎曼流形上比较Wasserstein与MMD的测地线、环境空间与切空间三种版本，揭示曲率与维度共同导致评价距离的度量依赖性问题。
AI.motivation: 在黎曼流形上，曲率与维度共同决定距离和体积增长，使生成模型评价天然依赖几何结构。现有指标（Wasserstein、MMD）在流形上的定义有多种选择，但缺乏系统性比较，不清楚不同度量版本是否可靠、如何受噪声与几何影响。
AI.method: 构建统一框架，将Wasserstein与MMD分别实现为测地线、环境空间与切空间三种版本，并在不同几何结构上比较。采用受控噪声扰动与Riemannian Flow Matching生成样本，评估指标间一致性（metric agreement）、噪声敏感性，并关联几何诱导的体积缩放。
AI.result: 没有任何一种度量在所有情形下都可靠：评价距离的选择会同时影响所测得的分布差异与噪声敏感性，且其表现随曲率与维度变化而不同。
AI.conclusion: 提出关于评价距离报告方式、度量类型比较以及基于样本几何进行度量校准的实用建议，强调评价指标需与流形几何相匹配。

title: Rivet: Utility-Preserving Context Control for Repository-Level Coding Agents
summary: Repository-level code generation asks an agent to implement a task requirement inside an existing repository. To produce code that works in the repository, the agent needs repository evidence, such as target locations, helper definitions, caller usages, and configuration constraints, which determine how the code should be located, integrated, and executed. Because the context budget cannot hold the entire repository, existing retrieval, compression, and structure-aware methods select context by task similarity, context length, or structural proximity, but these criteria do not directly measure whether the selected context contains this evidence. As a result, the selected context can appear relevant to the task yet miss the evidence that the implementation depends on. We call this failure mode context utility dilution. In this paper, we propose Rivet, a context control framework that preserves repository evidence for coding agents under a fixed context budget. Rivet, first uses Signal Grounding to select task-related code anchors by fusing lexical, semantic, and structural signals. Utility Linking then expands these anchors through dependency, usage, and configuration relations to collect repository evidence. Finally, Budget Shaping packs the evidence by priority and, when the budget is tight, reduces snippets to signatures or summaries before dropping them. We evaluate Rivet, on two executable repository-level benchmarks, DevEval and RepoExec, with four backbone models, two context budgets (4K and 8K tokens), and eight baselines. Rivet, achieves the highest Pass@1 in all 16 settings and improves over the strongest baseline by 3.73--5.15 percentage points on average. Moreover, GPT-5-mini with Rivet, outperforms GPT-5 without Rivet,on both benchmarks while reducing inference cost by 73.3%--84.5%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Rivet 上下文控制框架，通过 Signal Grounding、Utility Linking 与 Budget Shaping 三步，在固定上下文预算下为仓库级代码生成代理保留"仓库证据"，在 16 个设置下均取得最优 Pass@1。
AI.motivation: 仓库级代码生成要求代理在既有仓库中实现需求，必须获得目标位置、辅助定义、调用方用法、配置约束等"仓库证据"；但上下文预算无法容纳整个仓库。现有检索、压缩与结构感知方法按任务相似度、上下文长度或结构邻近性选上下文，并不直接衡量所选内容是否包含这些证据，导致上下文看似相关却缺失实现所依赖的证据，作者称之为 context utility dilution（上下文效用稀释）。
AI.method: Rivet 分三步：(1) Signal Grounding：融合词法、语义与结构信号，选取与任务相关的代码锚点；(2) Utility Linking：沿依赖、使用与配置关系扩展锚点，收集仓库证据；(3) Budget Shaping：按优先级打包证据，预算紧张时先将片段缩减为签名或摘要，再考虑丢弃。
AI.result: 在 DevEval 与 RepoExec 两个可执行仓库级基准上，使用 4 个骨干模型、2 种上下文预算（4K/8K tokens）与 8 个基线，Rivet 在全部 16 个设置中 Pass@1 最高，平均较最强基线提升 3.73–5.15 个百分点；GPT-5-mini + Rivet 在两个基准上均优于无 Rivet 的 GPT-5，同时推理成本降低 73.3%–84.5%。
AI.conclusion: 以"证据是否被保留"而非相似度作为上下文选择准则，可在固定预算下显著提升仓库级代码生成效果；小模型配合 Ri​vet 可在大幅降低推理成本的同时超越更强模型直接使用。

title: Human-Feedback-Guided Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Interactive Driving Behavior Modeling
summary: Modeling human driving behavior is fundamental to understanding driver decision-making and supporting autonomous vehicles (AVs) in mixed traffic. Reward learning offers a principled way to infer the latent objectives behind driving behaviors, yet most existing methods are formulated in single-agent settings and treat surrounding vehicles as dynamic obstacles. Directly extending reward learning to multi-agent scenarios is difficult because the joint action space grows exponentially with the number of interacting vehicles. In addition, existing approaches mainly rely on physical demonstrations and rarely exploit human feedback during reward recovery. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a Human-Feedback-Guided Multi-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning (HFG-MAIRL) framework for interactive driving behavior modeling. First, we develop a multi-agent maximum-entropy inverse reinforcement learning module that explicitly models each vehicle and its directly interacting neighbors in a localized Markov game, while using aggregated traffic states to capture the influence of the broader traffic environment. The resulting coupled multi-vehicle responses are approximated through finite marginal-response iterations over factorized vehicle-level policies, avoiding explicit enumeration of the full joint action space. Second, we incorporate human feedback as ordinal preference supervision through a Bradley-Terry likelihood. In our experiments, driver emotion labels are used as one instantiation of such feedback and converted into pairwise ordinal preference constraints. Experiments on the AIDE dataset show that HFG-MAIRL outperforms representative IRL baselines in decision modeling and produces interpretable feedback-aligned reward patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HFG-MAIRL框架，通过局部化马尔可夫博弈的多智能体最大熵逆强化学习与人类反馈序数偏好监督，解决交互驾驶行为建模中联合动作空间爆炸和反馈匮乏的问题，并在AIDE数据集上优于代表性IRL基线。
AI.motivation: 建模人类驾驶行为对理解驾驶决策与支撑混合交通中的自动驾驶至关重要。奖励学习可推断驾驶行为背后的潜在目标，但现有方法多为单智能体设定，将周围车辆视为动态障碍；直接扩展到多智能体面临联合动作空间随交互车辆数指数增长的困难，且主要依赖物理演示、很少利用人类反馈。
AI.method: 提出人类反馈引导的多智能体逆强化学习（HFG-MAIRL）框架。其一，构建多智能体最大熵逆强化学习模块，在局部化马尔可夫博弈中显式建模每辆车及其直接交互邻居，并用聚合交通状态刻画更广泛环境的影响；通过因子化车辆级策略上的有限边际响应迭代近似耦合的多车响应，避免枚举完整联合动作空间。其二，以Bradley-Terry似然将人类反馈作为序数偏好监督，实验中用驾驶员情绪标签作为反馈实例化并转为成对序数偏好约束。
AI.result: 在AIDE数据集上，HFG-MAIRL在决策建模方面优于代表性逆强化学习基线，并产生可解释的、与反馈对齐的奖励模式。
AI.conclusion: 局部化多智能体建模结合边际响应迭代可有效缓解联合动作空间爆炸，引入序数人类反馈能提升交互驾驶奖励恢复的可解释性与一致性。

title: Polynomial Residual Networks are Generically Identifiable
summary: We prove identifiability results for constant-width residual networks with polynomial activations and bias terms. For activations of degree at least five with generic coefficients, the fiber over a generic parameter is a singleton. For activations of degree at least three with no linear term after a suitable translation of the input, the generic fiber is given by translating biases and then scaling weights and translated biases by real roots of unity. These results specialize to networks without bias terms. With the same proof technique, we further derive necessary conditions for critical points of the ResNet parametrization, that are central in singular learning theory.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了常数宽度残差网络（多项式激活、含偏置）的参数可辨识性：高次一般系数激活下泛型参数纤维为单点；三次以上且平移后无线性项时，泛型纤维由偏置平移与单位根缩放刻画，并由此导出ResNet参数化临界点的必要条件。
AI.motivation: 残差网络的参数化映射通常不可辨识（存在对称性与冗余参数化），而奇异学习理论中需要理解该映射的临界点与纤维结构；此前缺乏对含偏置常数宽度ResNet的严格可辨识性刻画。
AI.method: 采用代数几何观点，研究参数化映射在泛型参数处的纤维（fiber）；结合多项式激活的次数与系数一般性假设、输入平移消去线性项等技巧进行证明，并将同一证明技术推广到临界点分析。
AI.result: 次数≥5且系数一般的激活：泛型纤维为单点（完全可辨识）。次数≥3且经合适输入平移后无线性项：泛型纤维等于“偏置平移后再以实单位根缩放权重与平移后偏置”所生成的群作用轨道。结果可特化到无偏置网络。此外给出ResNet参数化临界点的必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出常数宽度多项式残差网络可辨识性的精确刻画，明确了除单位根对称性外无其他泛型纤维退化，并为奇异学习理论中临界点研究提供代数工具。

title: Toward Methods and Tools for Critical Examination of Disparate Systems for Discovery of Hidden Dependencies in Engineering of Autonomous and Semi-Autonomous Systems
summary: We present a methodology, an initial AI Skill package, and emerging results, for enhancing software engineers' acquisition and application of domain knowledge and system-wide engineering perspectives towards the development of an autonomous or semi-autonomous system in a domain that may be new to them. At the core of the approach is a process involving proactive adversarial critiquing of videos of disparate systems in related environments. Among other things, the engineers and automated AI tools look for interactions, dependencies, and environment assumptions manifested in the observed systems, which are applicable also to the target system, but that otherwise might remain unarticulated in project artifacts. The approach and its supporting tools can enhance the quality of the target system, the individual engineer's skills and the organization's engineering practices.

AI.tldr: 提出一种方法、初始AI技能包及初步结果，通过对抗性批判性分析相关环境中的异构系统视频，帮助软件工程师获取领域知识并建立系统级工程视角。
AI.motivation: 工程师在开发面向新领域的自主或半自主系统时，往往缺乏该领域知识与系统级工程视角，许多关键的交互、依赖与环境假设未被明确表达在项目工件中。
AI.method: 核心是一个过程：由工程师与自动化AI工具对相关环境中不同系统的视频进行主动对抗性批判性审视，识别其中可迁移至目标系统的交互、依赖与环境假设。
AI.result: 给出初步涌现的结果，表明该流程与支持工具能够提升目标系统质量、工程师个人技能以及组织的工程实践水平。
AI.conclusion: 视频对抗性批判方法结合AI工具可有效补足领域知识缺口，改善个体与组织的工程能力。

title: All the Facts, Still the Wrong Answer: Integration Gaps in Vision-Language Models
summary: Multimodal reasoning requires models to combine multiple pieces of evidence into decisions that satisfy all relevant constraints. Evaluations centered on final-answer accuracy leave unclear whether failures arise from reading individual facts or using them together. We study this question through the multi-evidence integration gap, linking local fact recovery to global decision validity on controlled subset-selection and path-finding tasks. Our evaluation combines conditional performance given correct local answers with same-grid local queries, text-oracle inputs, retrieval controls, and constraint ablations. We further examine hidden-state probes and activation replacement across network depth, token positions, and model families. Across the evaluated models, accurate local recovery coexists with substantial global failure. For example, Gemma-3-27B recovers all evaluated isolated item facts correctly but achieves only 19.75% global validity on eight-item visual instances. Probes decode information about solution membership from global-prompt states, while corresponding clean-state replacement recovers failed decisions over model-dependent depth ranges. These findings show that recovering facts and representing solution-related information are insufficient for reliable joint decisions. They motivate evaluations and model improvements that explicitly target how available evidence is combined, alongside advances in perception and model scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"多证据整合鸿沟"（multi-evidence integration gap）概念，将局部事实恢复与全局决策有效性分离评估，发现模型能正确读取孤立事实却在联合约束决策上大幅失败，且解耦的隐藏状态信息不足以支撑可靠整合。
AI.motivation: 以最终答案准确率为核心的多模态推理评测无法区分失败源于"读不懂单个事实"还是"无法将多个证据组合使用"，因此需要一个能把局部事实恢复与全局决策有效性显式挂钩的评测框架。
AI.method: 在受控的子集选择与路径搜索任务上构建评测：对比"给定局部答案正确时的条件性能"与同网格局部查询；引入文本oracle输入、检索控制与约束消融；并在网络深度、token位置与不同模型家族上进行隐藏状态探针与激活替换实验。
AI.result: 在所评估模型中，准确的局部恢复与显著的全局失败并存：Gemma-3-27B 在孤立的条目事实上全部正确，但在八条目视觉实例上全局有效率仅19.75%。探针可从全局提示状态中解码出解成员信息，且相应的干净状态替换能在依赖模型的一定深度区间内恢复失败决策。
AI.conclusion: 事实恢复与解耦的解成员信息表示均不足以支撑可靠的联合决策；需在感知能力与模型规模之外，针对证据如何被组合这一环节设计评测与改进方法。

title: A quantum k-nearest neighbors implementation using magnitude-aware comparisons
summary: Much attention has recently been devoted to the k-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm as a case study for quantum computing algorithms. Several algorithms have devised methods to compute a similarity metric to solve Quantum KNN (QKNN). This paper presents a practical quantum encoding technique that enables Euclidean distance calculation between vectors with different L2 norms by appending a single component to each vector, then uses it in the QKNN problem. It is arguably simpler to understand and implement than comparable methods and uses fewer qubits. Further, an implementation of this algorithm is provided and is used to benchmark it against a recent Euclidean-distance QKNN method on standard labeled datasets. In addition to demonstrating proper formulation, the results show marked improvement over similar implementations during simulation with realistic noise due to the use of fewer qubits and thus more coherent circuits.

AI.tldr: 提出一种实用的量子编码技术，通过为每个向量追加单一分量实现不同L2范数向量间的欧氏距离计算，并用于量子KNN，所用比特更少、更易实现。
AI.motivation: 量子KNN（QKNN）多依赖相似度度量，现有欧氏距离量子算法在向量L2范数不同时处理复杂，且比特开销大、电路难实现，限制了含噪仿真下的实用性。
AI.method: 设计量子编码方案：在每个向量后追加一个分量以统一范数，从而可直接计算不同L2范数向量间的欧氏距离；将该编码嵌入QKNN流程，并给出算法实现，与近期欧氏距离QKNN方法在标准带标签数据集上进行基准对比。
AI.result: 实现更简单、所用比特数更少；在含真实噪声的仿真中，因比特更少、电路相干性更好，性能显著优于同类实现，并验证了算法的正确性。
AI.conclusion: 追加单一分量的量子编码可简洁高效地支撑欧氏距离QKNN，比特开销降低带来抗噪优势，具备实际可实现的工程价值。

title: V$^3$AST-Bench: Verifiable, Valid, and Versatile Safety Evaluation for Coding Agents
summary: Large language models increasingly act through code, modifying repositories, executing programs, and interacting with services in agent form. Their actions introduce risks that cannot be assessed from generated responses alone. Safety evaluation must verify actual consequences, distinguish harm avoidance from task incapability, and cover realistic workflows. We introduce V$^3$AST-Bench, a benchmark for Verifiable results, Valid interpretation, and Versatile risk coverage of Agent Safety. It comprises 212 risk tasks spanning 18 categories. Dedicated runtime environments verify harm and task outcomes through executable checks over states, records, and artifact behavior, while paired capability twin tasks verify workflow competence. Our experiments span 51 combinations of 11 models and five harnesses, spanning 86,496 trials and over 9 billion tokens of model interaction. Results show that V$^3$AST-Bench remains challenging even for frontier coding agents, as Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code still causes verified harm on 20.9% of tasks. Across model-harness combinations, agents with comparable competence exhibit markedly different safety outcomes, showing that task capability alone does not guarantee safe execution. More importantly, even explicit recognition of risks does not reliably prevent harmful actions, revealing a critical gap between risk awareness and safe execution. These findings highlight the need to move beyond risk recognition toward enforcing safety throughout execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 V$^3$AST-Bench，一个面向代码型智能体安全评测的基准，通过可执行运行时验证真实危害与任务结果，并配���能力孪生任务区分"无力完成"与"安全规避"。51 个模型-框架组合、86,496 次试验显示：即使前沿编码智能体仍有 20.9% 任务产生经核实的危害，且风险识别并不能可靠阻止有害执行。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多以智能体形式通过代码行动（修改仓库、执行程序、调用服务），其行为风险无法仅凭生成文本判断。现有安全评测局限于响应层面，无法验证实际后果、无法区分"避免危害"与"能力不足"，且缺乏对真实工作流的覆盖，因此需要可验证、可解释、覆盖面广的智能体安全评测。
AI.method: 构建 V$^3$AST-Bench，包含 18 类共 212 个风险任务。为每个任务配备专用运行时环境，通过对状态、记录与产物行为的可执行检查来验证危害是否发生及任务是否完成；同时设置配对的能力孪生任务以评测工作流胜任度，从而将危害规避与任务无能解耦。实验覆盖 11 个模型与 5 种智能体框架的 51 种组合，共 86,496 次试验、逾 90 亿 token 交互。
AI.result: 该基准对前沿编码智能体仍具挑战性：Claude Opus 4.8 配合 Claude Code 仍在 20.9% 的任务中造成经验证的实际危害。在能力相当的模型-框架组合之间，安全表现差异显著，说明任务能力本身不足以保证安全执行。此外，即使智能体明确识别出风险，也不能可靠阻止有害动作，暴露出风险意识与安全执行之间的关键鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 智能体安全评测应从"风险识别"转向"执行全过程的安全约束与强制"。V$^3$AST-Bench 通过可验证结果、有效解释性与多维风险覆盖，为代码型智能体安全提供了可复现的评测范式，并揭示能力、意识与安全执行三者不能互相替代。

title: Local Entropy Fluctuations for Black-Box LLM-Generated Text Detection
summary: Zero-shot detection of machine-generated text is vital for mitigating the risks of large language models (LLMs) misuse. While the state-of-the-art dual-model detectors and resampling-based detectors outperform single-model statistical detectors on unprompted continuations, they suffer a catastrophic breakdown on instruction-conditioned text in the black-box setting, where the source model is unknown. We analyze this failure and trace it to poor prompt conditioning for resampling-based methods and diminished cross-model discrepancy for dual-model detectors. Motivated by recent studies that human writing maintains a steady, uniform information flow, whereas machine-generated text exhibits sharp, localized entropy fluctuations, we propose a new metric, the Relative Peak Prominence Rate (RelPPR) to capture this structural contrast along the entropy trajectory and further leverage it as a signal for LLM-generated text detection. Extensive evaluations across diverse model families and datasets demonstrate that RelPPR achieves state-of-the-art black-box detection performance and remains the most reliable detector under various practical situations. Our code is available at https://github.com/brushing-git/entropy-llm-detector.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对黑盒场景下指令条件文本检测的性能崩塌问题，提出基于熵轨迹结构对比的新指标RelPPR，实现SOTA的零样本机器生成文本检测。
AI.motivation: 零样本检测机器生成文本对防范LLM滥用至关重要。现有双模型检测器和重采样检测器在无提示续写任务上表现优异，但在源模型未知的黑盒设定下、面对指令条件文本时出现灾难性失效。作者将其归因于：重采样方法对提示条件建模不足，双模型检测器的跨模型差异被削弱。
AI.method: 受"人类写作信息流稳定均匀、机器生成文本熵出现尖锐局部波动"的观察启发，提出相对峰值显著率（Relative Peak Prominentence Rate, RelPPR）指标，从熵轨迹上刻画上述结构差异，并将其作为LLM生成文本检测信号。
AI.result: 在多种模型家族与数据集上的广泛评估表明，RelPPR在黑盒检测任务上达到SOTA性能，并在多种实际场景下保持最可靠的检测表现。
AI.conclusion: 熵轨迹的结构性峰显著性差异是区分人机文本的有效零样本信号；RelPPR优于现有双模型与重采样检测器，尤其适用于指令条件下的黑盒检测场景。代码已开源。

title: A Distribution-Matching Perspective on LLM Training Algorithms
summary: In this work, we propose a unified framework for training algorithms across different stages of modern large language model development, based on the perspective of distribution matching. We show that a broad class of language model training algorithms can be interpreted as minimizing a certain divergence between the current model and a target distribution, and that characterizing the properties of this target distribution provides substantial insight into the behavior of the corresponding training algorithms. By analyzing specific forms of the target distribution, we establish that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) enjoys an advantage over classical Knowledge Distillation (KD) when the current model distribution is close to the target distribution, while exhibiting a disadvantage when the two distributions are far apart. Furthermore, when the target distribution itself depends on the model being optimized, we show that the accumulation of estimation variance can induce a deterministic degradation of the target distribution. These results provide a theoretical explanation, at least in part, for the long-term behavior of existing Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms. With this intuition we further designed Conditional KL (CKL) regularization for mitigating the degradation of the target distribution. CKL can effectively preserve mode diversity while relaxing the constraint imposed by classical KL regularization on reward improvements. We believe this theoretical perspective can bring some new understanding of language model training algorithms and provide useful guidance for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"分布匹配"视角统一现代大模型各阶段训练算法：将各类训练算法解释为最小化当前模型与目标分布间的某种散度，分析目标分布性质可揭示算法行为，并据此提出条件KL（CKL）正则化缓解目标分布退化。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型训练（预训练、蒸馏、强化学习等）分属不同阶段且算法各异，缺乏统一的理论刻画，也难以解释现有RL算法的长期行为（如模式坍塌、奖励提升受限等）。作者希望用统一的分布匹配框架给出理论解释并指导新方法设计。
AI.method: 1）将一大类语言模型训练算法统一表述为最小化当前模型与目标分布之间的某种散度；2）通过刻画目标分布的性质分析对应训练算法行为；3）比较在策略蒸馏（OPD）与经典知识蒸馏（KD）在不同模型-目标分布距离下的优劣；4）分析目标分布依赖被优化模型时估计方差累积导致的目标分布确定性退化；5）设计条件KL（CKL）正则化。
AI.result: 理论结果：（a）当当前模型分布接近目标分布时，OPD相对经典KD具有优势；当两者相距较远时OPD处于劣势。（b）当目标分布本身依赖被优化模型时，估计方差累积会导致目标分布的确定性退化，这部分解释了现有RL算法的长期行为。方法结果：CKL正则化能有效保持模式多样性，同时放松经典KL正则对奖励提升的约束。
AI.conclusion: 分布匹配视角为语言模型训练算法提供了统一的理论理解：目标分布的性质决定了算法行为，OPD/KD的优劣取决于分布距离，模型依赖的目标分布会因方差累积而退化；CKL正则化可缓解该退化并兼顾模式多样性与奖励优化。作者认为该视角能为未来研究提供有益指导。

title: Behavioral Regression Detection for Pull Requests via Structured Oracles
summary: Software regressions are unintended behavioral changes introduced by code modifications and are hard to detect at pull-request (PR) level. Existing methods rely on incomplete tests or directly analyze PRs via LLMs, lacking structured behavioral reasoning and explicit oracles. We present ORION, a staged framework for PR-level regression detection. ORION extracts PR intent and identifies impacted functions via AST-based impact analysis, then synthesizes function-level structured behavioral oracles encoding preserved/changed behaviors, setup constraints and control-flow hints from PR intent, static risk signals and code changes. Guided by these oracles, ORION generates executable tests, conducts oracle-coverage-guided augmentation and static repair, and differentially runs tests on pre- and post-change code. It classifies PRs with deterministic rules and constrained LLM reasoning. We build RegBench-Py, the first Python PR regression benchmark with 154 verified real-world PRs. ORION achieves F1-scores of 0.6125 (DeepSeek-Chat-V3.2) and 0.5578 (Claude-4.5-haiku), outperforming baselines including Testora, Codex and Claude Code. Compared with PatchGuru, ORION supports broader multi-function PRs while remaining competitive on single-function cases. On 1,459 merged PRs, ORION finds 9 reproducible regression candidates, 8 confirmed by maintainers. It takes ~15 minutes per PR, showing practicality for CI/CD screening.

AI.tldr: ORION：一个面向PR级回归检测的分阶段框架，通过意图提取、AST影响分析、结构化行为oracle合成、可执行测试生成与差分运行实现回归判定，并构建首个Python PR回归基准RegBench-Py。
AI.motivation: 软件回归是代码修改引入的非预期行为变化，在PR层面难以检测。现有方法依赖不完整的测试，或直接用LLM分析PR，缺乏结构化的行为推理与显式oracle。
AI.method: ORION为分阶段框架：(1)提取PR意图并经AST影响分析定位受影响函数；(2)合成函数级结构化行为oracle，编码保持/变更行为、setup约束与控制流提示，来源包括PR意图、静态风险信号与代码改动；(3)在oracle引导下生成可执行测试，进行oracle覆盖率引导的增强与静态修复；(4)在变更前后代码上差分运行测试；(5)用确定性规则与受约束LLM推理对PR分类。同时构建RegBench-Py，含154个经人工验证的真实PR。
AI.result: ORION的F1为0.6125（DeepSeek-Chat-V3.2）与0.5578（Claude-4.5-haiku），优于Testora、Codex、Claude Code等基线；相比PatchGuru支持更广的多函数PR且单函数场景仍具竞争力；在1,459个已合并PR中发现9个可复现回归候选，其中8个获维护者确认；每PR约耗时15分钟。
AI.conclusion: ORION通过结构化行为oracle与差分测试实现PR级回归检测，具备实用性，可用于CI/CD筛查；RegBench-Py为该任务提供了首个Python基准。

title: An actively trained neural operator for near-explicit atmospheric chemistry
summary: Earth-system models simplify atmospheric chemistry into condensed mechanisms, because near-explicit mechanisms such as the Master Chemical Mechanism (MCM) are too costly to solve in every grid cell. Neural emulators could lift this limit, but most advance the chemistry in small time steps and cover only a few species or a reduced mechanism. Here we introduce FNO-MoE, a Fourier neural operator with a mixture of experts that predicts the full near-explicit chemical state over 30 minutes in a single call. The same network also guides its own training, using the disagreement among its experts to select the most informative box-model simulations. At equal cost, this active sampling yields a more accurate emulator than random or evenly spread sampling. Fine-tuning on longer trajectories keeps it stable over multi-hour runs in which models trained on short simulations diverge. The resulting emulator reproduces the evolution of thousands of species with high fidelity, remains accurate for unseen chemical compositions and runs orders of magnitude faster than the numerical solver. These results open a new direction for emulating complex atmospheric systems: neural operators that predict the full chemical state over long windows and choose their own training data. Training under changing meteorology is the next step towards bringing near-explicit chemistry into Earth-system models.

AI.tldr: 提出 FNO-MoE：基于傅里叶神经算子与专家混合的神经代理模型，单次调用即可预测近显式大气化学完整状态在30分钟内的演化，并利用专家分歧主动挑选训练样本；在相同成本下比随机/均匀采样更准确，微调后可在多小时积分中稳定，速度比数值求解器快数个量级。
AI.motivation: 地球系统模型因近显式机制（如 MCM）逐网格求解代价过高，只能使用高度简化的化学机制；现有神经代理多为小步长推进、仅覆盖少数物种或简化机制，难以替代完整化学求解。
AI.method: 构建 FNO-MoE：傅里叶神经算子耦合专家混合结构，一次性输出30分钟窗口内的全部近显式化学状态；以专家间分歧作为不确定性度量进行主动采样，挑选信息量最大的箱模型模拟用于训练；并在更长轨迹上微调以提升长时间稳定性。
AI.result: 同等成本下主动采样精度优于随机与均匀采样；长轨迹微调后可在多小时运行中保持稳定（短轨迹训练的模型会发散）；高保真复现数千物种演化，对未见化学组成仍准确，运行速度比数值求解器快数个量级。
AI.conclusion: 神经算子可预测长窗口内的完整化学状态并自主选择训练数据，为复杂大气系统代理建模提供新方向；下一步需在变化气象条件下训练，以将近显式化学引入地球系统模型。

title: CFL-aware edge design for graph neural solvers of hyperbolic transport
summary: Hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs) transport information at finite speed along characteristics, often producing shocks and discontinuities that are challenging to capture numerically. Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer learned update rules, but neighbor aggregation alone does not tell a GNN how far information must travel and along which edge. As a result, when a GNN model takes a time step larger than what was used in training, shock fronts smear and oscillations grow. In this work, we ask whether making the scale of transport explicit as an edge-local Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) signal can enhance GNNs' ability to model hyperbolic PDEs. Holding the architecture fixed, we vary only the information given to each edge, from a raw edge form to forms that progressively expose the edge-local transport interaction through direction, length, and wave speed. Because all of these are computed from the same ingredients, what changes is not the amount of information but its form. The results show a consistent pattern, in which feature count is not the limiting factor, and appending CFL directly to a raw edge form produces almost no benefit. The CFL conditioning proves most effective when the edge information already exposes the transport interaction, reducing final-step error by 10.4-14.4%, and the improvement widens as the step size grows larger. Notably, this improvement arises not from smearing the solution but from suppressing oscillations near shocks. These results point to a specific design principle that CFL conditioning is most effective when the edge representation already separates the direction of interaction from spatial scale, so that the CFL value has a well-defined quantity to modulate.

AI.tldr: 在固定架构下仅改变边输入信息的表示形式，发现将边局部CFL（方向×尺度×波速）作为显式输运信号时，GNN对双曲PDE的建模最有效，前提是边表示已分离"交互方向"与"空间尺度"。
AI.motivation: 双曲PDE沿特征线以有限速度传播信息，易产生激波与间断。GNN的邻域聚合本身无法告知信息需传播多远、沿哪条边传播，导致推理时步长大于训练步长会出现激波面抹平与振荡增长。作者希望探究：把输运尺度显式化为边局部CFL信号，能否提升GNN建模能力。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：固定网络架构，只改变每条边获得的信息形式，从原始边形式（raw edge form）逐步过渡到显式暴露方向、长度、波速的边局部输运交互形式；所有形式由相同要素计算，故信息量不变、仅形式改变。并对比不同步长下的表现。
AI.result: 特征数量并非瓶颈；将CFL直接拼接至原始边形式几乎无收益。当边信息已暴露输运交互时，CFL条件化最有效，最终步误差降低10.4–14.4%，且步长越大增益越明显。该提升并非源于解的抹平，而是抑制激波附近的振荡。
AI.conclusion: 提出一条具体设计原则：只有当边表示已将交互方向与空间尺度分离、使CFL值具有可调制的明确量时，CFL条件化才最有效。

title: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
summary: Despite rapid progress in command-line interface (CLI) tasks, recent LLM-based agents still struggle with reliable task execution through graphical user interfaces (GUIs). A key challenge is the limited content visible within a bounded viewport, especially on mobile devices, where many task-relevant targets remain hidden and can only be revealed through swipe interactions. Therefore, although most GUI agents support swipe as an action primitive, the lack of target visibility makes it difficult for them to decide when, where, and how to swipe to reveal the hidden content. Our quantitative study further shows that GUI agents incorrectly choose a click action in 47.8% of cases that require swipe exploration. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes equipping GUI agents with scrollable-region perception to support hidden-area exploration before action selection. To this end, we trained the first multimodal model for scrollable-region perception on a manually collected dataset of 667 UI screens, called Hagasu. By correctly identifying 78.5% of scrollable regions, experiments across nine GUI agents show that integrating Hagasu improves the mean end-to-end completion rate from 64.8% to 82.7% on explore-dependent tasks. To facilitate follow-up research, we release the swipe dataset and the source code of Hagasu.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可滚动区域感知多模态模型Hagasu，使GUI智能体在动作选择前能识别并探索视口外隐藏内容。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的GUI智能体在移动端受限于有限视口，大量任务相关目标隐藏于视口外，仅能通过滑动（swipe）揭示；但智能体缺乏目标可见性，难以判断何时、何处、如何滑动。定量研究显示在需要滑动探索的情形中，智能体有47.8%错误地选择了点击动作。
AI.method: 为GUI智能体引入可滚动区域感知能力，支持在动作选择前进行隐藏区域探索；在人工采集的667张UI屏幕数据集上训练首个可滚动区域感知多模态模型Hagasu。
AI.result: Hagasu可正确识别78.5%的可滚动区域；在九个GUI智能体上的实验表明，集成Hagasu后，依赖探索类任务的平均端到端完成率由64.8%提升至82.7%。
AI.conclusion: 可滚动区域感知有效弥合GUI智能体的滑动探索能力缺口，显著提升探索依赖任务的完成率；作者开源滑动数据集与Hagasu源码以促进后续研究。

title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to System 1 Models: Fast Decision-Making Beyond LLMS
summary: Large Language Models excel at reasoning and generation but their autoregressive, token-by-token inference makes them unnecessarily slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated for the many routine decisions (routing, gating, scoring, classification) that modern AI systems require at sub-second latency. A growing class of models addresses this gap: System 1 decision models, architectures that map an input directly to a typed, structured decision in a single forward pass. This guide provides a comprehensive, practitioner-oriented treatment of the field. We propose a five-family taxonomy covering encoder-based classifiers, reward models, non-autoregressive decision engines, contrastive decision models, and extraction models, and we provide in-depth coverage of each family's architecture, training methodology, and deployment trade-offs. A central theme is calibration: we develop the theory of proper scoring rules, analyze Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions (RLCD), and examine recently discovered phenomena including IIA violations, ordinal-scale bias, and few-shot recalibration under distribution shift. On the integration side, we describe how System 1 models serve as decision infrastructure within agentic workflows and System 1 + System 2 cascades that route between fast and slow models based on calibrated confidence. The guide covers 18 application domains, maps the rapidly growing open-source ecosystem (over 70 model reproductions in weeks), provides runnable code throughout, and includes a practitioner's checklist, an open-source model zoo, and 22 self-assessment questions with detailed answers. Spanning 190 references, it is intended as a unified entry point for researchers and engineers working at the intersection of fast decision-making, calibration, and production AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇面向实践者的综述/指南，系统梳理"System 1 决策模型"——单次前向即输出结构化决策的架构，提出五类分类法，并重点讨论校准理论、与System 2的级联集成及落地实践。
AI.motivation: LLM 的自回归逐token推理在路由、门控、打分、分类等日常决策上速度慢、成本高且校准差，无法满足亚秒级延迟需求；该领域文献分散，缺少统一入口。
AI.method: 提出五族分类法（编码器分类器、奖励模型、非自回归决策引擎、对比式决策模型、抽取模型），逐族剖析架构、训练方法与部署权衡；围绕校准发展proper scoring rules理论、分析RLCD，并考察IIA违背、序数尺度偏差、分布漂移下的少样本重校准；集成层面给出agentic工作流中的决策基础设施与基于校准置信度的快慢级联路由。
AI.result: 覆盖18个应用域，梳理70余个开源复现模型，提供可运行代码、实践者清单、开源模型库及22道自评题，引用190篇文献。
AI.conclusion: 为快速决策、校准与生产级AI系统交叉领域的研究者与工程师提供了统一、实用的参考框架。

title: Testing with Coding Agents: A Large-Scale Comparison of Agent-Supported and Human-Authored Pull Requests
summary:
Context. Coding agents increasingly contribute tests through pull requests that developers then maintain, so how testing work is divided affects long-term maintainability.
  Objective. We compare pull requests in which developers and coding agents collaborate (agent-supported) with pull requests without detectable agent involvement (human-authored) along five dimensions: the frequency and extent of test changes, their type and context, test structure, test smells, and code coverage.
  Method. We analyze 114,134 pull requests merged between January 2025 and April 2026 in 391 Java repositories, identifying five coding agents through pull-request-level and commit-level signals. Since agent adoption varies across projects, we compare the two groups within repositories with mixed-effects models that control for change size.
  Results. Pooled across repositories, both groups change test code almost equally often; within repositories, the odds that an agent-supported pull request does so are 1.65 times higher. Agent-supported pull requests add tests more often (odds ratios 1.50-1.58) and modify (0.70-0.76) and delete (0.51-0.77) them less often. We detect no difference in most structural characteristics of the tests they add, which more often have an oracle, nor, in the 95 repositories we could build, in the coverage of their production changes; in test-only pull requests, however, their tests cover less of the code they exercise. Differences in test smells are borderline and not reproduced for individual test methods.
  Conclusions. Agent participation is associated with a different mix of testing work, which pooled comparisons across projects can hide or reverse; its relationship with test quality remains uncertain.

AI.tldr: 该论文在391个Java仓库的114,134个合并PR上，比较"人类+编码智能体协作"与"人类独立编写"的Pull Request在测试相关五个维度上的差异，发现智能体参与改变了测试工作的分工结构，但与测试质量的关系仍不确定。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体越来越多地通过Pull Request贡献测试代码，而这些测试最终由开发者长期维护，因此"测试工作如何在人与智能体之间分工"会直接影响可维护性；现有研究缺少大规模、控制项目差异的实证对比。
AI.method: 收集2025年1月至2026年4月间391个Java仓库的114,134个已合并PR；通过PR级与commit级信号识别5种编码智能体，划分agent-supported与human-authored两组。针对仓库间智能体采用率差异，采用控制变更规模的混合效应模型在仓库内部进行比较；分析维度包括：测试变更的频率与规模、变更类型与上下文、测试结构、测试异味（test smells）、代码覆盖率。
AI.result: 汇总层面两组修改测试代码的频率几乎相同，但仓库内部agent-supported PR修改测试代码的几率高1.65倍；其更常新增测试（OR 1.50–1.58），更少修改（OR 0.70–0.76）与删除测试（OR 0.51–0.77）。新增测试在多数结构特征上无差异，但更常包含测试预言（oracle）。在可成功构建的95个仓库中，其生产代码变更的覆盖率无差异；但在纯测试PR中，其测试对被执行代码的覆盖率更低。测试异味差异处于临界水平，且在单个测试方法层面无法复现。
AI.conclusion: 智能体参与对应着不同的测试工作组合（更多新增、更少修改/删除），而这种差异在跨项目汇总比较中会被掩盖甚至反向；智能体参与同测试质量的关系仍不确定，需在仓库内部分层分析与方法级验证。

title: InfiniteWorld: Separating Visual Evidence from Familiar Physics
summary: Physical reasoning requires adapting familiar expectations to the dynamics of the observed world. Existing benchmarks establish broad physical capabilities, yet an overall score leaves unclear whether answers follow visual evidence when familiar rules no longer apply. We introduce InfiniteWorld, a benchmark that pairs physical-reasoning questions with simulator videos whose physical parameters are systematically altered. Its generation pipeline connects simulation, scene screening, paired video translation, question construction, and input checks. Five tasks assess law identification, parameter estimation, temporal reasoning, analytic counterfactual comparison, and law induction. The evaluation defines five matched input settings for each question, comprising text-only evaluation and ordered or shuffled observations from simulator and translated videos. We evaluate a diverse set of video-language models under these matched settings. The results expose a persistent preference for familiar physical rules. Frames improve performance for most models, but gains differ across tasks. Strong accuracy on Earth-normal questions coexists with poor recognition of altered dynamics, and Earth-normal answers remain common when the observed physics changes. Task scores and semantic agreement further distinguish matching physical factors from matching their amount, and correct answers from repeated errors. InfiniteWorld makes these behaviors measurable through paired changes in the evidence supplied for the same question, separating visual evidence from familiar physics.

AI.tldr: 提出InfiniteWorld基准，用参数被系统性改变的模拟视频配对物理推理问题，在五种匹配输入设置下评测视频语言模型，揭示了模型对"熟悉物理规律"的持续偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只能给出总体分数，无法判断当熟悉的物理规律不再适用时，模型答案是否真正依据视觉证据。需要一个能把"视觉证据"与"熟悉物理先验"分离的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建生成流水线：模拟仿真、场景筛选、配对视频翻译、问题构造、输入校验；设五类任务（规律识别、参数估计、时间推理、解析反事实比较、规律归纳）；每题定义五种匹配输入设置，包括纯文本、仿真视频与翻译视频的有序/乱序观测；在此设置下评测多类视频语言模型。
AI.result: 模型普遍偏好熟悉的物理规则；帧输入对多数模型有增益但跨任务差异明显；在地球正常设定下准确率高，却难以识别被改变的动力学，且观测物理变化后仍常给出"地球正常"答案；任务分数与语义一致性可区分"匹配物理因素"与"匹配合量"、正确答案与重复性错误。
AI.conclusion: InfiniteWorld通过对同一问题的证据做配对式改变，把视觉证据与熟悉物理先验分开，使上述行为可测量，为物理推理评测提供了可控、可诊断的新范式。

title: Memory or a Clock? Auditing a Memory Advantage in XLand-MiniGrid with Seeds, Maps and Evaluation Noise Apart
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures. Code: https://github.com/Effiani-Core/memory-or-clock . Data and checkpoints: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23512311
summary: On a partially observable XLand-MiniGrid task, an LSTM agent beats a memory-free MLP by 25 percentage points. The gap looks like a clear case of memory. We ask two questions about it. First, how much of a measured gap is noise? Separating training seed, map and evaluation randomness in 60 runs, each re-evaluated three times, we find that about ten paired seeds detect a 10-point gap in final success. The binary "task acquired" verdict, a common summary of learning curves, is 76% evaluation noise and would need about a hundred seeds for the same gap. Second, is the gap memory? On a sealed panel of new maps, opened once, a memory-free MLP of the LSTM's size comes within 3.3 points of the LSTM when it is given the time step, and gains no measurable benefit from its width without it. With the time step, an MLP a quarter of the LSTM's size, and the LSTM with its state erased at every step, also come within about 5 points. A linear probe reads the time step from the trained LSTM's state. On this task, most of the apparent memory advantage is an advantage of knowing the time, which matters because episodes are cut at a fixed limit and the reward shrinks with time. We recommend giving memory-free baselines the time step, and we release the protocol, the event-driven tooling and every checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 在部分可观测XLand-MiniGrid任务中，LSTM相对无记忆MLP的25个百分点优势中，大部分并非记忆能力，而是"知道时间步"带来的优势；同时"任务习得"二值判定噪声极大。
AI.motivation: 文献中常把LSTM与MLP的成功率差距直接解读为记忆的作用，但作者怀疑该差距可能混淆了训练/评估噪声，以及时间步信息（回合固定截断、奖励随时间衰减）带来的影响，因此需要分别量化"噪声份额"与"记忆份额"。
AI.method: 1) 方差分解：60次运行，每次重复评估3次，分离训练种子、地图与评估随机性，比较配对种子数对10点差距的检测能力；2) 密封地图面板（仅开启一次）上的消融：同规模无记忆MLP加时间步输入、其1/4规模MLP加时间步、以及每一步清空状态的LSTM；3) 线性探针从训练后LSTM状态中读取时间步。
AI.result: 约10个配对种子即可检测10点最终成功率差距；而二值"任务习得"判定中约76%为评估噪声，需约100个种子。密封面板上，加时间步的同规模MLP与LSTM仅差3.3点，且无时间步时宽度无显著收益；1/4规模MLP加时间步与每步清空状态的LSTM均与LSTM相差约5点以内；线性探针可从LSTM状态线性读出时间步。
AI.conclusion: 该任务上表面上的记忆优势主要是"知晓时间"的优势；建议为无记忆基线提供时间步输入，并公开协议、事件驱动工具与全部检查点。

title: RepoTrace: Improving Requirement Tracing in Multi-Round Agent Interactions
summary:
Code agents have become increasingly capable of performing software engineering tasks through interaction with software environments. However, agents tend to degrade as the number of interaction rounds increases, making it difficult to maintain existing software during iterative modification. We analyze 2,656 agent trajectories in EvoCode-Bench and identify requirement focus misalignment as a recurring failure pattern, where agents struggle to distinguish the primary modification targets of a requirement from unrelated code.
  We propose Repotrace a requirement-driven repository understanding harness that combines repository structure with requirement semantics to construct a requirement-code correspondence and injects it into the agent context. This correspondence enables code agents to follow the repository architecture, trace requirements across multi-round interactions, and identify the core code elements corresponding to the current requirement. Experiments show that Repotrace improves the mean per-round reward (MPR) across different models (e.g., +19.99 on GLM-5.2) and agent harnesses (e.g., +10.22 on Claude Code). Across rounds, Repotrace increases the average per-round reward from 0.163 to 0.371 on Terminus-2 with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, while reducing average regression errors by 56.78%. We release the source code and agents' trajectories to support future research.

AI.tldr: 论文分析代码智能体多轮交互中性能退化问题，在EvoCode-Bench的2,656条轨迹中定位出"需求关注点错位"失败模式，提出Repotrace：结合仓库结构与需求语义构建需求-代码对应关系并注入智能体上下文，显著提升每轮平均奖励并降低回归错误。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体在高轮次交互中性能退化，难以在迭代修改中维护既有软件；作者从EvoCode-Bench的2,656条轨迹中分析发现，反复出现的失败模式是"需求关注点错位"——智能体难以区分需求的主要修改目标与无关代码。
AI.method: Repotrace是一种需求驱动的仓库理解框架（harness）：将仓库结构与需求语义相结合，构建"需求-代码"对应关系，并将该对应关系注入智能体上下文，使智能体能够遵循仓库架构、跨多轮交互追踪需求、并定位当前需求对应的核心代码元素。
AI.result: 在不同模型（如GLM-5.2上+19.99）和不同智能体框架（如Claude Code上+10.22）上均提升每轮平均奖励（MPR）；在Terminus-2 + DeepSeek-V4-Pro上，跨轮次的平均每轮奖励从0.163提升至0.371，同时平均回归错误降低56.78%。
AI.conclusion: 以需求-代码对应关系为核心的仓库理解注入可有效缓解多轮迭代中的关注点错位与性能退化，具备跨模型、跨框架的泛化性；作者开源代码与智能体轨迹以支持后续研究。

title: Unlocking the Specialization Capability of PPG Foundation Models for Wearable Signals through Structured Pruning and Adaptive Fine-Tuning
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) plays a central role in wearable health monitoring and clinical decision support. However, existing approaches to universal PPG representation learning are predominantly trained on high-quality large-scale datasets obtained from oximeters in hospital settings and often struggle to adapt to sparse and low-quality real-world datasets, thereby limiting their generalization to clinically relevant tasks on prevalent PPG data such as collected from wearable devices. Surprisingly, even after full fine-tuning, PPG foundation models cannot consistently outperform general-purpose time-series models. Therefore, a key question is how to effectively adapt PPG foundation models to target prediction tasks. Through empirical studies on various PPG foundation models, we find that pretrained models often exhibit inherent sparsity and computational redundancy, suggesting that PPG foundation models have learned to activate task-relevant network substructures for different prediction tasks. To preserve this valuable prior knowledge, we propose a structured pruning-and-fine-tuning framework, SPAFT, which regularizes the adaptive fine-tuning process by constraining it to a more relevant and compact parameter space based on parameter importance and structural redundancy. Extensive experiments across four PPG foundation models, five benchmark datasets, and ten downstream tasks demonstrate that SPAFT achieves win rates of 82.8% and 87.5% on regression and classification tasks, respectively. This prune-then-finetune paradigm often enables PPG foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance, laying a promising foundation for the real-world clinical deployment of PPG foundation models and the development of personalized PPG foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPAFT 结构化剪枝-微调框架，约束 PPG 基础模型在紧凑的、任务相关的参数空间内自适应微调，从而提升其在稀疏低质量真实 PPG 数据上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 PPG 通用表征学习主要基于医院血氧仪采集的高质量大规模数据训练，难以适应可穿戴设备采集的稀疏、低质量真实数据；即使全量微调，PPG 基础模型也未必稳定优于通用时序模型。因此核心问题是：如何有效地将 PPG 基础模型适配到下游预测任务。
AI.method: 通过多种 PPG 基础模型的实证研究发现，预训练模型存在固有的稀疏性与计算冗余，表明其已学会针对不同任务激活任务相关的网络子结构。据此提出 SPAFT 框架：基于参数重要性与结构冗余度，将自适应微调过程约束在更相关、更紧凑的参数空间内，即"先剪枝后微调"（prune-then-finetune）。
AI.result: 在 4 种 PPG 基础模型、5 个基准数据集、10 个下游任务上实验，SPAFT 在回归与分类任务上分别取得 82.8% 和 87.5% 的胜率，常使 PPG 基础模型达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝-微调范式为 PPG 基础模型的真实临床部署及个性化 PPG 基础模型的发展奠定了基础。

title: Learning What to Share: Expert Specialization for Time-Series Forecasting
summary: A central challenge in multivariate forecasting is deciding what to share across channels and where to specialize. Mixture-of-experts models offer flexible sharing, yet it remains unclear how much of their forecasting gains comes from added capacity or expert allocation. Through controlled comparisons across eleven datasets and three backbones, we show that informative channel assignments improve forecasting beyond matched shared capacity and random allocation. On frozen transformer backbones, persistent channel-specific mixtures outperform input-dependent routing on average. To examine when and how much specialization helps, we introduce GalaxyTS, a controlled synthetic dataset with exact shared and channel-specific forecasting references. It reveals how persistent channel mixtures exploit predictive differences concealed by short input windows and measures gains over matched shared corrections. These insights motivate Persistent Closed-Form Routing (PCR), a plug-and-play method that alternates exact conditional estimation of channel-specific mixture weights with gradient-based training of low-rank residual experts around a frozen pretrained forecaster. Averaged over four forecasting horizons, PCR-K4 achieves dataset-balanced mean squared error reductions of 3.86-14.25% relative to the three frozen backbones. In matched comparisons, PCR outperforms competing specialization methods on average while requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 通过受控实验区分"容量"与"专家分配"对多变量预测的贡献，提出合成数据集GalaxyTS揭示持续式通道混合的有效条件，并据此提出即插即用的持续闭式路由方法PCR。
AI.motivation: 多变量预测中"跨通道共享什么、何处专门化"是核心难题；MoE虽灵活，但其收益究竟来自增加容量还是专家分配机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在11个数据集、3种骨干网络上做受控比较（匹配共享容量 vs 随机分配 vs 信息性通道分配），比较持久式通道专属混合与输入依赖路由；构建具精确共享/通道专属参考的合成数据集GalaxyTS；提出PCR：在冻结预训练预测器上交替进行通道混合权重的精确条件估计与低秩残差专家的梯度训练。
AI.result: 信息性通道分配优于匹配容量的共享与随机分配；冻结Transformer骨干上持久式通道混合平均优于输入依赖路由；四预测步长平均下，PCR-K4相对三个冻结骨干实现数据集平衡MSE降低3.86–14.25%，匹配比较中平均优于竞品专门化方法且可训练参数显著更少。
AI.conclusion: 专家化收益主要源于通道分配与持续式结构而非单纯容量；PCR以轻量参数实现高效的通道专门化。

title: Toward Evidence-Based Agentic Software Engineering
summary: Task success rates and execution costs of agentic coding tools depend on both model and harness. The harness manages context, provides tools, and runs the agent loop. In empirical software engineering (SE) studies, comparisons that change model and harness together cannot isolate their effects. We qualitatively annotated 325 experiments reported in 146 peer-reviewed full papers published between 2025 and 2026. We examined the reported configurations and whether comparisons isolated harness effects, including harness configuration and version, model, tasks, and user interaction. The exact version of every harness used was reported for only 15 experiments. For five, the paper reported when the experiments were run, and for 31, authors shared execution traces for every session. Of the 226 experiments comparing harnesses, 35 never varied the harness in isolation. Based on this analysis, we derive requirements for a reference harness that the SE community can use for experiments. We call on the community to report all degrees of freedom of experiments with agentic coding tools and on SE venues to pilot dedicated tracks or special issues around a specified reference harness release. In these tracks, papers would hold the harness version fixed and vary features through separately versioned extensions to isolate feature effects and test their interactions.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过定性标注146篇论文中的325个实验，揭示agentic coding工具实验中模型与harness混淆、版本与执行轨迹报告不足等问题，并提出参考harness与专用track的规范要求。
AI.motivation: agentic coding工具的任务成功率与执行成本同时取决于模型和harness，而现有SE实证研究常同时改变二者，无法分离各自效应；同时实验可复现性所需的关键信息（harness精确版本、运行时间、执行轨迹）报告严重缺失。
AI.method: 对2025–2026年发表的146篇同行评审全文论文中报告的325个实验进行定性标注，考察其配置，以及比较是否隔离了harness效应，涵盖harness配置与版本、模型、任务和用户交互等自由度。
AI.result: 仅15个实验报告了所用harness的精确版本；5个实验报告了运行时间；31个实验由作者共享了每个会话的执行轨迹；在226个比较harness的实验中有35个从未单独变化harness。
AI.conclusion: 作者据此提出面向SE社区的参考harness需求，呼吁完整报告agentic coding实验的所有自由度，并建议SE会议/期刊试点围绕指定参考harness版本的专用track或专刊，在其中固定harness版本、通过独立版本化的扩展变更特性，以隔离特性效应并检验其交互。

title: Are We Done with UMLS Injection into Language Models for Medical Question Answering?
comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, 13 tables. Code and literature annotations: https://disi-unibo-nlp.github.io/are-we-done-with-umls
summary: Maybe not. The Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) has become an oracle for millions of clinicians and health system developers worldwide. Researchers have increasingly used knowledge graphs derived from UMLS to enhance language models' factual accuracy and reasoning traceability in high-stakes tasks. Medical Question Answering (MQA) is a prime testbed for integration, with benchmarks usually involving professional exercises such as disease diagnosis and drug prescription from patient history. Despite the assumed benefits, empirical evidence shows that UMLS-based graph injection typically yields modest performance gains. This paper reviews existing MQA work, critically analyzing the selected UMLS sources and their usage with language models, and probes each of these choices in isolation. We uncover methodological issues never discussed in prior work, from low UMLS coverage to weak subgraph retrieval pipelines. Based on our findings, we provide actionable recommendations to unlock the untapped potential of UMLS as an external knowledge source.

AI.tldr: 该文质疑UMLS知识图谱注入语言模型对医学问答的实际增益，通过隔离式实验揭示UMLS覆盖率低、子图检索流程薄弱等方法论问题，并给出可操作改进建议。
AI.motivation: 学术界普遍假设基于UMLS的知识图谱注入能提升语言模型在医学问答等高风险任务中的事实准确性与推理可追溯性，但实证显示性能提升有限，需系统性地审视这一假设背后的方法选择。
AI.method: 综述既有MQA工作，批判性分析其所选UMLS子源及与语言模型的结合方式，并对每一项设计选择进行隔离式（逐一控制变量）实证探测。
AI.result: 发现此前文献未曾讨论的方法论问题，包括UMLS覆盖度偏低以及子图检索流程薄弱等。
AI.conclusion: 现有UMLS注入流程存在系统性缺陷，需按所提建议改进知识源选择与子图检索，方能释放UMLS作为外部知识源的潜力。

title: Reactive Optimizers
comment: This document is a static version of our blog post. We recommend the original interactive version at https://xingjianbai.com/reactive-optimizers/. We release the code at https://github.com/xingjian-bai/opal
summary: We study a reactive optimizer that uses a pretrained language-model agent to inspect training dynamics and rewrite executable optimizer code during a single training run. The agent can change update rules and schedules for individual parameter groups, without optimizer-specific meta-training or memory transferred from other runs. We evaluate this approach, OPAL, on language modeling and image generation when a recipe has not been tuned for the target setting. Across the evaluated settings, it matches or improves on selected fixed recipes. Analysis of its decisions shows changes to learning-rate schedules, optimizer structure, numerical precision, and momentum. Controlled experiments also show adaptation to repeated data corruption and reduced overfitting. We report these behaviors together with the agent's computational cost and implementation requirements.

AI.tldr: 提出反应式优化器 OPAL，借助预训练语言模型 agent 在单次训练中检视训练动态并重写可执行优化器代码，在配方未针对目标设定调优时达到或超越选定固定配方。
AI.motivation: 现有优化器配方通常需针对具体任务与设置人工调优；当配方未适配目标场景时性能下降，而元学习式优化器需要优化器专属元训练或跨运行记忆迁移，灵活性受限。作者希望探索无需此类先验、能在单次训练内自适应改写优化器的方案。
AI.method: OPAL 使用预训练语言模型 agent，实时检查训练动态，并在训练过程中直接重写可执行优化器代码；可针对单个参数组修改更新规则与调度策略，且不依赖优化器专属元训练或跨运行迁移的记忆。评估涵盖语言建模与图像生成两类任务，均处于配方未针对目标设定调优的情形；并通过决策分析与受控实验考察其行为。
AI.result: 在所评估的各设定中，OPAL 匹配或优于选定的固定配方。对其决策的分析显示主要改动集中于学习率调度、优化器结构、数值精度与动量。受控实验表明其能适应重复数据损坏并减轻过拟合。文中同时报告了 agent 的计算开销与实现要求。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型 agent 驱动的训练中优化器代码改写是一种可行且有效的反应式优化途径，可在缺乏任务专属调优时提供竞争力，但需权衡额外计算成本与实现复杂度。

title: Making Small Code LLMs More Efficient for Secure Code Review with Neuro-Symbolic Fine-Tuning
summary: As AI coding assistants generate more code, the need to review it for security flaws grows. Existing approaches leave a gap: static analyzers identify program sites but offer little explanation, while language-model explanations can be difficult to verify. Small open-weight code models could make security review available without sending proprietary code to a hosted service. We study whether fine-tuning helps these models turn security evidence into explanations that developers and tools can check. We present secSemScan, which pairs a static analyzer with a locally deployable model that writes a schema-constrained security monologue naming program sites, assigning a CWE, and giving a machine-parseable verdict. We also introduce OGSM (Oracle-Grounded Security Monologue), a dataset of 1,993 C/C\texttt{++} functions covering 22 CWEs in the taint and lifetime families. Each record pairs a function with analyzer-derived or fix-diff-derived evidence and a monologue. We fine-tune three open-weight code models in two stages, first on the output format and then on the monologue content. Because evaluation prompts supply the verdict and evidence, our results measure how well models use that information, not whether they detect vulnerabilities independently. On 355 test records, fine-tuning raised Qwen2.5-Coder-7B's verdict accuracy from 4.8\% to 96.6\%; DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B reached 78.9\%, and StarCoder2-7B reached 43.7\%. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B cited 87.5\% of Tier~1 oracle sites, and every line it cited belonged to the oracle evidence. The results suggest that fine-tuning helps small models produce more structured, evidence-linked security reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 secSemScan：静态分析器 + 本地可部署小模型，将安全证据转化为结构化、可校验的"安全独白"（命名程序点、给出 CWE、可机器解析判定）；并构建 OGSM 数据集（1,993 个 C/C++ 函数、22 个 CWE），两阶段微调使 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 判定准确率从 4.8% 提升至 96.6%。
AI.motivation: AI 编码助手生成代码增多，安全审查需求上升。现有方案存在缺口：静态分析器能定位程序点但缺乏解释，语言模型解释难以验证；同时小型开源代码模型可避免将专有代码发送至托管服务。作者研究微调能否让小模型将安全证据转成开发者与工具可核查的解释。
AI.method: 将静态分析器与可本地部署的模型配对，模型输出受模式约束的安全独白，指名程序点、指派 CWE、给出机器可解析判定。构建 OGSM（Oracle-Grounded Security Monologue）数据集：1,993 个 C/C++ 函数，覆盖污点族与生命周期族共 22 个 CWE，每条含函数、来自分析器或修复 diff 的证据及独白。对三个开源权重代码模型分两阶段微调：先输出格式，后独白内容。评测提示中已提供判定与证据，因而衡量的是模型对给定信息的利用能力，而非独立漏洞检测能力。
AI.result: 在 355 条测试记录上：Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 判定准确率由 4.8% 升至 96.6%；DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B 达 78.9%；StarCoder2-7B 达 43.7%。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 引用 87.5% 的 Tier 1 oracle 站点，且其引用的每一行均属于 oracle 证据。
AI.conclusion: 微调有助于小模型生成更结构化、与证据关联的安全推理。局限在于结论基于给定判定与证据的条件，不代表模型的独立漏洞检测能力。

title: Beyond Static Structures: Linking Protein Dynamics to Function via DynaReason-Pro
summary: Intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) carry out their functions through heterogeneous conformational ensembles that reflect their dynamics, yet most protein function prediction methods rely on sequence or a single static structure. To this end, we introduce DynaReason-Pro, the first framework to jointly predict GO terms from conformational ensembles and generate natural-language functional rationales. We evaluate DynaReason-Pro on a curated IDP benchmark from the Protein Ensemble Database (PED), with sequence- and structure-cluster-disjoint splits to prevent data leakage. Variability-stratified evaluation shows the clearest gains in the high-conformational-variability regime.

AI.tldr: DynaReason-Pro 是首个从构象系综联合预测 GO 功能条目并生成自然语言功能解释的框架，在 PED 的 IDP 基准上以高构象变异性区间收益最明显。
AI.motivation: IDP 通过异质构象系综实现功能，其功能与动态性密切相关；但现有蛋白质功能预测方法多依赖序列或单一静态结构，无法刻画系综与动态信息。
AI.method: 提出 DynaReason-Pro，同时输入构象系综进行 GO 条目预测并生成自然语言功能 rationale；在 Protein Ensemble Database (PED) 构建的 IDP 基准上评估，采用序列与结构簇不相交划分以避免数据泄漏，并按构象变异性分层评估。
AI.result: 在高构象变异性区间获得最清晰的优势提升；具体数值指标摘要未给出。
AI.conclusion: 构象系综信息对 IDP 功能预测具有增量价值，尤其适用于高动态体系；系综级预测 + 可解释自然语言说明构成新的建模范式。

title: EEGBiFormer: Real-Time EEG Attention Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformer with EEG-Informed Auditory Protocol Validation
summary: Sustained attention is critical for academic performance, yet existing auditory support tools are static and not grounded in real-time neural evidence. This paper presents EEGBiFormer, a hybrid CNN-Transformer model for realtime binary classification of attention states, focus versus nonfocus, from 16-channel EEG signals. A custom analog front-end acquisition board was designed and built to collect a task-based EEG dataset. Before model training, spectral and connectivity analysis, using Power Spectral Density and Phase Locking Value, confirmed distinct neural signatures between attention states, providing physiological grounding for the classification approach. EEGBiFormer achieved 91.3 percent window-level validation accuracy with an F1 score of 94.5 percent, and 88.2 percent recording-level accuracy across 17 independent sessions. End-to-end system latency was measured below 100 ms, supporting real-time responsiveness. The trained model was further used to objectively rank auditory stimuli by focus-state confidence, yielding EEG-informed audio protocols. In a paired within-subject behavioral study with 37 participants, these protocols produced a statistically significant 20 percent improvement in composite attention scores over silent controls, with a medium-to-large effect size. This work demonstrates a complete pipeline from custom EEG hardware through neural signal analysis, deep learning classification, and evidence-based auditory protocol design.

AI.tldr: 提出EEGBiFormer（CNN-Transformer混合模型），基于16通道EEG实时二分类专注/非专注状态，并据此设计EEG信息驱动的听觉音频方案，配对实验显示注意力得分提升20%。
AI.motivation: 持续注意力对学业表现至关重要，但现有听觉辅助工具是静态的，缺乏实时神经证据支撑，因此需要可实时判定注意力状态并据此定制音频的系统。
AI.method: 自研模拟前端采集板构建任务态EEG数据集；用功率谱密度与相位锁定值做频谱与连通性分析，验证两类状态的神经特征差异；构建CNN-Transformer混合模型EEGBiFormer做实时二分类；用训练模型对听觉刺激按专注置信度排序生成音频协议；开展37人被试内配对行为实验。
AI.result: 窗口级验证准确率91.3%、F1 94.5%；17个独立session录音级准确率88.2%；端到端延迟低于100 ms；音频协议使综合注意力得分较静默对照显著提升20%，效应量为中到大。
AI.conclusion: 工作贯通了从自研EEG硬件、神经信号分析、深度学习分类到循证听觉协议设计的完整闭环，证明实时神经反馈驱动的音频干预可行且有效。

title: Understanding Python Linters through a Comprehensive and Systematic Empirical Study
summary: Code linters, tools that automatically detect code issues, help developers accelerate development and improve code quality by identifying errors early. Unlike previous studies that focused mainly on single linters or informal comparisons, this paper presents the first large-scale empirical study of five widely used Python linters: Ruff, Pylint, Flake8, Mypy and Black, through four key user concerns: linting rule checks, speed, configuration methods, and linter preferences. We analyze 1,551 linting rules, categorize them into five types, and construct rule mappings, finding that more than 40% are shared between multiple linters, with Ruff and Pylint together covering over 80% of all rules. Pylint has the most rules in the first two categories, and Ruff leads in the last three. Next, we measure their running times on 1,000 GitHub projects under three setups (single-rule, default, all-rules), finding a consistent speed ranking from fastest to slowest: Ruff, Mypy, Flake8, Black, and Pylint. Ruff is extremely fast, with runtimes typically within one second. Then, we summarize four configuration methods and four types of configuration options from 443 available options across the five linters. While all linters support the four configuration methods, they differ in project configuration formats and flexibility in their configuration options. Finally, an analysis of 3,094 GitHub projects using the five linters reveals that over 50% use multiple linters, share strong consensus on option selections and rule suppressions, but exhibit project-specific variations in enabled-rule configurations. Our findings provide actionable insights for linter users and establish a benchmark dataset and taxonomy to support future research, such as cross-linter rule mapping, performance modeling, and automated configuration.

AI.tldr: 首个针对五种主流Python linter（Ruff、Pylint、Flake8、Mypy、Black）的大规模实证研究，围绕规则检查、速度、配置方式与用户偏好四个维度展开。
AI.motivation: 以往研究多聚焦单一linter或非正式的对比，缺乏系统化、大规模的多linter实证分析与统一基准。
AI.method: 分析1,551条linting规则并归为五类、构建规则映射；在1,000个GitHub项目上以三种运行设置（单规则、默认、全规则）测量运行时间；从五种linter的443个选项中归纳出四种配置方式与四类配置选项；并分析3,094个GitHub项目的使用情况。
AI.result: 超过40%的规则被多个linter共享，Ruff与Pylint合计覆盖逾80%规则；速度排序稳定为Ruff > Mypy > Flake8 > Black > Pylint，Ruff通常1秒内完成；各linter均支持四种配置方式，但在配置格式与选项灵活性上有差异；超50%项目同时使用多个linter，选项选择与规则抑制高度一致，而启用规则配置存在项目特异性。
AI.conclusion: 研究为linter用户提供可操作建议，并建立基准数据集与分类体系，支撑跨linter规则映射、性能建模与自动化配置等后续研究。

title: Rectified Language Flow
summary: Continuous-state flow and diffusion models offer a promising approach to fast, parallel language generation, but matching the generation quality of autoregressive models remains challenging. We present Rectified Language Flow (ReLF), a language model that generates text by transporting noise to token embeddings using rectified flow. ReLF combines several complementary design choices: fixed token embeddings constructed with Hellinger-SVD, self-conditioning guidance trained with cross-entropy, and regularized reflow for few-step generation. We further introduce singular logits, which combine an analytically computed term that drives commitment to a valid token embedding as noise vanishes with a bounded neural residual that learns contextual token preferences. With 64 function evaluations on OpenWebText, ReLF achieves lower generative perplexity than autoregressive baselines at matched diversity across all three model sizes tested, while also outperforming prior continuous flow methods in this setting. After two reflow rounds, ReLF still outperforms autoregressive baselines with 16 function evaluations while generating 1,024-token sequences 15-19 times faster at batch size 1.

AI.tldr: ReLF用rectified flow将噪声输运到token嵌入进行并行语言生成，结合Hellinger-SVD固定嵌入、交叉熵训练的自条件引导、正则化reflow与singular logits，在OpenWebText上以64次函数评估取得低于自回归基线的生成困惑度，两步reflow后16次评估仍占优且1024长度序列提速15-19倍（batch size 1）。
AI.motivation: 连续状态流与扩散模型可实现快速并行语言生成，但在生成质量上仍难以匹配自回归模型；作者希望缩小这一差距并兼顾少步推理效率。
AI.method: 提出Rectified Language Flow（ReLF），通过rectified flow将噪声输运至token嵌入；采用Hellinger-SVD构造的固定token嵌入；以交叉熵训练自条件引导（self-conditioning guidance）；使用正则化reflow支持少步生成；并引入singular logits——由随噪声消失而驱动收敛到有效token嵌入的解析项与学习上下文token偏好的有界神经残差相加构成。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText上，64次函数评估时，三种模型规模下ReLF在匹配多样性条件下生成困惑度均低于自回归基线，并优于既有连续流方法；经两轮reflow后，16次评估仍优于自回归基线，且在batch size 1时生成1024-token序列快15-19倍。
AI.conclusion: ReLF表明基于rectified flow的连续状态语言建模在质量与效率上可同时超越自回归基线，singular logits与正则化reflow是实现少步高质量并行的关键设计。

title: Hessian-Similar Optimization with Capped Participation: Lower Bounds and Virtual Masters
summary: What is the round complexity of Hessian-similar optimization when each round can contact at most $s$ of $m$ clients? Prior rates permit a free master or full participation and do not characterize strict caps. We count every one-vector query and reply. A hidden-client chain gives a lower bound for zero-respecting local algorithms with adaptive cohorts and random stopping: on strongly convex quadratics, the required rounds are $Ω((m/s)\sqrt{\min\{δ_a,\barδ/\sqrt m\}/μ}\,\log(1/ε))$ for $s\leq(m-2)/2$ in the high-accuracy, high-dissimilarity regime. Here $μ$ is strong convexity, while $δ_a$ and $\barδ$ bound anchor and average Hessian variation. To remove dependence on a poor anchor, virtual-master SVRS uses independent estimator and proximal cohorts and averages the proximal replies. With Catalyst, it reaches relative gap $ε$ in $\tilde O(m/s+(\sqrt{m/s}+m^{3/4}/s)\sqrt{\barδ/μ})$ expected rounds on quadratics with strongly convex clients, independent of $δ_a$. Combining this method with charged analyses of existing algorithms matches the lower bound's polynomial dependence for $s\leq\sqrt m$ and $s=Ω(m)$; the worst gap is $O(m^{1/8})$. A held-out 12-seed synthetic study finds fewer rounds than tuned SVRP in nine of ten dip-family incomplete-cohort cells, versus two of 30 other cells. The lower bounds concern zero-respecting algorithms and do not cover unrestricted messages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究每轮仅能与 m 个客户端中 s 个通信的"Hessian-similar"优化问题的轮复杂度，给出零尊重局部算法的下界，并提出消除锚点依赖的 virtual-master SVRS 方法，在强凸二次情形下达到接近下界的轮复杂度。
AI.motivation: 已有率要么假设自由 master（全参与），要么允许全部参与，无法刻画每轮严格只能接触 s 个客户端的受限通信场景，缺乏对固定容量约束下轮复杂度的精确刻画。
AI.method: 以每轮一向量查询与回复计轮数；构造 hidden-client chain 给出零尊重局部算法（自适应队列、随机停止）的下界；提出 virtual-master SVRS：用独立估计器队列与近端队列，并对近端回复做平均，以摆脱对锚点 Hessian 变差 δ_a 的依赖，并结合 Catalyst 加速；再用 charged analysis 分析已有算法。
AI.result: 强凸二次、高精度高差异度、s≤(m-2)/2 时下界为 Ω((m/s)√(min{δ_a, δ̄/√m}/μ) log(1/ε))；virtual-master SVRS + Catalyst 在强凸客户端二次问题上以 Õ(m/s+(√(m/s)+m^{3/4}/s)√(δ̄/μ)) 期望轮数达到相对间隙 ε，且与 δ_a 无关；与下界的多项式依赖在 s≤√m 与 s=Ω(m) 时匹配，最坏差距 O(m^{1/8})；12 种子合成实验中在 10 个 dip 族不完整队列单元里的 9 个优于调优 SVRP，另 30 个单元中仅 2 个更优。
AI.conclusion: 在受限通信（每轮至多 s 个客户端）下首次给出轮复杂度下界与匹配上界，virtual-master SVRS 消除了对锚点质量的依赖并接近最优；下界仅针对零尊重算法，不覆盖任意消息模型。

title: FeatureLoop: Benchmarking Coding Agents under Evolving Requirements
summary: Software development with coding agents often begins with a rough request that users refine after trying the implementation. Final correctness alone does not capture the repeated guidance this process requires. We introduce FeatureLoop, a benchmark of 61 human-reviewed tasks from 34 repositories across five primary programming languages and seven software forms. Each task follows one development goal in a persistent workspace through evolution feedback, which adds or clarifies requirements, and completion feedback, which reports failures of stated requirements. Cumulative executable checks track new behavior, repair, and preservation of earlier functionality. We evaluate 12 frontier models and find that the strongest completes 72.1% of tasks with both feedback types. Across models, however, only 15.4% of observed failed stages recover within two corrective revisions. Further analysis reveals incomplete repairs, regressions, and model-specific differences in feedback use and token efficiency, identifying obstacles to reliable, low-intervention development.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FeatureLoop 基准，含 61 个人工审核任务（34 个仓库、5 种语言、7 类软件形态），通过"演进反馈"与"完成反馈"模拟用户多轮引导的开发过程，并用累进可执行检查追踪新功能、修复与既有功能保持。评测 12 个前沿模型：最强模型在两类反馈下完成 72.1% 任务；但跨模型仅 15.4% 的失败阶段能在两次纠正修订内恢复，暴露出修复不完整、功能回归及反馈利用与 token 效率的模型差异。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体评测多只关注单轮请求下的最终正确性，无法反映真实开发中用户试跑后再逐步细化需求的反复引导过程；仅以最终正确性衡量，会掩盖多轮交互中的引导负担与可靠性问题。
AI.method: 构建 FeatureLoop 基准：61 个来自 34 个仓库的人工审核任务，覆盖 5 种主要编程语言与 7 类软件形态；每个任务在持久化工作区内围绕单一开发目标推进，注入两类反馈——演进反馈（新增或澄清需求）与完成反馈（报告既定需求未通过）；采用累积式可执行检查，分别度量新行为实现、缺陷修复与早期功能保持。共评测 12 个前沿模型。
AI.result: 最强模型在同时提供两类反馈时完成 72.1% 的任务；跨模型整体上，观察到的失败阶段中仅 15.4% 能在两次纠正修订内恢复。进一步分析发现三类问题：修复不完整、既有功能回归，以及模型间在反馈利用方式与 token 效率上的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 最终正确性不足以刻画编码智能体的实际开发能力；多轮反馈下的错误恢复率偏低，是可靠、低干预开发的主要障碍。FeatureLoop 提供了可量化的多轮引导评测框架，指向未来需重点改进的方向：增量修复完整性、回归控制与反馈信号的充分利用。

title: EnvLunch: The Environment as a Free Lunch for Learning to Interact
summary: For agentic data analysis, language-model agents often require a large number of annotated tasks to learn how to interact effectively with executable environments (i.e., databases). While high-quality annotated tasks require heavy manual effort, an executable environment already provides rich interaction structure and verifiable outcomes. In this sense, the environment itself offers a free lunch, an additional set of verifiable tasks that require no human annotation. We propose EnvLunch, a warm-up stage that turns this environmental signal into agent training without human-written or model-generated task descriptions, before downstream agentic reinforcement learning. EnvLunch samples valid action trajectories, executes them to obtain final observations, and trains an agent to recover a functionally equivalent trajectory given only its final observation. This label-free warm-up enables the model to outperform the baseline by over 9 points on average across all downstream training budgets, and with few labels, the baseline needs 8 to 32 times as many annotated examples to match the accuracy that the EnvLunch model reaches at its smallest training budget. Letting the environment alone define the task yields a larger gain than having the model write its own tasks over the same environments, and this warm-up also improves fine-tuning on benchmarks beyond data analysis. EnvLunch therefore saves annotated tasks and provides a better starting point for fine-tuning agentic models when such tasks are limited.

AI.tldr: 提出 EnvLunch：无需人工或模型生成任务描述，仅利用可执行环境自身的交互结构与可验证结果构造"轨迹重建"自监督热身任务，为下游 agentic RL 提供更好起点。
AI.motivation: agentic 数据分析需要大量标注任务来学习与数据库等可执行环境的交互，但高质量标注成本极高；而可执行环境本身蕴含丰富的交互结构和可验证结果，构成一份"免费的午餐"——无需人工标注的可验证任务。
AI.method: EnvLunch 作为下游 agentic RL 之前的热身阶段：采样合法的动作轨迹，实际执行得到最终观测，然后训练 agent 在仅给定最终观测的条件下恢复出一条功能等价的轨迹。整个过程不使用人工编写或模型生成的任务描述。
AI.result: 在所有下游训练预算下平均比基线高 9 分以上；在标注数据稀少时，基线需要 8–32 倍标注样本才能达到 EnvLunch 在最小训练预算下的准确率。仅由环境定义任务带来的收益大于让模型自行编写任务；该热身还能提升数据分析以外基准上的微调效果。
AI.conclusion: EnvLunch 通过将环境信号转化为无标签热身任务，节省标注数据，并在标注任务有限时为 agentic 模型微调提供更优的初始点。

title: Sliding Networks: A Family of Residual Structures Preserving Feature Learning and Feature Diversity
summary: Deep learning models tend to perform best at large widths and depths. The growing interest in scaling laws, especially in the language modeling domain, has motivated procedures for scaling up network widths and depths in order to preserve stability and computational efficiency of training dynamics. Existing depth-scaling approaches force a choice between retaining locally maximal \emph{feature learning} and preserving a form of \emph{feature diversity} in the residual stream arising from random differences between channels. We examine a \textit{joint scaling recipe} that preserves both. With residual width $N_\flat$, hidden width $N_\sharp$, and depth $L$, the key quantity is, by default, the limiting ratio $N_\flat/(N_\sharp L)\toα$, while correlated initialization (Half Copy) can partially relax the resulting shape constraints. Theory and residual-MLP experiments support convergence at fixed positive $α$ to an SDE limit with locally maximal feature learning. Hidden computations can then be redistributed between width and depth while preserving this limit, like turning melody into harmony and back. Language-model experiments nevertheless show performance differences under regrouping at fixed parameter count. These results distinguish approximating a limit (ODE or SDE) from scaling for better performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种"联合缩放配方"，通过控制残差宽度与隐藏宽度之比 N♭/(N♯L)→α，在固定正 α 下同时保留局部最大特征学习与残差流中的特征多样性，并可将隐藏计算在宽度与深度间重新分配而不改变 SDE 极限。
AI.motivation: 现有深度缩放方法被迫在"保留局部最大特征学习"与"保留由通道间随机差异产生的特征多样性"之间二选一，需要一种能同时兼顾二者的缩放方案。
AI.method: 以残差宽度 N♭、隐藏宽度 N♯、深度 L 为变量，取默认极限比 N♭/(N♯L)→α；采用相关初始化（Half Copy）部分放松形状约束；用理论分析与残差 MLP 实验验证收敛到 SDE 极限。
AI.result: 理论与残差 MLP 实验表明：在固定正 α 下收敛到具有局部最大特征学习的 SDE 极限；隐藏计算可在宽度与深度之间重新分配（如旋律与和声互换）而保持该极限；但在固定参数量下，语言模型实验在重新分组后仍表现出性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 需区分"逼近某个极限（ODE 或 SDE）"与"为更好性能而缩放"；保持极限不保证性能等价，固定参数量下的重新分组会影响实际表现。

title: The Hidden Costs of Forgetting: A Study of Trajectory Deletion in Software Engineering Agents
summary: Software engineering agents resend their entire trajectory to an LLM at every turn, motivating online trajectory reduction. Prior work shows that randomly deleting 75% of tokens in old turns may preserve agent effectiveness, but it remains unclear why, how agents compensate for missing content, and whether it actually reduces costs. This paper presents an empirical study of 42 trajectory-reduction configurations, focusing on effectiveness, agent behavior, and cost. We systematically explore deleting content from old turns by varying the scope, granularity, amount, and timing of deletion across 9,400 runs with two state-of-the-art agents on SWE-bench Verified. We find deleting large amounts of trajectory content (e.g., up to 100% of reasoning text) can preserve overall effectiveness. Importantly, such deletion must be applied with a delay, as immediate deletion tends to significantly degrade effectiveness. Agents often compensate for deleted content by re-fetching it, increasing both the number of turns taken and the input/output tokens. Whether trajectory reduction reduces costs depends on the pricing model: Under a flat pricing model, estimated costs fall in 26 of 42 evaluations. Surprisingly, under a caching-aware pricing model, zero evaluations yield lower costs, since reducing the trajectory breaks the cached prefix billed at a lower rate. Our findings have three implications: First, token counts alone are misleading; trajectory reduction techniques must consider overall costs under a realistic pricing model. Second, analyzing trajectories is crucial to understand agent behavior, as end-to-end effectiveness hides differences such as excessive re-fetching. Finally, these results highlight the need for future work on memory management to reduce costs without sacrificing effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文对42种轨迹削减配置进行实证研究，发现大幅删除旧轮次内容（延迟执行时）可保持智能体有效性，但智能体会通过重新获取内容进行补偿，且在缓存感知定价下无一配置降低成本。
AI.motivation: 软件工程智能体每轮都将完整轨迹重发给LLM，成本高昂，因此需要在线轨迹削减；已有工作显示随机删除旧轮次75%token可能保持有效性，但缺乏对"为何有效、智能体如何补偿缺失内容、是否真能降本"的机理与成本分析。
AI.method: 在SWE-bench Verified上，以两个SOTA智能体开展9,400次运行，系统变化删除的范围、粒度、数量与时机，构建并分析42种轨迹削减配置，评估有效性、智能体行为与成本，并对比统一定价与缓存感知定价两种模型。
AI.result: 大量删除轨迹内容（如最多100%推理文本）可保持整体有效性，但必须延迟执行，立即删除会显著降低有效性；智能体常通过重新获取被删内容补偿，导致轮次与输入/输出token增加；统一定价下42项评估中26项估算成本下降，缓存感知定价下则为0项，因削减轨迹破坏了低价计费的缓存前缀。
AI.conclusion: 仅看token数量具有误导性，轨迹削减须在真实定价模型下衡量总成本；轨迹分析对理解智能体行为至关重要，端到端有效性会掩盖过度重新获取等差异；未来需研究不牺牲有效性的内存管理以降低成本。

title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern
summary: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%). TavernBench, 960 tasks in 40 scenarios, shows that the system the agents built is the strongest player: TavernAgent answers 91% of the play tasks against at most 63% for frontier LLMs, and decides in 0.03 s where they need up to 26 s; within the second a live turn allows, it keeps 90% and no LLM more than 26%. LLM agents build far better than they play. We will open-source TavernBench and TavernGym at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoTavern自改进研究系统，多LLM科研智能体共享类型化研究记忆、断言经校验门、实时对局闭环；20天内构建出完整复现炉石酒馆战棋的TavernGym与23版TavernAgent，实盘天梯评分约从6000升至15000，近20局平均名次1.60、80%吃鸡，全面超越服务器前十玩家。
AI.motivation: 检验LLM智能体能否端到端地把一个困难的真实世界问题（原始数据→可对抗人类的系统）做出来。选择炉石传说酒馆战棋作为测试床：8人自动对战、随机商店与战斗、隐藏信息、近千张交互卡牌，复杂度高且存在公开实盘与排行榜可供外部验证。
AI.method: AutoTavern：专用LLM科研智能体共享带类型的"研究记忆"，每条主张须通过验证门（verification gates），实时对局构成闭环反馈，使智能体同步改进模拟器、对手与策略，并据此改进自身科研流程；人类只负责设定目标与裁定歧义机制。产出包括第一份保真全内容的在线游戏复现TavernGym，以及用PPO在按真实对局校准的对手上训练的TavernAgent（共23版）。评测用TavernBench（40个场景、960任务）。
AI.result: TavernAgent可自主在实盘天梯打完整对局，评分由约6,000升至约15,000；按公开排行榜口径，最近20局平均名次1.60、第一率80%，各项统计均优于服务器评分最高的十名玩家（2.34、59%）。TavernBench上TavernAgent打对91%的操作任务（前沿LLM最高63%），决策耗时0.03 s（LLM最多需26 s）；在实时一回合允许的1秒预算内保持90%，而所有LLM不超过26%。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体"构建"系统的能力远强于其"直接游玩"的能力；以验证门+实盘闭环为核心的自改进科研流程，可在数周内把原始数据推进到超越人类顶尖水平的可用系统。TavernBench与TavernGym将开源（https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern）。

title: Approximate Universal Prediction under Interaction
summary: Bayesian mixtures, and Solomonoff induction in particular, provide an idealized model of prediction learned by minimizing population log loss, and they underlie universal agents such as AIXI. An agent that plans with an approximation of such a predictor decides where that predictor is evaluated, and a planner can be drawn toward branches on which its model is optimistic. We study which approximation guarantees survive this feedback. For normalized finite-horizon causal mixtures, the transfer coefficient factors into a policy likelihood ratio and task evidence available before each prediction, so task rarity and action-branch rarity can compound. Within one fixed universal mixture, infinitely many computable environments admit excess prediction error of order $κη\,2^{K(μ)}$, where $η$ is the training KL budget and $κ$ measures policy coverage. This order is sharp, and for each target a computable predictor attains it at a suitable finite horizon, so computability alone does not remove the penalty. For bounded returns, value error is controlled by the probability of entering a poorly covered branch plus a square-root term in $η$. Both terms are necessary, and finite maximum coverage ratios are not required. Motivated by the mentor override of Golden Handcuffs, we derive margins for preserving deferral decisions and conditional KL budgets with an unavoidable inverse-history-probability penalty, and a counterexample separates agreement of deferral decisions from task-wise event avoidance. The guarantees apply to any predictor architecture that meets explicit population approximation and coverage conditions, which gives concrete targets for implementing idealized universal agents.

AI.tldr: 研究"规划器主动选择预测器评估位置"这一反馈回路下，归一化有限时域因果混合（含Solomonoff归纳）的近似保证是否仍成立，给出转移系数的分解、$\\kappa\\eta\\,2^{K(\\mu)}$阶的紧致超额误差下界、有界回报下的价值误差控制，以及Golden Handcuffs式导师覆盖场景下的延迟决策保留边界。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯混合与Solomonoff归纳是AIXI等通用智能体的理想化预测模型，其保证建立在最小化总体对数损失上。但实际规划器只使用近似预测器，并且规划过程本身决定了预测器在哪些分支上被评估，导致模型可能被引向自身乐观的分支（反馈效应）。论文旨在刻画哪些近似保证能在此反馈下存续。
AI.method: 1）对归一化有限时域因果混合，将转移系数分解为策略似然比与每次预测前可用的任务证据之积，说明任务稀有性与动作分支稀有性会复合放大。2）在固定通用混合内构造可计算环境，证明超额预测误差可达$\\kappa\\eta 2^{K(\\mu)}$阶（$\\eta$为训练KL预算，$\\kappa$度量策略覆盖），并证明该阶紧致、可由可计算预测器在适当有限时域达到。3）对有界回报，将价值误差界为"进入覆盖不足分支的概率"加$\\eta$的平方根项，论证两项均必要且无需有限最大覆盖比。4）针对Golden Handcuffs的导师覆盖机制，推导保留延迟决策的边界与带不可避免逆历史概率惩罚的条件KL预算，并给出区分延迟决策一致性与任务级事件规避的反例。
AI.result: 转移系数可分解为策略似然比×任务证据，稀有性与覆盖不足会复合；单个固定通用混合下，无穷多可计算环境存在$\\kappa\\eta 2^{K(\\mu)}$阶超额误差且该阶紧致，故仅凭可计算性无法消除惩罚；有界回报下价值误差由覆盖不足分支进入概率与$\\sqrt{\\eta}$项控制，二者缺一不可，且不需要有限最大覆盖比；延迟决策保留存在不可避免的逆历史概率代价，且延迟决策一致性不等于任务级事件规避。
AI.conclusion: 近似保证在规划反馈下会以任务稀有性与策略覆盖不足的复合形式退化，可计算性本身不能免疫；所给条件（显式总体近似＋覆盖条件）对任意预测器架构成立，可作为实现理想化通用智能体的具体设计目标。

title: Ranking Function Generation with LLMs for Termination
summary: Ranking functions are a fundamental technique for proving loop termination, but constructing them manually is challenging and requires substantial expertise. We propose RAINFALL, a neuro-symbolic framework which follows the generate-verify-refine paradigm and tightly integrates LLMs with symbolic verification. RAINFALL formulates ranking function synthesis as a code-completion task by inserting placeholders into the input program and constraining the LLM to fill four predefined slots for each loop. The completed program is then checked by a symbolic verifier. If verification succeeds, a valid ranking function is obtained; otherwise, the verifier's diagnostics are translated into natural-language feedback that guides iterative refinement of the LLM's output. We evaluate RAINFALL on two public benchmark suites comprising 358 terminating C programs. Using MiniMax V2.7, RAINFALL synthesizes verifiable ranking functions for 323 programs (90.22%), outperforming all promising baselines. In particular, it solves 12 more programs than PROTON 2.1, the best-performing baseline and winner of the SV-COMP 2026 Termination category.
