AI.result: 系统梳理了RSI各阶段的失效模式与风险来源，归纳了相应保障措施与评估证据，并界定了直接证据与间接证据的边界，避免将相关系统的结论过度外推至RSI场景。
AI.conclusion: 论文最后考察评估设置，提出独立评估与纵向评估的要求，并讨论RSI的应用场景与开放研究问题，强调可信RSI需在改进真实性与持续性、约束保持和有效监督三方面同时成立。

title: Mechanistic Insights into LoRA: Layer Sparsity for Adaptive Fine-Tuning via Path Patching
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). 31 pages, including appendices and the paper checklist
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the dominant paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Standard all-layer LoRA applies adaptation throughout the transformer, despite heterogeneous contributions from its components. In this work, we conduct a systematic mechanistic interpretability analysis to understand how LoRA affects model internals. We observe that LoRA's adaptation effect is highly non-uniform, with significant component-wise and layer-wise sparsity. Most critically, we find that important layers are highly task-dependent, with limited overlap across tasks. Motivated by these insights, we propose Adaptive-LoRA, a calibration-driven method that automatically identifies task-specific layers via frozen-base zero-ablation, enabling efficient layer selection without exhaustive search. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-1.5B across 11 diverse reasoning tasks demonstrate that Adaptive-LoRA outperforms full-layer LoRA while using only 30% of layers, achieving a $3.5\times$ reduction in adapter parameters. This work bridges mechanistic interpretability and practical efficiency, providing both fundamental insights and a principled approach for adaptive fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Adaptive-LoRA：先用机制可解释性分析发现 LoRA 的任务适应效果在组件和层上高度非均匀、重要层高度任务相关，再基于冻结基座零消融的校准自动选出任务相关层，仅用 30% 的层即超越全层 LoRA，适配器参数减少 3.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 标准全层 LoRA 在 Transformer 全层施加适配，但各组件/各层对任务的贡献并不均等；作者希望从机制层面理解 LoRA 如何影响模型内部，并据此为每个任务挑选真正重要的层，以避免无差别适配带来的参数与计算浪费。
AI.method: 1）对 LoRA 适配进行系统性机制可解释性分析，刻画组件级与层级的稀疏性；2）发现关键层高度任务依赖、跨任务重叠有限；3）提出 Adaptive-LoRA：基于冻结基座的 zero-ablation 校准打分，自动识别任务特定层并实现高效层选择，无需穷举搜索。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上跨 11 个多样化推理任务，Adaptive-LoRA 仅用 30% 的层即优于全层 LoRA，并将适配器参数降低 3.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 工作连接了机制可解释性与参数高效微调的工程效率，既给出关于 LoRA 作用机制的基础认识，也提供了可复用的自适应微调原则性方案。

title: Same Story, Different Lens: A Multi-Agent System for Cross-Outlet News Framing Analysis
comment: The projects source code is available in the GitHub repository. Link: https://github.com/affanyasin1/multi-perspective-analyzer
summary: News outlets covering the same event differ in what they emphasize and omit. \textit{Same Story, Different Lens} is an experimental research prototype for comparing these choices. It collects world and politics coverage from 17 outlets, groups reports about the same event, and produces structured analyses of sentiment, political lean, framing, loaded language, possible omissions, and model-estimated proportions of factual claims and opinion. Loaded-language entries include quotations and neutral rewordings. Three model roles (agents) handle article analysis, assessment of source support, and cross-outlet briefing generation. Analyses are stored in a JSONL archive. The evaluation compares outlet-level lean estimates with approximate, predefined reference ratings and summarizes the Critic's model-assigned grounding scores. These measures provide preliminary diagnostics. A grounding score reflects the model's assessment of support in the supplied text and does not establish factual accuracy or constitute independent verification.

AI.tldr: 提出实验性原型Same Story, Different Lens，通过三角色模型代理对17家媒体的同一事件报道进行结构化对比分析，并用近似预设参考评级做初步诊断性评估。
AI.motivation: 不同新闻机构在报道同一事件时，在强调与省略的内容上存在差异，但目前缺少系统化的对比工具来揭示这些编辑选择。
AI.method: 采集17家媒体的国际与政治报道并按同一事件聚类；用三个模型代理分别负责文章分析、来源支持度评估和跨媒体简报生成；产出情感、政治倾向、框架、带倾向性语言（含引语与中性改写）、潜在遗漏、事实性主张与观点比例的结构化分析；结果存入JSONL档案。
AI.result: 评估将媒体层面的倾向估计与近似预设参考评级进行对比，并汇总Critic代理给出的模型接地分数。作者明确指出这些仅属初步诊断性指标。
AI.conclusion: 该原型可实现跨媒体的结构化报道对比，但接地分数仅反映模型对文本内部支持度的判断，不能确立事实准确性，也不构成独立核验。

title: TimeWorld: Towards Action-Conditioned Multimodal World Models for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting supports decision-making in web applications such as online retail and network management, where planned actions can reshape future dynamics. World models provide a natural paradigm for predicting such action-dependent changes beyond extrapolating historical patterns. However, existing time series world models (TSWMs) typically rely on fixed, domain-specific covariate schemas that limit flexible intervention specification, while multimodal forecasters treat text primarily as passive predictive context. To investigate these gaps, we introduce TSWM-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for multimodal TSWMs spanning seven real-world datasets, with textual interventions grounded in recorded action--outcome data. Our evaluation reveals that conventional multimodal forecasters underperform history-only time series foundation models (TSFMs) despite dataset-specific training, whereas simple text-prefix adaptations improve forecasting across all evaluated TSFM backbones. These findings suggest that pretrained TSFMs encode implicit world knowledge of temporal dynamics, offering a strong foundation for action-conditioned modeling beyond conventional multimodal fusion. Building on this insight, we propose TimeWorld, a plug-in framework that adapts pretrained TSFMs through explicit action-response modeling. Specifically, the Prototype-Guided Latent Modulation (PLM) module grounds textual actions in temporal dynamics by composing representative response prototypes to modulate future representations based on the action and historical patterns. The Action Contrastive Learning (ACL) component strengthens action-specific response modeling by contrasting these updates under alternative interventions sharing the same history, distinguishing action types while preserving relative intensity relationships.

AI.tldr: 提出跨域多模态时间序列世界模型基准TSWM-Bench，发现预训练TSFM隐含世界知识，进而提出即插即用框架TimeWorld，通过原型引导潜在调制与时序动作对比学习实现动作条件预测。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列世界模型依赖固定的领域特定协变量模式，难以灵活指定干预；多模态预测器仅将文本视为被动预测上下文。因此需要考察动作条件下的预测能力，并解决现有模型在该设定下的不足。
AI.method: 构建TSWM-Bench跨域基准：涵盖7个真实数据集，文本干预基于真实动作—结果记录。基于"预训练TSFM编码隐式时序世界知识"的发现，提出TimeWorld即插即用框架，包含Prototype-Guided Latent Modulation（PLM）——通过组合代表性响应原型，依据动作与历史模式调制未来表示；以及Action Contrastive Learning（ACL）——在同一历史下对比不同干预带来的表示更新，区分动作类型并保持相对强度关系。
AI.result: 常规多模态预测器尽管经过数据集特定训练，仍不及仅用历史的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）；简单的文本前缀适配则能在所有评估的TSFM骨干上提升预测表现。
AI.conclusion: 预训练TSFM具备时间动态的隐式世界知识，是动作条件建模的强基础，优于常规多模态融合；TimeWorld以显式动作—响应建模适配TSFM，为动作条件时间序列预测提供有效范式。

title: MuSID-KD: Multigranularity Knowledge Distillation for Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs
summary: Generative recommendation with semantic IDs (SIDs) represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens and autoregressively predicts the next item's SID. Despite strong recommendation performance, repeated decoding over multiple SID positions incurs substantial inference cost. Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a powerful generative teacher to a lightweight student, yet conventional objectives do not fully account for multi-token SID generation. We identify two limitations: item-level distribution alignment may not adequately preserve the teacher's ranking of candidate groups sharing SID prefixes, while uniform alignment across SID positions may affect final item ranking differently. We propose MuSID-KD, which combines Hierarchical Candidate Distribution Alignment (HCDA) and Ranking Impact Guided Levelwise Distillation (RIGD). HCDA aggregates item probabilities according to shared SID prefixes and aligns candidate distributions at successive levels, from candidate groups to individual items. RIGD evaluates the reduction in pairwise ranking surrogate loss when one student score contribution is replaced with the teacher's contribution, and allocates supervision accordingly. Experiments on real-world recommendation datasets using three lightweight student architectures demonstrate improved recommendation accuracy and better alignment of prefix marginal distributions and pairwise item rankings, without modifying the student's online inference architecture. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/m7k2-review-83f9/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MuSID-KD，一种面向生成式推荐（基于语义ID, SID）的知识蒸馏方法，通过分层候选分布对齐（HCDA）与排序影响引导的逐层蒸馏（RIGD）改进多token SID 生成的蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐用 SID（离散token序列）表示物品并自回归预测，精度好但多位置重复解码导致推理开销大。知识蒸馏可将强教师迁移到轻量学生，但传统蒸馏目标未充分考虑多token SID 生成：一是物品级分布对齐难以保留教师对共享SID前缀候选组的排序；二是各SID位置统一对齐对最终物品排序影响不同。
AI.method: MuSID-KD 含两部分：(1) HCDA 按共享 SID 前缀聚合物品概率，从候选组到单个物品在逐层级别对齐候选分布；(2) RIGD 用将一个学生分数贡献替换为教师贡献时成对排序替代损失的下降量来度量各位置/层级的重要性，并据此分配监督权重。学生在线推理结构不变。
AI.result: 在真实推荐数据集上，用三种轻量学生架构实验显示推荐精度提升，且前缀边缘分布对齐与成对物品排序对齐更好，同时不改变学生在线推理架构。
AI.conclusion: 针对多token SID 生成的蒸馏需分层级对齐候选分布并按排序影响分配监督；MuSID-KD 在保持学生推理架构的前提下提升了推荐准确性与排序一致性。

title: When Does Data Value Reduce to Class Balance? A Coverage View of Per-Point Data Valuation
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. 34 pages. Code: https://github.com/Benjy-byj/Data-Value-Class-Balance . Video: https://benjy-byj.github.io/Data-Value-Class-Balance/
summary:
Per-point data-valuation scores -- Data Shapley, influence, leverage -- are routinely used to select training data: keep the points with the top $k$ scores. We argue that top-$k$ by a fixed, mode-blind per-point score is the wrong selection rule precisely in the regime where data selection matters. The reason is that a point's value is not a fixed number but depends on what else has been selected -- a near-duplicate of an already-chosen point adds almost nothing, however high its score -- and a per-point scalar cannot express this interaction.
  The theory quantifies this failure exactly: in an equal latent-mode model, fixed top-$k$ selection incurs a closed-form excess risk over adaptive coverage because it repeatedly spends budget on already-covered modes. The gap is largest when the budget is tight, the learner representation is redundant, and missing a mode is costly.
  The practical rule is simple: use balance when the labels available at selection identify the learner's modes, and use explicit coverage when they do not. On standard classification tasks with strong pretrained features, class-balancing the same per-point scores recovers the missing coverage and matches or outperforms generic set coverage across our datasets. Without labels, label-free coverage improves accuracy by up to +0.20 while raw top-$k$ can fall below random; when labels are coarser than the modes, coverage within coarse strata performs best. We turn this distinction into a pre-specified diagnostic and validate it across both favorable and stress-test settings.
  The limits are part of the claim: the advantage is representation-relative. Coverage fails when the relevant modes are not expressed in the learner geometry, as with spurious subgroups, or when data quality varies independently of coverage -- exactly as the theory predicts.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，用固定、不考虑模态的逐点数据估值分数做 top-k 选择，在数据选择真正重要的场景下并不合适，因为点价值依赖已被选中的其他点；应改用标签平衡或显式覆盖，且该优势是相对于学习器表示几何而言的。
AI.motivation: 现有实践中普遍用 Data Shapley、influence、leverage 等逐点分数按 top-k 选取训练数据，但这类标量无法表达点与点之间的冗余交互（如与已选点近似重复的高分点几乎无增益），在预算紧张、表示冗余、漏模态代价高时失效最严重，因此需要重新审视选择规则。
AI.method: 理论层面在等潜模态模型下推导固定 top-k 选择相对自适应覆盖的闭式超额风险；实践层面提出简单规则：若选择时可用标签能识别学习器模态则用类别平衡，否则用显式覆盖（无标签时用 label-free 覆盖，标签粗于模态时在粗分层内做覆盖），并将其形式化为预先设定的诊断方法。
AI.result: 在强预训练特征的标准分类任务上，对同一逐点分数做类别平衡即可恢复缺失覆盖率，并达到或超过通用集合覆盖；无标签覆盖最多提升 +0.20 准确率，而原始 top-k 可能低于随机；标签粗于模态时，粗分层内覆盖表现最佳；诊断在有利与压力测试设置下均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 逐点分数应作为须与覆盖/平衡规则结合的信号，而非直接 top-k 的排序依据；该优势是表示相对的——当相关模态未体现在学习器几何中（如伪子群）或数据质量与覆盖独立变化时，覆盖会失效，与理论预测一致。

title: Trainable Boundary-Keeping Where No Formal Answer Exists: A Controlled Knock-In Study of Reward Training in Evidence-Sufficiency Judgment
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Aggregate data/figure code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23661668 (code MIT; data/text/figures CC BY 4.0). Writing/implementation assisted by AI agents; the author designed the study and is responsible for the final text
summary: Reasoning-tuned and reward-trained models are often assumed to verify more reliably because they reason longer or receive correctness signals. We test this in evidence-sufficiency judgment: deciding whether available information actually supports a causal claim, a domain with no decidable correctness reward. Using a pre-registered, same-base, controlled knock-in design, we compare a boundary-keeping recipe (SFT then GRPO) with its own baseline, a scrambled-pairing placebo, and a general-purpose reasoning model under an action-pressure protocol with no evaluation invitation. All load-bearing outcomes are rated by two separate model-rating sessions masked to arm labels; automatic judges only trigger. The trained arm raises spontaneous correct refusal from 25% to 100% (40 per arm; Wilson 95% CI lower bound 91.2%, non-overlapping with the baseline interval [14.2%, 40.2%]), while the scrambled placebo collapses (5% spontaneous / 7.5% invited correct; 91.1% false refusal). The effect is boundary-specific rather than blanket refusal: automatic false refusal on 281 well-formed claims is 1.1% (Wilson upper bound 3.09%), and a targeted 18-item arm-(c) recheck (3 flagged plus 15 accepted) yields 0/18 and 1/18 false refusals in two sessions. The dissociation is the main result: final boundary-keeping is trainable without an inference-time verifier, while observed active numeric/calculation checking in the H3 assay remains near zero; SFT saturation makes the GRPO increment not separately identifiable. A pre-registered mechanism adjudication favors reward internalization of final-action status (H2, best-supported, not proven). The scope is a controlled 14B same-family study: we do not claim proof, cross-family generality, or independent human-expert validation; the rating sessions are model sessions, not human reviewers.

AI.tldr: 在证据充分性判断任务中，经过SFT+GRPO的边界保持配方把自发正确拒答率从25%提升到100%，而打乱配对安慰剂崩溃；表明最终边界保持可在无推理时验证器条件下被训练获得，但与数值/计算检查行为解离。
AI.motivation: 推理微调与奖励训练模型常被认为因推理更长或获得正确性信号而验证更可靠，但这一假设缺乏检验；作者选择"证据充分性判断"这一无可判定正确性奖励的领域来检验该假设。
AI.method: 预注册、同基座、受控knock-in设计：比较边界保持配方（SFT后GRPO）与其基线、打乱配对安慰剂、通用推理模型；采用无评估邀请的动作压力协议。所有承重结果由两个独立、对分组标签遮蔽的模型评分会话评定，自动判分器仅作触发。并在281条良构主张上测自动误拒，及18项臂(c)复核。
AI.result: 训练臂自发正确拒答由25%升至100%（每臂40条；Wilson 95% CI下界91.2%，与基线区间[14.2%, 40.2%]不重叠）；打乱安慰剂崩溃（自发5%/受邀正确7.5%；91.1%误拒）。效应具边界特异性：281条良构主张自动误拒1.1%（Wilson上界3.09%）；18项复核两个会话为0/18与1/18误拒。解离为核心结果：H3测中观察到的主动数值/计算检查接近零；SFT饱和使GRPO增量不可单独识别。
AI.conclusion: 最终边界保持可在无推理时验证器情况下训练获得，机制裁定倾向于奖励内化最终动作状态（H2，最佳支持但未证实）。范围为受控14B同族研究，不主张证明、跨族泛化或独立人类专家验证；评分为模型会话而非人类评审。

title: Precedence-Aware Resource Allocation: Extending the AUTOC Framework to Multi-Level Treatments
summary: Many real-world decision problems require allocating limited resources across individuals to maximize total benefit often through interventions that vary in intensity rather than binary treat-or-not decisions. In these settings, higher levels treatments require first applying lower levels of treatment, inducing a precedence constraint that complicates allocation under a fixed budget. While the causal inference literature has largely emphasized accurate estimation of conditional average treatment effects (CATE), recent work has shown that estimation accuracy alone does not guarantee effective resource allocation, motivating ranking-based evaluation frameworks. The Area Under the Targeting Operating Characteristic (AUTOC) provides an effective way to evaluate prioritization rules across budget levels, but existing formulations are limited to binary treatments. We introduce Multi-Level AUTOC (ML-AUTOC), which is a generalization for AUTOC designed for multi-level treatment settings with precedence. We also propose precedence-aware policies for mapping true marginal treatment effects to feasible treatment assignments under fixed budget constraints. Our results show that in the setting of multi-level treatments, maximizing realized treatment effects may require re-allocation of treatments across individuals.

AI.tldr: 该论文将面向二元处理的AUTOC推广为多层AUTOC（ML-AUTOC），用于评估带优先级约束（必须先施加低强度处理）的多层级处理分配策略，并提出优先级感知策略在固定预算下将真实边际处理效应映射为可行分配。
AI.motivation: 现实决策常需在个体间分配有限资源，且处理强度是多层级而非二元；高层级处理须先施加低层级处理，形成优先级（precedence）约束，使固定预算下分配复杂化。CATE估计精度不足以保证有效分配，需排序式评估；但现有AUTOC仅适用于二元处理。
AI.method: 提出ML-AUTOC，作为AUTOC在带优先级多层处理设定下的推广，用于跨预算水平评估优先级排序规则；同时设计优先级感知策略，将真实边际处理效应映射为固定预算下可行的处理分配。
AI.result: 结果表明，在多层处理设定下，最大化实现处理效应可能需要在个体间重新分配处理（re-allocation），而非简单沿用基于排序的贪心分配。
AI.conclusion: CATE估计准确性不等于分配有效性；评估应基于排序/预算曲线指标。ML-AUTOC为多层带优先级场景提供统一评估框架，并揭示需重新分配处理以提升整体效应。

title: Before Blaming the LLM, Diagnose the Workflow: A Role-Level Difficulty Profile for Translating Natural Language into Ontology-Grounded Statements
summary:
Natural-language-to-domain-specific-language (NL-to-DSL) semantic parsing systems increasingly translate informal user descriptions into structured artifacts such as Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, Application Programming Interface (API) calls, workflows, formal specifications, and ontology-grounded domain-specific language (DSL) statements. This paper focuses on ontology-grounded Assertion Box (ABox) DSL generation: the translation of natural language domain descriptions into assertion-level DSL statements grounded in a pre-existing ontology vocabulary. In this setting, syntactic validity is often easier to achieve than semantic adequacy. Failures are frequently attributed to weak generator models, but recurring sources of difficulty are also structural: insufficient input, weak domain grounding, output template and vocabulary gaps, weak validation, and non-local repair.
  We propose a role-level difficulty profile for diagnosing difficulty in ontology-grounded NL-to-DSL semantic parsing at the workflow level. The profile organizes diagnostic variables across five recurring workflow roles: Input, Generator, Output, Validator, and Repairer. The seven variables are input sufficiency, context availability, grounding complexity, template fit, vocabulary coverage, validation strength, and error observability. Practitioners construct the difficulty profile through qualitative judgment over available evidence. This experience-informed, non-exhaustive difficulty profile is intended to support workflow diagnosis and guide redesign or human-in-the-loop intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个按工作流角色组织的"难度画像"，用于诊断本体锚定的自然语言到领域特定语言（NL-to-DSL）语义解析中的困难来源。
AI.motivation: NL-to-DSL 系统在本体锚定的 ABox DSL 生成中，语法有效性较易达成而语义充分性难以保证；失败常被归咎于生成模型能力弱，但实际上存在输入不足、领域锚定弱、输出模板与词表缺口、验证薄弱、非局部修复等结构性困难来源，缺少系统化的诊断框架。
AI.method: 提出角色级难度画像，将七个诊断变量（输入充分性、上下文可得性、锚定复杂度、模板契合度、词表覆盖度、验证强度、错误可观测性）分配到五个工作流角色（输入、生成器、输出、验证器、修复器）上；实践者基于可获证据进行定性判断以构建画像。
AI.result: 给出一个经验驱动、非穷尽的诊断画像框架，能够定位工作流中各环节的难度集中点，而非仅归因于生成器。
AI.conclusion: 该难度画像用于支持工作流级诊断，并指导系统重设计或引入人在回路干预；但其依赖定性判断且覆盖不穷尽，属于诊断辅助工具而非自动化度量。

title: Can System-1-Style Decision Models Replace Dedicated Rerankers in RAG? A Systems Evaluation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems often use a dedicated reranker to choose which retrieved candidates reach the language model. Reranking improves relevance but adds latency, so teams look for faster alternatives. System-1style decision models make direct, structured predictions instead of generating long responses. Could one provide comparable reranking quality with less inference overhead? We first screen 21 open-weight models on 11 benchmarks, then compare a promising decision model with a dedicated reranker on identical candidate lists. The default decision-model setup fails on many long candidate sets, so scoring only the requests it completes gives a misleading ranking. Limiting candidate text length largely restores reliability and makes some configurations competitive. A frozen evaluation on new retrieval data supports the reliability and ranking results, but confirms the latency requirement for only one of the two selected configurations. Across workloads, which model ranks better changes, and a tuned reranker remains faster and uses far less GPU memory. A decision model can perform competitive reranking, but replacing a reranker requires weighing quality, latency and memory together, and teams should tune the reranker they already run first.

AI.tldr: 论文考察用"系统1式"决策模型替代专用重排器（reranker）的可行性，发现截断候选文本长度可显著恢复可靠性，部分配置的重排质量具有竞争力，但延迟与显存优势仅在少数配置成立，整体仍不及调优后的重排器。
AI.motivation: RAG 系统中专用重排器提升相关性但带来额外延迟，团队希望找到更快的替代方案；决策模型直接输出结构化预测而非生成长文本，理论上可降低推理开销，因此需验证其能否以更低开销达到可比的重排质量。
AI.method: 先在11个基准上初筛21个开放权重模型，再在相同候选列表上对比一个有前景的决策模型与专用重排器；分析默认配置在长候选集上的失效问题，并通过限制候选文本长度进行修正，最后在新检索数据上做冻结评估，综合比较质量、延迟与显存占用。
AI.result: 默认决策模型配置在长候选集上大量失败，仅统计其"完成"的请求会得到虚假的排名结论；限制候选文本长度后可靠性大幅恢复，部分配置具竞争力。冻结评估支持可靠性与排名结论，但仅两个选定配置之一满足延迟要求；不同工作负载下更优模型会变化，调优后的重排器仍更快且显存占用远低。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可以完成有竞争力的重排，但替代专用重排器需同时权衡质量、延迟与显存，实践建议优先调优现有重排器而非直接替换。

title: Self-Supervised Pretraining for PHM: What Transfers, What Does Not, and What Federating It Costs
summary: Self-supervised pretraining has produced capable time-series foundation models, but its value for Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) has not been measured under leakage-controlled conditions. We measure it on a corpus of 47 public PHM datasets, harmonized to a single tensor contract and partitioned so that 11 datasets are withheld from pretraining in full. Transfer turns out to be task-dependent: a compact channel-independent Transformer encoder (801,808 parameters) pretrained with masked patch prediction raises fault-classification macro-F1 from 0.350 to 0.812 on CWRU and from 0.569 to 0.951 on HSG18, yet on CMAPSS remaining-useful-life estimation no pretrained checkpoint reliably improves upon a from-scratch baseline. We pretrain under two regimes---centralized, and simulated cross-silo federated with ten clients grouped by physical domain---holding architecture, objective, source data and optimization budget fixed. Two further findings are negative. At matched budget the centralized encoder leads by 15.5--20.2 macro-F1 points in four of four comparisons, although the comparison is confounded by a learning-rate schedule that favours the centralized arm and rests on a single pretraining run per regime; on RUL the two regimes are indistinguishable. And the intrinsic SSL loss is not a valid selection criterion: the centralized encoder more than halves the federated reconstruction loss without a corresponding gap on RUL, and a server-momentum sweep moves downstream validation macro-F1 by up to 0.29 while the SSL loss varies by 0.021. Transfer also hinges on the backbone learning rate: the same checkpoint yields 0.169 or 0.829 macro-F1 on CWRU depending on a single order of magnitude. We release the corpus pipeline, the protocol and the code.

AI.tldr: 在严格防泄漏条件下，用47个公共PHM数据集评测自监督时序基础模型的迁移价值：故障分类迁移显著（CWRU宏F1 0.350→0.812，HSG18 0.569→0.951），RUL估计无可靠提升；集中式预训练优于联邦式（4/4比较高15.5–20.2点），但SSL损失不能作为模型选择准则。
AI.motivation: 自监督预训练已催生能力较强的时间序列基础模型，但其在故障预测与健康管理（PHM）中的价值尚未在数据泄漏受控的条件下被量化验证；同时需要厘清集中式与联邦式预训练的差异，以及内在SSL损失是否能作为可靠的模型选择指标。
AI.method: 构建47个公共PHM数据集语料，统一为单一张量契约（tensor contract），并划分出11个完全不参与预训练的数据集；采用紧凑的通道独立Transformer编码器（801,808参数），以掩码patch预测为预训练目标；在集中式与模拟跨孤岛联邦（10客户端、按物理域分组）两种体制下，固定架构、目标、源数据与优化预算进行对比；下游任务为故障分类与RUL估计。
AI.result: 迁移效果任务依赖：故障分类宏F1在CWRU上由0.350升至0.812，HSG18上由0.569升至0.951；CMAPSS的RUL任务上无任何预训练检查点能可靠优于从零训练基线。等预算下集中式编码器在4/4比较中领先15.5–20.2个宏F1点（但受有利于集中式的学习率调度混淆，且每体制仅单次预训练运行）；RUL上两体制无差异。内在SSL损失非有效选择准则：集中式重构损失减半但RUL无对应差距；服务器动量扫描使下游验证宏F1变动达0.29，而SSL损失仅变化0.021。结果还依赖骨干学习率：同一检查点在CWRU上可因一个数量级差异得到0.169或0.829宏F1。
AI.conclusion: 自监督时序预训练对PHM的收益具有任务依赖性，在故障分类上显著、在RUL上不成立；联邦式预训练在分类上落后于集中式，而SSL损失与下游性能脱耦，不宜作为模型选择依据；骨干学习率等训练细节对结果影响巨大。作者公开语料流水线、协议与代码。该研究主要提供负面/警示性证据，并强调泄漏受控评测与超参敏感性的重要性。

title: Transporting Quantiles to Codebook: Scalable Vector Quantization without Codebook Collapse
summary: Effective discrete representation learning with VQ-VAE serves as a fundamental component of modern autoregressive generative models. However, it is widely known to suffer from codebook collapse and inefficient code utilization. To address this issue, we propose FlowVQ, a simple yet effective alternative to standard vector quantization by formulating neural quantization as a joint modeling and clustering process. Specifically, we learn the latent space using a lightweight flow matching model alongside training, corresponding to a probability flow ODE that transports an often fixed well-behaved source distribution while preserving probability mass. Based on this, we define the codebook C_1 by transporting even-quantile partitioned prior codes C_0 from the source space through the learned flow, and obtaining the Voronoi centroids under the induced distribution, leading to a structured discretization. We evaluated on image tokenization and generation, as well as on two tasks requiring high-precision tokenization, demonstrating scalability and improved expressivity of the codebook with full utilization.

AI.tldr: FlowVQ 将神经量化重构为联合建模与聚类过程：用轻量级 flow matching 学习潜空间（保持概率质量的概率流 ODE），并把等分位数划分的源先验码 C_0 经学到的流传输，在诱导分布下取 Voronoi 质心得到码本 C_1，从而缓解码本坍缩、实现结构化离散化与码本充分利用。
AI.motivation: VQ-VAE 是现代自回归生成模型的基础组件，但存在码本坍缩与码利用率低的问题；作者希望给出一个简单有效的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出 FlowVQ：把神经量化表述为联合建模与聚类。在训练中同步用轻量级 flow matching 模型学习潜空间，对应一条将固定的良态源分布传输、且保持概率质量的概率流 ODE；据此将源空间中等分位数划分的先验码 C_0 经学到的流传输，并在诱导分布下计算 Voronoi 质心，定义为码本 C_1，形成结构化离散化。
AI.result: 在图像 tokenization 与生成任务，以及两个需要高精度 tokenization 的任务上评估，表现出可扩展性、码本表达力提升且码本被充分利用。
AI.conclusion: FlowVQ 作为标准向量量化的简单有效替代，通过流匹配驱动的概率质量守恒传输与 Voronoi 质心构造，有效缓解码本坍缩并提升码本利用率与表达力，具备良好可扩展性。

title: Proof-of-Agentness: Towards Verifying Agents on the Web
summary: CAPTCHAs and bot detection have helped protect Web services from automated abuse for decades by distinguishing humans from bots. However, the emergence of LLM-powered agents introduces a new setting: Web services increasingly accommodate agents as legitimate users. Without a way to distinguish agents from other automated clients such as simple bots and scripts, these services risk large-scale automated junk submissions that waste service resources and consume users' attention or tokens. In this paper, we investigate a novel question for today's Web: "How can a Web service obtain evidence that a client is an agent?" We introduce the concept of "Proof-of-Agentness" (PoA), a mechanism for distinguishing agents from other automated clients, motivated by the parallel between human attention and an agent's inference resources. We outline two approaches: active verification through challenge-response and passive analysis of service-visible signals. Eight language models achieve an overall accuracy of 96.5% on our challenges, with an average overhead of 1,647 tokens. For passive analysis, we conduct an IRB-approved user study comparing the Web interactions of twelve human participants and representative Bot and Agent implementations, achieving an average classification accuracy of 95.8% across four classifiers, motivating further study.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Proof-of-Agentness"(PoA)概念与机制，用于区分LLM智能体与其他自动化客户端（简单机器人、脚本），并给出主动挑战-响应与被动信号分析两条技术路线。
AI.motivation: 传统CAPTCHA与机器人检测旨在区分人与机器人，但LLM智能体作为"合法用户"被Web服务接纳后，简单机器人与脚本可冒充智能体，导致大规模垃圾提交、浪费服务资源与用户注意力/Token。因此需要新的判别依据。
AI.method: 受"人类注意力"与"智能体推理资源"的类比启发，定义PoA。设计两类方案：(1)主动验证——基于挑战-响应（challenge-response）；(2)被动分析——对服务端可见的交互信号进行判定。并通过IRB批准的用户研究，比较12名人类参与者与代表性Bot、Agent实现的Web交互行为。
AI.result: 主动验证：8个语言模型在挑战集上总体准确率96.5%，平均开销1,647 tokens。被动分析：四类分类器在区分人类、Bot与Agent的交互上平均分类准确率达95.8%。
AI.conclusion: PoA可作为区分智能体与其他自动化客户端的可行机制，主动与被动两类途径均表现出较高判别能力，值得进一步研究。

title: Streaming Recurrent Memory
summary: Natural intelligence learns from a continuous stream of sensorimotor experience: data can arrive at high bandwidth, and behavior adapts to feedback as soon as it arrives, even when it is delayed. In contrast, most modern deep learning systems rely on stored datasets, replay buffers, and retained contexts through which credit is later assigned. At high data rates, storing and revisiting past experience can be impractical under tight memory and computational constraints. This paper studies recurrent memory under a streaming learning constraint: the learner learns from experience as soon as it arrives without storing raw experience. We ask whether a streaming learner can maintain a state that remains useful for future prediction and control from delayed feedback. We introduce Streaming Recurrent Memory (SRM), a recurrent memory designed for the streaming setting which preserves information that may matter later while remaining trainable with one-step backpropagation through time (BPTT). SRM provides a streaming-compatible recurrence that is designed to recall past information by content or time, track elapsed steps, and compose transformations whose outcome depends on the order in which inputs are observed. Across controlled memory tasks and streaming applications, SRM learns effectively with one-step BPTT, outperforming recurrent baselines in associative recall and online language modeling while achieving near-perfect success in associative T-Maze with delayed rewards. These results suggest that fixing how inputs are stored in the recurrent state, while learning how that state is read out, enables effective streaming learning without long-range backpropagation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出流式循环记忆（SRM），在"不存储原始经验、仅用一步BPTT"的流式学习约束下，让循环状态保留对未来预测与控制有用的信息，在关联回忆、在线语言建模和延迟奖励T-Maze任务上优于循环基线。
AI.motivation: 自然智能可从连续的感觉运动流中即时学习并利用延迟反馈调整行为；而主流深度学习依赖存储数据集、回放缓冲区和保留上下文来做信用分配，在高数据率与紧内存/算力约束下不可行。核心问题是：流式学习器能否在不存储原始经验的前提下，维护一个对延迟反馈下的未来预测与控制仍有用的状态。
AI.method: 提出SRM（Streaming Recurrent Memory）：一种为流式设定设计的循环记忆，其循环更新（如何把输入写入状态）是固定的，仅学习读出方式；该循环结构与流式兼容，可支持按内容或时间回忆过去信息、跟踪已流逝步数，并对依赖输入顺序的变换进行组合；训练仅需一步BPTT，无需长程反向传播。
AI.result: 在受控记忆任务与流式应用中，SRM用一步BPTT即可有效学习：在关联回忆与在线语言建模上优于循环基线，在带延迟奖励的关联T-Maze中达到接近完美的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将"输入如何写入循环状态"固定、只学习"如何从状态读出"，即可在无需长程反向传播的情况下实现有效的流式学习。

title: AgenticCity-Bench: Longitudinal Multimodal Observations of Urban Dynamics with Agentic Reasoning
summary: City systems are shaped by interactions among infrastructure, human activity, and environmental conditions. Existing earth observation and urban benchmarks are limited in unified modeling and in capturing their joint dynamics. We introduce AgenticCity-Bench, a longitudinal multimodal benchmark for multi-layer unified state modeling and agentic city task reasoning. The benchmark covers 16 cities in 12 countries across six continents from 2000 to 2025, and includes 18 modalities spanning urban function, activity, and environmental state. It organizes heterogeneous data sources around a common spatial reference and calendar index while preserving spatial and temporal coverage, provenance and tile-level availability. On this foundation, AgenticCity-Bench supports urban cross-modal translation together with diverse agentic city tasks involving forecasting, planning and resource analysis. This study provides a unified benchmark for studying the transition from multimodal urban and earth observation to joint understanding and agentic city decision-making. The dataset is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgenticCity-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgenticCity-Bench，一个覆盖16国12城、2000–2025、18种模态的纵向多模态基准，用于城市多层统一状态建模与智能体城市任务推理。
AI.motivation: 现有地球观测与城市基准在统一建模能力上受限，难以刻画基础设施、人类活动与环境条件之间的联合动态。
AI.method: 以共同空间参考与日历索引组织异构数据源，构建跨城市功能、活动、环境三类状态的18种模态，并保留时空覆盖、数据来源与瓦片级可用性信息；在此基础上设计城市跨模态转换及预测、规划、资源分析等智能体任务。
AI.result: 形成覆盖六大洲12国16城、2000–2025年的纵向多模态基准，支持统一状态表示和多样化智能体城市任务评测。
AI.conclusion: 为从多模态城市与地球观测向联合理解及智能体城市决策的研究转变提供统一基准。

title: When Respondents Are Scarce: LLM-Derived Semantic Priors for Bayesian Confirmatory Factor Analysis
summary: Across social and behavioral research, measuring latent constructs can be challenging when target populations are small or difficult to reach. Recruiting additional respondents may be costly or infeasible, leaving researchers with limited data for estimating questionnaire factor structures. Yet item wording contains structural expectations before data collection, and whether these can improve small-sample estimation without replacing empirical validation remains unclear. We introduce the Semantic-Empirical Updating Framework (SEUF), which converts large language model paraphrases and embeddings, aligned with hypothesized item-factor assignments, into prespecified priors for Bayesian confirmatory factor analysis. We evaluated SEUF using a 38-item survey of 617 industrial-park stakeholders and two public surveys, FEVS and RIASEC. Semantic structure persisted after wording controls across all three instruments. With 50 respondents, SEUF achieved loading precision comparable to conventional CFA with 70-82 respondents, equivalent to 29-39% fewer respondents at the specified precision benchmark. Results showed lower loading errors and improved credible-interval coverage relative to conventional CFA in both public surveys. Gains were greatest when respondent data were limited, highlighting the value of semantic priors under information scarcity. By harnessing structural information already embedded in questionnaires, SEUF advances a more resource-efficient approach to measurement and opens new directions for study design and empirical inference in hard-to-reach populations.

AI.tldr: SEUF框架将大语言模型对题项改写的语义结构与嵌入，转化为预设先验，用于贝叶斯验证性因子分析，以缓解小样本下因子结构估计困难的问题。
AI.motivation: 社会与行为研究中，当目标人群规模小或难以接触时，追加样本成本高或不可行，导致问卷因子结构估计数据有限。题项措辞本身在数据收集前就已蕴含结构信息，但这些信息能否在不替代实证验证的前提下改善小样本估计尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出语义—实证更新框架（SEUF）：利用大语言模型生成改写与嵌入，与假设的题项—因子归属对齐，构建预设先验并嵌入贝叶斯验证性因子分析（BCFA）。在617名产业园利益相关者的38题问卷、以及FEVS与RIASEC两项公开调查上进行评估。
AI.result: 三份工具中语义结构在控制措辞后依然稳健。50名受访者时，SEUF的载荷估计精度相当于传统CFA的70–82名受访者，即在特定精度基准下相当于减少29–39%的样本。两项公开调查中SEUF载荷误差更低、可信区间覆盖率更优；数据越有限，增益越显著。
AI.conclusion: SEUF将问卷中已嵌入的结构信息加以利用，提供更节省资源的测量路径，并为难以接触人群的研究设计与实证推断开辟新方向；但它补充而非取代实证验证。

title: Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Management of Climate Change-Related Health Issues in Africa
summary: While climate change disproportionately impacts African public health, AI predictive modeling remains heavily constrained. Using a Synthetic Knowledge Synthesis approach and VOSviewer, we conducted a bibliometric analysis of Scopus-indexed literature, comparing Global and African corpora. Network analysis reveals stark divergences: global research emphasizes complex, predictive models for planetary health, whereas African research focuses on localized, reactive solutions for immediate infectious disease triage. Severe structural barriers in Africa, including compute deficits, data silos, and energy instability, hinder advanced AI scaling. Ultimately, international funding must shift from siloed pilot projects toward building foundational digital infrastructure and localized AI frameworks.

AI.tldr: 该文对Scopus文献做文献计量分析，比较全球与非洲在气候变化与公共卫生AI预测建模研究上的差异。
AI.motivation: 气候变化对非洲公共卫生影响尤为严重，而AI预测建模在该地区的发展严重受限，亟需厘清全球与非洲研究格局的差异及结构性障碍。
AI.method: 采用合成知识综合（Synthetic Knowledge Synthesis）方法，结合VOSviewer对Scopus索引文献进行文献计量与网络分析，对比全球与非洲两个语料库。
AI.result: 网络分析显示明显分化：全球研究侧重行星健康的复杂预测模型，非洲研究则集中于面向即时传染病分诊的本地化、反应式方案；算力不足、数据孤岛与能源不稳定等结构性障碍制约非洲先进AI的规模化。
AI.conclusion: 国际资助应从孤立的试点项目转向建设基础数字基础设施与本地化AI框架。

title: AgriDefend: A $205 Offline Edge Device that Detects Crop Stress Before Visible Symptoms via Multimodal AI Fusion
summary: Most in-field crop-monitoring devices sense a single modality -- either a camera looking at the canopy or a probe reading the soil -- and so cannot detect stress that begins below ground before it becomes visible above it. We present AgriDefend, a self-contained consumer-grade edge device that fuses both. A MobileNetV2 convolutional neural network (CNN) analyses canopy imagery, and a Random Forest classifier integrates trend features from a single soil probe: moisture, the rate of change in pH and in N, P, K, and belowground CO2 relative to ambient (a proxy for soil respiration). A logistic-regression meta-learner fuses the two into a five-class crop-health prediction, all on a Raspberry Pi 5 with no cloud or cellular link. On a controlled greenhouse drought trial with wild radish, the fused model reached 87% accuracy (R^2=0.88, MAE=0.05) at 1.4 s INT8 TensorFlow Lite inference, and its soil signals preceded visible wilting by about four days. The complete bill of materials is $205, roughly a fifth of comparable commercial nodes, positioning multimodal, sustainable crop sensing as a practical consumer-electronics product for connectivity-limited settings.

AI.tldr: 提出AgriDefend——一款面向消费者的无云边缘设备，在Raspberry Pi 5上融合冠层图像（MobileNetV2）与单点土壤探针趋势特征（随机森林），经逻辑回归元学习器输出五类作物健康预测；温室干旱试验准确率87%，土壤信号较可见萎蔫提前约4天，物料成本205美元。
AI.motivation: 现有田间作物监测设备多为单一模态（仅相机观测冠层或仅探针读取土壤），无法在地下部胁迫显现于地上部之前将其检出，存在检测滞后。
AI.method: 自包含消费级边缘装置：MobileNetV2 CNN分析冠层图像；随机森林整合单点土壤探针的趋势特征（湿度、pH变化率、N/P/K变化率、相对环境的本底CO2作为土壤呼吸代理）；逻辑回归元学习器将双模态融合为五类作物健康预测；全部在Raspberry Pi 5本地运行，无云端或蜂窝连接，INT8 TensorFlow Lite推理。
AI.result: 在野生萝卜受控温室干旱试验中，融合模型准确率87%（R²=0.88，MAE=0.05），INT8推理耗时1.4 s；土壤信号较可见萎蔫提前约4天；整机物料成本205美元，约为同类商用节点成本的五分之一。
AI.conclusion: 多模态、可持续的作物感知可作为面向网络受限场景的实用消费电子产品，兼顾早期预警能力与低成本部署。

title: LLM-Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph Learning with Business Semantics for Financial Fraud Detection
summary: Financial fraud detection increasingly relies on heterogeneous transaction graphs, in which entities such as cards and merchants play distinct business roles and the risk meaning of an attribute depends on the entity's role: a high transaction volume may be routine for a merchant but unusual for a card. Heterogeneous graph neural networks preserve typed entities and relations but typically treat these attributes as role-agnostic inputs and leave their business meaning implicit. Meanwhile, most existing methods integrating large language models (LLMs) with graphs focus on homogeneous graphs or heterogeneous graphs with naturally available textual attributes, leaving their use on transaction graphs with structured attributes underexplored. To address this issue, we propose SemHGT, an LLM-enhanced framework that interprets structured attributes according to entity roles and makes the business semantics explicit in three stages: (1) role-aware prompts elicit risk-related business descriptions from node attributes, and a text encoder maps them to semantic vectors that enrich node representations; (2) semantic similarity guides multi-round sampling of target-specific path instances under transaction-to-transaction schemas; (3) schema-level tokens that combine local path evidence with global neighbor summaries are processed together with the target transaction by a unified transformer. Across three benchmark datasets, SemHGT leads the evaluated baselines on most dataset--metric comparisons. Further analyses provide additional evidence for the effectiveness of SemHGT's design and clarify how its semantic modeling and evidence selection contribute to fraud detection. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SemHGT-528A/.

AI.tldr: SemHGT：基于LLM按实体角色解读结构化属性的异构交易图欺诈检测框架，三阶段实现业务语义显式化，在三个基准数据集多数对比中领先。
AI.motivation: 金融欺诈检测依赖异构交易图（卡、商户等实体角色不同，同一属性的风险含义随角色变化，如高交易额对商户正常、对卡异常）。现有异构图神经网络将属性作角色无关输入，业务语义隐含；而LLM+图方法多聚焦同构图的或天然带文本属性的异构图，对含结构化属性的交易图探索不足。
AI.method: （1）角色感知提示词从节点属性中引出风险相关业务描述，文本编码器映射为语义向量以增强节点表示；（2）以语义相似度引导，在交易—交易模式（transaction-to-transaction schema）下多轮采样目标特定路径实例；（3）将结合局部路径证据与全局邻居摘要的模式级token与目标交易一起输入统一Transformer。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，SemHGT在大多数"数据集—指标"对比中优于所评估基线；进一步分析为其设计有效性提供证据，并阐明语义建模与证据选择对欺诈检测的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 按实体角色显式建模结构化属性的业务语义，并借助语义引导的证据选择，可有效提升异构交易图上的欺诈检测性能。

title: Priority-Preserving Advantage Aggregation for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
summary: LLM post-training often optimizes multiple objectives with unequal priorities, such as correctness and reasoning efficiency. However, the widely used additive reward aggregation in RL can violate these priorities: when primary and auxiliary advantages conflict, a sufficiently large auxiliary signal can overturn the preference induced by the primary objective. We term this problem \emph{advantage priority inversion}. Although reward-level gating can protect priority more directly, it still removes potentially useful auxiliary distinctions among rollout samples that fail the primary condition. To address this trade-off, we propose Primary Advantage Policy Optimization (\textbf{PAPO}), a priority-aware advantage aggregation method that asymmetrically combines a primary and an auxiliary advantage. PAPO retains auxiliary supervision when the objectives agree and smoothly attenuates conflicting auxiliary signals, preserving the primary sign during fusion for \emph{primary-consistent ordering}. This rule applies to sequence-level advantages in GRPO and token-level advantages in actor--critic PPO. Experiments on multiple domains and models show that PAPO consistently achieves the best primary objective while maintaining best or competitive auxiliary-objective performance across both GRPO- and PPO-based optimization. \href{https://xiangchi-yuan.github.io/papo-project/}{Code is available}.

AI.tldr: PAPO：优先级感知的非对称优势聚合方法，避免RL中辅助目标反转主目标偏好。
AI.motivation: LLM后训练需同时优化不平等优先级的多个目标（如正确性与推理效率）。常用加性奖励聚合在主要与辅助优势冲突时，足够大的辅助信号会逆转主目标诱导的偏好，作者称之为"优势优先级反转"；奖励级门控虽更直接保护优先级，但会抹去未满足主目标条件的样本中潜在有用的辅助区分信息。
AI.method: 提出 Primary Advantage Policy Optimization (PAPO)，一种优先级感知的优势聚合方法：非对称地组合主要与辅助优势——两者一致时保留辅助监督，冲突时平滑衰减辅助信号，并在融合中保持主要优势符号，实现"主要一致排序"；该规则可推广到GRPO的序列级优势与actor-critic PPO的token级优势。
AI.result: 在多领域、多模型实验中，PAPO在GRPO与PPO两类优化下均稳定取得最佳主目标表现，辅助目标性能达到最佳或具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 非对称优势聚合可在不牺牲辅助监督的前提下严格保护目标优先级，为多目标LLM后训练提供有效方案。

title: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization
summary: Users often request charts without knowing which database or table holds the relevant data. Such requests may be ambiguous, and users may ask follow-up questions to deepen their analysis or iteratively refine existing charts. A useful assistant must therefore discover relevant data sources among heterogeneous databases, ask clarifying questions when needed, and track evolving user intent while preserving constraints established in earlier turns. Yet recent text-to-visualization agents typically rely on static agent harnesses that are predefined and remain unchanged despite recurring failures across tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce RSIV-Harness, which keeps the language model weights fixed and applies Recursive Self-Improvement to revise the surrounding harness from the agent's own failure traces. To balance flexible self-improvement with stability, we introduce a four-layer framework that evaluates proposed harness revisions through anchor and memory checks, refining those that pass and restoring the best validated harness otherwise. We further introduce ODAC-Vis, a benchmark with 640 tasks for Open-Domain, Ambiguous, and Conversational text-to-visualization that jointly evaluates open-domain data discovery, ambiguity resolution, multi-turn visualization refinement, and executable chart generation. Experiments show that a single round of RSIV-Harness improves all six evaluation metrics relative to the seed harness, with particularly large gains in executability (+28.02 points) and chart structure (+34.01 points), demonstrating the ability to learn from task-solving experience and turn recurring failures across tasks into substantial performance improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RSIV-Harness：在冻结大模型权重的前提下，通过递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement）依据智能体自身的失败轨迹修改其外围执行框架（harness）。同时提出四层评估框架（含锚点检查与记忆检查）在自我改进与稳定性间取得平衡，并构建 ODAC-Vis 基准（640 个开放式、歧义、多轮对话式文本到可视化任务）。实验表明单轮自我改进即提升全部六项指标，可执行性 +28.02、图表结构 +34.01。
AI.motivation: 用户常在不清楚数据位于哪个数据库/表的情况下请求图表，请求存在歧义且需多轮追问与迭代优化，助手需完成异构数据源发现、歧义澄清与跨轮意图追踪。而现有文本到可视化智能体依赖预定义、静态不变的 agent harness，无法从跨任务的反复失败中学习改进。
AI.method: 1）RSIV-Harness：保持 LLM 权重固定，基于智能体自身失败轨迹对 harness 进行递归式自我修改；2）四层框架：通过锚点检查与记忆检查评估候选 harness 修订，通过者被采纳精化，未通过则回滚到已验证最优 harness，以兼顾灵活性与稳定性；3）ODAC-Vis 基准：640 个开放式（Open-Domain）、歧义（Ambiguous）、对话式（Conversational）文本到可视化任务，联合评测数据发现、歧义消解、多轮图表精化与可执行图表生成。
AI.result: 单轮 RSIV-Harness 即在全部六项评测指标上优于种子 harness，其中可执行性提升 28.02 分、图表结构提升 34.01 分，增幅最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 智能体能够从解题经验中学习，将跨任务反复出现的失败转化为显著的性能提升；无需改动模型权重即可通过 harness 自进化有效应对开放式、歧义与多轮可视化场景。

title: Checkpoint Reload Explains Most of the Measured State Gap in Two State Discovery Reproductions
comment: Equal contribution, 11 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS 2026). Equal contribution
summary: Temporal models that maintain per-sequence latent states during training must reconstruct those states when the stored table is unavailable at inference. This creates a basic consistency question: do the reconstructed states agree with those formed during training? We study this question for State Discovery in World Machine, which updates stored states in parallel each epoch but performs inference by sequential rollout from an all-zero start. On Toy1D, we analyze two paired-checkpoint runs whose decoded-state MSE is 27 to 36 percent above the published value. We compare the stored table with rollouts under the best-validation checkpoint reloaded after training and the last-epoch weights that wrote the table. Matching the rollout to the table-writing weights removes 90 to 91 percent of the mean per-dimension Wasserstein-1 distance. Causal distillation and frozen SD updates do not satisfy their pre-specified criteria under either checkpoint. Overall, checkpoint reload accounts for most of the measured gap in these runs.

AI.tldr: 该文针对"训练期维护的逐序列隐状态在推理时需通过rollout重建"的一致性展开分析：在World Machine的State Discovery中，用回写表格的末轮权重执行rollout可消除大部分状态偏差，说明checkpoint重载是主要误差来源。
AI.motivation: 时序模型训练时保存逐序列隐状态表，推理时表格不可用只能从全零起点顺序rollout重建，于是产生一个基本一致性问题：重建状态是否与训练时形成的状态一致。作者据此检验State Discovery中"并行逐epoch更新表格"与"推理顺序rollout"之间的差距来源。
AI.method: 在Toy1D上选取两组配对checkpoint运行（其解码状态MSE比已发表值高27%–36%）；将存储表格与两类rollout作对比——训练后按最佳验证集重载的checkpoint，以及实际写出该表格的末轮权重；以每维Wasserstein-1距离为度量，并检验因果蒸馏与冻结SD更新的预设判据。
AI.result: 将rollout对齐到"写表权重"后，平均每维Wasserstein-1距离下降90%–91%，即checkpoint重载解释了大部分实测差距；因果蒸馏与冻结SD更新在两种checkpoint下均未满足预设判据。
AI.conclusion: 在这些运行中，推理一致性差距主要源于checkpoint选择/重载而非方法本身；评估时序模型的状态一致性应显式匹配写表权重，两个候选改进方案（因果蒸馏、冻结SD更新）未获支持。

title: Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor Critic for Decentralized LLM Collaboration
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop PTA: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents. 18 pages, 3 figures
summary: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), but many approaches still rely on predefined workflows, limiting efficiency and scalability. Decentralized LLM collaboration is challenging because agents execute independently with limited communication, share a joint objective, and must infer useful information from communication traces. In this paper, we propose BCMAAC, a Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor-Critic method that maintains beliefs over contextual information and uses them to facilitate training. Experiments on Minecraft game-playing, web searching and tool-using tasks show that BCMAAC improves task performance and collaborative behavior compared to naive actor-critic baselines. The improvements are particularly pronounced in multi-turn tasks with richer contextual information, where belief modeling provides a clear advantage.

AI.tldr: 提出BCMAAC（信念条件多智能体Actor-Critic），通过维护对上下文信息的信念来训练去中心化LLM协作，在Minecraft、网页搜索和工具使用任务上优于朴素Actor-Critic基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MARL的LLM协作优化多依赖预定义工作流，效率与可扩展性受限；而去中心化协作中智能体独立执行、通信有限、共享联合目标，需从通信痕迹中推断有用信息，难度大。
AI.method: BCMAAC维护对上下文信息的信念，并将信念作为条件输入用于actor-critic训练，以支撑去中心化多智能体LLM协作。
AI.result: 在Minecraft游戏、网页搜索与工具使用任务上，任务性能与协作行为均优于朴素Actor-Critic基线；在多轮、上下文信息更丰富的任务中提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 信念建模对去中心化LLM协作有效，且在上下文丰富场景下优势明显，为摆脱预定义工作流提供了可行方向。

title: End-to-End MXFP8 Reinforcement Learning on Blackwell: What Matching Buys, When It Pays Off, and How It Fails
summary: Low-precision arithmetic can make reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models cheaper, but RL requires the sampler and the learner to agree. Several frameworks now run FP8 on both sides. We implement end-to-end MXFP8 RL in verl (Megatron/Transformer Engine training; vLLM and SGLang rollout; dense and MoE models) and measure on B200 GPUs, with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, what this design buys, when it is faster, and how it fails. (1) Matching. For an MXFP8 learner, a sampler on the learner's grid is more consistent than a higher-precision BF16 sampler: in one engine at fixed weights, train-rollout KL is 11% lower with half of the sampler's linear layers on the grid and 16% lower with all of them, and the synchronized weights we checked equal the learner's FP8 forward weights byte for byte. On the MoE model, an FP8 pipeline whose sampler uses another grid has twice the shared-grid pipeline's KL from the first step. Without a quantized KV cache, BF16 end to end remains 2.5-10x more consistent. (2) Speed. MXFP8 training adds a fixed cost per micro-batch and saves a per-token cost, so in our dense setting it pays off only above about 4.5k tokens per micro-batch; a micro-batch sweep on identical data confirms the per-micro-batch cost, and a trace shows the GPU waiting for the host for most of the added time. End to end, MXFP8 cuts MoE step time by 10.7% and generation time by 24%, and slows a short-sequence dense workload by 5%. (3) Correctness. We state seven conditions every weight synchronization must preserve and checks that test them against the live engine. Each of the seven failures we met on hardware broke one condition, five silently; the checks caught two at their first opportunity, each missed by the other checks, and CPU fault-injection tests reproduce five. All runs are single-seed and at most 60 steps long; we make no claim about final model quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文在 verl 中实现端到端 MXFP8 RL（Megatron/TE 训练，vLLM/SGLang 采样，覆盖 dense 与 MoE），在 B200 上以 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 量化评估该设计的收益、加速条件与失效模式，并从一致性、速度、正确性三方面给出实证结论。
AI.motivation: 低精度算术可降低大模型 RL 的成本，但 RL 要求采样器与学习器保持一致。已有框架在两侧使用 FP8，然而缺乏对“同网格（same grid）匹配”到底带来什么、何时更快、如何失败的端到端测量。
AI.method: 在 verl 中实现端到端 MXFP8 RL 流水线：训练侧用 Megatron/Transformer Engine，rollout 侧用 vLLM 与 SGLang，覆盖 dense 与 MoE；在 B200 GPU 上对 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-30B-A3B 做测量。测量内容包括：固定权重下的 train-rollout KL 对比（不同采样器精度/网格、量化 KV cache 有无）、同步权重与学习器 FP8 前向权重的逐字节比对、micro-batch 扫描与 GPU trace 成本分析，以及提出权重同步须保持的七条条件并配套在线引擎检查与 CPU 故障注入。
AI.result: (1) 匹配性：MXFP8 学习器下，采样器采用同一网格比更高精度 BF16 采样器更一致——单引擎固定权重时，半数线性层上网格使 KL 降低 11%，全部上网格降低 16%，同步权重与学习器 FP8 前向权重逐字节相等；MoE 上采样器使用其他网格的 FP8 流水线首步 KL 即为共享网格流水线的两倍；无量化 KV cache 时 BF16 端到端仍一致 2.5–10 倍。(2) 速度：MXFP8 训练有每 micro-batch 固定开销与每 token 节省，dense 设置下约需 >4.5k tokens/micro-batch 才回本，trace 显示新增时间主要为 GPU 等待 host；端到端 MoE step 时间降低 10.7%、生成时间降低 24%，短序列 dense 负载反而慢 5%。(3) 正确性：七条同步条件，硬件上遇到的七次失败各破坏一条（五次静默），检查在首次机会捕获两次且彼此互补，CPU 故障注入复现五次。
AI.conclusion: MXFP8 RL 的收益高度依赖采样器与学习器共享量化网格：共享网格显著改善一致性，但无量化 KV cache 时仍不及 BF16；速度收益随 micro-batch 规模与模型类型变化，存在明确阈值；权重同步的正确性可由七条条件系统性检验，但多数失败为静默失败，需多重互补检查。所有结论来自单种子、至多 60 步的运行，不对最终模型质量作任何声明。

title: AdaTrendLike: Adaptive Hierarchical Detrending and Trend Likelihood Scoring for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: The rapid proliferation of Industrial Internet of Things devices has led to increasingly large-scale and non-stationary time-series data, posing significant challenges for time-series anomaly detection (TSAD). Existing approaches often focus on reconstructing or forecasting observations while overlooking the role of trend dynamics, which constitute a major source of non-stationarity and contain valuable information for anomaly identification. To address this limitation, we propose AdaTrendLike, a TSAD framework that directly estimates trend likelihoods for anomaly detection. Specifically, we introduce Standardization Embedding to capture local statistical characteristics as latent representations and AdaDetrending to adaptively decompose input series into trend and detrended components. The detrended component is processed through a Fast Fourier Transform and a complex-valued convolutional neural network to learn normal periodic patterns, while TrendEst models the distribution of the trend component. Based on the estimated distribution, TrendLike computes anomaly scores by measuring the likelihood of observed trends, enabling effective detection of deviations from normal behavior. In addition to improving detection performance, the proposed framework provides feature-level interpretability by identifying anomalies through deviations in the estimated trend distribution. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that AdaTrendLike consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TSAD methods, validating its effectiveness and robustness across diverse application scenarios.

AI.tldr: AdaTrendLike：直接对趋势分量建模似然以进行时间序列异常检测的框架。
AI.motivation: 工业物联网设备快速增长带来大规模、非平稳时间序列，TSAD面临挑战；现有方法聚焦重构或预测观测值，忽视趋势动态——而趋势动态是非平稳性的主要来源、且蕴含异常识别的重要信息。
AI.method: 提出AdaTrendLike，直接估计趋势似然用于异常检测：引入Standardization Embedding捕获局部统计特征作为隐表示；AdaDetrending自适应分解输入序列为趋势与去趋势分量；去趋势分量经FFT与复数卷积网络学习正常周期模式；TrendEst建模趋势分量分布；TrendLike基于估计分布计算观测趋势的似然作为异常分数。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准数据集上，AdaTrendLike持续优于SOTA的TSAD方法，验证其有效性与跨场景鲁棒性；同时通过趋势分布偏差识别异常，提供特征级可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模趋势分布是提升TSAD性能与可解释性的有效途径；尚缺乏对计算开销与分布假设局限性的讨论。

title: A Certified Robustness Framework for Backdoor Poisoning Attacks using $f$-Divergences
summary: Machine learning systems trained on untrusted data are vulnerable to data and backdoor poisoning attacks, in which an adversary corrupts training and test samples to manipulate predictions at inference time. Randomized smoothing yields provable defenses against such attacks, but existing applications to train-time robustness are limited to specific threat models and smoothing mechanisms. We propose a general framework that allows expressing complex adversary constraints on the number of corrupted training examples, feature and label perturbation magnitudes, and test-time corruptions. Our framework randomizes inputs by combining data subsampling with feature, label and test-sample noising. We develop a composable certification procedure based on $f$-divergences that handles arbitrary combinations of threat models and noising strategies, and recovers several prior certification regimes exactly as special cases. We demonstrate our framework experimentally by certifying, for the first time, robustness under general $\ell_p$-constrained poisoning adversaries under bagging with additive Laplace, Gaussian, and Uniform noises.

AI.tldr: 提出一个通用的随机平滑框架，通过子采样结合特征、标签与测试样本加噪，并基于f-散度给出可组合的认证程序，统一表达并认证复杂的数据与后门投毒威胁模型。
AI.motivation: 现有针对训练时鲁棒性的随机平滑方法局限于特定威胁模型与特定平滑机制，无法统一处理复杂对手约束（如损坏样本数量、特征与标签扰动幅度、测试时扰动）。
AI.method: 将数据子采样（bagging）与特征噪声、标签噪声、测试样本噪声相结合来随机化输入；基于f-散度的可组合认证程序，处理任意威胁模型与加噪策略的组合，并将若干已有认证机制作为特例精确还原。
AI.result: 理论上统一并还原多种已有认证机制；实验上首次在bagging配合加性Laplace、Gaussian与Uniform噪声下，对一般ℓ_p约束的投毒对手给出认证鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 随机平滑可推广为统一、可组合的训练时鲁棒性认证框架，涵盖更一般的投毒威胁模型，并通过实验验证了其有效性。

title: NeSySpec: Neuro-Symbolic Technical Intelligence for Auditing Engineering Specifications with an Application to Aircraft
summary: Engineers who audit a declared specification of an engineered system need to know which physical constraints it respects, which it violates, which field was altered and how to correct it. NeSySpec is an integrated and interpretable neuro-symbolic audit framework, built on Logic Tensor Networks, that answers these questions in one pipeline. Its axioms encode the physical relations of the domain as differentiable graded predicates whose tolerances are learned from a fleet of real records; from the same degrees, it diagnoses the violated constraint, identifies the altered field by abduction, proposes a minimum-change correction and ties image evidence to the parts it describes, abstaining exactly where evidence is missing, and returns all of it in one verification report. We validate NeSySpec on 107 aircraft types, with 16 test aircraft of 9 families held out of training, on specification records paired with ground photographs and satellite imagery and on synthetic errors: generated corruptions, edits labeled from the edit alone and deliberate falsifications. NeSySpec combines all the assessed audit outputs in one pipeline, which no learned, rule-based, solver-based, neuro-symbolic or language-model comparator does; on the test aircraft none is ahead of it in the macro-F1 of its constraint verdicts, in naming the violated constraint and the altered field or in the repair error, and it is competitive in record and image-pair detection. Its diagnosis names the violated constraint in 94.2% of corrupted test records, against 79.5% for classical Fellegi-Holt diagnosis, and on edits labeled from the edit alone, without retraining, abduction finds the altered field in 59.3% of records, against 30.6% for minimum-cardinality localization with random tie- breaking. Only the knowledge base, the visual predicates, the corruption generator and the data are specific to the domain.

AI.tldr: NeSySpec 是基于 Logic Tensor Networks 的可解释神经符号审计框架，在单一流水线中同时完成约束验证、违规诊断、字段篡改定位、最小修改建议与图像证据关联，并在 107 种机型、留出 16 架测试机（9 个族）的数据上全面优于学习式、规则式、求解器式、神经符号与语言模型基线。
AI.motivation: 审计工程系统"申报规格"的工程师需要知道：该规格遵守哪些物理约束、违反哪些、哪个字段被改动以及如何修正。现有方法（学习式、规则式、求解器式、神经符号、语言模型）无法在同一流程中整合给出这些审计输出，缺少既统一又可解释的审计工具。
AI.method: 以 Logic Tensor Networks 为基础，将领域物理关系编码为可微分的分级谓词公理，其容差由真实记录集合学习得到；从同一组满足度（degrees）出发，通过溯因推理定位被违反的约束与被篡改字段，提出最小改动修正方案，并将图像证据与其描述的部件对齐，在证据缺失处精确弃答，最终输出统一的核查报告。验证数据为 107 种机型的规格记录，配对地面照片与卫星影像，并构造三类合成错误（生成的破坏、仅依据编辑本身标注的编辑、故意伪造）；留出 16 架测试机（9 个族）不参与训练。
AI.result: 在测试机上，NeSySpec 的约束判定 macro-F1、违规约束与篡改字段命名、修复误差均不落后于所有对比方法，记录级与图像对检测具竞争力；在损坏测试记录上以 94.2% 命中被违反约束（经典 Fellegi-Holt 诊断为 79.5%）；在仅依据编辑本身标注、无需重训练的条件下，溯因在 59.3% 记录中找出被改字段（随机打破平局的最小基数定位为 30.6%）。
AI.conclusion: NeSySpec 将多项审计输出统一到一个可解释的神经符号流水线中，性能优于各类基线；其领域无关性体现在仅知识库、视觉谓词、破坏生成器与数据为领域特定，其余框架组件可迁移。

title: Relational Composition as Parallel Transport: What Per-Entity Frames Force in Attention
summary: A dot product means something only when both vectors share a coordinate system. Content words have one; a fresh entity does not: rotating its coordinates alone changes nothing. We take this per-entity frame freedom as a symmetry and ask what it forces in attention. For orthogonal transports, invariant scores depend only on norms and the transported inner product $\langle x_i,T_{ij}x_j\rangle$; equivariant messages lie in the span of $x_i$ and $T_{ij}x_j$. Endpoint channel count bounds transport rank, so with one vector per entity relations must be supplied; standard attention is the flat sector of a shared frame. Representation theory attaches an integer to each mechanism; the readout decides which. With orthogonal transitions, a convex-cell readout composes a finite group exactly only at or above its smallest faithful real representation dimension. At this minimum, exactness forces a faithful representation. An even readout can decode a cover at smaller width, and the gap is unbounded. Below its threshold, the part of the group a mechanism cannot see sets an accuracy ceiling computable before training. 17/17 fitting seeds at minimal width passed tests through length 1000, versus 7/18 at twice the width; 12 models carry correctness certificates to explicit lengths, from the weights alone. On $C_3\times A_4$ (faithful width 5), descent at width 4 learned the 72-state double cover under sign-blind attention (6/48 seeds; monotone 0/48); on a frozen cover the cross-entropy-optimal affine head is uniform, a quadratic head exact. On parsed CLUTRR, transported composition beats a matched transformer by 41 points at 4-10 hops, but forcing isometries costs 65 points; on StepGame's commutative algebra, isometries help. Static embeddings gave each word one vector; contextual models gave each occurrence its own; per-entity frames make each relation an operator, the unit in which relations compose.

AI.tldr: 论文将"每个实体的坐标系自由"视为一种对称性，推导注意力机制在正交传输下的不变/等变形式，并用表示论给出机制能力的整数刻画与可计算的精度上界。
AI.motivation: 标准点积仅在共享坐标系下有意义：内容词有确定坐标系，而新实体没有，"仅旋转其坐标不改变任何东西"。论文把这一定义性缺陷提升为对称性假设，追问它在注意力中强制出什么形式的评分、消息与读出。
AI.method: 在正交传输$T_{ij}$假定下，证明不变评分只依赖范数与被传输内积$\langle x_i,T_{ij}x_j\rangle$，等变消息位于$\mathrm{span}\{x_i,T_{ij}x_j\}$；端点通道数约束传输秩，故每实体单向量时必须外生提供关系，标准注意力即"共享坐标系下的平坦扇区"。用表示论为每个机制赋一个整数（宽度/秩阈值），并由读出类型决定该整数含义：凸单元读出在正交转移下，恰在最小忠实实表示维数及以上才能精确复合有限群；偶数读出可在更小宽度解码覆盖，间隙无界；低于阈值时，机制"看不见"的部分给出先验可算的精度天花板。
AI.result: 最小宽度下17/17拟合种子通过长度1000测试，双倍宽度仅7/18；12个模型可仅由权重给出到显式长度的正确性证书。$C_3\times A_4$（忠实宽度5）上，宽度4的下降在符号盲注意力下学到72态双覆盖（6/48种子；单调版0/48）；冻结覆盖上，交叉熵最优仿射头退化为均匀，二次头精确。解析CLUTRR上，传输式复合在4–10跳比匹配transformer高41分，但强制等距代价65分；StepGame的交换代数中等距反而有益。
AI.conclusion: 从静态词向量（每词一向量）到上下文模型（每次出现一向量），再到本框架中每实体一坐标系、每个关系一个算子——关系成为组合的基本单位。坐标框架自由度是理解注意力组合能力的关键结构量。

title: From Denoising Dynamics to Endpoint Uncertainty in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Predictive uncertainty in stochastic language-model inference can be characterized by repeatedly sampling an input and measuring the distribution of outputs. This requires multiple complete generations. Masked diffusion language models expose another source of information: the evolution of the output during denoising. We ask whether convergence within diffusion trajectories is associated with uncertainty across their final outputs, or endpoints. We study four masked diffusion language models on four reasoning benchmarks, collecting 20 generations per question and 32,000 denoising trajectories in total. Within each trajectory, we measure within-run concentration as the area under the curve describing stable resolution of the eventual output. Across repeated trajectories, we measure endpoint-distribution uncertainty. Stronger within-run concentration is associated with lower endpoint entropy after accounting for model and dataset ($β=-0.222$, $p<10^{-25}$). This association persists for multi-token outputs and when reweighting positive-entropy cases. The relationship is asymmetric: high within-run concentration almost exclusively accompanies concentrated endpoint distributions, whereas lower concentration occurs under both concentrated and competing endpoint regimes. This relationship strengthens as denoising proceeds. Features from a single denoising run predict whether independent held-out runs will concentrate on a common endpoint or produce competing endpoints. These results connect dynamics within individual denoising runs to variability across repeated inference. Within-trajectory dynamics contain information about whether independent repetitions will concentrate on a common endpoint or produce competing endpoints, providing a route towards estimating endpoint-distribution properties with fewer complete generations.

AI.tldr: 在掩码扩散语言模型中，单条去噪轨迹内的收敛程度（within-run concentration）与跨多次重复采样的终点分布不确定性（endpoint entropy）显著负相关，且该关系不对称并随去噪推进而增强，可用于以更少完整生成估计输出不确定性。
AI.motivation: 传统预测不确定性需反复完整采样生成以刻画输出分布，成本高。掩码扩散语言模型的去噪过程本身提供额外信息源，作者希望探究轨迹内收敛性是否与终点分布不确定性相关联，从而减少所需完整生成次数。
AI.method: 在4个掩码扩散语言模型、4个推理基准上，每个问题采集20次生成，共32,000条去噪轨迹。轨迹内以"稳定解析最终输出的曲线下面积"度量within-run concentration；跨轨迹以终点分布熵度量不确定性。采用回归（控制模型与数据集）分析二者关联，并进行多token输出、正熵重加权、不对称性及去噪时间演化分析；最后用单条轨迹特征预测独立留出轨迹是否收敛到共同终点。
AI.result: 更强轨迹内收敛对应更低终点熵（β=-0.222, p<10^-25）；该关联在多token输出与正熵重加权下稳健。关系不对称：高轨迹内收敛几乎只伴随集中终点分布，而低收敛可出现在集中或竞争终点两种情形。关联随去噪推进增强。单条去噪轨迹特征可预测独立留出轨迹是集中于共同终点还是产生竞争终点。
AI.conclusion: 单条去噪轨迹的内部动态蕴含关于独立重复是否收敛于共同终点的信息，将轨迹内动态与重复推理间变异性联系起来，为以更少完整生成估计终点分布性质提供了途径。

title: Correlation-Aware Exploration for Long-Trace Reasoning
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Reasoning models trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) now produce chains of thought thousands of tokens long, and recent studies reveal that such training is prone to policy collapse. Entropy regularization is the standard remedy, but it works by pushing probability mass away from the few tokens that carry it and toward the vast low-probability tail of the vocabulary, and it applies this force once for every token of the reasoning trace. This puts the bonus in direct conflict with the entropy decay that convergence requires, and makes its coefficient difficult to set in the long-trace regime. To resolve this tension, we propose Info-GRPO, an information-theoretic framework that cultivates correlation between the policy and a latent prior. Rather than raising entropy everywhere, Info-GRPO builds on the mutual information between a latent variable and the trajectory it induces: augmenting prompts with latent seeds during training lets the model explore diverse policies correlated with the prior, while the seed-conditioned entropy is guided toward convergence. Diversity is therefore carried across whole reasoning traces rather than by per-token randomness, and exploration no longer fights entropy reduction. Experiments show that Info-GRPO outperforms vanilla GRPO and entropy-regularized GRPO across diverse reasoning benchmarks. On AIME24, it improves $Avg@8$ over GRPO by 3.75%, 1.66%, 4.16%, and 4.17% on four backbones, and it reaches the same majority-vote accuracy with $8\times$ fewer samples. Code and models will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出 Info-GRPO，用潜变量先验与轨迹间的互信息替代逐token熵正则，实现跨整条推理轨迹的多样性探索，缓解GRPO策略坍缩。
AI.motivation: GRPO训练的推理模型产生数千token的长思维链，易发生策略坍缩。标准做法熵正则需对每个token施加“把概率质量推向低频尾部”的力，与收敛所需的熵衰减直接冲突，且系数在长轨迹下难以设定。
AI.method: 基于信息论框架，最大化潜变量与其诱导轨迹之间的互信息：训练时用潜种子增强prompt，使模型探索与先验相关的多样策略；同时对种子条件熵施加引导以促进收敛。多样性由整条轨迹承载而非逐token随机性。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上优于vanilla GRPO与熵正则GRPO；AIME24上四个骨干的Avg@8分别提升3.75%、1.66%、4.16%、4.17%，并以1/8采样量达到相同多数投票准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将探索从逐token熵提升到轨迹级互信息层面，可化解探索与熵衰减的张力，是长思维链RL训练中更可控的正则化范式。

title: Faithful Explanations under Missing Modalities in Multimodal Dementia Prognosis
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to turn the feature attributions of multimodal prognostic models into narratives for clinicians, yet costly modalities such as amyloid PET and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers are often missing, and whether these explanations stay faithful under missing evidence has not been tested. We separate two failure points: phantom attribution, in which the model credits modalities that were never observed, and unfaithful narration, in which the report omits, cites or misjudges missing modalities. Using 307 participants of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative with complete data, we masked every subset of four costly modalities, predicted 36-month conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease, and restored the masked data to obtain interventional ground truth. All five missing-data strategies assigned 12% to 23% of attribution to unobserved modalities, and up to 45% with four absent; missingness-aware strategies minimised it at no cost in accuracy. Across 51,200 reports from four language models and four prompting regimes, naming absent modalities in the prompt raised acknowledgement from 48% to 88% and cut phantom evidence twenty-fold, but advice on whether acquiring a missing test would change the prediction was correct in only 27% to 41% of cases until checked against executed restorations, which raised accuracy to 69% for open-weight narrators and 99.9% for a proprietary model. Higher phantom attribution was associated with more phantom evidence and fewer faithful direction claims, and direction fidelity, measured by a calibrated language-model judge, depended on narrator scale rather than prompting. Narrators told to name absent modalities sometimes declared observed ones absent, an error that a structured template eliminated. We release the masking protocol and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 该研究将多模态预后模型在缺失证据下的解释忠实性拆分为“幻影归因”（模型将为观测到的模态计入贡献）与“不忠实叙述”（报告遗漏、误引或误判缺失模态），在ADNI 307名被试上系统遮蔽四类高成本模态并构造干预式真值，发现现有缺失策略将12–23%归因分配给未观测模态（四模态全缺时达45%），提示中明示缺失模态可将叙述确认率从48%提升至88%，但关于“补做检查是否改变预测”的建议正确率仅27–41%，经执行式还原校验后可提升至69%（开源）与99.9%（闭源）
AI.motivation: 多模态预后模型的特征归因正被大语言模型转写为面向临床医生的叙述，但淀粉样PET、脑脊液等昂贵模态常缺失，这些解释在证据缺失条件下是否仍忠实尚未被检验；作者据此区分幻影归因与不忠实叙述两类失效点，旨在建立可量化的评测框架
AI.method: 基于ADNI 307名数据完整参与者，对四种高成本模态的每个子集进行遮蔽，预测MCI向AD的36个月转化，并通过还原被遮蔽数据获得干预式（interventional）真值；比较五种缺失数据处理策略的幻影归因比例与准确率；构建51,200份报告（4个语言模型×4种提示范式），评估缺失模态确认率、幻影证据量、方向忠实度（由校准的语言模型评判器度量）及“补做检查是否改变预测”建议的正确性，并进行执行式还原校验与结构化模板干预
AI.result: 五种缺失策略均将12%–23%归因分配给未观测模态，四模态全缺时高达45%；缺失感知策略在精度无损前提下将幻影归因降至最低。提示中命名缺失模态使确认率由48%升至88%、幻影证据减少约20倍，但获取检查建议正确率仅27%–41%，经执行式还原校验后开源叙述模型升至69%、闭源模型达99.9%。幻影归因越高，幻影证据越多、忠实方向断言越少；方向忠实度取决于叙述模型规模而非提示方式。被告知命名缺失模态的模型有时会将已观测模态误报为缺失，结构化模板可消除该错误
AI.conclusion: 缺失证据下的解释忠实性需分项评测：幻影归因与不忠实叙述可分别量化，缺失感知训练策略与显式声明缺失的提示可显著改善前者与确认率，但反事实建议的可靠性必须依赖执行式还原而非模型自述；方向忠实度受模型规模制约，结构化模板可消除模态状态误报。作者公开遮蔽协议与评测代码

title: MINT: Mitigating Structural Inconsistency via Attentive Message Passing for Financial Anomaly Detection
summary: Illicit account detection is a critical task for financial risk control systems, aiming to pinpoint malicious actors within transaction networks. Existing efforts typically recast transaction networks into directed multigraphs and leverage graph neural networks (GNNs) to detect anomalies via topological structures under the homophily assumption. However, directly grafting GNNs onto transaction graphs is faced with at least two pivotal challenges, i.e., structural inconsistency and label scarcity. The former arises from deceptive connections forged by malicious actors, while the latter stems from the lack of annotated data. In light of these, we introduce MINT, a novel graph neural framework that mitigates structural inconsistency via an attentive message-passing scheme on transaction graphs. Specifically, MINT introduces a discrepancy-aware feature propagation, which tracks malicious actors by quantifying deviations between nodes across bi-directional transaction flows. A transaction salience module is proposed to mitigate structural inconsistency by adaptively regularizing the interaction strength between nodes. Furthermore, to alleviate label scarcity, MINT is optimized via Positive-Unlabeled (PU) learning, which exploits only a minority of illicit nodes coupled with a majority of unlabeled ones. Extensive experiments conducted on three financial transaction benchmarks, including two large-scale public and one in-house real-world datasets, validate the superior effectiveness of MINT over several cutting-edge baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出MINT图神经网络框架用于交易网络中的非法账户检测，通过差异感知特征传播、交易显著性模块与PU学习，缓解结构不一致与标签稀缺两大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将交易网络建模为有向多重图并用GNN在同质性假设下检测异常，但直接应用GNN面临两个关键挑战：(1) 结构不一致，源于恶意行为者伪造的欺骗性连接；(2) 标签稀缺，源于标注数据不足。
AI.method: MINT包含：1) 差异感知特征传播，通过量化双向交易流中节点间的偏差来追踪恶意账户；2) 交易显著性模块，自适应正则化节点间交互强度以缓解结构不一致；3) 采用Positive-Unlabeled (PU) 学习优化，仅利用少量非法节点与大量未标注节点以缓解标签稀缺。
AI.result: 在三个金融交易基准（两个大规模公开数据集与一个内部真实数据集）上进行大量实验，验证MINT显著优于多个先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MINT通过注意力消息传递、交易显著性正则与PU学习有效应对交易图中的结构不一致与标签稀缺问题，在非法账户检测任务上表现出优越的有效性。

title: Skill$^{\infty}$: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system also improves the way it improves, is a long-standing aspiration on the path to AGI. Language agents increasingly store procedural knowledge in reusable skills. Optimizing skills offers a direct way to achieve RSI, because the optimization procedure itself can be encoded as a skill. Existing skill optimizers, however, follow a hand-designed procedure. Even methods that evolve a meta-skill confine it to a fixed pipeline and relearn it for each task. We present Skill$^{\infty}$, which makes skill optimization recursively self-improving: a meta agent follows a meta-skill to optimize task skills and optimizes the meta-skill itself using the same procedure. The optimization is agent-led. The meta agent diagnoses execution traces, proposes candidates, requests independent reviews, and allocates the search budget. The meta-skill defines these steps, allowing self-improvement to rewrite them. This meta-skill is also decoupled from task skills, refined on multiple skill optimization tasks and then reused to optimize task skills across diverse domains. As in deployment, skills at both levels are standard packages loaded through native skill discovery. On 83 SkillsBench tasks, Skill$^{\infty}$ reaches a pass rate of 60.7%, compared with 56.4% for human-curated skills and 54.5% for SkillEvolver.

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill^∞，将技能优化本身编码为可被优化的元技能，实现递归自我改进，在 SkillsBench 上取得 60.7% 通过率。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体逐渐以可复用技能形式存储过程性知识，优化技能是通往递归自我改进（RSI）的直接路径，因为优化过程本身可被编码为技能。但现有技能优化器采用手工设计流程，即使演化元技能也只限于固定流水线并为每个任务重新学习，缺乏真正的递归自我改进能力。
AI.method: 构建元智能体：依照元技能优化任务技能，并以同一流程优化元技能自身。优化由智能体主导——诊断执行轨迹、提出候选、请求独立评审、分配搜索预算。元技能定义这些步骤，使自我改进能够重写它们；元技能与任务技能解耦，在多个技能优化任务上精炼后跨领域复用；两级技能均为标准包，通过原生技能发现机制加载。
AI.result: 在 83 个 SkillsBench 任务上，Skill^∞ 通过率达 60.7%，高于人工整理技能的 56.4% 和 SkillEvolver 的 54.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将优化流程本身作为可优化对象，可实现技能层面的递归自我改进，且元技能可跨领域复用，性能优于人工整理技能与现有技能演化方法。

title: Improving Reasoning with Rollout Agreement for Group-Based Policy Optimization
summary: Recent methods for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) use rollout diversity to improve reasoning performance or training efficiency. Despite these gains, the extent to which differences among correct-answer rollouts reflect useful alternative reasoning or unresolved errors remains poorly understood. We investigate this question through a blind paired analysis of a model trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), comparing the highest- and lowest-agreement correct-answer traces for the same problem. Across 126 pairs, low-agreement traces have more spurious reasoning than high-agreement traces (35% vs. 22%), including internal inconsistencies and misuse of problem conditions. Based on these findings, we propose RoAR (Rollout-Agreement Reward), which adds reasoning-level agreement to GRPO's rewards for verified-correct rollouts. RoAR computes this signal from existing on-policy rollout groups, requiring no human-written rationales, additional sampling, or separately trained process evaluator. On five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, the 1.5B GRPO-RoAR model reaches 55.5% mean pass@1 under zero-shot evaluation using 7K training examples, exceeding GRPO and GRPO-CARE by 6.0 and 5.5 percentage points. A separate blind audit of 100 problems answered correctly by all four 1.5B models finds spurious rates of 18% for GRPO-RoAR, 32% for GRPO, 27% for GRPO-CARE, and 37% for DRA-GRPO. Our findings identify reasoning validity as an important consideration when using rollout differences to guide learning. Our code is available at https://github.com/ldi-kyunghee/RoAR.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过盲配对分析发现，GRPO中低一致性正确答案轨迹的虚假推理比例显著更高（35% vs. 22%），据此提出RoAR（Rollout-Agreement Reward），将推理层一致性作为额外奖励信号，无需人工理由或额外采样，在五个数学推理基准上以1.5B模型达到55.5%平均pass@1，并显著降低虚假推理率。
AI.motivation: RLVR方法常利用rollout多样性提升推理或训练效率，但正确答案轨迹之间的差异究竟反映有用的替代推理还是未解决的错误，尚不清楚，缺乏对"正确但推理无效"问题的系统认识。
AI.method: 对GRPO训练的模型进行盲配对分析，比较同一问题下最高一致性与最低一致性的正确轨迹（126对）；基于发现提出RoAR，在GRPO对已验证正确rollout的奖励中加入推理层一致性信号，该信号直接从现有on-policy rollout组计算，无需人工撰写的推理理由、额外采样或单独训练的过程评估器。
AI.result: 低一致性轨迹虚假推理更多（35% vs. 22%），含内部不一致与问题条件误用。五个数学推理基准上，1.5B GRPO-RoAR零样本平均pass@1达55.5%，较GRPO和GRPO-CARE分别高6.0和5.5个百分点；对100道四模型均答对问题的盲审显示虚假率为RoAR 18%、GRPO 32%、GRPO-CARE 27%、DRA-GRPO 37%。
AI.conclusion: 利用rollout差异引导学习时，推理有效性是关键考量；仅凭答案正确不足以衡量推理质量，奖励轨迹间一致性可有效提升推理保真度与性能。

title: Omni-InteractScope: Benchmarking Proactive and Agentic Interaction in Continuous Omnimodal Streams
summary: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) are increasingly expected to assist users while observing continuous audiovisual streams. However, existing evaluations provide limited insight into how reliably these models connect stream evidence and user needs to timely, sustained interventions. We introduce \textbf{Omni-InteractScope}, a benchmark of 1,479 human-annotated, cross-reviewed interactions with 1,790 temporal targets across eight task groups. It links input modalities, event triggers, intervention types, and user needs, covering event-timed tool invocation and query-free assistance alongside notifications, warnings, state tracking, and continuous responses. Our experimental results on the proposed benchmark reveal three critical limitations of current Omni-LLMs: (1) \textbf{Timely tool invocation remains unreliable}: all 12 evaluated models produce an on-time first response for at most 40\% of tool-invocation targets, and joint timing-and-tool accuracy reaches at most 32.0\%. (2) \textbf{Query-free reminders remain poorly covered}: all evaluated models achieve lower timely reference-target recall on query-free reminders than on explicit questions, measured on their respective target sets. Reminder recall never exceeds 23.0\%. (3) \textbf{End-to-end guidance coverage remains limited}: nine models cover none of the 26 guidance sequences in full, and the remaining three cover only one to three sequences each. Targeted controls further show that tool-invocation scores alone do not establish event grounding and that reminder coverage depends on response history and frequency. These findings motivate developing and evaluating streaming assistants for timely action, initiative under general user needs, and coverage of entire response sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出 Omni-InteractScope 基准，用 1,479 条人工标注交互、1,790 个时间目标、8 类任务评估全模态大模型在连续音视频流中的及时工具调用、无查询主动提醒与端到端引导覆盖，揭示当前模型三大关键缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有评测难以反映 Omni-LLM 在连续音视频流中能否可靠地将流内证据与用户需求关联，并做出及时、持续、主动的干预；需要面向“流式助手”行为的新评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 Omni-InteractScope：1,479 条人机标注、交叉复核的交互，覆盖 8 类任务组、1,790 个时间目标；将输入模态、事件触发、干预类型与用户需求显式关联，涵盖事件定时工具调用与无查询辅助，以及通知、警告、状态跟踪与连续响应；并对 12 个模型做实验，辅以针对性对照分析。
AI.result: (1) 及时性差：12 个模型对工具调用目标按时首次响应最高仅 40%，时序-工具联合准确率最高 32.0%；(2) 无查询提醒召回低：均低于显式提问场景，召回不超过 23.0%；(3) 端到端覆盖不足：26 条引导序列中 9 个模型零覆盖，其余 3 个各仅覆盖 1–3 条。对照实验表明单独工具调用分数不能证明事件定位能力，提醒覆盖依赖响应历史与频率。
AI.conclusion: 当前 Omni-LLM 在流式场景中的及时行动、面向泛化用户需求的主动性以及完整响应序列覆盖三方面仍显不足；未来流式助手的研究与评测应围绕这三点展开。

title: Beyond feature attribution: Recovering latent interaction structures in machine learning models via localized CBFI
summary: Background: Understanding individual predictions in complex tabular models remains challenging, as existing additive frameworks like SHAP and LIME often obscure structural logic by absorbing nonlinear interactions into individual feature scores. Exposing these latent interaction structures is essential for automated auditing in high-stakes environments where understanding the logic of model behavior is as essential as predictive accuracy. Methods: To address this limitation, we introduce the localized case-based feature importance (CBFI) framework. Unlike traditional numerical attribution, our method decomposes instance-specific predictions into structurally distinct components, effectively separating independent main effects (G1) from pure interactions (G4) to capture explicit feature synergies and provide a principled approach for diagnosing feature combinations. Results: Comprehensive experiments on wine quality classification and medical insurance regression demonstrate that localized CBFI successfully disentangles complex interactions hidden by additive models. Furthermore, fidelity tests and synthetic ground-truth benchmarks confirm that the identified interactions correspond precisely to the nonlinear structural dependency patterns embedded in complex architectures, including gradient boosting and deep neural networks, thereby successfully shifting the explainable AI paradigm from simple numerical attribution to the recovery of interaction-driven contributions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出局部化案例特征重要度（CBFI）框架，将实例级预测分解为可结构化区分的成分，把独立主效应（G1）与纯交互项（G4）分离，从而显式暴露加性方法所掩盖的特征交互结构。
AI.motivation: SHAP、LIME 等加性归因框架会把非线性交互吸收进单个特征得分，导致复杂表格模型的结构逻辑被遮蔽；在高风险场景中，不仅需要预测精度，还需要理解模型行为逻辑以支持自动化审计，因此必须显式暴露潜在的交互结构。
AI.method: 提出 CBFI（localized case-based feature importance）框架，用基于案例的结构化分解替代传统数值归因：把实例特异性预测拆解为结构上可区分的组件，将独立主效应（G1）与纯交互（G4）分开建模，以刻画明确的特征协同关系，并为诊断特征组合提供有原则的方法。评估上采用保真度检验与合成真值基准。
AI.result: 在葡萄酒质量分类与医疗保险回归任务上，局部化 CBFI 成功拆解了加性模型所掩盖的复杂交互；保真度测试与合成真值基准表明，所识别的交互精确对应梯度提升与深度神经网络中嵌入的非线性结构依赖模式。
AI.conclusion: CBFI 将可解释 AI 的范式从简单数值归因转向交互驱动贡献的恢复，为高风险场景下的模型逻辑审计提供了可行路径。

title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
summary: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated.
